paras.en: The following are abbreviations, acronyms, and definitions of certain terms used in this prospectus:
paras.zh: 以下为本招股说明书中使用的缩写、首字母缩略词及若干术语的定义：

paras.en: - “AI” stands for artificial intelligence. AI includes GenAI, machine learning, and other artificial intelligence tools, systems, products, and related technologies.
paras.zh: - “AI”指人工智能。AI 包括 GenAI、机器学习及其他人工智能工具、系统、产品和相关技术。

paras.en: - “API” stands for Application Programming Interface. An API is a set of rules, protocols, and tools that allow different software applications to communicate and interact with each other.
paras.zh: - “API”指应用程序编程接口。API 是一组规则、协议和工具，使不同的软件应用程序能够相互通信和交互。

paras.en: - “Chassis” means the metal frame that supports and houses the components of an electronic device, including the circuits that connect the components.
paras.zh: - “Chassis（机箱）”指支撑并容纳电子设备组件的金属框架，包括连接各组件所用的电路。

paras.en: - “CPU” stands for Central Processing Unit. A CPU is the brain of a computer, responsible for executing instructions and carrying out computations. It is a complex IC that fetches, decodes, and executes instructions, typically from main memory under the control of software programs.
paras.zh: - “CPU”指中央处理器。CPU 是计算机的大脑，负责执行指令并进行计算。它是一种复杂的 IC，通常在软件程序的控制下从主存储器中取指、译码并执行指令。

paras.en: - “Customers” refers to our end customers. When the context requires, we may use “end customers,” which include hyperscalers, foundation model labs, AI-native and digital-native businesses, Fortune 500 companies, and Sovereign AI initiatives. When used in our audited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus, “customers” means parties we directly invoice for products or services.
paras.zh: - “Customers（客户）”指我们的终端客户。在语境需要时，我们可能使用“终端客户”，其包括超大规模云服务商、基础模型实验室、AI 原生和数字原生企业、财富 500 强公司以及主权 AI 计划。在本招股说明书其他部分所载经审计合并财务报表中使用时，“客户”指我们直接向其开具产品或服务发票的各方。

paras.en: - “GenAI” stands for generative AI. GenAI is a type of AI technology that can produce various types of content, including text, imagery, audio, and synthetic data.
paras.zh: - “GenAI”指生成式 AI。GenAI 是一种能够生成多种类型内容（包括文本、图像、音频和合成数据）的 AI 技术。

paras.en: - “GPU” stands for Graphics Processing Unit. GPU is a specialized IC with a high degree of parallelism used to accelerate the rendering of complex graphics onto a screen. Due to their ability to perform numerous computations simultaneously, GPUs outperform CPUs on certain tasks and are used for scientific computing and accelerating AI workloads, such as training and inference workloads of large language models.
paras.zh: - “GPU”指图形处理器。GPU 是一种具有高度并行性的专用 IC，用于加速将复杂图形渲染到屏幕上。由于能够同时执行大量计算，GPU 在某些任务上优于 CPU，并被用于科学计算以及加速 AI 工作负载，例如大语言模型的训练和推理工作负载。

paras.en: - “HBM” stands for High Bandwidth Memory. HBM is a type of computer memory designed to provide high bandwidth and low latency for GPUs, other AI accelerators, and CPUs. HBM is significantly faster and more expensive than traditional DRAM memory and is typically integrated within the IC package.
paras.zh: - “HBM”指高带宽内存。HBM 是一种计算机内存，旨在为 GPU、其他 AI 加速器和 CPU 提供高带宽和低延迟。HBM 的速度显著快于传统 DRAM 内存，且价格也显著更高，通常集成在 IC 封装内。

paras.en: - “Hyperscalers” means large technology companies that offer highly scalable cloud computing services, utilizing extensive data centers. They offer a wide range of dynamically-provisioned services, including computing infrastructure, software platforms, and, increasingly, AI model training and inferencing. These services are available on an as-needed basis, managed and scaled via software by the users.
paras.zh: - “Hyperscalers（超大规模云服务商）”指利用大规模数据中心提供高度可扩展云计算服务的大型科技公司。它们提供广泛的动态配置服务，包括计算基础设施、软件平台，以及日益增多的 AI 模型训练和推理服务。这些服务按需提供，由用户通过软件进行管理和扩展。

paras.en: - “IC” stands for an Integrated Circuit. IC is a miniaturized electronic circuit that combines multiple transistor components and other elements into a single small package. ICs are the fundamental building blocks of modern electronics, and they are used in a wide variety of applications, including computers, servers, networking equipment, smartphones, automobiles, and medical devices.
paras.zh: - “IC”指集成电路。IC 是一种微型化电子电路，将多个晶体管组件及其他元件组合到单个小型封装中。IC 是现代电子设备的基本构建模块，广泛应用于计算机、服务器、网络设备、智能手机、汽车和医疗设备等多种场景。

paras.en: - “Inference” means the process of using a trained machine learning model to make predictions or decisions based on new data. It involves applying the patterns and knowledge the model learned during training to analyze and interpret new, unseen inputs.
paras.zh: - “推理”是指使用经过训练的机器学习模型，基于新数据作出预测或决策的过程。它涉及运用模型在训练期间学到的模式与知识，来分析并解读新的、未见过的输入。

paras.en: - “IT” stands for information technology.
paras.zh: - “IT”代表信息技术。

paras.en: - “LLM” stands for Large Language Model. LLMs are a class of artificial intelligence models that are trained on vast amounts of text data to understand, interpret, and generate human-like language.
paras.zh: - “LLM”代表大语言模型。LLM 是一类人工智能模型，通过在大量文本数据上训练，以理解、解读并生成类人语言。

paras.en: - “Node,” in the context of chip manufacturing, is used as shorthand for “process node,” which refers to specific semiconductor manufacturing processes corresponding to different circuit generations and architectures, for example, 14 nanometer and 5 nanometer nodes.
paras.zh: - “节点”在芯片制造语境中用作“工艺节点”的简称，指对应不同电路世代与架构的特定半导体制造工艺，例如 14 纳米和 5 纳米节点。

paras.en: - “Rack” means an open-frame cabinet of standard dimensions used to organize and house servers, networking equipment, power supplies, and other IT hardware. A data center typically houses thousand s of racks interconnected by networking switches typically using Ethernet protocol.
paras.zh: - “机架”是指标准尺寸的开放式框架机柜，用于组织并容纳服务器、网络设备、电源及其他 IT 硬件。一个数据中心通常容纳数千个机架，这些机架通过网络交换机互联，通常使用以太网协议。

paras.en: - “Sovereign AI” refers to AI systems that are developed, controlled, and managed by a particular nation or established in furtherance of such nation’s public interests.
paras.zh: - “主权 AI”是指由特定国家开发、控制和管理，或为促进该国公共利益而建立的人工智能系统。

paras.en: - “SRAM” stands for Static Random-Access Memory. SRAM is a type of memory that stores data within transistors so long as power is being supplied. Compared to DRAM (Dynamic Random-Access Memory), another common type of RAM used in computers, SRAM is faster and consumes less power during active use. However, it is more expensive and takes up more space than DRAM due to its complex architecture. SRAM is often used on-chip in processors for cache memory because of its speed and efficiency, providing quick access to frequently used data.
paras.zh: - “SRAM”代表静态随机存取存储器。SRAM 是一种在供电期间将数据存储在晶体管内的存储器。与计算机中另一种常用 RAM——DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）相比，SRAM 速度更快，且在活跃使用期间功耗更低。然而，由于其架构复杂，它比 DRAM 更昂贵且占用更多空间。由于其速度和效率，SRAM 常被用于处理器片上作为缓存存储器，可快速访问频繁使用的数据。

paras.en: - “Tape-out” is the final phase of the chip design process for integrated circuits, where the completed design is released to manufacturing.
paras.zh: - “流片”是集成电路芯片设计流程的最后阶段，即完成的设计被交付制造。

paras.en: - “Training” refers to the process of teaching an artificial intelligence model to make accurate predictions or decisions by feeding it large amounts of data and adjusting its internal parameters based on identified patterns. During training, the AI model uses algorithms to learn from the input data, iteratively refining its accuracy by adapting its behavior to minimize errors.
paras.zh: - “训练”是指通过向人工智能模型输入大量数据，并基于识别出的模式调整其内部参数，教会模型作出准确预测或决策的过程。在训练期间，AI 模型使用算法从输入数据中学习，通过调整其行为以最小化误差，迭代地提升其准确性。

paras.en: - “Wafer” means a thin slice of a semiconductor material, typically made of silicon, upon which integrated circuits are fabricated. Wafers serve as the foundation for the production of electronic components, including microchips and microprocessors.
paras.zh: - “晶圆”是指一片薄薄的半导体材料，通常由硅制成，集成电路即在其上制造。晶圆是包括微芯片和微处理器在内的电子元件生产的基础。

paras.en: This summary highlights selected information contained elsewhere in this prospectus. This summary does not contain all of the information that you should consider before deciding to invest in our Class A common stock. You should read this entire prospectus carefully, including the sections titled “Risk Factors,” “Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” and “Business,” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this prospectus before making an investment decision.
paras.zh: 本摘要重点介绍本招股说明书其他部分所载的部分信息。本摘要并不包含您在决定投资我们的 A 类普通股之前应考虑的全部信息。在作出投资决定之前，您应仔细阅读本招股说明书全文，包括标题为“风险因素”“关于前瞻性陈述的特别说明”“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析”和“业务”的章节，以及本招股说明书其他部分所载我们的合并财务报表及相关附注。

paras.en: We are building the fastest AI infrastructure in the world.
paras.zh: 我们正在打造世界上最快的人工智能基础设施。

paras.en: In AI, speed is critical to win. Speed improves user engagement, expands product capabilities, can lower operating costs, and opens new markets. It shortens iteration cycles for engineers, researchers, and professionals across industries, allowing them to be more productive. Speed unlocks new applications and new industries.
paras.zh: 在人工智能领域，速度是取胜的关键。速度能提升用户参与度、扩展产品能力、降低运营成本，并开辟新的市场。它缩短了各行业工程师、研究人员和专业人士的迭代周期，使他们能够更高效地工作。速度释放新的应用和新的行业。

paras.en: In technology, “speed unlocking value” is a pattern that has repeated itself over the past 30 years. Faster solutions are used more often and for more demanding tasks. For example, the speed of broadband transformed the internet from static pages into real-time applications, enabling new products and industries. Similarly, in search, Google showed that even short delays in delivering answers significantly reduced usage and engagement.
paras.zh: 在技术领域，“速度释放价值”是过去 30 年来不断重复的模式。更快的解决方案被更频繁地使用，并用于要求更高的任务。例如，宽带的速度将互联网从静态页面转变为实时应用，催生了新产品和新行业。同样，在搜索领域，谷歌表明，即使交付答案出现短暂延迟，也会显著降低使用量和用户参与度。

paras.en: AI repeats this pattern. As AI has moved from novelty to necessity, AI work has grown more demanding, and speed has become a bottleneck. Faster AI does more work in less time, providing better answers sooner.
paras.zh: 人工智能重复了这一模式。随着人工智能从新奇事物变为必需品，人工智能工作变得要求更高，速度已成为瓶颈。更快的人工智能在更短时间内完成更多工作，更快地提供更好的答案。

paras.en: Our solutions are built for speed. Cerebras Inference delivers answers up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models. Similarly, many customers have achieved more than 10 times faster training time-to-solution compared to leading GPU systems of the same generation.
paras.zh: 我们的解决方案专为速度而构建。根据领先开源模型的基准测试，Cerebras Inference 交付答案的速度比领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案快达 15 倍。同样，许多客户相比同代领先的 GPU 系统，实现了超过 10 倍的训练问题解决时间提速。

paras.en: These performance breakthroughs are the result of our core innovation: the world’s first and only commercialized wafer-scale processor. Called the Wafer-Scale Engine (“WSE”), our processor is 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip and has 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which contains two individual chips. To build the WSE, we solved the 75-year-old compute industry problem of wafer-scale integration to produce, yield, power, and cool a chip of this size. This size is what enables our incredible AI speeds. By bringing massive compute and memory onto a single piece of silicon and integrating it into a purpose-built system and software stack, we deliver exceptional AI speed for customers on premises and via the cloud.
paras.zh: 这些性能突破源于我们的核心创新：世界上首个也是唯一一个商业化的晶圆级处理器。我们的处理器名为晶圆级引擎（“WSE”），其尺寸是 NVIDIA B200 芯片的 58 倍，内存带宽是包含两个独立芯片的 NVIDIA B200 封装的 2,625 倍。为构建 WSE，我们解决了计算行业存在 75 年之久的晶圆级集成问题，实现了如此尺寸芯片的生产、良率、供电和散热。正是这一尺寸成就了我们惊人的 AI 速度。通过将大规模算力和内存集成到单块硅片上，并将其整合到专为特定目的构建的系统和软件栈中，我们为本地部署和云端客户提供卓越的 AI 速度。

paras.en: Our strategic partners and customers include hyperscalers, foundation model labs, AI-native and digital-native businesses, enterprises, and Sovereign AI initiatives. OpenAI, the world’s leading foundation model lab, selected us to be its fast inference solution. With Cerebras, OpenAI’s Codex-Spark users turn ideas into working software in seconds. Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), the world’s leading hyperscale cloud, has signed a binding term sheet with us to become the first hyperscaler to deploy Cerebras in its own data centers, providing massive distribution to a broad base of enterprise customers. Our customers use Cerebras solutions to run applications that demand speed, scale, and intelligence. This work includes training and serving large frontier models with near-instant responses, processing massive datasets in real time, and generating full-stack applications in a single step. Once customers adopt fast inference, user expectations for interactivity rise, and engineering teams shift from latency optimizations to other work, making it difficult to return to slower inference.
paras.zh: 我们的战略合作伙伴和客户包括超大规模云服务商、基础模型实验室、AI 原生和数字原生企业、大型企业以及主权 AI 计划。全球领先的基础模型实验室 OpenAI 选择我们作为其快速推理解决方案。借助 Cerebras，OpenAI 的 Codex-Spark 用户可在数秒内将想法转化为可运行的软件。全球领先的超大规模云服务商 Amazon Web Services（“AWS”）已与我们签署具有约束力的条款清单，将成为首家在其自有数据中心部署 Cerebras 的超大规模云服务商，为广泛的企业客户群体提供大规模分销渠道。我们的客户使用 Cerebras 解决方案运行对速度、规模和智能有要求的应用。这些工作包括以近乎即时的响应训练和服务大型前沿模型、实时处理海量数据集，以及一步生成全栈应用。一旦客户采用快速推理，用户对交互性的期望便会提升，工程团队也会从延迟优化转向其他工作，从而难以再回到较慢的推理。

paras.en: We deliver our solutions to customers in several different ways. Organizations that require full data and infrastructure control can purchase Cerebras AI supercomputers for on-premises deployments. Customers seeking cloud flexibility can access Cerebras compute through consumption-based models on Cerebras Cloud or through partner clouds. For example, our high-speed inference services are available through partners, including AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Marketplace, IBM watsonx Model Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, and Hugging Face, enabling seamless adoption within existing workflows.
paras.zh: 我们通过多种不同方式向客户交付解决方案。需要完全掌控数据和基础设施的组织可以购买 Cerebras AI 超级计算机进行本地部署。寻求云灵活性的客户可以通过 Cerebras Cloud 上基于用量的模式或通过合作伙伴云获取 Cerebras 算力。例如，我们的高速推理服务可通过合作伙伴获取，包括 AWS Marketplace、Microsoft Marketplace、IBM watsonx Model Gateway、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenRouter 和 Hugging Face，从而能够在现有工作流中无缝采用。

paras.en: Our ability to deliver differentiated performance has made us a strategic partner to many of our largest customers. Beyond providing compute infrastructure, we provide AI services to our customers to co-develop solutions to address their most complex challenges, from training state-of-the-art models to optimizing deployments for each application’s needs. These partnerships have expanded over time; notably, our top ten customers by year-to-date revenue through December 31, 2025 increased their aggregate spend with us by approximately 80% within 12 months of their initial purchase, often including contracts for co-development.
paras.zh: 我们提供差异化性能的能力使我们成为许多最大客户的战略合作伙伴。除提供算力基础设施外，我们还向客户提供 AI 服务，共同开发解决方案以应对其最复杂的挑战，从训练最先进的模型到针对每个应用的需求优化部署。这些合作关系随时间不断扩大；值得注意的是，按截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年初至今收入计算，我们的前十大客户在首次购买后的 12 个月内将其与我们的总支出增加了约 80%，其中通常包括共同开发合同。

paras.en: AI is one of the fastest growing technologies in history. We believe that our high-speed AI solutions give us a meaningful competitive advantage in this market. We believe that further adoption of AI, accelerated by increased penetration, more frequent usage, and more complex applications, will continue to rapidly expand the market. According to IDC, investments in AI solutions and services are projected to yield a global cumulative impact of $22.3 trillion by 2030, representing approximately 3.7% of the global gross domestic product (“GDP”). The combined market for AI training infrastructure and our addressable market within AI inference is estimated to be $251 billion in 2025 and is expected to grow to $672 billion by 2029—a 28% CAGR, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. This estimate indicates that AI inference will grow more than twice as fast as AI training infrastructure through 2029. With the fastest inference platform on the market, as benchmarked by Artificial Analysis, and a proven track record in large-scale training, we believe we are well-positioned to capture growth across both parts of the AI infrastructure market.
paras.zh: AI 是历史上增长最快的技术之一。我们相信，我们的高速 AI 解决方案使我们在这一市场中拥有显著的竞争优势。我们相信，随着渗透率提升、使用频率增加以及应用日益复杂，AI 的进一步普及将加速，并持续快速扩大市场。根据 IDC，到 2030 年，AI 解决方案和服务方面的投资预计将在全球产生 22.3 万亿美元的累计影响，约占全球国内生产总值（“GDP”）的 3.7%。根据 Bloomberg Intelligence，AI 训练基础设施市场与我们在 AI 推理领域的可服务市场合计，2025 年估计为 2510 亿美元，预计到 2029 年将增长至 6720 亿美元——复合年增长率（CAGR）为 28%。这一估计表明，到 2029 年，AI 推理的增长速度将超过 AI 训练基础设施的两倍以上。凭借以 Artificial Analysis 为基准的市场上最快的推理平台，以及在大规模训练方面经过验证的过往业绩，我们相信我们处于有利地位，能够把握 AI 基础设施市场这两个部分的增长机遇。

paras.en: Our growth reflects the broader acceleration of AI adoption. Our revenue increased from $24.6 million in 2022 to $78.7 million in 2023 and to $290.3 million in 2024, representing a more than tenfold increase over three years. Our revenue increased to $510.0 million in 2025, representing year-over-year growth of 76%. We earned net income of $237.8 million in 2025 and incurred net loss of $481.6 million in 2024. We incurred non-GAAP net loss of $75.7 million in 2025 and $21.8 million in 2024, after excluding the impact of stock-based compensation expense and change in fair value (extinguishment) of forward contract liability from our GAAP net income (loss). For more information and for a reconciliation of non-GAAP net loss to net income (loss), see the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Non-GAAP Financial Measures.”
paras.zh: 我们的增长反映了 AI 应用的更广泛加速。我们的收入从 2022 年的 $24.6 million 增至 2023 年的 $78.7 million，并进一步增至 2024 年的 $290.3 million，三年间增长超过十倍。我们的收入在 2025 年增至 $510.0 million，同比增长 76%。我们在 2025 年实现净利润 $237.8 million，并在 2024 年产生净亏损 $481.6 million。在从我们的 GAAP 净利润（亏损）中剔除股权激励费用以及远期合同负债公允价值变动（清偿）的影响后，我们在 2025 年和 2024 年分别产生非 GAAP 净亏损 $75.7 million 和 $21.8 million。有关更多信息以及非 GAAP 净亏损与净利润（亏损）的对账，请参见标题为“管理层对财务状况和经营成果的讨论与分析——非 GAAP 财务指标”的章节。

paras.en: #### AI is the Next Technological Shift
paras.zh: #### AI 是下一次技术变革

paras.en: Over the past 50 years, the compute industry has undergone a series of secular shifts, each of which expanded access to compute and transformed global productivity. We believe AI represents the next major technological shift —one with the potential to exceed the transformational impact of prior cycles.
paras.zh: 过去 50 年间，算力行业经历了一系列长期性变革，每一次都扩大了算力的可及性并重塑了全球生产力。我们相信，AI 代表着下一次重大技术变革——其变革性影响有可能超越此前各轮周期。

paras.en: According to Pew Research Center, as of June 2025, around 62% of U.S. adults interacted with AI at least several times a week, with 31% doing so almost constantly (at least several times a day), and one-third of U.S. adults under 30 saying they interacted with AI several times a day. Additionally, the Digital Education Council found in 2024 that 86% of higher-education students used AI. According to a McKinsey survey in 2025, the share of respondents saying their organizations are using AI in at least one business function has increased since their research last year: 88% reported regular AI use in at least one business function in 2025 compared with 78% a year ago. In the third quarter of 2025, Gallup reported daily use of AI in the workplace had more than doubled in the past 12 months, with 10% of U.S. employees reporting they used AI in their daily roles.
paras.zh: 根据皮尤研究中心的数据，截至 2025 年 6 月，约 62% 的美国成年人至少每周数次使用 AI，其中 31% 几乎持续使用（每天至少数次），而 30 岁以下的美国成年人中有三分之一表示他们每天数次使用 AI。此外，数字教育委员会在 2024 年发现，86% 的高等教育学生使用 AI。根据麦肯锡 2025 年的一项调查，表示其组织在至少一项业务职能中使用 AI 的受访者比例较其去年研究有所上升：2025 年有 88% 的受访者报告在至少一项业务职能中定期使用 AI，而一年前为 78%。2025 年第三季度，盖洛普报告称工作场所中 AI 的日常使用在过去 12 个月内增长了一倍以上，10% 的美国员工表示他们在日常工作中使用 AI。

paras.en: The strong rate of AI adoption is driven by the simple fact that AI has transitioned from novelty to necessity and is now used across consumer and enterprise domains. Individuals and organizations rely on AI to solve problems, build products, accelerate research, improve patient outcomes, enhance decision-making, streamline operations, enable innovation, and deliver personalized experiences.
paras.zh: AI 采用率的强劲增长源于一个简单的事实：AI 已从新奇事物转变为必需品，如今在消费者和企业领域得到广泛应用。个人和组织依赖 AI 来解决问题、构建产品、加速研究、改善患者治疗结果、增强决策、简化运营、推动创新并提供个性化体验。

paras.en: The rise of AI depends on massive computational resources. This is where Cerebras fits in.
paras.zh: AI 的崛起依赖于大规模的计算资源。这正是 Cerebras 的用武之地。

paras.en: **Inference is Driving the AI Compute Demand, as Frontier AI Models Grow More Capable**
paras.zh: **随着前沿 AI 模型能力不断增强，推理正在驱动 AI 算力需求**

paras.en: AI is composed of two stages: training and inference. Training is the process of creating and teaching the AI model; inference is the process of using the model to generate responses. Today, AI has entered a new era centered on inference. New techniques have emerged that make models smarter as they are being used. This approach— called “inference-time compute” or “test-time compute”—has become the dominant mode of inference.
paras.zh: AI 由两个阶段组成：训练和推理。训练是创建和教导 AI 模型的过程；推理是使用模型生成响应的过程。如今，AI 已进入以推理为中心的新时代。新的技术不断涌现，使模型在使用过程中变得更加智能。这种方法——称为“推理时算力”或“测试时算力”——已成为推理的主导模式。

paras.en: Instead of depending primarily on the trained model for accuracy, today’s frontier models—such as OpenAI’s GPT-5.4, Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7, and Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro—perform substantial computation during inference to simulate reasoning. These models effectively “think through” the problem: planning steps, checking their own work, and refining responses before delivering a final, higher-quality result. These additional steps use substantially more compute during inference, while producing more accurate answers.
paras.zh: 如今的前沿模型——例如 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.4、Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.7 和 Google 的 Gemini 3.1 Pro——不再主要依赖训练好的模型来保证准确性，而是在推理过程中执行大量计算以模拟推理。这些模型有效地“思考”问题：规划步骤、检查自身工作，并在给出最终更高质量结果之前完善响应。这些额外步骤在推理过程中使用了显著更多的算力，同时产生更准确的答案。

paras.en: These reasoning capabilities have fundamentally changed how people use AI. Inference is no longer limited to answering questions; modern AI applications now perform actions on behalf of their users. They can directly book travel itineraries, code full web applications from scratch, help customers apply for mortgages, automatically analyze legal contracts for discrepancies, process insurance claims, and more. As a result, demand for AI inference has surged alongside the adoption of these smarter reasoning models that leverage more inference-time compute.
paras.zh: 这些推理能力从根本上改变了人们使用 AI 的方式。推理不再局限于回答问题；现代 AI 应用如今能够代表用户执行操作。它们可以直接预订旅行行程、从零开始编写完整的 Web 应用程序、帮助客户申请抵押贷款、自动分析法律合同中的差异、处理保险理赔等等。因此，随着这些更智能的推理模型得到采用——它们利用更多的推理时算力——对 AI 推理的需求也随之激增。

paras.en: Ultimately, inference compute demand is driven by the compounding effect of three forces: the number of users, the frequency of use, and the compute per use. Each of these forces is growing at an extraordinary rate, producing a geometric expansion of demand for inference and its underlying compute.
paras.zh: 归根结底，推理算力需求由三股力量的复合效应驱动：用户数量、使用频率以及每次使用的算力。这三股力量均以惊人的速度增长，从而带来推理及其底层算力需求的几何级扩张。

paras.en: Reasoning during inference delivers smarter AI responses but requires significantly more compute. As models become more capable, users rely on them for increasingly ambitious tasks, further driving compute needs. Today’s workloads—including video generation, deep research, and long-form analysis—can require many orders of magnitude more compute than answering basic questions.
paras.zh: 推理过程中的推理能力可带来更智能的 AI 响应，但需要显著更多的算力。随着模型能力不断增强，用户依赖它们完成日益宏大的任务，进一步推动算力需求。当今的工作负载——包括视频生成、深度研究和长篇分析——所需的算力可能比回答基本问题高出多个数量级。

paras.en: #### Reasoning Makes Inference Speed a Necessity
paras.zh: #### 推理能力使推理速度成为必需

paras.en: Speed enables reasoning models to deliver more accurate answers faster, reducing the frustration created by forcing customers to wait for answers.
paras.zh: 速度使推理模型能够更快地给出更准确的答案，减少因迫使客户等待答案而产生的挫败感。

paras.en: Complex tasks (harder problems) are more valuable to solve but they require the reasoning system to go through a longer sequence of steps. This amplifies the benefit of speed and the penalty for being slow. Speed enables more accurate answers to harder problems in less time. Speed expands the range of tasks that AI can address, thereby broadening its addressable market.
paras.zh: 复杂任务（更难的问题）解决起来更有价值，但它们需要推理系统经历更长的步骤序列。这放大了速度带来的收益以及缓慢带来的惩罚。速度使更难的问题能够在更短时间内得到更准确的答案。速度扩大了 AI 可处理的任务范围，从而拓宽了其可触达市场。

paras.en: **Fast Inference Enables the Next Generation of AI Workloads, With Coding as a Clear Early Signal**
paras.zh: **快速推理赋能下一代 AI 工作负载，编程是明确的早期信号**

paras.en: As AI uses more compute to tackle increasingly complex problems, a fundamental challenge emerges: everyone wants a better response for complicated requests, but nobody wants to wait to get a response.
paras.zh: 随着 AI 使用更多算力来处理日益复杂的问题，一个根本性挑战浮现出来：每个人都希望复杂请求能得到更好的响应，但没有人愿意等待响应。

paras.en: We are solving this problem. Cerebras Inference delivers answers up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models. This speed advantage enables our solutions to deliver real-time performance for the most advanced reasoning models, enabling complex tasks to be completed more accurately and quickly.
paras.zh: 我们正在解决这个问题。根据领先开源模型的基准测试，Cerebras Inference 提供答案的速度最高可达领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案的 15 倍。这一速度优势使我们的解决方案能够为最先进的推理模型提供实时性能，使复杂任务能够更准确、更快速地完成。

paras.en: These dynamics are already visible in the market. Three fast-growing categories—software development, deep research systems, and voice applications—illustrate the importance of speed. For these and many other similar applications, inference speed is a necessity.
paras.zh: 这些动态已在市场中显现。三个快速增长的类别——软件开发、深度研究系统和语音应用——说明了速度的重要性。对于这些以及许多其他类似应用而言，推理速度是必需的。

paras.en: - AI-powered software development provides a clear early signal. Coding with AI is interactive and sensitive to delay. Delay impairs a developer’s train of thought, and as a result, developers are more likely to abandon tools that slow them down.
paras.zh: - AI 驱动的软件开发提供了一个明确的早期信号。使用 AI 编程具有交互性，且对延迟敏感。延迟会损害开发者的思路连贯性，因此开发者更有可能放弃那些拖慢他们速度的工具。

paras.en: AI can now write code. It reasons over large codebases and then uses the multi-step process previously described to generate, modify, and run code. Inference speed has become a primary determinant for adoption. Products such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot act as autonomous collaborators—planning, editing, and validating code across repositories in response to natural-language instructions from developers. These systems require complex, multi-step tasks, including continuous reasoning and long-context memory. Fast inference is the only way to avoid frustrating wait times.
paras.zh: AI 现在能够编写代码。它会对大型代码库进行推理，然后运用前述多步骤流程来生成、修改和运行代码。推理速度已成为决定其采用的首要因素。Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、Windsurf 和 GitHub Copilot 等产品充当自主协作者——根据开发者的自然语言指令，跨代码仓库进行规划、编辑和验证代码。这些系统需要执行复杂的多步骤任务，包括持续推理和长上下文记忆。快速推理是避免令人沮丧的等待时间的唯一途径。

paras.en: AI-native coding products barely existed in 2023. Yet they collectively generated billion s in ARR in 2025 and continue to accelerate. For example, AI coding applications like Lovable and Cursor are among some of the fastest growing developer tools in history. AI coding agents have become central to how software is written. Anthropic’s Claude Code is already at a reported annual revenue run rate of $2.5 billion as of February 2026; Claude Code’s creator said in January 2026 that he writes 100% of his code with AI. In addition, professional developers report that 42% of code is now AI-generated or assisted, according to a survey conducted by SonarSource in October 2025. By droves, software engineers are shifting from writing code to supervising fleets of AI coding agents. Faster inference means more productive engineers. Coding demonstrates a fundamental pattern in reasoning systems: wherever AI involves continuous interaction, multi-step reasoning, and sensitivity to response time, speed determines utility. Those same conditions are present across a growing set of AI applications.
paras.zh: AI 原生编程产品在 2023 年几乎还不存在。然而它们在 2025 年合计创造了数十亿美元的 ARR，并且仍在持续加速增长。例如，Lovable 和 Cursor 等 AI 编程应用是历史上增长最快的开发者工具之一。AI 编程智能体已成为软件编写方式的核心。据报道，截至 2026 年 2 月，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 年化收入运行率已达 $2.5 billion;Claude Code 的创造者于 2026 年 1 月表示，他的代码 100% 由 AI 编写。此外，根据 SonarSource 于 2025 年 10 月开展的一项调查，专业开发者报告称目前 42% 的代码由 AI 生成或辅助完成。大量软件工程师正从编写代码转向监督 AI 编程智能体集群。更快的推理意味着更高生产率的工程师。编程展示了推理系统中的一个基本模式：只要 AI 涉及持续交互、多步推理以及对响应时间的敏感性，速度就决定了其效用。这些相同的条件在越来越多的 AI 应用中同样存在。

paras.en: - Deep research systems apply similar reasoning to knowledge work, performing multi-step retrieval and synthesis across large datasets to deliver structured insights in real time. Platforms such as AlphaSense rely on real-time inference to sift through a higher volume of documents to help analysts and enterprises find answers faster.
paras.zh: - 深度研究系统将类似的推理应用于知识工作，在大型数据集上执行多步检索与综合，以实时提供结构化洞察。AlphaSense 等平台依赖实时推理来筛选更大数量的文档，帮助分析师和企业更快找到答案。

paras.en: - Voice applications include conversational agents, avatars, and digital twins from companies like Meta, Tavus, and OpenCall. Real-time performance is critical for voice: sub-second latency makes interactions feel natural and gives these systems time to call tools or retrieve data mid-conversation for richer, contextual responses.
paras.zh: - 语音应用包括来自 Meta、Tavus 和 OpenCall 等公司的对话智能体、虚拟形象和数字孪生。实时性能对语音至关重要：亚秒级延迟使交互感觉自然，并让这些系统能够在对话过程中调用工具或检索数据，从而提供更丰富、更具上下文关联的回复。

paras.en: Together, we believe these applications lead the way in the next phase of AI adoption: systems that think, act, and interact continuously, driving sustained demand for faster and more efficient compute infrastructure.
paras.zh: 我们相信，这些应用共同引领 AI 采用的下一阶段：能够持续思考、行动和交互的系统，推动对更快、更高效算力基础设施的持续需求。

paras.en: In this environment, speed directly shapes usage. Long wait times limit real-time applications, stunt the diffusion of AI capabilities, and can inhibit new markets and applications. As a result, slow systems lose users, limit capability, and stall innovation, while faster systems are used more often and for more demanding workloads.
paras.zh: 在这种环境下，速度直接塑造使用情况。漫长的等待时间限制了实时应用，阻碍了 AI 能力的扩散，并可能抑制新市场和新应用的出现。因此，缓慢的系统会流失用户、限制能力并阻碍创新，而更快的系统则被更频繁地使用，并用于要求更高的工作负载。

paras.en: We believe speed is a defining advantage in modern AI. Reasoning is intelligence, and intelligence compounds with speed. We believe the ability to deliver fast, scalable reasoning will define not only the next decade of technology, but also shape the future of how people work, create, and interact.
paras.zh: 我们相信，速度是现代 AI 的一项决定性优势。推理即智能，而智能会随速度而复合增长。我们相信，交付快速、可扩展推理的能力不仅将定义未来十年的技术，还将塑造人们工作、创造和互动的未来方式。

paras.en: We are building the fastest commercial AI infrastructure in the world. Our AI supercomputers are purpose built to make AI fast. Our full-stack hardware and software platform is designed to complete AI tasks significantly faster and more efficiently than comparable GPU-based solutions, whether deployed on premises, through the Cerebras Cloud, or via partner clouds.
paras.zh: 我们正在打造全球最快的商用 AI 基础设施。我们的 AI 超级计算机专为让 AI 运行得更快而构建。我们的全栈硬件与软件平台旨在比同类基于 GPU 的解决方案显著更快、更高效地完成 AI 任务，无论部署在本地、通过 Cerebras Cloud 还是经由合作伙伴云。

paras.en: #### 1. Hardware Platform
paras.zh: #### 1. 硬件平台

paras.en: At the core of our solution is the Cerebras WSE, the largest and fastest AI processor ever brought to market in high volumes. The WSE combines 900,000 compute cores, 44 gigabytes of on-chip memory, and 21 petabytes of memory bandwidth on the largest commercial chip ever built. The WSE-3 is 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip. The WSE has 19 times more transistors, 250 times more on-chip memory, and 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which contains two individual chips.
paras.zh: 我们解决方案的核心是 Cerebras WSE，这是迄今已实现大规模量产上市的最大、最快的 AI 处理器。WSE 在迄今已构建的最大商用芯片上集成了 900,000 个计算核心、44 GB 片上内存和 21 PB 内存带宽。WSE-3 的尺寸是 NVIDIA B200 芯片的 58 倍。相比 NVIDIA 的 B200 封装（其中包含两颗独立芯片）,WSE 的晶体管数量多 19 倍、片上内存多 250 倍、内存带宽多 2,625 倍。

paras.en: Each WSE is housed inside a Cerebras CS-3 system, our fully integrated AI compute system that includes advanced cooling, power delivery, and interconnect technology. Multiple CS-3 systems connect to form Cerebras AI supercomputers deployed on premises in customer data centers and in the cloud.
paras.zh: 每颗 WSE 均封装于一台 Cerebras CS-3 系统之中，这是我们完全集成的 AI 算力系统，包含先进的冷却、供电和互连技术。多台 CS-3 系统相互连接，组成部署于客户数据中心本地及云端的 Cerebras AI 超级计算机。

paras.en: #### 2. Co-designed Software Platform
paras.zh: #### 2. 协同设计的软件平台

paras.en: Our software platform makes wafer-scale computing simple to use. It spans the full AI life cycle—from model programming and compilation, to training and inference, to cluster orchestration.
paras.zh: 我们的软件平台让晶圆级计算变得易于使用。它覆盖完整的 AI 生命周期——从模型编程与编译，到训练与推理，再到集群编排。

paras.en: - Cerebras Compiler compiles PyTorch models directly to the WSE, eliminating the need for CUDA or distributed programming and providing an easy-to-use developer experience.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Compiler 将 PyTorch 模型直接编译至 WSE，无需 CUDA 或分布式编程，并提供易于使用的开发者体验。

paras.en: - Cerebras Inference Serving Stack delivers ultra-low-latency inference with industry-standard APIs for production use.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Inference Serving Stack 通过行业标准 API 提供超低延迟推理，可供生产环境使用。

paras.en: - Cerebras Cluster Manager orchestrates multiple CS-3 systems into one logical AI supercomputer, handling scheduling, telemetry, and health monitoring at scale.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Cluster Manager 将多台 CS-3 系统编排为一台逻辑上的 AI 超级计算机，大规模处理调度、遥测和健康监控。

paras.en: Because every layer is co-designed with our hardware, customers can scale training and inference across frontier-size models without rewriting code or managing distributed infrastructure.
paras.zh: 由于每一层都与我们的硬件协同设计，客户可以跨前沿规模的模型扩展训练和推理，而无需重写代码或管理分布式基础设施。

paras.en: #### 3. Flexible Deployment Models
paras.zh: #### 3. 灵活的部署模式

paras.en: Our technology is designed to be delivered in the form that best accelerates a customer’s AI roadmap. Our platform is designed for flexibility—meeting organizations where they are, and scaling with them as their ambitions grow.
paras.zh: 我们的技术旨在以最能加速客户 AI 路线图的形式交付。我们的平台在设计上注重灵活性——在组织所处的位置与其对接，并随着其雄心增长而共同扩展。

paras.en: - Cerebras Cloud: Provides high-performance AI compute through a simple API, allowing customers to serve open-source, fine-tuned, or proprietary models with production-grade reliability.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Cloud：通过简单的 API 提供高性能 AI 算力，使客户能够以生产级可靠性部署开源模型、微调模型或专有模型。

paras.en: - Partner Clouds: Offer seamless access to Cerebras systems through leading cloud providers including AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Marketplace, IBM watsonx Model Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, and Hugging Face, extending our reach across the global AI ecosystem.
paras.zh: - 合作伙伴云：通过领先的云服务商提供对 Cerebras 系统的无缝访问，包括 AWS Marketplace、Microsoft Marketplace、IBM watsonx Model Gateway、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenRouter 和 Hugging Face，从而在全球 AI 生态系统中拓展我们的覆盖范围。

paras.en: - On-Premises Deployments: Deliver fully integrated AI supercomputers and install them directly in customer environments, giving enterprises, Sovereign AI initiatives, national laboratories, and defense organizations complete control over data, performance, and operations. We also operate and manage large clusters of AI supercomputers for some of our customers.
paras.zh: - 本地部署：交付完全集成的 AI 超级计算机并直接安装到客户环境中，使企业、主权 AI 计划、国家实验室和国防组织能够完全掌控数据、性能和运营。我们还为部分客户运营和管理大型 AI 超级计算机集群。

paras.en: - Hybrid Deployments: Enable customers to move fluidly between on-premises and cloud environments through a unified software stack, maintaining consistent performance and workflows as they scale.
paras.zh: - 混合部署：通过统一的软件栈，使客户能够在本地和云环境之间灵活迁移，在扩展过程中保持一致的性能和工作流程。

paras.en: Customers choose the consumption model that fits their needs—buying inference by the token, running training workloads by the week or month, reserving dedicated capacity for long-term production deployments, or purchasing on-premises infrastructure.
paras.zh: 客户可选择契合自身需求的消费模式——按 token 购买推理服务、按周或按月运行训练工作负载、为长期生产部署预留专用容量，或购买本地基础设施。

paras.en: #### 4. AI Model Services
paras.zh: #### 4. AI 模型服务

paras.en: Our AI experts accelerate customers’ ability to take AI applications from concept to production. With deep experience training and deploying frontier-scale models across modalities, our team helps customers select model architectures, prepare large-scale training data, and train and fine-tune models for production. We also design optimized deployments for customers—training draft or speculative decoding models and tuning configurations to balance latency, throughput, and cost for each application.
paras.zh: 我们的 AI 专家帮助客户加速将 AI 应用从概念推向生产。凭借跨多种模态训练和部署前沿规模模型的深厚经验，我们的团队帮助客户选择模型架构、准备大规模训练数据，并为生产训练和微调模型。我们还为客户设计优化的部署方案——训练草稿模型或投机解码模型，并调整配置，以针对每个应用在延迟、吞吐量和成本之间取得平衡。

paras.en: #### What This Means for Customers
paras.zh: #### 这对客户意味着什么

paras.en: Our customers, which include hyperscalers, foundation model labs, AI-native and digital-native businesses, enterprises, and leaders of Sovereign AI initiatives, complete tasks dramatically faster than on GPU-based systems. Faster reasoning improves user experience, increases engagement, accelerates iteration, and enables new classes of AI applications. This speed advantage compounds in production environments, where reduced latency and shorter training cycles have meaningful business impact.
paras.zh: 我们的客户包括超大规模云服务商、基础模型实验室、AI 原生和数字原生企业、大型企业以及主权 AI 计划的领导者，他们完成任务的速度远快于基于 GPU 的系统。更快的推理可改善用户体验、提升参与度、加速迭代，并催生新类别的 AI 应用。这一速度优势在生产环境中会进一步放大，因为降低的延迟和更短的训练周期会带来切实的业务影响。

paras.en: Through our full-stack AI offerings, we deliver tangible improvements across four key dimensions that define AI value in the real world: speed, quality, cost, and simplicity.
paras.zh: 通过我们的全栈 AI 产品，我们在定义 AI 现实价值的四个关键维度上实现切实提升：速度、质量、成本和简便性。

paras.en: #### 1. Speed: Real-Time Reasoning Unlocks New Benefits From AI
paras.zh: #### 1. 速度：实时推理释放 AI 的新价值

paras.en: Our systems achieve dramatically faster inference than GPU clusters, enabling applications such as real-time coding agents, nearly instant deep research, and digital twins that were previously impractical or impossible. Customers describe the leap in inference speed as akin to going from dial-up to broadband—an advancement that redefines what AI can do.
paras.zh: 我们的系统推理速度远快于 GPU 集群，使实时编程智能体、近乎即时的深度研究以及此前不切实际或不可能实现的数字孪生等应用成为可能。客户将推理速度的跃升形容为从拨号上网到宽带的跨越——这一进步重新定义了 AI 的能力边界。

paras.en: New classes of products that customers have built and use daily with Cerebras include:
paras.zh: 客户基于 Cerebras 构建并日常使用的新品类产品包括：

paras.en: - Real-time coding agents: Copilots that read, write, and debug code nearly instantly—turning AI into an interactive programming partner.
paras.zh: - 实时编程智能体：几乎即时读取、编写和调试代码的编程助手——将 AI 变为交互式编程伙伴。

paras.en: - Nearly instant deep research agents: Systems that analyze thousand s of documents in seconds, accelerating market, scientific, and policy research.
paras.zh: - 近乎即时的深度研究智能体：数秒内分析数千份文档的系统，加速市场、科学和政策研究。

paras.en: - Digital twins: Lifelike AI personas that think, speak, and react in real time. With Cerebras, avatars respond without awkward delays, and carry conversations that are more natural and interactive.
paras.zh: - 数字孪生：实时思考、说话和反应的逼真 AI 形象。借助 Cerebras，虚拟形象响应时没有尴尬的延迟，对话更加自然和具有互动性。

paras.en: #### 2. Quality: More Accurate Responses Faster
paras.zh: #### 2. 质量：更快获得更准确的回答

paras.en: On GPUs, latency forces a tradeoff between speed and intelligence. Developers often have to limit the accuracy of a response in order to have it delivered in a reasonable amount of time. Our offerings are designed to remove this tradeoff. Our inference speed allows developers to use substantially more reasoning tokens while maintaining the same end-to-end task completion time. We turn quality from a limitation into a feature; customers can now serve some of the largest models at full strength, in nearly real time.
paras.zh: 在 GPU 上，延迟迫使人们在速度与智能之间做出取舍。开发者往往不得不限制回答的准确性，以便在合理时间内完成交付。我们的产品旨在消除这一取舍。我们的推理速度使开发者能够使用多得多的推理 token，同时保持相同的端到端任务完成时间。我们将质量从一项限制转变为一项特性；客户现在可以以完整能力、近乎实时地运行部分规模最大的模型。

paras.en: #### 3. Cost: Higher Performance at Lower Power
paras.zh: #### 3. 成本：更低功耗实现更高性能

paras.en: Moving data from one chip to another is one of the most power-intensive parts of AI compute. And power is the largest contributor to operating expenses in AI compute.
paras.zh: 将数据从一个芯片移动到另一个芯片是 AI 算力中能耗最高的环节之一。而电力是 AI 算力运营支出的最大构成部分。

paras.en: Our wafer-scale architecture keeps data on-chip, reducing data movement significantly, which in turn reduces power consumption. It also eliminates layers of costly and complex networking equipment. By way of comparison, moving a bit of data on the WSE-3 consumes a fraction of the energy required to move the same bit of data over GPU interconnects.
paras.zh: 我们的晶圆级架构将数据保留在芯片上，显著减少数据移动，进而降低功耗。它还省去了多层昂贵且复杂的网络设备。作为对比，在 WSE-3 上移动一位数据所消耗的能量，仅为通过 GPU 互连移动同样一位数据所需能量的一小部分。

paras.en: Because our performance advantages stem from fundamental architectural efficiency, we expect these benefits to endure across future generations that continue to build on our wafer-scale technology.
paras.zh: 由于我们的性能优势源于根本性的架构效率，我们预计这些优势将在未来继续基于我们的晶圆级技术构建的各代产品中得以延续。

paras.en: **4. Simplicity: One Platform; No Distributed Programming; Easy to Train and Deploy Models**
paras.zh: **4. 简洁性：单一平台；无需分布式编程；模型易于训练和部署**

paras.en: We eliminate the complexity of distributed programming across GPU clusters, which is one of the most challenging aspects of AI deployment. Even extremely large models run without code changes, and scale automatically and seamlessly across clusters of Cerebras systems. Because training, fine-tuning, and inference all occur on a unified platform, customers avoid the operational overhead of moving between different compute environments, enabling inference, fine-tuning, and training from scratch on the same cluster. Cerebras Compiler’s PyTorch integration makes model customization and compilation simple, the Inference Serving Stack enables deployment of frontier-sized models in minutes, and our AI experts support customers throughout the model life cycle to accelerate results. Cerebras’s deployment platform also allows customers to run models that were not trained on Cerebras hardware and still achieve exceptional inference performance.
paras.zh: 我们消除了跨 GPU 集群分布式编程的复杂性，而这是 AI 部署中最具挑战性的方面之一。即使是极大规模的模型也无需更改代码即可运行，并可在 Cerebras 系统集群间自动、无缝地扩展。由于训练、微调和推理均在同一统一平台上进行，客户无需承担在不同算力环境之间迁移的运营开销，从而可在同一集群上完成推理、微调和从零开始的训练。Cerebras 编译器的 PyTorch 集成使模型定制和编译变得简单，推理服务栈可在数分钟内完成前沿规模模型的部署，我们的 AI 专家在模型全生命周期内为客户提供支持以加速成果实现。Cerebras 的部署平台还允许客户运行并非在 Cerebras 硬件上训练的模型，同时仍能实现卓越的推理性能。

paras.en: #### Wafer-Scale Integration: The Foundation
paras.zh: #### 晶圆级集成：基础

paras.en: Cerebras started with a simple question: How could a new class of processors be designed with the singular goal of solving the compute challenges presented by AI? Beginning with a clean slate, how could we avoid the trade-offs made for graphics and other workloads to ensure that every transistor, every single part of the processor, was optimized for the requirements of AI?
paras.zh: Cerebras 始于一个简单的问题：如何设计一类全新的处理器，以解决 AI 带来的算力挑战为唯一目标？从零开始，我们如何避免为图形及其他工作负载所做的权衡取舍，从而确保每一个晶体管、处理器的每一个部分都针对 AI 的需求进行优化？

paras.en: Our answer is wafer-scale integration. Wafer-scale integration enabled us to use a vastly faster memory and avoid the complexity of switches and routers and associated complexity necessary to link together thousand s of GPUs.
paras.zh: 我们的答案是晶圆级集成。晶圆级集成使我们能够使用速度大幅提升的存储器，并避免交换机与路由器带来的复杂性，以及将数千个 GPU 连接在一起所必需的相应复杂性。

paras.en: SRAM is the fastest memory to date. But existing industry players could not use as much SRAM because they could not fit it on their chip. By building a chip 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip, we can maximize fast, on-chip SRAM and get the benefits of two worlds: (1) significantly more memory capacity because we built such a big chip, and (2) the benefits of the massive bandwidth provided by SRAM. Wafer scale enables us to deliver a solution with 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which is how we are able to deliver inference at extremely fast speeds.
paras.zh: SRAM 是迄今为止速度最快的存储器。但现有行业参与者无法使用同样多的 SRAM，因为他们无法将其容纳在芯片上。通过构建一个比 NVIDIA 的 B200 芯片大 58 倍的芯片，我们能够最大化快速的片上 SRAM，并获得两方面的优势：(1) 由于我们构建了如此大的芯片，存储容量显著增加；(2) 获得 SRAM 所提供的巨大带宽带来的优势。晶圆级使我们能够交付一个内存带宽比 NVIDIA 的 B200 封装高 2,625 倍的解决方案，这正是我们能够以极快速度提供推理的原因。

paras.en: The second fundamental advantage provided by wafer-scale integration is that it kept the wafer intact. Instead of building a wafer, cutting it into dozens of small GPUs, and using expensive, power-hungry switches, and complex cables to wire them back together, our solution consists of one processor that is the size of an entire silicon wafer. This reduced the need, cost, managerial complexity, and power draw of much of the networking stack required to build a GPU solution.
paras.zh: 晶圆级集成提供的第二个根本性优势在于它保持了晶圆的完整性。我们的解决方案不是先制造一片晶圆、将其切割成数十个小 GPU，再使用昂贵、高功耗的交换机和复杂的线缆将它们重新连接起来，而是由一个与整片硅晶圆尺寸相当的处理器构成。这减少了对构建 GPU 解决方案所需的大部分网络堆栈的需求、成本、管理复杂性和功耗。

paras.en: Our wafer-scale solution unifies compute and memory and communications on the same piece of silicon, eliminating the data-movement bottlenecks that slow GPU systems.
paras.zh: 我们的晶圆级解决方案将算力、存储器和通信统一在同一片硅片上，消除了拖慢 GPU 系统的数据传输瓶颈。

paras.en: #### The Underpinnings of Wafer-Scale Integration
paras.zh: #### 晶圆级集成的基础

paras.en: We solved a problem that flummoxed the compute industry for its entire history: how to build chips the size of full silicon wafers. The advantages of size were well known. But no company had ever brought a wafer-scale solution to market.
paras.zh: 我们解决了一个困扰算力行业整个历史的问题：如何构建整片硅晶圆大小的芯片。尺寸带来的优势众所周知。但此前没有任何公司曾将晶圆级解决方案推向市场。

paras.en: To make wafer-scale commercially viable, we invented and productized two foundational semiconductor technologies:
paras.zh: 为使晶圆级在商业上可行，我们发明并产品化了两个基础性半导体技术：

paras.en: - Multi-die interconnect: Traditionally, die—regions of silicon containing an integrated circuit—are individually stamped onto a silicon wafer and then cut up (“diced”) into small, separate chips. Prior to Cerebras, the largest known chip was about 840 mm2. We invented technology to interconnect these otherwise independent die together at the wafer level, at the semiconductor fabrication plant. The inter-die connectivity uses a proprietary cross-reticle connection that is integrated into our overall fabrication process. This allowed us to use existing processes to do something we believe had never been done before —namely, deliver a wafer that communicated across the entire 46,225 mm2 of silicon and therefore is a single massive processor.
paras.zh: - 多裸片互连：传统上，裸片——即包含集成电路的硅区域——被逐个压印到硅晶圆上，然后被切割（“划片”）成小型、独立的芯片。在 Cerebras 之前，已知最大的芯片约为 840 mm2。我们发明了在半导体制造厂中于晶圆层面将这些原本独立的裸片互连在一起的技术。裸片间连接采用专有的跨掩模版连接，并集成到我们的整体制造工艺中。这使我们能够利用现有工艺做到我们认为此前从未有人做到的事情——即交付一片可在整个 46,225 mm2 硅片上实现通信的晶圆，从而构成一个单一的大型处理器。

paras.en: - Fault-tolerant architecture: A primary factor in the commercial viability of a semiconductor is the yield. Flaws are present in wafers. Large chips have a higher probability of hitting such a flaw. Traditionally, chips with flaws have been thrown out or “down binned,” that is, sold as a less capable part. Thus, using traditional techniques, larger chips have lower yield and are therefore more expensive. We designed the architecture to absorb and route around defects using redundant building blocks—similar to a hyperscale data center but on the wafer. Flaws are designed to be recognized, shut down, and routed around. Redundant building blocks are used to re-form a logically functional whole. This approach had been previously used in memory manufacturing to achieve near-perfect yield, but to our knowledge, prior to Cerebras had not been used to build processors.
paras.zh: - 容错架构：半导体商业可行性的一个主要因素是良率。晶圆中存在缺陷。大芯片遇到此类缺陷的概率更高。传统上，有缺陷的芯片会被丢弃或“降级”，即作为性能较低的部件出售。因此，采用传统技术时，较大芯片的良率较低，因而成本更高。我们设计的架构使用冗余构建模块来吸收和绕过缺陷——类似于超大规模数据中心，但发生在晶圆上。缺陷被设计为可被识别、关闭并绕过。冗余构建模块用于重新构成逻辑上完整的功能整体。这种方法此前曾用于存储器制造以实现近乎完美的良率，但据我们所知，在 Cerebras 之前，尚未用于构建处理器。

paras.en: These innovations made wafer-scale computing commercially viable for the first time in semiconductor history.
paras.zh: 这些创新使晶圆级计算在半导体历史上首次具备商业可行性。

paras.en: #### The Cerebras Chip, System, and Software
paras.zh: #### Cerebras 芯片、系统与软件

paras.en: Cerebras delivers a full-stack AI infrastructure solution. It contains innovations at each layer. At the base is the Cerebras WSE, our wafer-scale processor. Each WSE is integrated into a CS-3 system with advanced power delivery, cooling, and system management. Multiple CS-3 systems link together to form Cerebras AI supercomputers that are deployed in data centers around the world.
paras.zh: Cerebras 提供全栈 AI 基础设施解决方案。它在每一层都包含创新。最底层是 Cerebras WSE，即我们的晶圆级处理器。每个 WSE 集成到一个 CS-3 系统中，配备先进的供电、冷却和系统管理。多个 CS-3 系统连接在一起，组成部署在全球数据中心的 Cerebras AI 超级计算机。

paras.en: Lightweight management and orchestration software operate these systems as one logical computer, while our training and inference platforms make it simple to run large models at scale. Because each layer is designed with the others in mind, the platform delivers consistent performance, reduced infrastructure complexity, and faster time to deployment and results.
paras.zh: 轻量级管理和编排软件将这些系统作为一个逻辑计算机运行，而我们的训练和推理平台使大规模运行大型模型变得简单。由于每一层在设计时都考虑到了其他层，该平台可提供一致的性能、降低基础设施复杂性，并加快部署和取得结果的时间。

paras.en: #### 1. The Chip: Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine
paras.zh: #### 1. 芯片：Cerebras 晶圆级引擎

paras.en: At the heart of our platform is the Cerebras WSE, the world’s largest and fastest commercialized AI processor. A single WSE replaces an entire cluster of GPUs by combining 900,000 compute cores and 44 gigabytes of on-chip memory on one piece of silicon, with 21 petabytes per second of on-chip memory bandwidth. The WSE-3 is 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip. The WSE-3 also has 19 times more transistors, 250 times more on-chip memory, and 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which contains two individual chips.
paras.zh: 我们平台的核心是 Cerebras WSE，全球最大、最快的商业化 AI 处理器。单个 WSE 通过将 900,000 个计算核心和 44 GB 片上内存集成在一块硅片上，并具备每秒 21 PB 的片上内存带宽，取代了整个 GPU 集群。WSE-3 比 NVIDIA 的 B200 芯片大 58 倍。WSE-3 的晶体管数量也比 NVIDIA 的 B200 封装（包含两个独立芯片）多 19 倍，片上内存多 250 倍，内存带宽多 2,625 倍。

paras.en: We believe our architecture solves for memory bandwidth, which is a primary bottleneck in modern AI. By keeping compute and memory on a single chip, WSE-3 eliminates the off-chip data transfers that dominate GPU latency and power consumption. As a result, our systems are faster, simpler to program, and more power-efficient than GPUs on AI tasks.
paras.zh: 我们相信我们的架构解决了内存带宽问题，这是现代 AI 的主要瓶颈。通过将计算和内存保留在单个芯片上，WSE-3 消除了主导 GPU 延迟和功耗的片外数据传输。因此，在 AI 任务上，我们的系统比 GPU 更快、更易于编程且更节能。

paras.en: #### 2. CS-3: System Innovation for Wafer-Scale Compute
paras.zh: #### 2. CS-3：面向晶圆级计算的系统创新

paras.en: The WSE-3 is deployed inside the CS-3 system, a data center-ready appliance engineered to support wafer-scale operation and integrate seamlessly into enterprise and Sovereign AI environments. The CS-3 provides the power delivery, cooling, networking, and system management required to operate a wafer-scale processor reliably and at scale. Multiple CS-3 systems can be connected to form Cerebras AI supercomputers, which function as a single logical computer for large-scale training and inference.
paras.zh: WSE-3 部署于 CS-3 系统内，CS-3 是一款面向数据中心、专为支持晶圆级运行而设计并可与企业和主权 AI 环境无缝集成的设备。CS-3 提供可靠、规模化运行晶圆级处理器所需的供电、冷却、网络和系统管理能力。多台 CS-3 系统可互联组成 Cerebras AI 超级计算机，在大型训练和推理场景中作为单一逻辑计算机运行。

paras.en: #### 3. Cerebras Software: Making Wafer-Scale Simple
paras.zh: #### 3. Cerebras 软件：让晶圆级计算变得简单

paras.en: Our software platform extends our hardware advantage by making wafer-scale computing simple to use and highly efficient. Our software spans the full AI life cycle—from programming and compiling models, to training and inference, to orchestration across large clusters. Each layer is co-designed with our hardware to deliver maximum performance with minimal developer effort.
paras.zh: 我们的软件平台使晶圆级计算易于使用且高效，从而进一步放大我们的硬件优势。我们的软件覆盖完整的 AI 生命周期——从模型编程与编译，到训练与推理，再到大规模集群的编排。每一层均与我们的硬件协同设计，以最小的开发者投入实现最高性能。

paras.en: - Model Programming and Compilation. Our Cerebras Compiler (CSoft) makes it simple to run large language models on our systems. CSoft is core to our solution and provides intuitive usability for developers. CSoft eliminates the need for low-level programming in CUDA or other hardware-specific languages. For both training and inference, our CSoft platform enables developers to easily represent and map large language models onto the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine using familiar frameworks such as PyTorch. CSoft allows machine-learning users to accelerate training and inference on models of any size, scaled across any configuration of the Cerebras AI supercomputer.
paras.zh: - 模型编程与编译。我们的 Cerebras 编译器（CSoft）使在我们的系统上运行大语言模型变得简单。CSoft 是我们解决方案的核心，为开发者提供直观的易用性。CSoft 无需使用 CUDA 或其他硬件专用语言进行底层编程。无论是训练还是推理，我们的 CSoft 平台都能让开发者使用 PyTorch 等熟悉的框架，轻松表示大语言模型并将其映射到 Cerebras 晶圆级引擎上。CSoft 使机器学习用户能够在任意规模的模型上加速训练和推理，并可跨 Cerebras AI 超级计算机的任意配置进行扩展。

paras.en: - Inference Serving Stack. Our Cerebras Inference Serving Stack manages model hosting, scaling, and request routing across Cerebras systems and clusters. It provides real-time observability and load balancing, enabling ultra-low-latency inference for production workloads. Customers can serve both open-source and proprietary models through standard APIs, including industry-standard endpoints, with consistent performance across on-premises and cloud deployments.
paras.zh: - 推理服务栈。我们的 Cerebras 推理服务栈负责跨 Cerebras 系统和集群的模型托管、扩缩容和请求路由。它提供实时可观测性和负载均衡，为生产工作负载实现超低延迟推理。客户可通过标准 API（包括行业标准端点）提供开源和专有模型服务，并在本地部署和云部署中保持一致的性能。

paras.en: - Orchestration and Life Cycle Management. Our Cerebras Cluster Manager orchestration software unifies multiple CS-3 systems into a single logical computer, managing scheduling, telemetry, and health monitoring. Built-in observability of all hardware and software components is designed to ensure reliability and high utilization across on-premises and in cloud environments. This orchestration layer also allows customers to switch seamlessly between training and inference on the same systems.
paras.zh: - 编排与生命周期管理。我们的 Cerebras 集群管理器编排软件将多台 CS-3 系统统一为单一逻辑计算机，管理调度、遥测和健康监控。对所有硬件和软件组件内置的可观测性旨在确保本地和云环境中的可靠性和高利用率。该编排层还使客户能够在同一系统上无缝切换训练和推理。

paras.en: Together, these components form a unified software platform that integrates seamlessly with our hardware to deliver a complete, end-to-end AI computing system that can be deployed on customer premises or in the cloud. Because our software and hardware are co-designed, customers can train and/or deploy frontier-scale models with consistent and simple workflows—without rewriting code or managing distributed infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些组件共同构成统一的软件平台，与我们的硬件无缝集成，交付一套完整、端到端的 AI 计算系统，可部署在客户本地或云端。由于我们的软件与硬件协同设计，客户能够以一致且简单的工作流程训练和/或部署前沿规模模型——无需重写代码或管理分布式基础设施。

paras.en: Wafer-scale integration is not a single achievement—it is a collection of technologies and processes with a multi-generation roadmap. Each successive WSE generation (from 16 nanometer to 7 nanometer and now to 5 nanometer) has delivered substantial improvements in performance, memory bandwidth, efficiency, yield, and manufacturability, without requiring changes to how developers program or deploy models.
paras.zh: 晶圆级集成并非单一成就——它是一系列技术与工艺的集合，并配有跨多代的产品路线图。每一代 WSE（从 16 纳米到 7 纳米，再到如今的 5 纳米）都在性能、内存带宽、效率、良率和可制造性方面带来了大幅提升，且无需改变开发者编写或部署模型的方式。

paras.en: Our roadmap builds on the advantages of wafer-scale integration. We intend to invest heavily in research and development to continue to expand on-chip memory and memory bandwidth, improve interconnect density, and leverage advancements in process technology to increase transistor counts and reduce power in future WSE generations. As a result, we expect that future generations of WSEs will have faster compute, and more and faster memory and communication onto and off of the wafer.
paras.zh: 我们的路线图建立在晶圆级集成的优势之上。我们打算在研发上投入大量资源，以继续扩大片上内存和内存带宽、提高互连密度，并利用工艺技术的进步来提升未来各代 WSE 的晶体管数量并降低功耗。因此，我们预计未来各代 WSE 将具备更快的算力，以及更多、更快的进出晶圆的内存与通信能力。

paras.en: The same architectural foundation also supports long-term extensibility across emerging AI workloads. As models grow in size, increase in reasoning depth, and shift toward real-time, multi-step interactions, they place even greater emphasis on memory bandwidth and locality—all areas where wafer-scale architectures possess inherent, structural advantages.
paras.zh: 同样的架构基础还支持面向新兴 AI 工作负载的长期可扩展性。随着模型规模增大、推理深度增加，并转向实时、多步骤交互，它们对内存带宽和局部性的重视程度更高——而这些正是晶圆级架构具备固有结构性优势的领域。

paras.en: We believe wafer-scale computing positions us as a leader in AI infrastructure, providing a long-term technology roadmap designed to scale with the requirements of modern and future AI systems.
paras.zh: 我们相信，晶圆级计算使我们处于 AI 基础设施领域的领先地位，并提供了一条长期技术路线图，旨在随现代及未来 AI 系统的需求而扩展。

full.sec: 1. Our culture of fearless engineering has enabled us to do pioneering engineering work; we are the
full.secZh: 1. 我们无畏工程的文化使我们能够开展开创性的工程工作；我们是

paras.en: only company ever to deliver a wafer-scale processor to market. Our culture of fearless engineering enables us to solve problems that others failed to solve or were afraid to tackle.
paras.zh: 是唯一一家将晶圆级处理器推向市场的公司。我们无畏工程的文化使我们能够解决他人未能解决或不敢应对的问题。

paras.en: 2. We have durable advantages rooted in our unique silicon architecture. We believe wafer-scale integration is a fundamental advantage in AI compute, enabling large amounts of high-speed memory and hundreds of thousand s of compute cores to reside close together on the same piece of silicon. We have now delivered three generations of wafer-scale processors at the 16, 7, and 5 nanometer nodes.
paras.zh: 2. 我们拥有植根于独特硅架构的持久优势。我们相信，晶圆级集成是 AI 算力的一项根本性优势，使大量高速内存和数十万个计算核心能够紧密地共存于同一片硅片上。我们现已交付了采用 16、7 和 5 纳米节点的三代晶圆级处理器。

paras.en: 3. We are an end-to-end systems company. From inception, we co-designed our wafer-scale engine, our CS-system, and our software stack for optimal AI performance. We were among the first in the AI community to deliver water cooling to the processor, enabling us to run colder and extend our processors’ lifetime. The co-design of processor, system, and software is a meaningful competitive advantage.
paras.zh: 3. 我们是一家端到端的系统公司。自成立之初，我们就协同设计了我们的晶圆级引擎、我们的 CS 系统和我们的软件栈，以实现最优的 AI 性能。我们是 AI 社区中最早为处理器提供水冷的公司之一，这使我们能够以更低的温度运行并延长处理器的使用寿命。处理器、系统和软件的协同设计是一项有意义的竞争优势。

paras.en: 4. We are building the fastest inference infrastructure in the world. On Cerebras infrastructure, AI responses are up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models. Speed is customer experience. Speed changes the way companies design their experiences.
paras.zh: 4. 我们正在构建世界上速度最快的推理基础设施。在 Cerebras 基础设施上，以领先的开源模型为基准，AI 响应速度最高可达领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案的 15 倍。速度就是客户体验。速度改变了企业设计其体验的方式。

paras.en: 5. We are serving some of the largest and most demanding customers in the AI market. We are engaged with customers such as OpenAI, the world’s leading foundation model lab, and AWS, the world’s leading hyperscale cloud, who have stringent requirements for performance, scale, and reliability. We offer a full-stack hardware and software platform that can be optimized for each customer’s workloads and paired with AI services in order to deploy and operate high-capacity, production-grade systems without requiring customers to manage complex infrastructure.
paras.zh: 5. 我们正在服务 AI 市场中一些规模最大、要求最严苛的客户。我们与 OpenAI——全球领先的基础模型实验室，以及 AWS——全球领先的超大规模云服务商等客户开展合作，这些客户对性能、规模和可靠性有着严格要求。我们提供全栈硬件和软件平台，可针对每位客户的工作负载进行优化，并与 AI 服务相配合，从而部署和运营高容量、生产级系统，而无需客户管理复杂的基础设施。

paras.en: 6. We operate at massive scale with more than 100 exaflops of deployed compute. In collaboration with our partners, we have trained some of the largest models in the industry, gaining unique experience and providing rare insight.
paras.zh: 6. 我们以大规模运营，已部署算力超过 100 exaflops。我们与合作伙伴携手，训练了业内一些最大的模型，获得了独特的经验并提供了罕见的洞见。

paras.en: Our business is subject to a number of risks and uncertainties of which you should be aware before making a decision to invest in our Class A common stock. These risks are more fully described in the section titled “Risk Factors.” These risks include, among others, the following:
paras.zh: 我们的业务面临多项风险和不确定性，您在决定投资我们的 A 类普通股之前应当了解这些风险和不确定性。这些风险在题为“风险因素”的章节中有更完整的描述。这些风险包括但不限于以下各项：

paras.en: - We may not sustain our growth rate, and we may not be able to manage future growth effectively.
paras.zh: - 我们可能无法维持我们的增长率，也可能无法有效管理未来的增长。

paras.en: - We have a history of generating net losses, and if we are unable to achieve adequate revenue growth while our expenses increase, we may not achieve and maintain profitability in the future.
paras.zh: - 我们历来存在净亏损，如果我们在费用增加的同时无法实现足够的收入增长，我们可能无法在未来实现并保持盈利。

paras.en: - We have a limited operating history at our current scale, and we may have difficulty evaluating our current business and accurately predicting our future revenue for the purpose of appropriately budgeting and adjusting our expenses.
paras.zh: - 我们在当前规模下的经营历史有限，我们可能难以评估当前业务并准确预测未来收入，以便适当编制预算和调整费用。

paras.en: - A substantial portion of our revenue has been, and is expected to continue to be, driven by a limited number of customers. A reduction in demand from, or a material adverse development in our relationship with any of our significant customers, including OpenAI, G42, MBZUAI, and AWS, or our failure to meet our obligations under the MRA with OpenAI, would harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: - 我们的收入中有相当大一部分一直由数量有限的客户驱动，并且预计将继续如此。来自任何重要客户（包括 OpenAI、G42、MBZUAI 和 AWS）的需求减少，或我们与这些客户的关系出现重大不利发展，或我们未能履行与 OpenAI 的 MRA 项下的义务，都将损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: - Our revenue historically has been derived from sales of our hardware systems. We are in the early stages of delivering our cloud-based offerings, the market for which is new and evolving rapidly, and which require significant data center capacity and capital investments for which we expect to require significant additional capital. There is no assurance that we will be able to sustain revenues from these efforts.
paras.zh: - 我们的收入历来来自硬件系统的销售。我们正处于提供云服务的早期阶段，该市场是新兴且快速演变的，并且需要大量数据中心容量和资本投资，我们预计将需要大量额外资本。无法保证我们能够从这些努力中持续获得收入。

paras.en: - Our cloud-based offerings are subject to certain risks and challenges. Unfavorable or uncertain conditions in the training or inference cloud market, as well as for AI infrastructure, may cause fluctuations in our results of operations.
paras.zh: - 我们的云服务面临某些风险和挑战。训练或推理云市场以及 AI 基础设施市场的不利或不确定状况，可能导致我们的经营业绩出现波动。

paras.en: - The broader adoption, use, and commercialization of AI technology, and the continued rapid pace of developments in the AI field, are inherently uncertain. If we are unable to expand the application of our products, keep up with evolving AI technology requirements, or if the new products we develop and introduce into the market are not successful, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed.
paras.zh: - AI 技术更广泛的采用、使用和商业化，以及 AI 领域持续快速的发展，本质上具有不确定性。如果我们无法扩大产品的应用范围、跟上不断演变的 AI 技术要求，或者我们开发并推向市场的新产品不成功，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。

paras.en: - The market for AI computing solutions is competitive, evolving, and requires scale, and if we do not compete effectively, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed.
paras.zh: - AI 算力解决方案市场竞争激烈、不断演变且需要规模，如果我们不能有效竞争，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。

paras.en: - We depend on third-party suppliers, including certain sole sources, and substantially all of our manufacturing services and components are procured on a purchase order basis without capacity or volume commitments, which may harm our ability to compete with larger companies, meet customer demand, satisfy customer contracts or bring products to market, and our reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: - 我们依赖第三方供应商，包括某些独家供应商，并且我们几乎所有的制造服务和组件均按采购订单采购，没有产能或数量承诺，这可能损害我们与更大公司竞争、满足客户需求、履行客户合同或将产品推向市场的能力，以及我们的声誉、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: - Our supply chain is long, complex, and global, with many interdependencies. Any significant fluctuations of supply and demand or disruption to our supply chain may harm our ability to manufacture and deliver our products to our customers.
paras.zh: - 我们的供应链漫长、复杂且遍布全球，存在诸多相互依赖关系。供需的任何重大波动或供应链中断，都可能损害我们制造产品并向客户交付产品的能力。

paras.en: - Our business and our products and services are subject to various governmental regulations, and compliance with these regulations may cause us to incur significant expense. If we fail to comply with applicable regulations, we could be subject to civil or criminal penalties.
paras.zh: - 我们的业务以及我们的产品和服务受各类政府法规约束，遵守这些法规可能导致我们产生重大费用。如果我们未能遵守适用法规，我们可能面临民事或刑事处罚。

paras.en: - Our offerings are subject to U.S. export controls and may be exported outside the United States only with the required export license or through a license exception. We cannot guarantee that we will be successful in obtaining all required licenses in the future. If we are unable to obtain licenses to export our products, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed.
paras.zh: - 我们的产品受美国出口管制约束，只有在取得所需出口许可证或通过许可例外的情况下，方可出口至美国境外。我们无法保证未来能够成功取得所有所需许可证。如果我们无法取得产品出口许可证，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。

paras.en: - We identified material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting. If we are unable to remediate these material weaknesses, or if we identify additional material weaknesses in the future or otherwise fail to maintain an effective system of internal controls, we may not be able to accurately or timely report our financial condition or results of operations, which may adversely affect investor confidence in us and, as a result, the value of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: - 我们已识别出财务报告内部控制存在重大缺陷。如果我们无法弥补这些重大缺陷，或者未来识别出更多重大缺陷，或未能以其他方式维持有效的内部控制体系，我们可能无法准确或及时报告我们的财务状况或经营业绩，这可能对投资者对我们的信心产生不利影响，并因此影响我们 A 类普通股的价值。

paras.en: - The multi-class structure of our capital stock as contained in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation has the effect of concentrating voting control with those stockholders who held our securities prior to this offering, including our executive officers, employees, and directors and their affiliates, and limiting your ability to influence corporate matters, which could adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: - 我们经修订和重述的公司章程所载的多类别股本结构，具有将投票控制权集中于本次发行前持有我们证券的股东（包括我们的高管、员工和董事及其关联方）的效果，并限制您影响公司事务的能力，这可能对我们 A 类普通股的价格产生不利影响。

paras.en: - No public market for our common stock currently exists and an active liquid market may not develop or be sustained following this offering.
paras.zh: - 我们的普通股目前不存在公开市场，且本次发行后可能不会形成或维持活跃的流通市场。

full.sec: Implications of Being an Emerging Growth Company
full.secZh: 作为新兴成长型公司的影响

paras.en: We are an emerging growth company as defined in the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act of 2012 (the “JOBS Act”). We will remain an emerging growth company until the earliest of: (i) the last day of the fiscal year following the fifth anniversary of the completion of this offering; (ii) the last day of the fiscal year in which we have total annual gross revenue of at least $1.235 billion; (iii) the last day of the fiscal year in which we are deemed to be a “large accelerated filer” as defined in Rule 12b-2 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), which would occur if the market value of our Class A common stock held by non-affiliates exceeded $700.0 million as of the last business day of the second fiscal quarter of such year; or (iv) the date on which we have issued more than $1.0 billion in non-convertible debt securities during the prior three-year period. An emerging growth company may take advantage of specified reduced reporting requirements and is relieved of certain other significant requirements that are otherwise generally applicable to public companies. As an emerging growth company:
paras.zh: 我们是一家根据 2012 年《创业企业扶助法》（“JOBS 法案”）定义的新兴成长型公司。我们将一直作为新兴成长型公司，直至以下日期中最早发生者：(i) 本次发行完成五周年之后的财年最后一日；(ii) 我们年度总营业收入至少达到 $1.235 billion 的财年最后一日；(iii) 我们被视为经修订的 1934 年《证券交易法》（“《交易法》”）第 12b-2 条规则所定义的“大型加速申报人”的财年最后一日，若该财年第二财季最后一个营业日非关联方持有的 A 类普通股市值超过 $700.0 million，即属此种情形；或 (iv) 我们在前三年期间发行非可转换债务证券超过 $1.0 billion 之日。新兴成长型公司可利用特定的简化报告要求，并豁免原本普遍适用于上市公司的某些其他重大要求。作为一家新兴成长型公司：

paras.en: - we will present in this prospectus only two years of audited annual financial statements, plus any required unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, and related management’s discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations;
paras.zh: - 我们将在本招股说明书中仅列示两年的经审计年度财务报表，以及任何所需的未经审计简明合并财务报表和相关管理层对财务状况及经营成果的讨论与分析；

paras.en: - we will avail ourselves of the exemption from the requirement to obtain an attestation and report from our independent registered public accounting firm on the assessment of our internal control over financial reporting pursuant to the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002;
paras.zh: - 我们将利用豁免，无需根据 2002 年《萨班斯-奥克斯利法》就我们对财务报告的内部控制评估取得独立注册公共会计师事务所的鉴证和报告；

paras.en: - we will provide less extensive disclosure about our executive compensation arrangements; and
paras.zh: - 我们将提供关于高管薪酬安排的较少披露；以及

paras.en: - we will not require stockholder non-binding advisory votes on executive compensation or golden parachute arrangements.
paras.zh: - 我们将无需就高管薪酬或金色降落伞安排进行股东无约束力咨询投票。

paras.en: In addition, the JOBS Act provides that an emerging growth company can take advantage of an extended transition period for complying with new or revised accounting standards. This provision allows an emerging growth company to delay the adoption of some accounting standards until those standards would otherwise apply to private companies. We have elected to use the extended transition period for any other new or revised accounting standards until the date that we are no longer an emerging growth company or affirmatively and irrevocably opt out of the extended transition period. As a result, our financial statements may not be comparable to companies that comply with new or revised accounting pronouncements as of public company effective dates.
paras.zh: 此外，JOBS 法案规定，新兴成长型公司可利用延长的过渡期来遵守新的或修订的会计准则。该规定允许新兴成长型公司推迟采用某些会计准则，直至这些准则原本适用于私营公司之时。我们已选择对任何其他新的或修订的会计准则使用延长的过渡期，直至我们不再是一家新兴成长型公司或明确且不可撤销地选择退出延长过渡期之日。因此，我们的财务报表可能无法与在上市公司生效日期起即遵守新的或修订的会计公告的公司进行比较。

paras.en: Class A common stock offered by us

Use of proceeds We estimate that we will receive net proceeds from this offering of approximately $5,408.5 million (or $6,221.4
million if the underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full), based upon the initial public offering price of $185.00 per share of Class A common stock, and after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us.
The principal purposes of this offering are to obtain additional capital to fund our operations, create a public market for our Class A common stock, facilitate our future access to the public equity markets, and increase awareness of our company among potential partners.
We currently intend to use the net proceeds from this offering, together with our existing cash, cash equivalents, and investments, for general corporate purposes, including working capital, operating expenses, and capital expenditures. We may also use a portion of the net proceeds to in-license, acquire, or invest in complementary technologies, assets, businesses, or intellectual property. We periodically evaluate strategic opportunities; however, we have no current commitments to enter into any such acquisitions or make any such investments.
We intend to use approximately $416.1 million of the net proceeds to satisfy tax withholding and remittance obligations related to the RSU Net Settlement (as defined below) for restricted stock units (“RSUs”) that will vest in connection with this offering.
We will have broad discretion in the way that we use the net proceeds of this offering. See the section titled
“Use of Proceeds” for additional information.
Voting rights common stock, Class B common stock, and Class N common stock. Each share of Class A common stock is entitled to one vote per share, each share of Class B common stock is entitled to 20 votes per share and is convertible at any time into one share of Class A common stock, and each share of Class N common stock is non-voting and is convertible into one share of
Class A common stock.
Holders of Class A common stock and Class B common stock will generally vote together as a single class, unless otherwise required by law or our amended and restated certificate of incorporation that will be in effect immediately prior to the completion of this offering.
Once this offering is completed, based on beneficial ownership as of March 31, 2026, the holders of our outstanding Class B common stock will hold approximately 85.3% of our outstanding shares and control approximately 99.2% of the voting power of our outstanding shares, and our executive officers, directors, and stockholders holding more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, together with their affiliates, will beneficially own, in the aggregate, approximately
38.1% of our outstanding shares and control approximately 50.8% of the voting power of our outstanding shares.
The holders of our outstanding Class B common stock will have the ability to control the outcome of matters submitted to our stockholders for approval, including the election of our directors and the approval of any change in control transaction.
See the sections titled “Principal Stockholders” and
“Description of Capital Stock” for additional information.

募集资金用途 我们估计，按每股 A 类普通股 185.00 美元的首次公开发行价格计算，并在扣除承销折扣和佣金以及我们应付的估计发行费用后，我们将从本次发行中获得约 5,408.5 百万美元（若承销商全额行使超额配售选择权，则为 6,221.4 百万美元）的募集资金净额。
本次发行的主要目的是获取额外资本以支持我们的运营、为我们的 A 类普通股建立公开市场、促进我们未来进入公开股权市场，并提高潜在合作伙伴对我们公司的认知度。
我们目前拟将本次发行的募集资金净额连同我们现有的现金、现金等价物及投资用于一般公司用途，包括营运资金、经营费用和资本支出。我们也可能将部分募集资金净额用于引进许可、收购或投资于互补性技术、资产、业务或知识产权。我们会定期评估战略机会；但是，我们目前并无任何进行此类收购或作出此类投资的承诺。
我们拟将约 416.1 百万美元的募集资金净额用于履行与限制性股票单位（“RSU”）的 RSU 净额结算（定义见下文）相关的代扣代缴和汇缴税款义务，该等 RSU 将因本次发行而归属。
我们将在本次发行募集资金净额的使用方式上拥有广泛的自主决定权。更多信息请参见标题为“募集资金用途”的章节。
投票权 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 N 类普通股。每股 A 类普通股享有一票投票权，每股 B 类普通股享有 20 票投票权并可随时转换为一股 A 类普通股，每股 N 类普通股无投票权并可转换为一股 A 类普通股。
A 类普通股和 B 类普通股的持有人通常将作为一个单一类别共同投票，除非法律或我们将在本次发行完成前立即生效的经修订和重述的公司章程另有要求。
本次发行完成后，基于截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的受益所有权，我们已发行 B 类普通股的持有人将持有我们已发行股份的约 85.3%，并控制我们已发行股份约 99.2%的投票权，而我们的高级管理人员、董事以及持有我们已发行股本 5%以上的股东连同其关联方，将合计实益持有我们已发行股份的约 38.1%，并控制我们已发行股份约 50.8%的投票权。
我们已发行 B 类普通股的持有人将有能力控制提交我们股东批准的事项的结果，包括选举我们的董事以及批准任何控制权变更交易。
更多信息请参见标题为“主要股东”和“股本说明”的章节。

paras.en: 1,500,000 shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus, for sale at the initial public offering price through a directed share program to certain persons identified by our management and certain long-tenured employees, which may include parties with whom we have a business relationship and friends and family of management and such employees. Any reserved shares of Class A common stock that are not so purchased will be offered by the underwriters to the general public on the same terms as the other shares of our Class A common stock offered by this prospectus. See the section titled “Underwriters—Directed Share Program” for additional information. If purchased by these persons, these shares will not be subject to lock-up restrictions, except to the extent that the purchasers of such shares are otherwise subject to lock-up agreements as a result of their relationships with us. The number of shares of Class A common stock available for sale to the general public will be reduced by the number of reserved shares sold pursuant to this program.
paras.zh: 本招股说明书发售的 1,500,000 股 A 类普通股，通过定向股份计划按首次公开发行价格向由我们管理层指定的若干人士及若干长期任职员工出售，其中可能包括与我们存在业务关系的各方以及管理层与该等员工的亲友。任何未被如此认购的预留 A 类普通股将由承销商按与本招股说明书发售的其他 A 类普通股相同的条款向公众发售。详情请参见“承销商——定向股份计划”一节。若由该等人士认购，则该等股份不受锁定期限制，但若该等股份的认购人因与我们之间的关系而另行受锁定期协议约束的除外。向公众发售的 A 类普通股数量将减去根据该计划售出的预留股份数量。

paras.en: We use certain non-GAAP financial measures to supplement the performance measures in our consolidated financial statements, which are presented in accordance with GAAP. These non-GAAP financial measures include non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss. We use these non-GAAP financial measures for financial and operational decision-making and as a means to assist us in evaluating period-to-period comparisons. By excluding certain items that may not be indicative of our recurring core operating results, we believe that non-GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP net loss provide meaningful supplemental information regarding our performance. Accordingly, we believe these non-GAAP financial measures are useful to investors and others because they allow for additional information with respect to financial measures used by management in its financial and operational decision-making and they may be used by our institutional investors and the analyst community to help them analyze the health of our business. However, there are a number of limitations related to the use of non-GAAP financial measures, and these non-GAAP measures should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for or in isolation from, our financial results prepared in accordance with GAAP. Other companies, including companies in our industry, may calculate these non-GAAP financial measures differently or not at all, which reduces their usefulness as comparative measures.
paras.zh: 我们使用某些非 GAAP 财务指标来补充我们合并财务报表中的业绩指标，该等合并财务报表按照 GAAP 列报。该等非 GAAP 财务指标包括非 GAAP 经营亏损和非 GAAP 净亏损。我们将该等非 GAAP 财务指标用于财务和经营决策，并作为协助我们评估各期间比较的手段。通过剔除某些可能无法反映我们经常性核心经营业绩的项目，我们认为非 GAAP 经营亏损和非 GAAP 净亏损提供了有关我们业绩的有意义的补充信息。因此，我们认为该等非 GAAP 财务指标对投资者和其他人士有用，因为它们提供了有关管理层在其财务和经营决策中所使用财务指标的额外信息，并且我们的机构投资者和分析师群体可能会使用该等指标来帮助他们分析我们业务的健康状况。然而，使用非 GAAP 财务指标存在若干局限性，该等非 GAAP 指标应与我们按照 GAAP 编制的财务业绩一并考虑，而不应作为其替代或孤立地看待。其他公司（包括我们行业中的公司）可能以不同方式计算该等非 GAAP 财务指标，或根本不计算该等指标，这降低了其作为比较指标的实用性。

paras.en: #### Non-GAAP Operating Loss
paras.zh: #### 非 GAAP 经营亏损

paras.en: We define non-GAAP operating loss as operating loss presented in accordance with GAAP, adjusted to exclude stock-based compensation expenses. We have presented non-GAAP operating loss because we consider non-GAAP operating loss to be a useful metric for investors and other users of our financial information in evaluating our operating performance because it excludes the impact of stock-based compensation, a non-cash charge that can vary from period to period as such variations are unrelated to our core operating performance. This metric also provides investors and other users of our financial information with an additional tool to compare business performance across companies and periods, while eliminating the effects of items that may vary for different companies for reasons unrelated to core operating performance.
paras.zh: 我们将非 GAAP 经营亏损定义为按照 GAAP 列报的经营亏损，并调整以剔除股权激励费用。我们列报非 GAAP 经营亏损，是因为我们认为非 GAAP 经营亏损对投资者和我们财务信息的其他使用者而言是一项有用的指标，可用于评估我们的经营业绩，因为它剔除了股权激励的影响，而股权激励是一项非现金费用，可能因各期间而异，因为该等变动与我们的核心经营业绩无关。该指标还为投资者和我们财务信息的其他使用者提供了一项额外工具，用于比较不同公司和不同期间的业务表现，同时消除可能因与核心经营业绩无关的原因而在不同公司之间存在差异的项目的影响。

paras.en: We monitor non-GAAP net loss for planning and performance measurement purposes. We define non-GAAP net loss as net loss reported on our consolidated statements of operations, excluding the impact of stock-based compensation expenses and change in fair value (extinguishment) of forward contract liability. We have presented non-GAAP net loss because we believe that the exclusion of these charges allows for a more relevant comparison of our results of operations to other companies in our industry and facilitates period-to-period comparisons as it eliminates the effect of certain factors unrelated to our overall operating performance. Our calculation of non-GAAP net loss does not currently include the tax effects of the stock-based compensation expense adjustment because such tax effects have not been material to date.
paras.zh: 我们出于规划和业绩衡量的目的监控非 GAAP 净亏损。我们将非 GAAP 净亏损定义为我们合并经营报表中报告的净亏损，剔除股权激励费用以及远期合同负债公允价值变动（清偿）的影响。我们列示非 GAAP 净亏损，是因为我们认为剔除这些费用能够使我们的经营业绩与同行业其他公司进行更具相关性的比较，并有助于进行期间对比，因为它消除了与我们的整体经营业绩无关的某些因素的影响。我们目前对非 GAAP 净亏损的计算未包含股权激励费用调整的税务影响，因为迄今为止该等税务影响并不重大。

In such an event, the price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material may also harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.

full.sec: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry
full.secZh: 与我们的业务和行业相关的风险

paras.en: **We may not sustain our growth rate, and we may not be able to manage future growth effectively.**
paras.zh: **我们可能无法维持增长率，也可能无法有效管理未来增长。**
