We are dependent on the availability and cooperation of our suppliers to manufacture and assemble our products, and our suppliers have not provided assurances that adequate capacity will be available to us in the future. Our suppliers, including our sole or single-sourced suppliers, may choose, for any reason or no reason, including due to a dispute or failed or stalled negotiations, to cease supplying critical components or services to us. An adverse change in any critical supplier relationship may cause us to discontinue the manufacture and deployment of our products and services, including against committed delivery dates to customers, and materially harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 我们的一些供应商在向我们交付产品和服务方面出现延迟或未能交付，原因包括所需原材料、组件和服务供应短缺或中断、物流和运输问题、争议、诉讼、禁令及其他法律程序，以及监管问题。我们依赖供应商的可用性和配合来制造和组装我们的产品，而我们的供应商并未保证未来能向我们提供充足的产能。我们的供应商（包括我们的独家或单一来源供应商）可能出于任何理由或无理由（包括因争议或谈判失败或停滞）选择停止向我们供应关键组件或服务。任何关键供应商关系的不利变化都可能导致我们停止制造和部署我们的产品和服务（包括无法按对客户的承诺交付日期交付），并对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景造成重大损害。

paras.en: If our suppliers’ operations are curtailed or disrupted, or if they discontinue their business relationship with us, we may need to seek alternate sources of supply, which may not exist. The lead time needed to identify, qualify, and establish reliable production at acceptable yields with a new supplier is typically lengthy, and there is often no readily available alternative supplier. In addition, qualifying new suppliers is often expensive, and they may not develop products or provide services as cost-effectively as our current suppliers, which could harm our ability to price our products competitively while achieving our desired margin. These shortages and disruptions may, in turn, harm our ability to manufacture and timely deliver our products to our customers, and may cause us to breach our agreements with our customers. We have also had to qualify alternative suppliers and have experienced delays in delivering our products when existing suppliers no longer supported our requirements due to changes in their business. If one or more of our suppliers no longer manufactures our products, fails to perform its obligations in a timely manner or at satisfactory quality levels, is obligated to prioritize other entities in a constrained environment, or decides to discontinue their business relationship with us, our ability to bring products to market and to timely deliver products to our customers may be harmed.
paras.zh: 如果我们的供应商运营受到限制或中断，或者如果他们终止与我们的业务关系，我们可能需要寻求替代供应来源，而替代来源可能并不存在。寻找、认证并在可接受的良率下与新供应商建立可靠生产所需的提前期通常很长，而且往往没有现成的替代供应商。此外，认证新供应商通常成本高昂，且他们开发和提供的产品或服务可能不如我们现有供应商那样具有成本效益，这可能损害我们以有竞争力的价格定价产品同时实现目标利润率的能力。这些短缺和中断反过来可能损害我们制造产品并及时向客户交付产品的能力，并可能导致我们违反与客户的协议。我们还曾不得不认证替代供应商，并在现有供应商因业务变化而不再支持我们的需求时，经历过产品交付延迟。如果一个或多个供应商不再制造我们的产品、未能及时履行其义务或未达到令人满意的质量水平、在受限环境中被要求优先考虑其他实体，或决定终止与我们的业务关系，那么我们将其产品推向市场并及时向客户交付产品的能力可能会受到损害。

paras.en: Additionally, if our component suppliers cease to, or become unable to, manufacture a component for us, we may also be forced to make a significant “lifetime” purchase of the affected component or part from an existing supplier, in order to enable us to meet our customer demand or to re-engineer a product. Significant lifetime purchases of such discontinued components could significantly increase our inventory and other expenses, such as insurance costs, and expose us to additional risks, such as the loss of, or damage to, products that may not subsequently be available to us from an alternative source. In any such circumstances, we may be unable to meet our customers’ demands and may fail to meet our contractual obligations and may need to redesign our products. This may result in the payment of significant damages by us to our customers and our revenue may decline, harming our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. We may also have excess inventory if we overestimate the “lifetime” purchase quantity, which would result in write-offs.
paras.zh: 此外，如果我们的组件供应商停止或无法为我们制造某一组件，我们可能还被迫向现有供应商进行大规模的“全生命周期”采购，购买受影响的组件或部件，以便我们能够满足客户需求或重新设计产品。对此类停产组件进行大规模的全生命周期采购，可能大幅增加我们的库存和其他费用（例如保险费用），并使我们需要承担额外风险，例如产品可能随后无法从替代来源获得而导致的损失或损坏。在任何此类情况下，我们可能无法满足客户需求，可能无法履行合同义务，并可能需要重新设计产品。这可能导致我们向客户支付巨额损害赔偿，我们的收入可能下降，从而损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。如果我们高估了“全生命周期”采购数量，我们还可能产生过剩库存，从而导致核销。

paras.en: There are certain components in our products that require long lead times to manufacture and deliver, including the wafer for our WSE. Accordingly, we must make estimates of demand well in advance of certainty of revenue and carry sufficient working capital to pay for these and other components. In addition, the yield on components, including our wafers, is variable and thus we must account for a certain amount of waste when purchasing components. If our estimates of customer demand are ultimately inaccurate, as we have experienced from time to time, there could be a significant mismatch between supply and demand. This mismatch has in the past resulted, and may in the future result, in both product shortages and excess inventory, with a corresponding impact to our results of operations. If we underestimate our customers’ future demand for our products, our suppliers may not have adequate lead-time or capacity to increase production and we may not be able to obtain sufficient inventory to fill orders on a timely basis or in a cost-effective manner. If we fail to fulfill our customers’ orders on a timely basis, or at all, our customer relationships could be damaged, we may lose revenue and market share and our reputation may be harmed. If we overestimate our customers’ future demand, we may have excess inventory with limited or no resale value, which would harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. To the extent we increase our manufacturing capacity to fulfill capacity forecasts, our working capital needs will also increase.
paras.zh: 我们产品中有某些组件（包括我们 WSE 所用的晶圆）的制造和交付需要较长的提前期。因此，我们必须在收入确定之前很早就对需求作出估计，并持有充足的营运资金来支付这些组件和其他组件的费用。此外，包括晶圆在内的组件良率存在波动，因此我们在采购组件时必须考虑一定数量的损耗。如果我们对客户需求的估计最终不准确（我们不时遇到这种情况），供需之间可能出现严重不匹配。这种不匹配在过去已经导致、未来也可能导致产品短缺和库存过剩，并对我们的经营业绩产生相应影响。如果我们低估了客户对我们产品的未来需求，我们的供应商可能没有足够的提前期或产能来增加生产，我们可能无法及时或以具有成本效益的方式获得足够的库存来满足订单。如果我们未能及时或完全履行客户订单，我们的客户关系可能受损，我们可能失去收入和市场份额，我们的声誉可能受到损害。如果我们高估了客户的未来需求，我们可能持有转售价值有限或毫无转售价值的过剩库存，这将损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。如果我们为提高产能以满足产能预测而扩大制造能力，我们的营运资金需求也将增加。

paras.en: Some of our customer agreements provide for, and future customer agreements may also require, certain remedies if we do not deliver our products and services in a timely manner or by a certain date. If our third-party suppliers do not perform services or deliver components on our expected timeline, including due to force majeure or other reasons beyond their control, we may owe damages or incur other liabilities with our customers. In addition, certain of our customers prepay for hardware purchases and are entitled to refunds of such advances in certain situations.
paras.zh: 我们的部分客户协议规定，且未来客户协议也可能要求，若我们未能及时或在特定日期前交付产品和服务，需承担某些补救措施。若我们的第三方供应商未能按预期时间表提供服务或交付组件（包括因不可抗力或其他超出其控制的原因），我们可能需向客户支付损害赔偿或承担其他责任。此外，我们的部分客户会预付硬件采购款，并在某些情况下有权要求退还该等预付款。

paras.en: Prior to our wafer-scale engine, a full wafer-sized processor had not previously been successfully manufactured and commercially deployed in high volumes. We worked with TSMC to develop the processes necessary to manufacture the semiconductor wafers needed for our wafer-scale engine, which involve many complexities and proprietary technologies. We are currently dependent on TSMC to produce all of the wafers that we use in our products. We have no formalized long-term supply or allocation commitments from TSMC, and TSMC also fabricates wafers for other companies, including certain of our competitors, many of whom are significantly larger than us and purchase considerably more wafers from TSMC than we do. TSMC could reduce or eliminate deliveries to us on short notice, or raise their prices to us, all of which may result in loss of revenue opportunities, damage our relationships with our customers, and harm our results of operations and gross margin. Many of our suppliers, including TSMC, are located in areas of high geopolitical tension, such as Taiwan and South Korea, or in areas prone to natural disasters, such as earthquakes and typhoons. Any substantial disruption in TSMC’s supply of wafers to us, or in the other contract manufacturing services that we utilize, as a result of a natural disaster, climate change, water shortages, political unrest, military conflict, geopolitical turmoil, trade tensions, inflation, government orders, global pandemics or health crises, economic instability, equipment failure, or other causes, may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 在我们的晶圆级引擎之前，全晶圆尺寸处理器从未被成功制造并实现大规模商业化部署。我们与台积电合作开发了制造晶圆级引擎所需半导体晶圆所必需的工艺，该等工艺涉及诸多复杂性和专有技术。我们目前依赖台积电生产我们产品中使用的全部晶圆。我们与台积电并无正式的长期供应或分配承诺，且台积电亦为其他公司（包括我们的某些竞争对手）代工晶圆，其中许多竞争对手的规模远大于我们，向台积电采购的晶圆数量也远多于我们。台积电可能短时间通知即减少或终止向我们供货，或提高对我们的售价，所有这些均可能导致收入机会损失、损害我们与客户的关系，并对我们的经营业绩和毛利率造成不利影响。我们的许多供应商（包括台积电）位于地缘政治紧张地区（如台湾和韩国），或位于易发生自然灾害（如地震和台风）的地区。若台积电对我们的晶圆供应或我们所使用的其他合同制造服务因自然灾害、气候变化、水资源短缺、政治动荡、军事冲突、地缘政治动荡、贸易紧张、通货膨胀、政府命令、全球大流行病或健康危机、经济不稳定、设备故障或其他原因而出现任何重大中断，均可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **Our supply chain is long, complex, and global, with many interdependencies. Any significant fluctuations of supply and demand or disruption to our supply chain may harm our ability to manufacture and deliver our products to our customers.**
paras.zh: **我们的供应链漫长、复杂且遍布全球，存在诸多相互依赖关系。供需的任何重大波动或供应链中断均可能损害我们制造产品并向客户交付产品的能力。**

paras.en: Our products depend on many different electronic components of varying complexity and raw materials, as well as software tools for the design of our products. Accordingly, our supply chain is dependent on many aspects of the global semiconductor industry, which is highly cyclical and subject to wide fluctuations of supply and demand as a result of rapid technological change, rapid product obsolescence and price erosion, evolving standards, and frequent new product introductions, among other reasons. The industry has experienced significant downturns during recent global recessions, characterized by diminished product demand, production overcapacity, and high inventory levels. Any upturn in the semiconductor industry could result in increased competition for access to suppliers. Additionally, the impact of industry-wide trends on specific segments and suppliers is difficult to predict.
paras.zh: 我们的产品依赖于许多不同复杂程度的电子元件和原材料，以及用于产品设计的软件工具。因此，我们的供应链依赖于全球半导体行业的诸多方面，该行业具有高度周期性，并因快速的技术变革、产品的快速过时和价格侵蚀、不断演变的标准以及频繁的新产品推出等原因而出现供需的大幅波动。在近期的全球经济衰退期间，该行业经历了显著的低迷，其特征是产品需求减少、产能过剩和库存水平高企。半导体行业的任何好转都可能导致对供应商资源的竞争加剧。此外，行业整体趋势对特定细分领域和供应商的影响难以预测。

paras.en: Our products have long and complex bills of materials, with several long lead time components and single-source suppliers for certain critical components. For example, TSMC fabricates all of our wafers, and switching to a different foundry would require development of new proprietary processes and technologies, which may be expensive and increase production time. Some of our suppliers are small and are unable to accommodate fluctuations in required capacity. In other cases, our requirements represent a small portion of a supplier’s business, and therefore we may not be a priority for such supplier.
paras.zh: 我们产品的物料清单冗长且复杂，包含若干交货周期较长的组件，某些关键组件依赖单一来源供应商。例如，台积电制造我们的全部晶圆，而更换为其他代工厂将需要开发新的专有工艺和技术，这可能成本高昂并延长生产时间。我们的一些供应商规模较小，无法适应所需产能的波动。在其他情况下，我们的需求仅占供应商业务的一小部分，因此我们可能不是此类供应商的优先客户。

paras.en: Our supply chain is also subject to complex and frequently changing rules and regulations regarding global trade, such as imports, exports, tariffs, and taxes, as well as the effects of U.S. and foreign government programs and initiatives regarding the semiconductor supply chain and other geopolitical forces. For example, both the United States and China have national programs directed toward influencing the future of the global semiconductor industry, and the effects of such programs on our business are not easily predictable.
paras.zh: 我们的供应链还受到有关全球贸易（如进口、出口、关税和税收）的复杂且频繁变化的规则和法规的约束，同时也受到美国和外国政府针对半导体供应链的项目和举措以及其他地缘政治力量的影响。例如，美国和中国都设有旨在影响全球半导体行业未来的国家项目，而此类项目对我们业务的影响不易预测。

paras.en: Further, force majeure and other events beyond our and our suppliers’ control, such as the COVID-19 pandemic and natural disasters such as earthquakes in Taiwan, have in the past and may in the future result in disruption to parts of our supply chain, including difficulty procuring wafers and other necessary components in a timely fashion, with suppliers increasing lead times or placing products on allocation, requiring committed, non-cancelable purchases and raised prices. Such events may excuse performance of certain suppliers but not excuse our performance to our customers, which may cause us to incur liabilities.
paras.zh: 此外，不可抗力以及我们和供应商无法控制的其他事件，例如 COVID-19 疫情和台湾地震等自然灾害，过去曾导致并未来可能继续导致我们部分供应链中断，包括难以及时采购晶圆和其他必要组件，供应商延长交货周期或将产品置于配给供应状态，要求承诺不可取消的采购并提高价格。此类事件可能免除某些供应商的履约义务，但不免除我们对客户的履约义务，这可能导致我们承担赔偿责任。

paras.en: Transportation disruptions, such as shortages in available cargo capacity or labor availability, changes in frequency of service, and shipping channel disruptions, may also increase delivery times and costs for materials and components to our facilities, transfers of our products to our key suppliers, and may affect our ability to timely ship our products to customers. In addition, sometimes we bear the risk of loss during transportation of components from our suppliers and products to our customers.
paras.zh: 运输中断，例如可用货运能力或劳动力短缺、服务频率变化以及运输渠道中断，也可能增加材料和组件运至我们工厂、我们的产品转移至关键供应商的交付时间和成本，并可能影响我们及时向客户发货的能力。此外，有时我们承担组件从供应商处运输以及产品运至客户途中的损失风险。

paras.en: In periods when broad fluctuations or changes in business conditions occur, it is difficult to assess the impact on our business. We have experienced substantial period-to-period fluctuations in our results of operations and expect, in the future, to experience period-to-period fluctuations in our results of operations due to these changes in business conditions.
paras.zh: 在业务状况出现广泛波动或变化的时期，很难评估其对我们业务的影响。我们的经营业绩已经历过大幅的期间波动，并且预计未来由于这些业务状况的变化，我们的经营业绩仍将出现期间波动。

paras.en: **Raw material and component price fluctuations or decreased availability of certain raw materials or components can increase the cost of our products, impact our ability to meet customer commitments, and may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.**
paras.zh: **原材料和组件价格波动或某些原材料或组件供应减少，可能增加我们的产品成本，影响我们履行客户承诺的能力，并可能对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: The cost of raw materials and components is a key element in the cost of our products, both directly and indirectly through our suppliers. Our inability to offset material price inflation may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. Although we believe that sources of supply for raw materials and components are generally adequate, it is difficult to predict what effects shortages or price increases may have in the future. Our inability to meet our supply needs would jeopardize our ability to fulfill obligations under our contracts, which could, in turn, result in reduced sales and profits, contract penalties or terminations, and damage to our customer relationships. Furthermore, increases in the price of certain raw materials may result in increased production costs and may result in a decrease in our gross margins. We may choose not to, or may not be able to, pass on such price increases to our customers. In addition, because we primarily outsource manufacturing of our products, global market trends such as shortage of capacity to fulfill our fabrication needs also may increase our raw material costs and thus decrease our gross margins.
paras.zh: 原材料和组件的成本是我们产品成本的关键要素，既直接体现，也通过供应商间接体现。若我们无法抵消材料价格上涨，可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。尽管我们认为原材料和组件的供应来源总体充足，但难以预测未来短缺或价格上涨可能产生的影响。若我们无法满足供应需求，将危及我们履行合同义务的能力，进而可能导致销售额和利润下降、合同处罚或终止，并损害我们的客户关系。此外，某些原材料价格的上涨可能导致生产成本增加，并可能导致我们的毛利率下降。我们可能选择不将此类价格上涨转嫁给客户，也可能无法转嫁。另外，由于我们主要将产品制造外包，全球市场趋势（例如满足我们制造需求的产能短缺）也可能增加我们的原材料成本，从而降低我们的毛利率。

paras.en: **Dependency on third-party suppliers and their technology to manufacture, assemble, test, or design our products reduces our control over product quantity and quality, manufacturing yields, development, enhancement, and product delivery schedules and could harm our business.**
paras.zh: **依赖第三方供应商及其技术来制造、组装、测试或设计我们的产品，会削弱我们对产品数量和质量、制造良率、开发、改进和产品交付进度的控制，并可能损害我们的业务。**

paras.en: Except for certain assembly, packaging, and testing steps that we conduct internally, we depend on third-party suppliers to manufacture, assemble, and test our products, and utilize third-party development tools for design, simulation, and verification of new products. Further, while we primarily generate intellectual property internally, we have, on occasion, leveraged certain third parties for software development purposes. We also face several other risks related to our third-party suppliers that have adversely affected or could adversely affect our ability to meet customer demand and scale our supply chain, negatively impact longer-term demand for our products and services, and harm our business or results of operations, including:
paras.zh: 除我们内部进行的某些组装、封装和测试环节外，我们依赖第三方供应商来制造、组装和测试我们的产品，并使用第三方开发工具进行新产品的设计、仿真和验证。此外，尽管我们主要在内部产生知识产权，但我们有时也会利用某些第三方进行软件开发。我们还面临与第三方供应商相关的其他若干风险，这些风险已经或可能对我们的满足客户需求和扩展供应链的能力产生不利影响，对产品和服务较长期的需求造成负面影响，并损害我们的业务或经营业绩，包括：

paras.en: - lack of guaranteed supply of wafer, component, and capacity or decommitment and potential higher wafer and component prices, from long lead times, incorrectly estimating demand, and failing to place orders with our suppliers with sufficient quantities or in a timely manner;
paras.zh: - 缺乏晶圆、组件和产能的供应保证，或供应商取消承诺以及潜在的晶圆和组件价格上涨，原因包括交货周期长、需求预估不准确，以及未能及时向供应商下达足够数量的订单；

paras.en: - failure by our foundries or suppliers to procure raw materials or provide adequate levels of manufacturing or test capacity for our products;
paras.zh: - 我们的代工厂或供应商未能采购原材料，或未能为我们的产品提供充足水平的制造或测试产能；

paras.en: - failure by our foundries to develop, obtain, or successfully implement high quality process technologies, including transitions to smaller geometry process technologies such as advanced process node technologies and memory designs needed to manufacture our products;
paras.zh: - 我们的代工厂未能开发、获得或成功实施高质量的工艺技术，包括向更小几何尺寸工艺技术的过渡，例如制造我们产品所需的先进制程节点技术和存储器设计；

paras.en: - failure by our suppliers to comply with our policies and expectations and emerging regulatory requirements;
paras.zh: - 我们的供应商未能遵守我们的政策和期望以及新兴的监管要求；

paras.en: - limited number and geographic concentration of global suppliers, foundries, contract manufacturers, assembly, and test providers;
paras.zh: - 全球供应商、代工厂、合同制造商、组装和测试服务提供商数量有限且地域集中；

paras.en: - loss of a supplier and additional expense and/or production delays as a result of qualifying a new foundry or other supplier and commencing volume production or testing in the event of a loss, addition, or change of a supplier;
paras.zh: - 在供应商流失、新增或变更的情况下，因认证新代工厂或其他供应商并开始量产或测试而导致供应商流失以及额外费用和/或生产延迟；

paras.en: - disputes with or among our suppliers or prospective suppliers, including with respect to intellectual property infringement or other legal and regulatory matters;
paras.zh: - 与我们的供应商或潜在供应商之间或供应商相互之间的争议，包括涉及知识产权侵权或其他法律和监管事项的争议；

paras.en: - lack of direct control over product quantity, quality, and delivery schedules;
paras.zh: - 对产品数量、质量和交付时间表缺乏直接控制；

paras.en: - responsibility or lack of recourse for loss or damage incurred while our products are in transit;
paras.zh: - 我们的产品在运输途中发生损失或损坏时的责任或缺乏追索途径；

paras.en: - failure of our suppliers or their suppliers to supply high-quality products and/or making changes to their products without our qualification;
paras.zh: - 我们的供应商或其供应商未能供应高质量产品和/或未经我们认证即更改其产品；

paras.en: - delays in product shipments, shortages, a decrease in product quality, and/or higher expenses in the event our subcontractors or foundries prioritize our competitors’ or other customers’ orders over ours;
paras.zh: - 如果我们的分包商或代工厂优先处理我们的竞争对手或其他客户的订单而非我们的订单，则会出现产品发货延迟、短缺、产品质量下降和/或费用上升；

paras.en: - requirements to place orders that are not cancellable upon changes in demand or requirements to prepay for supply in advance;
paras.zh: - 在需求发生变化时须下达不可取消的订单，或须预先支付供应款项；

paras.en: - low manufacturing yields resulting from a failure in our product design or a foundry’s proprietary process technology;
paras.zh: - 因我们的产品设计或代工厂专有工艺技术出现故障而导致制造良率低下；

paras.en: - disruptions in manufacturing, assembly, and other processes due to closures related to heat waves, earthquakes, fires, or other natural disasters and electricity conservation efforts; and
paras.zh: - 因热浪、地震、火灾或其他自然灾害导致的停工以及节电措施，造成制造、组装及其他流程中断；以及

paras.en: - failure by our third-party software development tools to meet consumer demands for greater functionality from the design, simulation, and verification of new products or product enhancements.
paras.zh: - 我们的第三方软件开发工具未能满足消费者对新产品或产品改进的设计、仿真和验证方面更高功能的需求。

paras.en: **The complexity of our offerings could result in delays in adoption by our customers, unforeseen expense or undetected defects, bugs, or security vulnerabilities, which may harm the market acceptance of new products and services, damage our reputation with current or prospective customers, cause significant remediation expenses, and may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们产品的复杂性可能导致客户采用延迟、产生不可预见的费用或未被发现的缺陷、漏洞或安全漏洞，这可能损害新产品和服务的市场接受度，损害我们在现有或潜在客户中的声誉，导致重大补救费用，并可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。**

paras.en: Our AI computing solutions, including both hardware and software, are highly complex to design and complicated to make, involve novel manufacturing processes, and may contain defects, bugs, or security vulnerabilities or experience failures or unsatisfactory performance due to a variety of issues, including design, fabrication, packaging, materials, or use. Our offerings may contain defects when they are first introduced or as new versions or enhancements are released, or their release may be delayed due to unforeseen difficulties during product development. We shipped our first CS-1 system in 2020 and our first CS-2 system in 2021, first introduced our CS-3 system and our inference solutions in 2024, and executed our first substantial scale-up of our data center footprint in 2025. As a result, we and our customers have not had a significant amount of time to gauge the long-term performance and reliability of our offerings. If our AI solutions, third-party components used in our products, the AI models we create or train on behalf of our customers, third-party models that we host in our cloud, or our inference output contain defects, bugs, or vulnerabilities or have reliability, quality, or compatibility problems, we may not be able to successfully design workarounds or resolve the issues in a timely manner. For example, the AI models that we host or train may not generate the responses that our customers want or expect, or may be otherwise flawed, and our inference speed or throughput may be lower than what customers desire. Any defects discovered in our offerings, or any components included in our products, prior to their shipping or release could delay our ability to deliver products or services to our customers. Further, defects in our products, services, the AI models we build or help train, or the AI models that we host, may only be discovered after a product or model has been shipped, released, or used by our customers. Our offerings may also have undiscovered vulnerabilities that could be exploited by hackers or other unscrupulous third parties who develop and deploy viruses and other malicious software programs, thereby exposing our customers to potential adverse consequences. Additionally, our hardware products may be difficult to repair in the field and may need to be shipped back to our facility for repair. Failures of our offerings to perform to specifications, including certain performance requirements with respect to service-level commitments in our customer agreements or issues caused by data center disruptions or failures, or other product defects, have caused us to incur, and could cause us to incur in the future, significant warranty, support, and repair or replacement costs, including credits or damages pursuant to our service-level commitments, and divert the attention of our engineering personnel from our product development efforts to find and correct the issue or to design workarounds. Further, issues with, or subpar performance of, AI models that we develop or help develop for customers, or that we host in our inference cloud, may require additional and unexpected personnel cost to remedy. In addition, delays in shipping or releasing products or training or hosting AI models or the discovery of an error or defect in new products or software after commencement of commercial shipment or release could harm our relationships with customers, as well as the perception of our brand, and may result in failure to achieve market acceptance of our offerings and harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 我们的 AI 计算解决方案（包括硬件和软件）设计高度复杂、制造难度大，涉及新颖的制造工艺，并可能因设计、制造、封装、材料或使用等多种原因而存在缺陷、漏洞或安全脆弱性，或出现故障或性能不达预期。我们的产品在首次推出时，或在发布新版本或增强功能时，可能存在缺陷；或者由于产品开发过程中出现不可预见的困难，其发布可能被延迟。我们于 2020 年交付了首套 CS-1 系统，于 2021 年交付了首套 CS-2 系统，于 2024 年首次推出 CS-3 系统及我们的推理解决方案，并于 2025 年首次对我们数据中心的规模进行了大幅扩展。因此，我们和我们的客户尚未有足够长的时间来评估我们产品的长期性能和可靠性。如果我们的 AI 解决方案、产品中使用的第三方组件、我们代表客户创建或训练的 AI 模型、我们在云中托管的第三方模型，或我们的推理输出存在缺陷、漏洞或脆弱性，或存在可靠性、质量或兼容性问题，我们可能无法成功设计出变通方案或及时解决该等问题。例如，我们托管或训练的 AI 模型可能无法生成客户想要或期望的响应，或可能存在其他缺陷，且我们的推理速度或吞吐量可能低于客户的期望。在我们的产品交付或发布之前，若在我们的产品（或产品中所含任何组件）中发现任何缺陷，可能延迟我们向客户交付产品或服务的能力。此外，我们的产品、服务、我们构建或协助训练的 AI 模型，或我们托管的 AI 模型中的缺陷，可能仅在产品或模型已交付、发布或由客户使用后才被发现。我们的产品还可能存在未被发现的脆弱性，可能被开发和部署病毒及其他恶意软件程序的黑客或其他无良第三方利用，从而使我们的客户面临潜在的不利后果。此外，我们的硬件产品可能难以在现场维修，可能需要运回我们的设施进行维修。我们的产品未能按规格运行（包括客户协议中有关服务级别承诺的某些性能要求，或由数据中心中断或故障引起的问题），或其他产品缺陷，已经并可能在未来导致我们产生重大的保修、支持及维修或更换成本（包括根据我们的服务级别承诺支付的补偿或赔偿），并使我们工程人员的注意力从产品开发工作转移到查找和纠正问题或设计变通方案上。此外，我们为客户开发或协助开发的 AI 模型，或我们在推理云中托管的 AI 模型出现问题或性能不佳，可能需要额外且意外的人员成本来补救。此外，产品交付或发布延迟，或 AI 模型训练或托管延迟，或新产品或软件在开始商业交付或发布后发现错误或缺陷，可能损害我们与客户的关系以及我们品牌的认知度，并可能导致我们的产品无法获得市场认可，损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **New developments and enhancements of our offerings require significant investment. Our failure to develop new or enhanced offerings and introduce them in a timely and effective manner would undermine our competitiveness.**
paras.zh: **我们产品的新的开发和增强需要大量投资。若我们未能及时有效地开发新产品或增强产品并将其推出，将削弱我们的竞争力。**

paras.en: We have invested, and expect to continue to invest, significant resources in the development of our AI compute solutions, both at a hardware and software level. For example, we periodically publish software releases that may contain significant new features or improvements, which require personnel and IT resources to develop and deploy. Similarly, we periodically develop and release new versions of our hardware, including new generations of processors at smaller process nodes and systems with state-of-the-art packaging technologies, which also requires significant financial and engineering resources, including design, fabrication, assembly, and testing costs. We introduced our inference solution in 2024, which has new software and novel techniques in computation that required significant investment.
paras.zh: 我们已在 AI 算力解决方案的硬件和软件层面投入大量资源，并预计将继续投入。例如，我们会定期发布软件版本，其中可能包含重要的新功能或改进，这需要人员和 IT 资源进行开发和部署。同样，我们会定期开发和发布新版本的硬件，包括采用更小制程节点的新一代处理器以及采用最先进封装技术的系统，这同样需要大量的财务和工程资源，包括设计、制造、组装和测试成本。我们于 2024 年推出了推理解决方案，该方案采用了新的软件和新的计算技术，需要大量投资。

paras.en: Our failure to anticipate or timely adapt to changes in AI model architecture and other developments in AI technologies could result in our current and next generation products not meeting the most prevalent customer needs, leading to the loss of customers and decreased demand for our offerings. For instance, we have developed software kernels and made hardware design decisions that optimize for AI solutions built on autoregressive transformer architectures with higher compute demand. However, AI architecture is a rapidly evolving field, and the design cycles for our products can be long. Therefore, there can be no assurance that our solutions will be optimized for future AI workloads. Our solution currently integrates with the PyTorch machine learning framework to enable familiar programmability for developers. New deep-learning frameworks emerge periodically, and while we intend to evolve our solution to support those that become popular and widely adopted, we can provide no assurance that we will be able to support all such frameworks with existing or future versions of our software. Likewise, our inference solution was initially designed to support a limited set of leading third-party foundational models and our inference cloud offering is exposed via an OpenAI-compatible API solution. While we intend to expand the number of supported models and keep pace with industry leading model API, we must make decisions as to the order in which popular foundational models and other product features will be integrated into our solution. If we do not timely expand our inference solution to support models and product features that become popular within the AI community, our inference product may lose current and potential customers.
paras.zh: 若我们未能预见或及时适应 AI 模型架构的变化以及 AI 技术的其他发展，可能导致我们当前和下一代产品无法满足最普遍的客户需求，从而造成客户流失和对我们产品需求的下降。例如，我们开发的软件内核和做出的硬件设计决策是针对基于自回归 Transformer 架构、算力需求更高的 AI 解决方案进行优化的。然而，AI 架构是一个快速演进的领域，而我们产品的设计周期可能较长。因此，无法保证我们的解决方案将针对未来的 AI 工作负载进行优化。我们的解决方案目前与 PyTorch 机器学习框架集成，以便为开发者提供熟悉的可编程性。新的深度学习框架会定期出现，虽然我们打算演进我们的解决方案以支持那些变得流行并被广泛采用的框架，但我们无法保证现有或未来版本的软件能够支持所有此类框架。同样，我们的推理解决方案最初设计为支持有限的一组领先的第三方基础模型，我们的推理云产品通过兼容 OpenAI 的 API 解决方案对外提供。虽然我们打算扩大支持的模型数量并与行业领先的模型 API 保持同步，但我们必须就热门基础模型和其他产品功能集成到我们解决方案中的顺序做出决策。若我们未能及时扩展推理解决方案以支持 AI 社区中变得流行的模型和产品功能，我们的推理产品可能会失去现有和潜在客户。

paras.en: At the same time, the AI compute market is subject to rapid technological change, product obsolescence, design changes, and frequent new product introductions and feature enhancements. For example, continuous and rapid advances in semiconductor technology compel providers of compute to release new and improved products at a regular cadence. Failure to timely introduce new offerings that leverage the latest hardware and software advancements in computing or in AI may result in diminished relevance, decreased competitiveness, and loss of market share, which may harm our reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. We have experienced, and may continue to experience, difficulties in transitioning to next generation systems, including due to adopting advanced process node technologies and advanced packaging solutions. Our ability to generate usage of additional products by our customers may also require increasingly sophisticated, more costly and differentiated sales efforts and result in longer sales cycles. In addition, adoption of new products or enhancements may put additional strain on our customer support or compliance teams, which could require us to make additional expenditures related to further hiring and training. Further, the investment required to stay abreast of innovations in AI and AI compute, including research and development and intellectual property expenditures and capital investments, is substantial. If we allocate our resources incorrectly, we may impair our product development cycle and erode our competitive positioning. Resource constraints may also require us to discontinue existing products or services to support new offerings. The effects of such business model changes may be difficult to predict and may not be evident for a long period of time. If we choose to focus on the wrong products and services, it may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 与此同时，AI 算力市场面临快速的技术变革、产品过时、设计变更以及频繁的新产品推出和功能增强。例如，半导体技术的持续快速进步迫使算力提供商以固定的节奏发布新的和改进的产品。若未能及时推出利用计算或 AI 领域最新硬件和软件进展的新产品，可能导致相关性下降、竞争力减弱和市场份额流失，进而可能损害我们的声誉、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。我们在向下一代系统过渡方面已经遇到并可能继续遇到困难，包括因采用先进制程节点技术和先进封装解决方案而产生的困难。我们通过客户推动其他产品使用的能力，也可能需要日益复杂、成本更高且更具差异化的销售工作，并导致销售周期延长。此外，采用新产品或增强功能可能给我们的客户支持或合规团队带来额外压力，这可能要求我们在进一步招聘和培训方面增加支出。再者，为紧跟 AI 和 AI 算力领域的创新所需的投资（包括研发和知识产权支出以及资本投资）规模巨大。如果我们错误地配置资源，可能损害我们的产品开发周期并削弱我们的竞争定位。资源约束还可能要求我们为支持新产品而停用现有产品或服务。此类商业模式变化的影响可能难以预测，且可能在很长一段时间内都不明显。如果我们选择聚焦错误的产品和服务，可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: As a result of the rapid evolutions in AI technologies and the length of our product development cycle, we must make decisions as to where to dedicate resources and develop product functionality based on our assessment of which evolving AI technologies we think are likely to become widely adopted in the future. Our ability to successfully compete and to continue to grow our business depends in significant part upon our ability to develop, introduce, and sell new and enhanced products on a timely and cost-effective basis, and to correctly anticipate and respond to changing customer requirements. If we are incorrect in our assessments, we will have expended financial and engineering resources that may not generate revenue, and which may harm our competitive position, to the extent we do not have adequate solutions for use cases that become prevalent. Lack of market acceptance for our new products for any reason could jeopardize our ability to recoup substantial research and development expenditures and may harm our reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 由于 AI 技术的快速演进以及我们产品开发周期的长度，我们必须基于对未来哪些不断演进的 AI 技术可能被广泛采用的评估，就资源投向何处以及开发何种产品功能做出决策。我们能否成功竞争并持续增长业务，在很大程度上取决于我们能否及时且具有成本效益地开发、推出和销售新的及增强的产品，以及能否正确预判并回应不断变化的客户需求。如果我们的评估有误，我们将耗费可能无法产生收入的财务和工程资源，并且在我们对成为主流的用例缺乏足够解决方案的情况下，这可能损害我们的竞争地位。我们的新产品若因任何原因未获市场认可，可能危及我们收回大量研发支出的能力，并可能损害我们的声誉、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: We have experienced, and may experience in the future, delays and unanticipated expenses in the development and introduction of new products. A failure to develop products with required feature sets or performance standards or a delay in bringing a new product or service to market may significantly reduce our return on investment as well as our sales, all of which may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. Delays in the development of new products and services or product and service enhancements could also benefit our competitors and allow them to achieve greater market share. We cannot assure that our future product development efforts will be successful or result in products that gain market acceptance.
paras.zh: 我们在新产品的开发和推出过程中已经经历、且未来可能经历延迟和意外支出。未能开发出具备所需功能组合或性能标准的产品，或新产品或服务推迟上市，可能大幅降低我们的投资回报以及销售额，所有这些都可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。新产品和服务或产品和服务增强功能的开发延迟，也可能使我们的竞争对手受益，并使其获得更大的市场份额。我们无法保证未来的产品开发工作将会成功，或开发出的产品能够获得市场认可。

paras.en: **If our customers do not purchase additional products from us or expand their purchases with us in the future, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be harmed.**
paras.zh: **如果我们的客户未来不从我们这里购买更多产品，或不扩大在我们这里的采购，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。**

paras.en: In order for us to maintain or improve our results of operations, it is important that our customers continue to purchase our offerings on similar or improved terms, and that we increase the products and services our customers purchase. Our on-premises system purchases are generally handled on a purchase order basis, and customers are not otherwise required to purchase specific or additional quantities of products from us. Likewise, our cloud solutions can be purchased by developers on a pay-as-you-go model without any long-term commitments. Even when customers agree to purchase an agreed quantity of hardware products from us, we generally do not recognize revenue until shipment or delivery, depending on shipping terms, or until we have met the contractual acceptance terms. As a result, we may not generate the amount of revenue on the timeline that we expect. Moreover, our customers’ purchasing power have, in some cases, given them the ability to make greater demands on us with regard to pricing and contractual terms. We expect this trend to continue, which we expect to adversely affect our gross margin in the near term and, should we fail to perform under these arrangements, we could also be liable for significant monetary damages. If our efforts to maintain and expand our relationships with our existing customers are not successful, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed.
paras.zh: 为维持或改善我们的经营业绩，我们的客户必须继续以类似或更优的条件购买我们的产品，并且我们必须增加客户购买的产品和服务。我们的本地部署系统采购通常以采购订单方式进行，客户并无义务向我们购买特定数量或额外数量的产品。同样，我们的云解决方案可由开发者按按需付费模式购买，无需任何长期承诺。即使客户同意向我们购买约定数量的硬件产品，我们通常也要等到发货或交付（视运输条款而定）之后，或在我们满足合同验收条款之后，才确认收入。因此，我们可能无法按预期的时间表实现预期收入。此外，在某些情况下，客户的购买力使其能够就定价和合同条款向我们提出更高的要求。我们预计这一趋势将持续下去，预计这将在短期内对我们的毛利率产生不利影响；如果我们未能履行这些安排，我们还可能承担重大金钱损失赔偿责任。如果我们维护和扩大与现有客户关系的努力不成功，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。

paras.en: **Our sales cycles can be long and unpredictable, and our sales efforts require considerable time and expense. If our sales cycle lengthens or we invest substantial resources pursuing unsuccessful sales opportunities, our business and results of operations may be harmed.**
paras.zh: **我们的销售周期可能漫长且不可预测，我们的销售工作耗费大量时间和费用。如果我们的销售周期延长，或我们投入大量资源去争取不成功的销售机会，我们的业务和经营业绩可能受到损害。**

paras.en: Our results of operations may fluctuate, in part, because of the resource-intensive nature of our sales efforts, the length and variability of the sales cycle for our products, and the difficulty in making short-term adjustments to our operating expenses. The timing of our sales is difficult to predict. The length of our sales cycle, from initial evaluation to purchase of our product, can vary substantially from customer to customer. Our sales efforts involve educating our customers about the use, technical capabilities, and benefits of our solution. Customers often undertake a lengthy evaluation of our products, which may involve not only our solution but also those of our competitors. Potential customers have and may continue to request paid proof of concept trials prior to purchase, which can be time intensive for our sales and technical personnel, and use compute capacity that could otherwise have been sold. In addition, sales to large organizations and government agencies, and in highly regulated verticals, tend to take longer to conclude because such organizations typically go through a significant evaluation and lengthy negotiation process due to their size, organizational structure, and internal approval requirements, including extensive information security requirements. We may spend substantial time, effort, and money on sales efforts without any assurance that our efforts will produce any sales. As a result, it is difficult to predict if or exactly when we will make a sale to a potential customer, or if we can increase sales to our existing customers. New product developments or releases may lead to changes in the size, quantity and complexity of our customer relationships, making it more difficult for us to predict timing of our sales or the expected impact to our results of operations. If our sales cycle lengthens or we invest substantial resources pursuing unsuccessful sales opportunities, our business, financial condition, and results of operations may be harmed.
paras.zh: 我们的经营业绩可能发生波动，部分原因在于我们的销售工作具有资源密集型特点、我们产品的销售周期较长且存在差异，以及难以对运营费用进行短期调整。我们的销售时点难以预测。从初步评估到购买我们产品，我们的销售周期长度可能因客户不同而存在重大差异。我们的销售工作涉及向客户介绍我们解决方案的用途、技术能力和优势。客户往往会对我们的产品进行长时间的评估，评估对象可能不仅包括我们的解决方案，还包括竞争对手的解决方案。潜在客户已经并可能继续要求在购买前进行付费的概念验证试用，这可能耗费我们销售和技术人员大量时间，并占用原本可用于销售的算力。此外，向大型组织和政府机构以及高度监管行业销售往往需要更长时间才能完成，因为此类组织通常因其规模、组织结构和内部审批要求（包括广泛的信息安全要求）而需经历大量评估和漫长的谈判过程。我们可能在销售工作上投入大量时间、精力和资金，却无法保证这些努力能带来任何销售。因此，我们难以预测是否会或究竟何时能向潜在客户实现销售，也难以预测能否增加对现有客户的销售。新产品开发或发布可能导致我们客户关系的规模、数量和复杂性发生变化，使我们更难预测销售时点或对经营业绩的预期影响。如果我们的销售周期延长，或我们投入大量资源追求不成功的销售机会，我们的业务、财务状况和经营业绩可能受到损害。

paras.en: Each individual sale tends to be large as a proportion of our overall sales, which has impacted our ability to accurately forecast revenue and manage cash flows. In addition, sales have, in some cases, occurred in later quarters than anticipated, or have not occurred at all, and within each quarter, it is difficult to predict when a transaction will close. Therefore, it is often difficult to determine whether we will meet our quarterly or annual expectations until near the end of such periods. Many of our expenses are relatively fixed or require time to adjust. If expectations for our business are not accurate, we may not be able to adjust our cost structure on a timely basis, and our margins and cash flows may differ from expectations.
paras.zh: 单笔销售占我们整体销售的比例往往较大，这影响了我们准确预测收入和现金流管理的能力。此外，在某些情况下，销售发生在晚于预期的季度，或根本未能发生，而在每个季度内，难以预测交易何时完成。因此，往往难以在此类期间临近结束时才确定我们能否达到季度或年度预期。我们的许多费用相对固定，或需要时间才能调整。如果对我们业务的预期不准确，我们可能无法及时调整成本结构，我们的利润率和现金流可能与预期存在差异。

paras.en: **The estimates of market opportunity and forecasts of market growth included in this prospectus may prove to be inaccurate, and even if the markets in which we compete achieve the forecasted growth, our business may not grow at similar rates, or at all, or we may not be able to service these markets in full.**
paras.zh: **本招股说明书中包含的市场机会估计和市场增长预测可能被证明不准确，即使我们竞争所在的市场实现了预测的增长，我们的业务也可能不会以类似速度增长，或根本不会增长，或者我们可能无法充分服务这些市场。**

paras.en: Market opportunity estimates and growth forecasts included in this prospectus, including third-party market research and internal estimates, are subject to significant uncertainty and are based on assumptions and estimates which may not prove to be accurate. While we believe the information on which we base our market opportunity estimates and forecasts is generally reliable, such information is inherently imprecise and particularly so for a new market such as AI. Furthermore, even if the markets in which we compete meet the size estimates and growth forecasts included in this prospectus, our business may not grow at similar rates, or at all. For example, we are in the early stages of commercializing our solutions at its current scale, and there can be no assurance that we will be able to capture any significant part of the relevant market or have the manufacturing capacity, data center commitments or other dependencies to service the market in full. Exclusivity provisions in our customer agreements also limit our ability to service certain parties in these markets. Moreover, the market for high-speed training and inference, including real-time and agent-based systems, may not exist or increase as expected. Our growth is subject to many factors, including our success in implementing our business strategy, which has many risks and uncertainties, including those described herein. If our market opportunity estimates or growth forecasts prove to be inaccurate, our future growth opportunities may be lower than we currently expect.
paras.zh: 本招股说明书中包含的市场机会估计和增长预测（包括第三方市场研究和内部估计）存在重大不确定性，且基于可能被证明并不准确的假设和估计。尽管我们认为，我们据以作出市场机会估计和预测的信息总体上是可靠的，但此类信息本身并不精确，对于 AI 这样的新兴市场而言尤其如此。此外，即使我们参与竞争的市场达到了本招股说明书所包含的规模估计和增长预测，我们的业务也未必能以类似速度增长，甚至未必会增长。例如，我们按当前规模将解决方案商业化的进程仍处于早期阶段，无法保证我们能够占据相关市场的任何重要份额，或具备制造产能、数据中心承诺或其他依赖条件以充分服务该市场。我们客户协议中的排他性条款也限制了我们在这些市场中为某些方提供服务的能力。此外，高速训练和推理（包括实时系统和基于智能体的系统）的市场可能并不存在，或未必能如预期般增长。我们的增长受诸多因素影响，包括我们能否成功实施业务战略，而该战略存在许多风险和不确定性，包括本招股说明书所述的风险和不确定性。如果我们的市场机会估计或增长预测被证明不准确，我们未来的增长机会可能低于我们当前的预期。

paras.en: **Any failure to offer high-quality maintenance and support services for our customers and maintain customer satisfaction may harm our relationships with our customers and, consequently, our business.**
paras.zh: **任何未能为客户提供高质量维护和支持服务、未能维持客户满意度的情形，都可能损害我们与客户的关系，进而损害我们的业务。**

paras.en: Our customers depend on our maintenance and support teams to resolve technical and operational issues with respect to our on-premises and cloud products. Our ability to provide effective customer maintenance and support is dependent on our ability to attract, train, and retain qualified personnel with AI, software programming, IT, and complex hardware maintenance experience. In particular, our hardware systems are very complex and difficult to repair in the field, with many components that are challenging and expensive to upgrade. When we sell hardware units for installation on premises at our customers’ facilities, we may in certain circumstances provide spare units that may be used during repair downtime. Where we also provide cluster management services for hardware that we have sold, our customer agreements typically provide for service credits in the event we do not meet certain uptime requirements. Our cloud-based customer agreements may also include service credits for uptime requirements.
paras.zh: 我们的客户依赖我们的维护和支持团队来解决其本地部署产品和云产品的技术和运营问题。我们能否提供有效的客户维护和支持，取决于我们能否吸引、培养和留住具备 AI、软件编程、IT 和复杂硬件维护经验的合格人员。特别是，我们的硬件系统非常复杂，难以在现场维修，许多组件的升级难度大且成本高昂。当我们销售用于在客户设施本地安装的硬件单元时，我们在某些情况下可能提供备用单元，以便在维修停机期间使用。在我们还就所售硬件提供集群管理服务的情况下，我们的客户协议通常约定，如果我们未达到某些正常运行时间要求，我们将提供服务抵扣。我们基于云的客户协议也可能包含针对正常运行时间要求的服务抵扣。

paras.en: Additionally, growth in our customer base puts additional pressure on our customer maintenance and support teams. Our customer support and cloud operations services teams may need additional personnel to respond to customer demand. We may be unable to respond quickly enough to accommodate short-term increases in customer demand for services. If we are unable to provide efficient, high-quality customer maintenance and support services or if we are unable to hire sufficient additional maintenance and support personnel in a timely or efficient manner, we may incur significant warranty, support, and repair, replacement, or service credit costs, and our business and our relationships with our customers may be harmed.
paras.zh: 此外，我们客户群的增长给客户维护和支持团队带来了额外压力。我们的客户支持和云运营服务团队可能需要增加人员以响应客户需求。我们可能无法足够迅速地响应客户对服务的短期增长需求。如果我们无法提供高效、高质量的客户维护和支持服务，或者如果我们无法及时或高效地聘用足够的额外维护和支持人员，我们可能会产生重大的保修、支持、维修、更换或服务信用成本，我们的业务以及与客户的关系可能会受到损害。

paras.en: In addition, as we continue to grow our operations and expand outside of the United States, we need to be able to provide efficient services that meet our customers’ needs globally at scale, and our customer support and cloud operations services teams may face additional challenges, including those associated with operating the platforms and delivering support, training, and documentation in languages other than English and providing services across expanded time-zones. If we are unable to provide efficient customer support services globally at scale, our ability to grow our operations may be harmed, and we may need to hire additional services personnel, which could increase our expenses, and negatively impact our business, financial condition, operating results, and prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，随着我们持续扩大运营规模并向美国境外扩张，我们需要能够大规模地提供满足全球客户需求的高效服务，我们的客户支持和云运营服务团队可能面临额外挑战，包括与运营平台以及以英语以外的语言提供支持、培训和文档相关的挑战，以及在扩大的时区内提供服务的挑战。如果我们无法在全球范围内大规模提供高效的客户支持服务，我们扩大运营的能力可能会受到损害，我们可能需要聘用额外的服务人员，这可能会增加我们的费用，并对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景产生负面影响。

paras.en: **If we are not able to maintain and enhance our reputation and brand recognition, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed.**
paras.zh: **如果我们无法维护和提升我们的声誉和品牌认知度，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能会受到损害。**

paras.en: We believe that maintaining and enhancing our reputation and brand recognition is critical to our relationships with existing customers and our ability to attract new customers. The promotion of our brand may require us to make substantial investments and we anticipate that, as our market becomes increasingly competitive, these marketing initiatives may become increasingly difficult and expensive. Our marketing activities may not be successful or yield increased revenue, and to the extent that these activities yield increased revenue, the increased revenue may not offset the expenses we incur, and our results of operations may be harmed. In addition, any factor that diminishes our reputation or that of our management, including failing to meet the expectations of our customers and public or investor perception, may make it substantially more difficult for us to attract new customers. Similarly, because our customers often act as references for us with prospective new customers, any existing customer that questions the quality of our work or that of our employees could impair our ability to secure additional new customers. If we do not successfully maintain and enhance our reputation and brand recognition with our customers, our business may not grow and we may lose these relationships, which may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 我们认为，维护和提升我们的声誉和品牌认知度对于我们与现有客户的关系以及我们吸引新客户的能力至关重要。推广我们的品牌可能需要我们进行大量投资，我们预计，随着我们的市场竞争日益激烈，这些营销举措可能会变得越来越困难和昂贵。我们的营销活动可能不会成功或带来收入增长，而且即使这些活动带来收入增长，收入增长也可能无法抵消我们产生的费用，我们的经营业绩可能会受到损害。此外，任何损害我们或我们管理层声誉的因素，包括未能满足客户的期望以及公众或投资者的看法，都可能使我们吸引新客户变得困难得多。同样，由于我们的客户经常作为我们面向潜在新客户的推荐人，任何质疑我们或我们员工工作质量的现有客户都可能损害我们获得更多新客户的能力。如果我们未能成功维护和提升我们在客户中的声誉和品牌认知度，我们的业务可能无法增长，我们可能会失去这些关系，这可能会损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **Our semiconductor and hardware system design and manufacturing processes involve numerous technical, operational, and financial risks, including challenges associated with advanced process nodes, tape-outs, and complex packaging technologies, that could delay our product roadmap, increase our costs, and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们的半导体及硬件系统设计与制造流程涉及众多技术、运营和财务风险，包括与先进制程节点、流片及复杂封装技术相关的挑战，这些风险可能延误我们的产品路线图、增加我们的成本，并对我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景产生不利影响。**

paras.en: Developing high-performance processors and systems requires us to continuously transition to more advanced process node technologies and invest in increasingly complex packaging, power delivery, cooling, and integration solutions. For example, the WSE-2 was manufactured on TSMC’s 7nm process technology and the WSE-3 on TSMC’s 5nm process technology, and we expect future products to require even more advanced nodes and packaging approaches. These transitions are essential for maintaining competitiveness but involve substantial design complexity, significant engineering resources, and difficult trade-off decisions, including the opportunity costs associated with technologies we choose not to pursue. As process and packaging technologies advance, the risks, costs, and development timelines associated with semiconductor design generally increase.
paras.zh: 开发高性能处理器和系统要求我们持续向更先进的制程节点技术过渡，并投资于日益复杂的封装、供电、散热和集成解决方案。例如，WSE-2 采用台积电 7nm 制程技术制造，WSE-3 采用台积电 5nm 制程技术制造，我们预计未来产品将需要更先进的节点和封装方案。这些过渡对于保持竞争力至关重要，但涉及巨大的设计复杂性、大量工程资源以及艰难的权衡决策，包括与我们选择不采用的技术相关的机会成本。随着制程和封装技术的进步，与半导体设计相关的风险、成本和开发周期通常都会增加。

paras.en: We rely heavily on our foundry partner, currently TSMC, for successful transitions to next generation products and for the manufacture of all of our wafers. We cannot assure you that TSMC or any future foundry partner will be able or willing to support our product transitions on the schedules we require, in sufficient volume to meet customer demand, or at all. Transitioning to another foundry would require substantial additional development effort, increase our time to market, and could introduce new technical and supply-chain risks. In addition, we have experienced, and may continue to experience, delays in securing tape-out slots and in resolving technical issues associated with new designs. Failures or delays at tape-out, which marks the finalization of a chip design prior to manufacturing, carry particularly high impact because the process requires significant engineering time, financial resources, and close cooperation with the foundry. Tape-out failures, whether due to design flaws, manufacturing defects, or process-related issues, can require restarts of the design cycle, increase costs, reduce yields, and delay product launches.
paras.zh: 我们在很大程度上依赖我们的代工合作伙伴（目前为台积电）来实现向下一代产品的成功过渡以及我们所有晶圆的制造。我们无法向您保证，台积电或任何未来的代工合作伙伴能够或愿意按照我们要求的时间表、以足以满足客户需求的产量、或无论如何支持我们的产品过渡。过渡到另一家代工厂将需要大量额外的开发工作，延长我们的上市时间，并可能引入新的技术和供应链风险。此外，我们曾经经历、并且可能继续经历在获取流片档期以及解决与新设计相关的技术问题方面的延误。流片标志着芯片设计在制造前的最终定稿，流片失败或延误的影响尤其重大，因为该过程需要大量工程时间、财务资源以及与代工厂的密切合作。流片失败，无论是由于设计缺陷、制造缺陷还是制程相关问题，都可能导致设计周期重启、增加成本、降低良率并延迟产品发布。

paras.en: Our advanced wafer-scale architecture also requires continual innovation in power delivery, cooling, input/ output integration, and other aspects of advanced packaging. As we push the limits of power density, thermal management, and interconnect complexity, we may encounter fundamental constraints that require new engineering solutions. If we fail to develop such solutions on the required timeline, or at all, we may be unable to meet our product-roadmap objectives or deliver next-generation products. Reduced manufacturing yields, delays in product deliveries, higher development and production expenses, or an inability to introduce competitive next-generation products could harm our customer relationships, reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 我们先进的晶圆级架构还需要在供电、散热、输入/输出集成以及先进封装的其他方面持续创新。随着我们不断突破功率密度、热管理和互连复杂度的极限，我们可能会遇到需要全新工程解决方案的根本性制约。如果我们未能在要求的时间表内开发出此类解决方案，或根本无法开发出此类解决方案，我们可能无法实现产品路线图目标或交付下一代产品。制造良率下降、产品交付延迟、开发和生产费用上升，或无法推出具有竞争力的下一代产品，都可能损害我们的客户关系、声誉、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **Issues relating to the responsible use of our technologies may result in reputational or financial harm and liability.**
paras.zh: **与我们技术负责任使用相关的问题可能导致声誉或财务损害及责任。**

paras.en: As with many new emerging technologies, AI presents risks and challenges and increasing ethical and legal concerns relating to its responsible use that could affect the adoption of AI, and thus our business. Concerns relating to the responsible use of new and evolving technologies in our offerings may also result in reputational or financial harm and liability and may cause us to incur costs to resolve such issues. For instance, we offer AI model services in which we develop proprietary AI models with and on behalf of our customers, as well as open-source AI models that we or our customers make generally available to the community. We may not have insight into, or control over, how our customers and other third parties use or deploy the AI models that we trained or assisted in training, or that were trained using our computing solutions, or that we otherwise make available to customers. We do not control how others, including customers, use AI models that we develop or make available. We also cannot fully control how users interact with our inference solution, including whether they may breach our terms of use or that of third-party model providers with which we integrate or host. If we enable or offer AI models that draw controversy due to their perceived or actual impact on society, including, for example, AI models that have unintended consequences, infringe intellectual property rights or rights of publicity, disseminate illegal, inaccurate, defamatory, or harmful content, or are controversial because of their impact on human rights, privacy, cybersecurity, employment or other social, economic or political issues, or if we are unable to develop effective internal policies and frameworks relating to the responsible development and use of AI models, we may experience brand or reputational harm, competitive harm, financial harm, or legal liability. Complying with multiple laws, statutes, regulations, guidelines, self-regulatory frameworks, and industry standards from different jurisdictions related to AI could increase our cost of doing business, may change the way that we operate in certain jurisdictions, or may impede our ability to offer certain products and services in certain jurisdictions if we are unable to comply with applicable legal requirements. Compliance with existing and proposed government regulation of AI, including in jurisdictions such as the European Union (the “EU”), may also increase the cost of related research and development and compliance, and create additional reporting or transparency requirements. In addition, unfavorable developments with evolving laws and regulations worldwide related to AI, such as those laws that may pause or inhibit continued development or adoption of AI, may limit global adoption, reduce demand for our offerings, increase our costs to provide our offerings, impede our strategy, and negatively impact our long-term expectations in this area. For example, given the adoption of the EU’s Artificial Intelligence Act (the “AI Act”), which went into force in August 2024, and AI-related laws in the United States, including the Colorado Artificial Intelligence Act (the “Colorado AI Act”), we anticipate that there will continue to be significant developing laws and regulations with respect to AI as the AI industry continues to develop. Changes in AI-related regulation may disproportionately impact and disadvantage us and require us to change our business practices, which may harm our results of operations. Our, our customers, or others’ failure to adequately address any of the foregoing concerns or regulations relating to the responsible use of AI may undermine public confidence in AI and slow adoption of our offerings or harm our reputation or business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 与许多新兴技术一样，AI 带来了风险与挑战，以及与其负责任使用相关的日益增多的伦理和法律关切，这些可能影响 AI 的采用，进而影响我们的业务。与在我们产品中负责任地使用新兴和不断演进的技术相关的关切，也可能导致声誉或财务损害及责任，并可能使我们产生解决此类问题的成本。例如，我们提供 AI 模型服务，在该服务中我们与客户共同并代表客户开发专有 AI 模型，以及我们或我们的客户向社区普遍提供的开源 AI 模型。我们可能无法洞察或控制我们的客户及其他第三方如何使用或部署我们训练或协助训练的、或使用我们的算力解决方案训练的、或我们以其他方式向客户提供的 AI 模型。我们无法控制他人（包括客户）如何使用我们开发或提供的 AI 模型。我们也无法完全控制用户如何与我们的推理解决方案交互，包括他们是否可能违反我们的使用条款或我们与之集成或托管的第三方模型提供商的使用条款。如果我们启用或提供的 AI 模型因其对社会被感知或实际的影响而引起争议，例如，包括具有意外后果、侵犯知识产权或形象权、传播非法、不准确、诽谤性或有害内容，或因其对人权、隐私、网络安全、就业或其他社会、经济或政治问题的影响而存在争议的 AI 模型，或者如果我们无法就 AI 模型的负责任开发和使用制定有效的内部政策和框架，我们可能遭受品牌或声誉损害、竞争损害、财务损害或法律责任。遵守来自不同司法管辖区的与 AI 相关的多项法律、法规、规章、指南、自律框架和行业标准，可能增加我们的经营成本，可能改变我们在某些司法管辖区的运营方式，或者如果我们无法遵守适用的法律要求，可能阻碍我们在某些司法管辖区提供某些产品和服务的能力。遵守现有和拟议的政府对 AI 的监管（包括在欧盟（“EU”）等司法管辖区）也可能增加相关研发和合规成本，并产生额外的报告或透明度要求。此外，全球范围内与 AI 相关的不断演进的法律和法规的不利发展，例如可能暂停或抑制 AI 持续开发或采用的法律，可能限制全球采用、减少对我们产品的需求、增加我们提供产品的成本、阻碍我们的战略，并对我们在此领域的长期预期产生负面影响。例如，鉴于欧盟《人工智能法案》（“AI 法案”）已于 2024 年 8 月生效，以及美国与 AI 相关的法律（包括科罗拉多州《人工智能法案》（“科罗拉多 AI 法案”））的通过，我们预计随着 AI 行业的持续发展，与 AI 相关的重要法律和法规将不断出台。AI 相关监管的变化可能对我们产生不成比例的影响和不利影响，并要求我们改变业务实践，这可能损害我们的经营业绩。我们、我们的客户或他人未能充分应对上述任何与负责任使用 AI 相关的关切或法规，可能削弱公众对 AI 的信心并减缓对我们产品的采用，或损害我们的声誉或业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **Events outside of our control, adverse economic conditions, or economic uncertainty may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们无法控制的事件、不利的经济状况或经济不确定性可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。**

paras.en: Disruptive and/or unpredictable global events beyond our control (such as geopolitical conflict or terrorism, including the ongoing conflicts between Russia and Ukraine and in the Middle East, global pandemics or health crises, natural disasters, or labor unrest) may increase the severity of political and economic volatility around the world, and could result in a protracted localized or widespread decrease in demand for our products. In particular, the war in the Middle East, where our strategic partners G42 and MBZUAI are headquartered, may negatively impact our business, including exposing local infrastructure and operations to heightened risk. This decrease in demand, depending on its scope and duration, could significantly impact and harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects over the short and long-term.
paras.zh: 我们无法控制的破坏性和/或不可预测的全球事件（例如地缘政治冲突或恐怖主义，包括俄罗斯与乌克兰之间以及中东地区持续进行的冲突、全球大流行病或健康危机、自然灾害或劳工骚乱）可能加剧全球政治和经济波动，并可能导致对我们产品的需求在局部或大范围出现长期下降。特别是，我们的战略合作伙伴 G42 和 MBZUAI 总部所在地中东地区的战争，可能对我们的业务产生负面影响，包括使当地基础设施和运营面临更高风险。这种需求下降，视其范围和持续时间而定，可能在短期和长期内显著影响并损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: Additionally, many of our suppliers, including our sole source of wafers, TSMC, are located in areas of high geopolitical tension, such as Taiwan and South Korea, or in areas prone to natural disasters such as earthquakes and typhoons. Similarly, the potential for military conflict between China and Taiwan could have negative impacts on the global economy, including by affecting the supply of semiconductors from Taiwan, contributing to higher energy prices and creating uncertainty in the global capital markets. Any substantial disruption in TSMC’s supply of wafers to us, or in the other supply services that we utilize, as a result of a natural disaster, climate change, water shortages, political unrest, military conflict, geopolitical turmoil, trade tensions, government orders, medical epidemics, economic instability, equipment failure or other causes, could materially disrupt our operations, may harm our customer relationships, business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. Further, in 2025, a significant majority of our revenue was generated from customers headquartered in the United Arab Emirates. Recent wars, political instability, and protests in the Middle East have caused significant disruptions to many industries. Conflict, political instability, and social unrest in, policy changes (including by the U.S government as well as the governments of other countries in which we operate) with respect to, or negative public sentiment toward, the Middle East may significantly harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 此外，我们的许多供应商，包括我们的晶圆独家供应商台积电（TSMC），位于地缘政治紧张局势高企的地区，例如台湾和韩国，或位于易发生地震和台风等自然灾害的地区。同样，中国大陆与台湾之间发生军事冲突的可能性可能对全球经济产生负面影响，包括影响来自台湾的半导体供应、推高能源价格并在全球资本市场造成不确定性。如果台积电对我们的晶圆供应或我们使用的其他供应服务因自然灾害、气候变化、水资源短缺、政治动荡、军事冲突、地缘政治动荡、贸易紧张局势、政府命令、流行病、经济不稳定、设备故障或其他原因而出现任何重大中断，可能严重扰乱我们的运营，并可能损害我们的客户关系、业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。此外，2025 年，我们收入的绝大部分来自总部位于阿拉伯联合酋长国的客户。中东地区近期的战争、政治不稳定和抗议活动已对许多行业造成严重扰乱。中东地区的冲突、政治不稳定和社会动荡、相关（包括美国政府和我们在其中运营的其他国家政府）政策变化，或公众对中东地区的负面情绪，可能严重损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: Further, adverse macroeconomic conditions, including a general slowdown in the United States or global economy or in a particular region or industry, inflation, recession, changes to fiscal and monetary policy, tighter credit, higher interest rates, new or increased trade tariffs, or an increase in trade tensions with United States trading partners, may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. In particular, the imposition of tariffs, trade controls, border taxes, or other barriers to trade may directly or indirectly impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. For example, the 2025 U.S. announcement of tariffs on imported goods from many countries and the announcement of retaliatory tariffs from select countries has contributed to volatility in the markets, and has and may continue to negatively impact our costs. A deterioration in economic conditions may cause our customers to reduce, delay or forego technology spending, including spending on our products. Significant inflation may increase our costs and expenses, which we may choose not, or not be able to, pass on to our customers. In addition, uncertainty about, or a decline in, global or regional economic conditions may have a significant impact on our suppliers, some of which are located outside the United States. If customers or prospective customers elect not to purchase our offerings as a result of a weak economy or rising inflation and increased costs or otherwise, or our suppliers are unable to continue supplying our products, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed. There can be no assurance that we will be able to mitigate the impacts of the foregoing or any future changes in global trade dynamics on our business. Potential effects include financial instability, inability to obtain credit to finance operations and insolvency.
paras.zh: 此外，不利的宏观经济状况，包括美国或全球经济或特定地区或行业普遍放缓、通货膨胀、衰退、财政和货币政策变化、信贷收紧、利率上升、新的或增加的贸易关税，或与美国贸易伙伴的贸易紧张局势加剧，可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。特别是，征收关税、贸易管制、边境税或其他贸易壁垒可能直接或间接影响我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。例如，2025 年美国宣布对来自许多国家的进口商品征收关税，以及部分国家宣布报复性关税，加剧了市场波动，并已且可能继续对我们的成本产生负面影响。经济状况恶化可能导致我们的客户减少、推迟或放弃技术支出，包括对我们的产品的支出。显著的通货膨胀可能增加我们的成本和费用，我们可能选择不转嫁或无法转嫁给客户。此外，全球或区域经济状况的不确定性或下滑可能对我们的供应商产生重大影响，其中一些供应商位于美国境外。如果客户或潜在客户因经济疲软或通胀上升和成本增加或其他原因选择不购买我们的产品，或者我们的供应商无法继续供应我们的产品，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能受到损害。无法保证我们能够减轻上述因素或全球贸易动态的任何未来变化对我们业务的影响。潜在影响包括金融不稳定、无法获得信贷为运营融资以及破产。

paras.en: **Pricing for the current generation of our existing products often decreases over time, which may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.**
paras.zh: **我们现有产品当前一代的定价往往随时间推移而下降，这可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。**

paras.en: We launched the CS-3 in 2024 and no longer manufacture the CS-2. In the future, we expect to release new generations of our AI compute system, which may require us to reduce prices of then-current systems in anticipation of such releases. In addition, customers may delay purchasing an existing system, or cloud compute capacity associated therewith, in anticipation of our release of a next generation or newer, more advanced system. Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed by a decline in the pricing for the current generation of our existing products. Additionally, as competition increases in our target markets, we may need to reduce the prices of our existing products and services in anticipation of competitive pricing pressures, new product introductions by us or our competitors, new generations of such existing products, or for other reasons. If we are unable to offset any reductions in pricing for existing products by increasing our sales volumes, decreasing costs, or introducing new products or services or new product generations of such existing products with higher margins, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may be harmed. To maintain our results of operations, we must develop and introduce new products and services, next-generation products, and product enhancements on a timely basis and continually reduce our costs as well as our customers’ costs. Failure to do so may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects.
paras.zh: 我们于 2024 年推出 CS-3，并已不再生产 CS-2。未来，我们预计将发布新一代 AI 算力系统，这可能要求我们在此类发布之前下调当时在售系统的价格。此外，客户可能会因预期我们发布下一代或更新、更先进的系统而推迟购买现有系统或与之相关的云算力容量。我们现有产品当前一代产品定价的下降可能会损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。此外，随着我们目标市场竞争的加剧，我们可能因预期竞争性定价压力、我们或竞争对手推出新产品、此类现有产品的新一代产品或其他原因，而需要下调我们现有产品和服务的价格。如果我们无法通过提高销售量、降低成本，或推出具有更高利润率的新产品或服务或此类现有产品的新一代产品来抵消现有产品定价的任何下降，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景可能会受到损害。为维持我们的经营业绩，我们必须及时开发并推出新产品和服务、下一代产品以及产品增强功能，并持续降低我们的成本以及客户的成本。未能做到这一点可能会损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景。

paras.en: **Our business and operations have experienced significant growth, and if we do not effectively manage our growth, or are unable to improve our systems and processes, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects will be harmed.**
paras.zh: **我们的业务和运营经历了显著增长，如果我们不能有效管理增长，或无法改进我们的系统和流程，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景将受到损害。**

paras.en: We have grown rapidly since we were founded in 2016. For example, our total headcount has grown to 708 people as of December 31, 2025, and we have employees located in the United States, Canada, India, and other countries. Our customer base has also grown and we expect it to continue to grow. The rapid growth and expansion of our business places a continuous and significant strain on our management, operational, and financial resources.
paras.zh: 自 2016 年成立以来，我们实现了快速增长。例如，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我们的员工总数已增至 708 人，员工分布于美国、加拿大、印度及其他国家。我们的客户群也有所扩大，我们预计其将继续增长。业务的快速增长和扩张对我们的管理、运营和财务资源持续构成重大压力。

paras.en: To manage future growth effectively, we will need to expand and improve our operating, financial, IT and other administrative systems, controls, and procedures, and continue to manage headcount expansion and capital in an efficient manner. We may not be able to successfully implement requisite improvements to these systems, processes, controls, and procedures in a timely or efficient manner. Any failure to improve our systems and processes, or their failure to operate in the intended manner, whether as a result of the significant growth of our business or otherwise, may result in our inability to manage the growth of our business or to accurately forecast our revenue, expenses and earnings, or to prevent certain losses or replace anticipated revenue that we do not receive as a result of delays arising from these factors. Moreover, the failure of our systems and processes could undermine our ability to provide accurate, timely, and reliable reports on our results of operations and financial condition and could adversely impact the effectiveness of our internal controls over financial reporting. In addition, our systems and processes may not prevent or detect all errors, omissions, or fraud. Accordingly, our results of operations in future reporting periods may be below the expectations of investors.
paras.zh: 为有效管理未来增长，我们将需要扩展和改进我们的运营、财务、IT 及其他行政系统、控制措施和流程，并继续以高效方式管理员工规模扩张和资本。我们可能无法及时或高效地成功实施对这些系统、流程、控制措施和流程的必要改进。若未能改进我们的系统和流程，或这些系统和流程未能按预期方式运行，无论是否因业务显著增长或其他原因所致，均可能导致我们无法管理业务增长，或无法准确预测收入、费用和盈利，或无法防止某些损失，或无法弥补因上述因素导致的延迟而未能获得的预期收入。此外，我们的系统和流程若出现故障，可能削弱我们提供准确、及时、可靠的经营业绩和财务状况报告的能力，并可能对财务报告内部控制的有效性产生不利影响。此外，我们的系统和流程可能无法防止或发现所有错误、遗漏或舞弊。因此，我们未来报告期的经营业绩可能低于投资者预期。

paras.en: We will also face increased compliance costs associated with growth and the expansion of business, particularly as we expand into new countries, if the number of our government customers increases, and as we become a public company. We have encountered and expect to continue to encounter additional risks and difficulties frequently experienced by growing companies in rapidly changing industries, including effectively managing increasing expenses, and allocating valuable financial and other resources as we continue to grow our business. If we do not manage these risks successfully, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects will be harmed.
paras.zh: 随着业务增长和扩张，我们还将面临更高的合规成本，尤其是在我们拓展新国家、政府客户数量增加以及我们成为上市公司的情况下。我们已经遇到并预计将继续遇到快速增长行业中的成长型公司经常面临的额外风险和困难，包括在持续发展业务的过程中有效管理不断增长的费用，以及分配宝贵的财务和其他资源。如果我们未能成功管理这些风险，我们的业务、财务状况、经营业绩和前景将受到损害。

paras.en: **We are subject to the risks associated with conducting business operations outside the United States, which may harm our business.**
paras.zh: **我们面临在美国境外开展业务运营相关的风险，这可能损害我们的业务。**

paras.en: In addition to our U.S. operations, we also have international operations. We have foreign subsidiaries in Canada and India, and a smaller number of employees in several other countries, including the United Arab Emirates. In addition, we are planning to expand our data center locations to multiple geographies. We also on occasion provide services at our customers’ facilities, including those not located in the United States, and engage in sales and marketing efforts in many foreign jurisdictions. International activities are subject to the uncertainties associated with international business operations, including global laws and regulations, economic sanctions, tax laws and regulations, privacy laws, export and import regulations, duties, tariffs, and other trade restrictions and barriers, changes in trade policies, anti-corruption laws, foreign governmental regulations, potential vulnerability of and reduced protection for intellectual property, and our ability to acquire and retain local employees, any of which may harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects may also be harmed in the event of political conflicts, economic crises, wars, or other changes in international relations affecting countries where our subsidiaries, manufacturers, suppliers, and customers are located.
paras.zh: 除美国业务外，我们亦有国际业务。我们在加拿大和印度设有子公司，并在包括阿联酋在内的其他若干国家拥有少量员工。此外，我们正计划将数据中心选址扩展至多个地区。我们亦不时在客户设施（包括位于美国境外的设施）提供服务，并在多个外国司法管辖区开展销售与营销活动。国际活动受国际业务经营相关不确定性的影响，包括全球法律法规、经济制裁、税法与法规、隐私法、进出口法规、关税、税费及其他贸易限制与壁垒、贸易政策变化、反腐败法律、外国政府法规、知识产权潜在脆弱性及保护力度减弱，以及我们获取和留住本地员工的能力，上述任何一项均可能损害我们的业务、财务状况、经营成果和前景。若发生政治冲突、经济危机、战争或其他影响我们子公司、制造商、供应商和客户所在国家的国际关系变化，我们的业务、财务状况、经营成果和前景亦可能受到损害。

paras.en: A deterioration in relations between the United States and any country in which we have significant operations or sales, or the implementation of government regulations in such a country, may result in the adoption or expansion of trade restrictions, including economic sanctions and export license requirements, that may harm our business.
paras.zh: 美国与我们拥有重大业务或销售的任何国家之间关系恶化，或该等国家实施政府法规，可能导致贸易限制的采用或扩大，包括经济制裁和出口许可要求，从而可能损害我们的业务。

paras.en: **We plan to expand our international operations, including to jurisdictions where we have limited operating experience and may be subject to increased business and economic risks that may harm our financial condition and results of operations.**
paras.zh: **我们计划扩展国际业务，包括扩展至我们运营经验有限且可能面临更高商业和经济风险的司法管辖区，这可能损害我们的财务状况和经营成果。**

paras.en: We plan to continue the international expansion of our business operations. We may enter new international markets where we have limited or no experience in marketing, selling, and deploying our offerings. If we fail to deploy or manage our operations in these countries successfully, our business and operations may suffer. In addition, we are subject to a variety of risks inherent in doing business internationally, including:
paras.zh: 我们计划继续扩展我们的国际业务经营。我们可能进入我们在营销、销售和部署我们的产品方面经验有限或毫无经验的新国际市场。若我们未能成功在这些国家部署或管理我们的运营，我们的业务和经营可能受损。此外，我们面临在国际经营中固有的多种风险，包括：

paras.en: - political, social, and/or economic instability, including as a result of the ongoing conflicts between Russia and Ukraine and in the Middle East;
paras.zh: - 政治、社会和/或经济不稳定，包括因俄罗斯与乌克兰之间以及中东地区持续冲突所导致的不稳定；

paras.en: - risks related to governmental regulations in foreign jurisdictions and unexpected changes in regulatory requirements and enforcement;
paras.zh: - 与外国司法管辖区政府法规以及监管要求和执法意外变化相关的风险；

paras.en: - existing trade laws and regulations, including those related to exports and deemed exports of U.S. technology;
paras.zh: - 现行贸易法律法规，包括与出口及视同出口美国技术相关的法律法规；

paras.en: - changes in trade relationships, including the imposition of new trade restrictions and sanctions, trade embargoes, trade protection measures, export or import requirements, entity lists, tariffs, quotas, and other trade barriers and restrictions, including those related to the ongoing trade disputes between China and the United States;
paras.zh: - 贸易关系变化，包括实施新的贸易限制和制裁、贸易禁运、贸易保护措施、进出口要求、实体清单、关税、配额及其他贸易壁垒和限制，包括与中国和美国之间持续贸易争端相关的措施；

paras.en: - fluctuations in currency exchange rates;
paras.zh: - 汇率波动；

paras.en: - higher levels of credit risk and payment fraud;
paras.zh: - 更高的信用风险和支付欺诈风险；

paras.en: - enhanced difficulties of integrating any foreign acquisitions;
paras.zh: - 整合任何境外收购的难度加大；

paras.en: - burdens of complying with a variety of foreign laws;
paras.zh: - 遵守多种外国法律带来的负担；

paras.en: - reduced protection for intellectual property rights in some countries and practical difficulties in enforcing intellectual property and other rights outside the United States;
paras.zh: - 部分国家知识产权保护力度较弱，且在美国境外执行知识产权及其他权利存在实际困难；

paras.en: - difficulties in staffing and managing global operations and the increased travel, infrastructure and legal compliance costs associated with multiple international locations and subsidiaries;
paras.zh: - 全球运营的人员配备和管理困难，以及因多个国际地点和子公司而增加的差旅、基础设施和法律合规成本；

paras.en: - new and different sources of competition;
paras.zh: - 新的、不同的竞争来源；

paras.en: - different regulations and practices with respect to employee/employer relationships, existence of workers’ councils and labor unions, and other challenges caused by distance, language, and cultural differences, making it harder to do business in certain international jurisdictions;
paras.zh: - 在员工/雇主关系、工人委员会和工会的存在方面存在不同的法规和惯例，以及因距离、语言和文化差异造成的其他挑战，使得在某些国际司法管辖区开展业务更加困难；

paras.en: - different regulations and practices with respect to real property, data center leases, power and utilities, and environmental matters;
paras.zh: - 在不动产、数据中心租赁、电力和公用事业以及环境事项方面存在不同的法规和惯例；

paras.en: - compliance with statutory equity requirements; and
paras.zh: - 遵守法定权益要求；以及

paras.en: - management of tax consequences.
paras.zh: - 税务后果的管理。

paras.en: If we are unable to manage the complexity of our global operations successfully, our results of operations and financial condition may be harmed.
paras.zh: 如果我们无法成功管理全球运营的复杂性，我们的经营业绩和财务状况可能会受到损害。

paras.en: **Our business and ongoing expansion depend on attracting and retaining qualified personnel, especially our engineering and technical personnel.**
paras.zh: **我们的业务和持续扩张依赖于吸引和留住合格人员，尤其是我们的工程和技术人员。**

paras.en: Our success depends in large part on our ability to attract and retain highly qualified personnel. We strive to employ talented engineering and technical personnel, as well as effective sales, marketing, finance, and support employees, all of which are in high demand. Maintaining our brand and reputation, as well as a diverse and inclusive work environment that enables all our employees to thrive, is important to our ability to recruit and retain employees. There is intense competition for highly qualified technologists in the AI industry, particularly in the San Francisco Bay Area, where our headquarters are located, as well as in Toronto, Canada and in Bangalore, India, where we also have offices. We use various measures, including offering competitive salaries and benefits and an equity incentive program, to attract and retain the personnel we require to operate and grow our business effectively. However, these measures may not be sufficient, and our employees may decide not to continue working for us and leave us with little or no notice. Many of our competitors are significantly larger than we are, with greater financial resources and publicly traded stock, and may be able to offer more attractive compensation packages than we can, particularly with regard to equity compensation. As a result, it may be difficult for us to continue to retain and motivate these employees, and the value of their holdings could affect their decisions about whether or not they continue to work for us. Our ability to attract, retain and motivate employees may be adversely affected by declines in the price of our Class A common stock. If we issue significant equity to attract employees or to retain our existing employees, we would incur substantial additional stock-based compensation expense and the ownership of our existing stockholders would be further diluted. In addition, some of our employees are employed with us on temporary work visas, and any change in U.S. or other countries’ immigration laws affecting their status or such visas may make it difficult to retain such individuals or hire new personnel. The loss of even a few qualified employees, or an inability to attract, retain and motivate additional highly skilled employees could harm our ability to develop and sell our products, as well as our results of operations, and impair our ability to expand and grow our business.
paras.zh: 我们的成功在很大程度上取决于我们吸引和留住高素质人才的能力。我们努力聘用优秀的工程和技术人员，以及高效的销售、市场营销、财务和支持员工，而所有这些人才都需求旺盛。维护我们的品牌和声誉，以及营造一个多元、包容、能让所有员工茁壮成长的工作环境，对于我们招聘和留住员工的能力至关重要。AI 行业对高素质技术人才的竞争十分激烈，尤其是在我们总部所在地旧金山湾区，以及我们设有办公室的加拿大多伦多和印度班加罗尔。我们采取多种措施，包括提供有竞争力的薪酬和福利以及股权激励计划，来吸引和留住我们有效运营和发展业务所需的人员。然而，这些措施可能并不足够，我们的员工可能会决定不再为我们工作，并且在离职时几乎或完全不提前通知。我们的许多竞争对手规模显著大于我们，拥有更多的财务资源和公开交易的股票，可能能够提供比我们更具吸引力的薪酬方案，尤其是在股权薪酬方面。因此，我们可能难以继续留住和激励这些员工，而他们所持股份的价值可能影响他们是否继续为我们工作的决定。我们吸引、留住和激励员工的能力可能会受到我们 A 类普通股价格下跌的不利影响。如果我们发行大量股权以吸引员工或留住现有员工，我们将产生大量额外的股权激励费用，我们现有股东的所有权将被进一步稀释。此外，我们的一些员工是以临时工作签证受雇于我们，美国或其他国家移民法律的任何变化若影响他们的身份或此类签证，可能使我们难以留住这些个人或聘用新人员。即使失去少数合格员工，或无法吸引、留住和激励更多高技能员工，也可能损害我们开发和销售产品的能力以及我们的经营业绩，并削弱我们扩展和发展业务的能力。

paras.en: As our company grows and evolves, we may need to implement more complex organizational management structures, adapt our corporate culture and work environments, streamline our organization, or adjust the size and structure of our workforce to scale for the future and execute our long-term growth plan.
