paras.en: Speed enables AI to address more complex, higher value tasks. This, in turn, brings new users to AI, who use AI more frequently and to solve more complex problems. And herein is the flywheel. More users, more frequent users, and more complex use cases all increase AI compute usage.
paras.zh: 速度使 AI 能够处理更复杂、更高价值的任务。这反过来又为 AI 带来新用户，这些用户会更频繁地使用 AI，并用其解决更复杂的问题。飞轮效应正在于此。更多用户、更频繁的用户以及更复杂的使用场景，都会增加 AI 算力使用量。

paras.en: **Fast Inference Enables the Next Generation of AI Workloads, With Coding as a Clear Early Signal**
paras.zh: **快速推理赋能下一代 AI 工作负载，编程是明确的早期信号**

paras.en: As AI uses more compute to tackle increasingly complex problems, a fundamental challenge emerges: everyone wants a better response for complicated requests, but nobody wants to wait to get a response.
paras.zh: 随着 AI 使用更多算力来处理日益复杂的问题，一个根本性挑战浮现出来：每个人都希望复杂请求能得到更好的响应，但没有人愿意等待响应。

paras.en: We are solving this problem. Cerebras Inference delivers answers up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models. This speed advantage enables our solutions to deliver real-time performance for the most advanced reasoning models, enabling complex tasks to be completed more accurately and quickly.
paras.zh: 我们正在解决这一问题。根据在领先开源模型上的基准测试，Cerebras Inference 提供答案的速度最高可达领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案的 15 倍。这一速度优势使我们的解决方案能够为最先进的推理模型提供实时性能，从而更准确、更快速地完成复杂任务。

paras.en: As discussed, fast and accurate results delight users, drive engagement, and unlock new classes of applications and business opportunities. Faster AI compute produces answers in less time, which drives more frequent usage, new types of applications, and therefore greater compute demand.
paras.zh: 如前所述，快速而准确的结果能够取悦用户、提升参与度，并开启新的应用类别和商业机会。更快的 AI 算力能在更短时间内给出答案，从而带来更频繁的使用、新型应用，进而产生更大的算力需求。

paras.en: These dynamics are already visible in the market. Three fast-growing categories—software development, deep research systems, and voice applications—illustrate the importance of speed. For these and many other similar applications, inference speed is a necessity.
paras.zh: 这些动态已在市场中显现。三个快速增长的类别——软件开发、深度研究系统和语音应用——说明了速度的重要性。对于这些以及许多其他类似应用而言，推理速度是必需品。

paras.en: - AI-powered software development provides a clear early signal. Coding with AI is interactive and sensitive to delay. Delay impairs a developer’s train of thought, and as a result, developers are more likely to abandon tools that slow them down.
paras.zh: - AI 驱动的软件开发提供了一个清晰的早期信号。使用 AI 编程具有交互性，且对延迟敏感。延迟会打断开发者的思路，因此开发者更有可能放弃那些拖慢他们速度的工具。

paras.en: AI can now write code. It reasons over large codebases and then uses the multi-step process previously described to generate, modify, and run code. Inference speed has become a primary determinant for adoption. Products such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot act as autonomous collaborators—planning, editing, and validating code across repositories in response to natural-language instructions from developers. These systems require complex, multi-step tasks, including continuous reasoning and long-context memory. Fast inference is the only way to avoid frustrating wait times.
paras.zh: AI 现在能够编写代码。它会对大型代码库进行推理，然后使用前述的多步骤流程来生成、修改和运行代码。推理速度已成为决定采用与否的首要因素。Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、Windsurf 和 GitHub Copilot 等产品充当自主协作者——根据开发者用自然语言下达的指令，跨代码仓库规划、编辑和验证代码。这些系统需要复杂的多步骤任务，包括持续推理和长上下文记忆。快速推理是避免令人沮丧的等待时间的唯一途径。

paras.en: AI-native coding products barely existed in 2023. Yet they collectively generated billion s in ARR in 2025 and continue to accelerate. For example, AI coding applications like Lovable and Cursor are among some of the fastest growing developer tools in history. AI coding agents have become central to how software is written. Anthropic’s Claude Code is already at a reported annual revenue run rate of $2.5 billion as of February 2026; Claude Code’s creator said in January 2026 that he writes 100% of his code with AI. In addition, professional developers report that 42% of code is now AI-generated or assisted, according to a survey conducted by SonarSource in October 2025. By droves, software engineers are shifting from writing code to supervising fleets of AI coding agents. Faster inference means more productive engineers. Coding demonstrates a fundamental pattern in reasoning systems: wherever AI involves continuous interaction, multi-step reasoning, and sensitivity to response time, speed determines utility. Those same conditions are present across a growing set of AI applications.
paras.zh: AI 原生编程产品在 2023 年几乎还不存在。然而它们在 2025 年合计创造了数十亿美元的 ARR，并继续加速增长。例如，Lovable 和 Cursor 等 AI 编程应用是历史上增长最快的开发者工具之一。AI 编程智能体已成为软件编写方式的核心。据报道，截至 2026 年 2 月，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 年化收入运行率已达 $2.5 billion;Claude Code 的创造者于 2026 年 1 月表示，他的代码 100% 由 AI 编写。此外，根据 SonarSource 于 2025 年 10 月进行的一项调查，专业开发者报告称目前 42% 的代码由 AI 生成或辅助完成。大量软件工程师正从编写代码转向监督 AI 编程智能体集群。更快的推理意味着更高生产率的工程师。编程展示了推理系统中的一个基本模式：只要 AI 涉及持续交互、多步骤推理和对响应时间的敏感性，速度就决定了实用性。这些相同的条件存在于越来越多的 AI 应用中。

paras.en: - Deep research systems apply similar reasoning to knowledge work, performing multi-step retrieval and synthesis across large datasets to deliver structured insights in real time. Platforms such as AlphaSense rely on real-time inference to sift through a higher volume of documents to help analysts and enterprises find answers faster.
paras.zh: - 深度研究系统将类似的推理应用于知识工作，在大型数据集上执行多步骤检索与综合，以实时提供结构化洞察。AlphaSense 等平台依赖实时推理来筛选更大量的文档，帮助分析师和企业更快找到答案。

paras.en: - Voice applications include conversational agents, avatars, and digital twins from companies like Meta, Tavus, and OpenCall. Real-time performance is critical for voice: sub-second latency makes interactions feel natural and gives these systems time to call tools or retrieve data mid-conversation for richer, contextual responses.
paras.zh: - 语音应用包括来自 Meta、Tavus 和 OpenCall 等公司的对话式智能体、虚拟形象和数字孪生。实时性能对语音至关重要：亚秒级延迟使交互感觉自然，并让这些系统有时间在对话过程中调用工具或检索数据，从而给出更丰富、更具上下文关联的回复。

paras.en: Together, we believe these applications lead the way in the next phase of AI adoption: systems that think, act, and interact continuously, driving sustained demand for faster and more efficient compute infrastructure.
paras.zh: 我们相信，这些应用共同引领着 AI 应用的下一阶段：能够持续思考、行动和交互的系统，推动对更快、更高效算力基础设施的持续需求。

paras.en: In this environment, speed directly shapes usage. Long wait times limit real-time applications, stunt the diffusion of AI capabilities, and can inhibit new markets and applications. As a result, slow systems lose users, limit capability, and stall innovation, while faster systems are used more often and for more demanding workloads.
paras.zh: 在这种环境下，速度直接影响使用情况。漫长的等待时间限制了实时应用，阻碍了 AI 能力的普及，并可能抑制新市场和新应用的出现。因此，缓慢的系统会流失用户、限制能力并阻碍创新，而更快的系统则被更频繁地使用，并用于要求更高的工作负载。

paras.en: We believe speed is a defining advantage in modern AI. Reasoning is intelligence, and intelligence compounds with speed. We believe the ability to deliver fast, scalable reasoning will define not only the next decade of technology, but also shape the future of how people work, create, and interact.
paras.zh: 我们相信，速度是现代 AI 的决定性优势。推理即智能，而智能会随速度而累积。我们相信，提供快速、可扩展推理的能力不仅将定义下一个十年的技术，还将塑造人们工作、创造和交互方式的未来。

paras.en: We address a large and rapidly growing market for AI infrastructure. According to Dell’Oro Group, worldwide data center infrastructure capital expenditures are expected to grow from $679 billion in 2025 to $1.7 trillion by 2030, representing a 21% CAGR. AI infrastructure increasingly dominates global IT spending.
paras.zh: 我们所面对的是一个规模庞大且快速增长的 AI 基础设施市场。根据 Dell'Oro Group 的数据，全球数据中心基础设施资本支出预计将从 2025 年的 $679 billion 增长至 2030 年的 $1.7 trillion，复合年增长率（CAGR）为 21%。AI 基础设施正日益主导全球 IT 支出。

paras.en: #### Training

The AI training infrastructure market is expected to grow from approximately $185 billion in 2025 to $380 billion by 2029, a 20% CAGR, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. This market is characterized by large-scale capital buildouts as hyperscalers, foundation model labs, enterprises, and Sovereign AI initiatives, invest in developing foundation models and fine-tuning capabilities. We have demonstrated strong success in this market, most notably through hardware and models we’ve trained for G42, MBZUAI, GlaxoSmithKline, Sandia National Laboratory, the U.S. Department of Defense, and other training customers.
paras.zh: 根据 Bloomberg Intelligence 的数据，AI 训练基础设施市场预计将从 2025 年的约 $185 billion 增长至 2029 年的 $380 billion，复合年增长率为 20%。该市场的特点是超大规模云厂商、基础模型实验室、企业以及主权 AI 倡议进行大规模资本投入，以开发基础模型和微调能力。我们已在该市场展现出强劲的成功，尤其体现在我们为 G42、MBZUAI、GlaxoSmithKline、Sandia National Laboratory、美国国防部及其他训练客户训练硬件和模型方面。

paras.en: #### Inference
Based on Bloomberg Intelligence data, our addressable market within the AI inference market is expected to grow from approximately $66 billion in 2025 to $292 billion by 2029, a 45% CAGR.
paras.zh: 根据 Bloomberg Intelligence 的数据，我们在 AI 推理市场中的可服务市场预计将从 2025 年的约 $66 billion 增长至 2029 年的 $292 billion，复合年增长率为 45%。

paras.en: The AI inference market scales with the number of AI users, a number we expect to converge with the global internet user base over time. Inference compute can be accessed at the hardware level through on-premises deployments and at the cloud/API level, measured in tokens served. We serve both through Cerebras AI supercomputers, which are deployed directly in customer data centers, and Cerebras Inference Cloud, which addresses the token-based API market.
paras.zh: AI 推理市场随 AI 用户数量的增长而扩大，我们预计这一数字将随时间推移与全球互联网用户基数趋于一致。推理算力可在硬件层面通过本地部署获取，也可在云/API 层面获取，并以所服务的 token 数量计量。我们通过直接部署在客户数据中心的 Cerebras AI 超级计算机，以及面向基于 token 的 API 市场的 Cerebras Inference Cloud，同时服务这两类需求。

paras.en: The token-based market is expanding rapidly. In October 2025, Google reported Gemini was serving 1.3 quadrillion tokens per month—a market that was effectively zero before the launch of ChatGPT in late 2022. Cerebras Inference Cloud directly serves this market. Because the AI compute we provide is general purpose, we serve a wide range of models used across verticals—consumer applications, code generation, enterprise AI, and more. The same infrastructure that powers a chat application can power a financial model or a coding agent.
paras.zh: 基于 token 的市场正在快速扩张。2025 年 10 月，Google 报告 Gemini 每月处理 1.3 quadrillion 个 token——而在 2022 年末 ChatGPT 推出之前，这一市场实际上为零。Cerebras Inference Cloud 直接服务该市场。由于我们提供的 AI 算力具有通用性，我们服务于各垂直领域使用的广泛模型——消费级应用、代码生成、企业 AI 等。为聊天应用提供支持的同一基础设施，也可为金融模型或编程智能体提供支持。

paras.en: The combined market for AI training infrastructure and our addressable market within AI inference is estimated to be $251 billion in 2025 and is expected to grow to $672 billion by 2029—a 28% CAGR, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. This estimate indicates that AI inference will grow more than twice as fast as AI training infrastructure through 2029, and we expect AI inference to represent an increasing share of total AI infrastructure demand as deployed models scale to serve global user bases. With the fastest inference platform on the market, as benchmarked by Artificial Analysis, and a proven track record in large-scale training, we believe we are well-positioned to capture growth across both markets.
paras.zh: 根据 Bloomberg Intelligence 的数据，AI 训练基础设施市场与我们在 AI 推理中的可服务市场合计规模在 2025 年估计为 $251 billion，并预计到 2029 年增长至 $672 billion——复合年增长率为 28%。该估计表明，到 2029 年，AI 推理的增长速度将超过 AI 训练基础设施的两倍以上，并且我们预计，随着已部署模型扩展以服务全球用户基数，AI 推理将在 AI 基础设施总需求中占据越来越大的份额。凭借 Artificial Analysis 基准测试所认定的市场上最快的推理平台，以及在大规模训练方面经过验证的过往业绩，我们相信我们处于有利地位，能够把握这两个市场的增长机遇。

paras.en: We are building the fastest commercial AI infrastructure in the world. Our AI supercomputers are purpose built to make AI fast. They are built for the latency-sensitive, reasoning workloads that define modern AI. Our full-stack hardware and software platform is designed to complete AI tasks significantly faster and more efficiently than comparable GPU-based solutions, whether deployed on premises, through the Cerebras Cloud, or via partner clouds.
paras.zh: 我们正在打造全球最快的商用 AI 基础设施。我们的 AI 超级计算机专为让 AI 变快而构建。它们专为定义现代 AI 的延迟敏感型推理工作负载而打造。我们的全栈硬件和软件平台旨在比同类基于 GPU 的解决方案显著更快、更高效地完成 AI 任务，无论是在本地部署、通过 Cerebras Cloud 部署，还是通过合作伙伴云部署。

paras.en: #### 1. Hardware Platform
paras.zh: #### 1. 硬件平台

paras.en: At the core of our solution is the Cerebras WSE, the largest and fastest AI processor ever brought to market in high volumes. The WSE combines 900,000 compute cores, 44 gigabytes of on-chip memory, and 21 petabytes of memory bandwidth on the largest commercial chip ever built. The WSE-3 is 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip. The WSE has 19 times more transistors, 250 times more on-chip memory, and 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which contains two individual chips.
paras.zh: 我们解决方案的核心是 Cerebras WSE，这是迄今已实现大批量上市的最大、最快的 AI 处理器。WSE 在迄今已建成的最大商用芯片上集成了 900,000 个计算核心、44 吉字节片上内存和 21 拍字节内存带宽。WSE-3 的尺寸是 NVIDIA B200 芯片的 58 倍。WSE 的晶体管数量是 NVIDIA B200 封装（内含两颗独立芯片）的 19 倍，片上内存是其 250 倍，内存带宽是其 2,625 倍。

paras.en: Each WSE is housed inside a Cerebras CS-3 system, our fully integrated AI compute system that includes advanced cooling, power delivery, and interconnect technology. Multiple CS-3 systems connect to form Cerebras AI supercomputers deployed on premises in customer data centers and in the cloud.
paras.zh: 每颗 WSE 均封装于 Cerebras CS-3 系统之中，这是我们完全集成的 AI 算力系统，包含先进冷却、供电和互连技术。多台 CS-3 系统相互连接，构成部署在客户数据中心本地及云端的 Cerebras AI 超级计算机。

paras.en: The Cerebras CS-3 World’s Fastest AI System
paras.zh: Cerebras CS-3 全球最快的 AI 系统

paras.en: #### 2. Co-designed Software Platform
paras.zh: #### 2. 协同设计的软件平台

paras.en: Our software platform makes wafer-scale computing simple to use. It spans the full AI life cycle—from model programming and compilation, to training and inference, to cluster orchestration.
paras.zh: 我们的软件平台让晶圆级计算变得简单易用。它覆盖完整的 AI 生命周期——从模型编程与编译，到训练与推理，再到集群编排。

paras.en: - Cerebras Compiler compiles PyTorch models directly to the WSE, eliminating the need for CUDA or distributed programming and providing an easy-to-use developer experience.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Compiler 将 PyTorch 模型直接编译至 WSE，无需 CUDA 或分布式编程，并提供易于使用的开发者体验。

paras.en: - Cerebras Inference Serving Stack delivers ultra-low-latency inference with industry-standard APIs for production use.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Inference Serving Stack 通过行业标准 API 提供超低延迟推理，可供生产环境使用。

paras.en: - Cerebras Cluster Manager orchestrates multiple CS-3 systems into one logical AI supercomputer, handling scheduling, telemetry, and health monitoring at scale.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Cluster Manager 将多台 CS-3 系统编排为一台逻辑上的 AI 超级计算机，大规模处理调度、遥测和健康监控。

paras.en: Because every layer is co-designed with our hardware, customers can scale training and inference across frontier-size models without rewriting code or managing distributed infrastructure.
paras.zh: 由于每一层都与我们的硬件协同设计，客户无需重写代码或管理分布式基础设施，即可在前沿规模模型上扩展训练和推理。

paras.en: #### 3. Flexible Deployment Models
paras.zh: #### 3. 灵活的部署模式

paras.en: Our technology is designed to be delivered in the form that best accelerates a customer’s AI roadmap. Our platform is designed for flexibility—meeting organizations where they are, and scaling with them as their ambitions grow.
paras.zh: 我们的技术旨在以最能加速客户 AI 路线图的形式交付。我们的平台以灵活性为设计目标——在组织所处的阶段与其对接，并随着其雄心增长而扩展。

paras.en: - Cerebras Cloud: Provides high-performance AI compute through a simple API, allowing customers to serve open-source, fine-tuned, or proprietary models with production-grade reliability.
paras.zh: - Cerebras Cloud：通过简单的 API 提供高性能 AI 算力，使客户能够以生产级可靠性服务开源、微调或专有模型。

paras.en: - Partner Clouds: Offer seamless access to Cerebras systems through leading cloud providers including AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Marketplace, IBM watsonx Model Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, and Hugging Face, extending our reach across the global AI ecosystem.
paras.zh: - 合作伙伴云：通过包括 AWS Marketplace、Microsoft Marketplace、IBM watsonx Model Gateway、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenRouter 和 Hugging Face 在内的领先云服务商提供对 Cerebras 系统的无缝访问，将我们的覆盖范围扩展至全球 AI 生态。

paras.en: - On-Premises Deployments: Deliver fully integrated AI supercomputers and install them directly in customer environments, giving enterprises, Sovereign AI initiatives, national laboratories, and defense organizations complete control over data, performance, and operations. We also operate and manage large clusters of AI supercomputers for some of our customers.
paras.zh: - 本地部署：交付完全集成的 AI 超级计算机并直接安装于客户环境，使企业、主权 AI 计划、国家实验室和国防组织能够完全掌控数据、性能和运营。我们还为部分客户运营和管理大型 AI 超级计算机集群。

paras.en: - Hybrid Deployments: Enable customers to move fluidly between on-premises and cloud environments through a unified software stack, maintaining consistent performance and workflows as they scale.
paras.zh: - 混合部署：通过统一的软件栈使客户能够在本地和云环境之间流畅迁移，在扩展过程中保持一致性能和 workflows。

paras.en: Customers choose the consumption model that fits their needs—buying inference by the token, running training workloads by the week or month, reserving dedicated capacity for long-term production deployments, or purchasing on-premises infrastructure.
paras.zh: 客户选择适合自身需求的消费模式——按 token 购买推理、按周或按月运行训练工作负载、为长期生产部署预留专用容量，或购买本地基础设施。

paras.en: Customers Choose the Consumption Model that Fits Their Needs Cerebras Cloud On-Premises Shared Tier Try and explore. Dedicated Capacity Deploy in production. Partner Clouds Hyperscale Cloud Mass distribution. On-Premises Deployment Security & control.
paras.zh: 客户选择适合自身需求的消费模式 Cerebras Cloud 本地部署 共享层级 试用与探索。专用容量 部署于生产环境。合作伙伴云 超大规模云 大规模分发。本地部署 安全与控制。

paras.en: #### 4. AI Model Services
paras.zh: #### 4. AI 模型服务

paras.en: Our AI experts accelerate customers’ ability to take AI applications from concept to production. With deep experience training and deploying frontier-scale models across modalities, our team helps customers select model architectures, prepare large-scale training data, and train and fine-tune models for production. We also design optimized deployments for customers—training draft or speculative decoding models and tuning configurations to balance latency, throughput, and cost for each application.
paras.zh: 我们的 AI 专家加速客户将 AI 应用从概念推向生产的能力。凭借在跨模态训练和部署前沿规模模型方面的深厚经验，我们的团队帮助客户选择模型架构、准备大规模训练数据，并为生产训练和微调模型。我们还为客户设计优化部署——训练草稿模型或推测解码模型，并调整配置以平衡每个应用的延迟、吞吐量和成本。

paras.en: We excel at turning AI ambition into business results. By augmenting customer teams with advanced AI expertise, we help customers design, build, and deploy custom models that often outperform existing state of the art, giving customers a meaningful competitive advantage.
paras.zh: 我们擅长将 AI 雄心转化为业务成果。通过以先进的 AI 专业知识增强客户团队，我们帮助客户设计、构建和部署通常优于现有最先进水平的定制模型，为客户带来显著的竞争优势。

paras.en: Together, our hardware platform, unified software, and AI model services form an integrated platform that becomes increasingly valuable over time. As customers build models, workflows, and applications on Cerebras, the platform can become deeply embedded in their AI development and operations, leading to durable relationships.
paras.zh: 我们的硬件平台、统一软件和 AI 模型服务共同构成一个随时间推移价值日益提升的集成平台。随着客户在 Cerebras 上构建模型、workflows 和应用，该平台能够深度嵌入其 AI 开发与运营之中，从而形成持久的关系。

paras.en: #### What This Means for Customers
paras.zh: #### 这对客户意味着什么

paras.en: Our customers, which include hyperscalers, foundation model labs, AI-native and digital-native businesses, enterprises, and leaders of Sovereign AI initiatives, complete tasks dramatically faster than on GPU-based systems. Faster reasoning improves user experience, increases engagement, accelerates iteration, and enables new classes of AI applications. This speed advantage compounds in production environments, where reduced latency and shorter training cycles have meaningful business impact.
paras.zh: 我们的客户包括超大规模云服务商、基础模型实验室、AI 原生和数字原生企业、各类企业以及主权 AI 计划的领导者，他们完成任务的速度远快于基于 GPU 的系统。更快的推理能力可改善用户体验、提升参与度、加快迭代速度，并催生新类别的 AI 应用。这一速度优势在生产环境中会不断累积放大，因为更低的延迟和更短的训练周期会带来切实的业务影响。

paras.en: Through our full-stack AI offerings, we deliver tangible improvements across four key dimensions that define AI value in the real world: speed, quality, cost, and simplicity.
paras.zh: 通过我们的全栈 AI 产品，我们在定义 AI 现实价值的四个关键维度上带来切实改善：速度、质量、成本和简便性。

paras.en: #### 1. Speed: Real-Time Reasoning Unlocks New Benefits From AI
paras.zh: #### 1. 速度：实时推理释放 AI 的新价值

paras.en: Our systems achieve dramatically faster inference than GPU clusters, enabling applications such as real-time coding agents, nearly instant deep research, and digital twins that were previously impractical or impossible. Customers describe the leap in inference speed as akin to going from dial-up to broadband—an advancement that redefines what AI can do.
paras.zh: 我们的系统推理速度远快于 GPU 集群，使实时编程智能体、近乎即时的深度研究以及此前不切实际或不可能实现的数字孪生等应用成为可能。客户将推理速度的跃升形容为从拨号上网到宽带的跨越——这一进步重新定义了 AI 的能力边界。

paras.en: New classes of products that customers have built and use daily with Cerebras include:
paras.zh: 客户基于 Cerebras 构建并日常使用的新品类产品包括：

paras.en: - Real-time coding agents: Copilots that read, write, and debug code nearly instantly—turning AI into an interactive programming partner.
paras.zh: - 实时编程智能体：几乎即时读取、编写和调试代码的编程助手——将 AI 变为交互式编程伙伴。

paras.en: - Nearly instant deep research agents: Systems that analyze thousand s of documents in seconds, accelerating market, scientific, and policy research.
paras.zh: - 近乎即时的深度研究智能体：可在数秒内分析数千份文档的系统，加速市场、科学和政策研究。

paras.en: - Digital twins: Lifelike AI personas that think, speak, and react in real time. With Cerebras, avatars respond without awkward delays, and carry conversations that are more natural and interactive.
paras.zh: - 数字孪生：实时思考、说话和反应的逼真 AI 形象。借助 Cerebras，虚拟形象响应时没有尴尬的延迟，对话更加自然和具有互动性。

paras.en: #### 2. Quality: More Accurate Responses Faster
paras.zh: #### 2. 质量：更快获得更准确的回答

paras.en: On GPUs, latency forces a tradeoff between speed and intelligence. Developers often have to limit the accuracy of a response in order to have it delivered in a reasonable amount of time. Our offerings are designed to remove this tradeoff. Customers run long-context, multi-step reasoning models interactively, delivering higher-quality results without comparable delays. Our inference speed allows developers to use substantially more reasoning tokens while maintaining the same end-to-end task completion time. We turn quality from a limitation into a feature; customers can now serve some of the largest models at full strength, in nearly real time.
paras.zh: 在 GPU 上，延迟迫使人们在速度与智能之间做出取舍。开发者往往不得不限制回答的准确性，以便在合理时间内完成交付。我们的产品旨在消除这一取舍。客户可以交互式运行长上下文、多步推理模型，在无需承受类似延迟的情况下获得更高质量的结果。我们的推理速度使开发者能够使用多得多的推理 token，同时保持相同的端到端任务完成时间。我们将质量从一项限制转变为一项特性；客户现在可以近乎实时地以全功率运行部分规模最大的模型。

paras.en: #### 3. Cost: Higher Performance at Lower Power
paras.zh: #### 3. 成本：更低功耗实现更高性能

paras.en: Moving data from one chip to another is one of the most power-intensive parts of AI compute. And power is the largest contributor to operating expenses in AI compute.
paras.zh: 将数据从一颗芯片传输到另一颗芯片是 AI 算力中能耗最高的环节之一。而电力是 AI 算力运营支出的最大构成部分。

paras.en: Our wafer-scale architecture keeps data on-chip, reducing data movement significantly, which in turn reduces power consumption. It also eliminates layers of costly and complex networking equipment. By way of comparison, moving a bit of data on the WSE-3 consumes a fraction of the energy required to move the same bit of data over GPU interconnects.
paras.zh: 我们的晶圆级架构将数据保留在芯片上，显著减少数据搬运，进而降低功耗。它还省去了多层昂贵且复杂的网络设备。作为对比，在 WSE-3 上搬运一位数据所消耗的能量，仅为通过 GPU 互连搬运同样一位数据所需能量的一小部分。

paras.en: Because our performance advantages stem from fundamental architectural efficiency, we expect these benefits to endure across future generations that continue to build on our wafer-scale technology.
paras.zh: 由于我们的性能优势源于根本性的架构效率，我们预计这些优势将在未来继续基于我们的晶圆级技术构建的各代产品中得以延续。

paras.en: **4. Simplicity: One Platform; No Distributed Programming; Easy to Train and Deploy Models**
paras.zh: **4. 简洁性：单一平台；无需分布式编程；模型易于训练和部署**

paras.en: We eliminate the complexity of distributed programming across GPU clusters, which is one of the most challenging aspects of AI deployment. Even extremely large models run without code changes, and scale automatically and seamlessly across clusters of Cerebras systems. Because training, fine-tuning, and inference all occur on a unified platform, customers avoid the operational overhead of moving between different compute environments, enabling inference, fine-tuning, and training from scratch on the same cluster. Cerebras Compiler’s PyTorch integration makes model customization and compilation simple, the Inference Serving Stack enables deployment of frontier-sized models in minutes, and our AI experts support customers throughout the model life cycle to accelerate results. Cerebras’s deployment platform also allows customers to run models that were not trained on Cerebras hardware and still achieve exceptional inference performance.
paras.zh: 我们消除了跨 GPU 集群分布式编程的复杂性，而这是 AI 部署中最具挑战性的方面之一。即使是极大规模的模型也无需更改代码即可运行，并可在 Cerebras 系统集群间自动、无缝地扩展。由于训练、微调和推理均在同一统一平台上进行，客户无需承担在不同算力环境之间迁移的运营开销，从而可在同一集群上完成推理、微调和从零开始的训练。Cerebras 编译器的 PyTorch 集成使模型定制和编译变得简单，推理服务栈可在数分钟内完成前沿规模模型的部署，我们的 AI 专家在模型全生命周期内为客户提供支持以加速成果实现。Cerebras 的部署平台还允许客户运行并非在 Cerebras 硬件上训练的模型，同时仍能实现卓越的推理性能。

full.sec: Factors Preventing GPUs From Being Faster at AI
full.secZh: 阻碍 GPU 在 AI 领域更快运行的因素

paras.en: AI inference speed is limited by how fast data moves between memory and compute; this is called memory
paras.zh: AI 推理速度受限于数据在内存与算力之间移动的速度；这被称为内存

paras.en: **bandwidth.**

When a large language model generates a response, it predicts one word (token) at a time. Each token generated requires a large amount of data—all of the model weights—to be moved from memory to compute. Because each token depends on the previous one, this work cannot be parallelized, making AI inference speed fundamentally limited by memory bandwidth.
paras.zh: 当大语言模型生成回复时，它一次预测一个词（token）。每生成一个 token 都需要将大量数据——即全部模型权重——从内存移动到算力。由于每个 token 都依赖于前一个 token，这项工作无法并行化，使得 AI 推理速度从根本上受限于内存带宽。

paras.en: Al Inference is a Memory Bandwidth Problem; Inference is Sequential Work that Cannot be Parallelized During inference, all of the model weights move from memory to compute to generate each word. The bigger the model, the more “weight data” has to be moved. Generating 100 words takes 100 passes through all the parameters in the model. This cannot be parallelized and is limited by the memory bandwidth. The Quick Brown Compute V Fox Jumps The Quick Brown Over Time
paras.zh: AI 推理是一个内存带宽问题；推理是顺序工作，在推理过程中无法并行化，全部模型权重从内存移动到算力以生成每个词。模型越大，需要移动的“权重数据”就越多。生成 100 个词需要对模型中的所有参数进行 100 次遍历。这无法并行化，且受限于内存带宽。The Quick Brown Compute V Fox Jumps The Quick Brown Over Time

paras.en: GPUs were designed for graphics workloads. Graphics can tolerate slower memory movement because the highly parallelizable workload allows the GPU to keep many compute cores busy while more data is moved over, masking the memory latency. These workload characteristics made high-capacity off-chip memory, placed far away from the compute processor, a strong architectural choice for graphics.
paras.zh: GPU 是为图形工作负载设计的。图形可以容忍较慢的内存移动，因为高度可并行化的工作负载使 GPU 能够在移动更多数据的同时让许多计算核心保持忙碌，从而掩盖内存延迟。这些工作负载特征使得高容量片外内存——放置在远离计算处理器之处——成为图形处理的强有力架构选择。

paras.en: But the tradeoff of off-chip memory is speed. Off-chip memory connects to the compute processors through a narrow data “pipe” with low memory bandwidth. This was the right tradeoff for graphics, but it creates a critical limitation for AI speed, where data movement is the bottleneck. The result is a GPU “memory wall” for AI, where a GPU’s memory bandwidth cannot keep up with compute for AI workloads, and thereby limits the speed with which AI answers can be generated.
paras.zh: 但片外内存的代价是速度。片外内存通过一条狭窄的低内存带宽数据“管道”连接到计算处理器。这对图形而言是正确的取舍，但它对 AI 速度造成了关键限制，因为数据移动才是瓶颈。结果是 GPU 在 AI 方面遭遇“内存墙”，即 GPU 的内存带宽无法跟上 AI 工作负载的算力需求，从而限制了生成 AI 答案的速度。

paras.en: These are not software issues. They are the physical limits of the memory + GPU architecture.
paras.zh: 这些不是软件问题。它们是内存 + GPU 架构的物理极限。

paras.en: In order to be fast, we believe AI requires a fundamentally different architecture that solves the memory wall. Such architecture must provide vastly more memory bandwidth to enable data to move more quickly between memory and compute, which can thereby accelerate the generation of AI responses.
paras.zh: 为了达到高速，我们认为 AI 需要一种从根本上不同的架构来解决内存墙问题。这种架构必须提供大幅更高的内存带宽，使数据能够在内存与算力之间更快地移动，从而加速 AI 回复的生成。

paras.en: #### Wafer-Scale Integration: The Foundation
paras.zh: #### 晶圆级集成：基础

paras.en: Cerebras started with a simple question: How could a new class of processors be designed with the singular goal of solving the compute challenges presented by AI? Beginning with a clean slate, how could we avoid the trade-offs made for graphics and other workloads to ensure that every transistor, every single part of the processor, was optimized for the requirements of AI?
paras.zh: Cerebras 始于一个简单的问题：如何设计一类全新的处理器，以解决 AI 带来的算力挑战为唯一目标？从零开始，我们如何避免为图形及其他工作负载所做的权衡取舍，从而确保每一个晶体管、处理器的每一个部分都针对 AI 的需求进行优化？

paras.en: Our answer is wafer-scale integration. Wafer-scale integration enabled us to use a vastly faster memory and avoid the complexity of switches and routers and associated complexity necessary to link together thousand s of GPUs.
paras.zh: 我们的答案是晶圆级集成。晶圆级集成使我们能够使用速度大幅提升的存储器，并避免交换机与路由器带来的复杂性，以及将数千个 GPU 连接在一起所必需的相应复杂性。

paras.en: SRAM is the fastest memory to date. But existing industry players could not use as much SRAM because they could not fit it on their chip. By building a chip 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip, we can maximize fast, on-chip SRAM and get the benefits of two worlds: (1) significantly more memory capacity because we built such a big chip, and (2) the benefits of the massive bandwidth provided by SRAM. Wafer scale enables us to deliver a solution with 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which is how we are able to deliver inference at extremely fast speeds.
paras.zh: SRAM 是迄今为止速度最快的存储器。但现有行业参与者无法使用同样多的 SRAM，因为他们无法将其容纳在芯片上。通过构建一个比 NVIDIA 的 B200 芯片大 58 倍的芯片，我们能够最大化快速的片上 SRAM，并获得两方面的优势：(1) 由于我们构建了如此大的芯片，存储容量显著增加；(2) 获得 SRAM 所提供的巨大带宽带来的优势。晶圆级使我们能够交付一个内存带宽比 NVIDIA 的 B200 封装高 2,625 倍的解决方案，这正是我们能够以极快速度提供推理的原因。

paras.en: The second fundamental advantage provided by wafer-scale integration is that it kept the wafer intact. Instead of building a wafer, cutting it into dozens of small GPUs, and using expensive, power-hungry switches, and complex cables to wire them back together, our solution consists of one processor that is the size of an entire silicon wafer. This reduced the need, cost, managerial complexity, and power draw of much of the networking stack required to build a GPU solution.
paras.zh: 晶圆级集成提供的第二个根本性优势在于它保持了晶圆的完整性。我们的解决方案不是先制造一片晶圆、将其切割成数十个小 GPU，再使用昂贵、高功耗的交换机和复杂的线缆将它们重新连接起来，而是由一个与整片硅晶圆尺寸相当的处理器构成。这减少了对构建 GPU 解决方案所需的大部分网络堆栈的需求、成本、管理复杂性和功耗。

paras.en: Our wafer-scale solution unifies compute and memory and communications on the same piece of silicon, eliminating the data-movement bottlenecks that slow GPU systems.
paras.zh: 我们的晶圆级解决方案将算力、存储器和通信统一在同一片硅片上，消除了拖慢 GPU 系统的数据传输瓶颈。

paras.en: #### The Underpinnings of Wafer-Scale Integration
paras.zh: #### 晶圆级集成的基础

paras.en: We solved a problem that flummoxed the compute industry for its entire history: how to build chips the size of full silicon wafers. The advantages of size were well known. But no company had ever brought a wafer-scale solution to market.
paras.zh: 我们解决了一个困扰算力行业整个历史的问题：如何构建整片硅晶圆大小的芯片。尺寸带来的优势众所周知。但此前没有任何公司曾将晶圆级解决方案推向市场。

paras.en: To make wafer-scale commercially viable, we invented and productized two foundational semiconductor technologies:
paras.zh: 为使晶圆级在商业上可行，我们发明并产品化了两个基础性半导体技术：

paras.en: - Multi-die interconnect: Traditionally, die—regions of silicon containing an integrated circuit—are individually stamped onto a silicon wafer and then cut up (“diced”) into small, separate chips. Prior to Cerebras, the largest known chip was about 840 mm2. We invented technology to interconnect these otherwise independent die together at the wafer level, at the semiconductor fabrication plant. The inter-die connectivity uses a proprietary cross-reticle connection that is integrated into our overall fabrication process. This allowed us to use existing processes to do something we believe had never been done before —namely, deliver a wafer that communicated across the entire 46,225 mm2 of silicon and therefore is a single massive processor.
paras.zh: - 多裸片互连：传统上，裸片——即包含集成电路的硅区域——被逐个压印到硅晶圆上，然后被切割（“划片”）成小型、独立的芯片。在 Cerebras 之前，已知最大的芯片约为 840 mm2。我们发明了在半导体制造厂中于晶圆层面将这些原本独立的裸片互连在一起的技术。裸片间连接采用专有的跨掩模版连接，并集成到我们的整体制造工艺中。这使我们能够利用现有工艺做到我们认为此前从未有人做到的事情——即交付一片可在整个 46,225 mm2 硅片上实现通信的晶圆，从而构成一个单一的大型处理器。

paras.en: - Fault-tolerant architecture: A primary factor in the commercial viability of a semiconductor is the yield. Flaws are present in wafers. Large chips have a higher probability of hitting such a flaw. Traditionally, chips with flaws have been thrown out or “down binned,” that is, sold as a less capable part. Thus, using traditional techniques, larger chips have lower yield and are therefore more expensive. We designed the architecture to absorb and route around defects using redundant building blocks—similar to a hyperscale data center but on the wafer. Flaws are designed to be recognized, shut down, and routed around. Redundant building blocks are used to re-form a logically functional whole. This approach had been previously used in memory manufacturing to achieve near-perfect yield, but to our knowledge, prior to Cerebras had not been used to build processors.
paras.zh: - 容错架构：半导体商业可行性的一个主要因素是良率。晶圆中会存在缺陷。大芯片遇到此类缺陷的概率更高。传统上，有缺陷的芯片会被丢弃或“降级”，即作为性能较低的部件出售。因此，采用传统技术时，较大的芯片良率较低，因而成本更高。我们设计的架构使用冗余构建模块来吸收缺陷并绕开缺陷——类似于超大规模数据中心，但发生在晶圆上。缺陷被设计为可被识别、关闭并绕开。冗余构建模块用于重新构成逻辑上功能完整的整体。这种方法此前曾用于存储器制造以实现近乎完美的良率，但据我们所知，在 Cerebras 之前，尚未被用于构建处理器。

paras.en: These innovations made wafer-scale computing commercially viable for the first time in semiconductor history.
paras.zh: 这些创新使晶圆级计算在半导体历史上首次具备商业可行性。

paras.zh: Cerebras WSE-3 与 NVIDIA B200 “Blackwell”对比 Cerebras WSE 3 4 万亿晶体管 46.225 mm2 硅片 NVIDIA B200 封装 2080 亿晶体管 ~ 1,600 mm2 硅片（合计）注：图片仅为示意，比例约为近似值。

paras.en: #### The Cerebras Chip, System, and Software
paras.zh: #### Cerebras 芯片、系统与软件

paras.en: Cerebras delivers a full-stack AI infrastructure solution. It contains innovations at each layer. At the base is the Cerebras WSE, our wafer-scale processor. Each WSE is integrated into a CS-3 system with advanced power delivery, cooling, and system management. Multiple CS-3 systems link together to form Cerebras AI supercomputers that are deployed in data centers around the world.
paras.zh: Cerebras 提供全栈 AI 基础设施解决方案。它在每一层都包含创新。最底层是 Cerebras WSE，即我们的晶圆级处理器。每个 WSE 都集成到 CS-3 系统中，配备先进的供电、冷却和系统管理。多个 CS-3 系统连接在一起，组成部署于全球数据中心的 Cerebras AI 超级计算机。

paras.en: Lightweight management and orchestration software operate these systems as one logical computer, while our training and inference platforms make it simple to run large models at scale. Because each layer is designed with the others in mind, the platform delivers consistent performance, reduced infrastructure complexity, and faster time to deployment and results.
paras.zh: 轻量级管理与编排软件将这些系统作为一个逻辑计算机运行，而我们的训练和推理平台使大规模运行大型模型变得简单。由于每一层在设计时都考虑到了其他层，该平台可提供一致的性能、降低基础设施复杂性，并加快部署和取得结果的时间。

paras.en: #### 1. The Chip: Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine
paras.zh: #### 1. 芯片：Cerebras 晶圆级引擎

paras.en: At the heart of our platform is the Cerebras WSE, the world’s largest and fastest commercialized AI processor. A single WSE replaces an entire cluster of GPUs by combining 900,000 compute cores and 44 gigabytes of on-chip memory on one piece of silicon, with 21 petabytes per second of on-chip memory bandwidth. The WSE-3 is 58 times larger than NVIDIA’s B200 chip. The WSE-3 also has 19 times more transistors, 250 times more on-chip memory, and 2,625 times more memory bandwidth than NVIDIA’s B200 package, which contains two individual chips.
paras.zh: 我们平台的核心是 Cerebras WSE，这是全球最大、最快的已商业化 AI 处理器。单个 WSE 将 900,000 个计算核心和 44 GB 片上内存集成在一块硅片上，片上内存带宽达 21 PB/s，从而取代整个 GPU 集群。WSE-3 比 NVIDIA 的 B200 芯片大 58 倍。WSE-3 的晶体管数量还多 19 倍，片上内存多 250 倍，内存带宽比 NVIDIA 的 B200 封装（包含两个独立芯片）多 2,625 倍。

paras.en: We believe our architecture solves for memory bandwidth, which is a primary bottleneck in modern AI. By keeping compute and memory on a single chip, WSE-3 eliminates the off-chip data transfers that dominate GPU latency and power consumption. As a result, our systems are faster, simpler to program, and more power-efficient than GPUs on AI tasks.
paras.zh: 我们相信我们的架构解决了内存带宽问题，而这是现代 AI 的主要瓶颈。通过将计算和内存保留在单个芯片上，WSE-3 消除了主导 GPU 延迟和功耗的片外数据传输。因此，在 AI 任务上，我们的系统比 GPU 更快、更易于编程，且能效更高。

paras.en: Fast inference depends on memory bandwidth. Below, we show the traditional GPU architecture with HBM, a type of off chip DRAM, and a GPU. For the GPU to generate a single word based on an inference prompt for a 70 billion parameter model, it must move more than 140 gigabytes of data from memory to compute. That is roughly 100 1-hour HD movies. This is to generate a single word. And this must be done again and again for each word in sequence.
paras.zh: 快速推理取决于内存带宽。下面我们展示采用 HBM（一种片外 DRAM）和 GPU 的传统 GPU 架构。对于 70 亿参数模型，GPU 要基于推理提示生成单个词，必须将超过 140 GB 的数据从内存移动到计算单元。这大约相当于 100 部 1 小时高清电影。而这仅仅是为了生成单个词。并且，对于序列中的每个词，都必须一遍又一遍地重复这一过程。

paras.en: Traditional GPU Architectures with HBM are Limited by Memory Bandwidth In a GPU, HBM memory is off-chip, far away from the compute. Moving weights from HBM and compute takes times and produces slower inference. GPU Compute “fox” A 70B parameter model is 140 GB of data. This is about 100 Movies worth of data. This data must travel across this wire to generate each word.
paras.zh: 采用 HBM 的传统 GPU 架构受限于内存带宽 在 GPU 中，HBM 内存位于片外，远离计算单元。将权重从 HBM 移动到计算单元需要时间，并导致推理变慢。GPU 计算 “fox”一个 70B 参数模型是 140 GB 的数据。这大约相当于 100 部电影的数据量。要生成每个词，这些数据都必须经过这条线路传输。

paras.en: The speed of generating a response is limited by the rate at which data can move from memory to computer. In the figure below, we show the underpinning of our performance advantage. We have a 2,625 times larger pipe between memory and compute. More data can move though our pipes, meaning we generate “words” (tokens) much more quickly.
paras.zh: 生成响应的速度受限于数据从内存移动到计算单元的速度。在下图中，我们展示了我们性能优势的基础。我们在内存与计算单元之间拥有 2,625 倍大的管道。更多数据可以通过我们的管道传输，这意味着我们生成“词”（token）的速度要快得多。

paras.en: Cerebras WSE Delivers 2,625 Times More Memory Bandwidth than NVIDIA’S B200 Package, Resulting in Up to 15 Times Faster Inference Speeds GPU Cerebras WSE Memory BW: 21,000 Terabytes/s The WSE puts massive amounts of high-performance SRAM directly on the wafer. Faster memory, closer to compute, delivers faster results.
paras.zh: Cerebras WSE 提供的内存带宽是 NVIDIA B200 封装的 2,625 倍，从而实现最高 15 倍的推理速度 GPU Cerebras WSE 内存带宽：21,000 TB/s WSE 将大量高性能 SRAM 直接置于晶圆上。更快的内存、更接近计算单元，带来更快的结果。

paras.en: #### 2. CS-3: System Innovation for Wafer-Scale Compute
paras.zh: #### 2. CS-3:面向晶圆级计算的系统创新

paras.en: The WSE-3 is deployed inside the CS-3 system, a data center-ready appliance engineered to support wafer-scale operation and integrate seamlessly into enterprise and Sovereign AI environments. The CS-3 provides the power delivery, cooling, networking, and system management required to operate a wafer-scale processor reliably and at scale. Multiple CS-3 systems can be connected to form Cerebras AI supercomputers, which function as a single logical computer for large-scaletraining and inference.
paras.zh: WSE-3 部署在 CS-3 系统内，这是一款面向数据中心、专为支持晶圆级运行而设计、并可无缝集成到企业和主权 AI 环境中的设备。CS-3 提供可靠、大规模运行晶圆级处理器所需的供电、冷却、网络和系统管理。多台 CS-3 系统可以连接组成 Cerebras AI 超级计算机，在大规模训练和推理中作为一台单一逻辑计算机运行。

We have been yielding, packaging, delivering, and running software on the industry’s first commercial wafer-scale AI systems since 2020.

paras.en: #### 3. Cerebras Software: Making Wafer-Scale Simple
paras.zh: #### 3. Cerebras 软件：让晶圆级变得简单

paras.en: Our software platform extends our hardware advantage by making wafer-scale computing simple to use and highly efficient. Our software spans the full AI life cycle—from programming and compiling models, to training and inference, to orchestration across large clusters. Each layer is co-designed with our hardware to deliver maximum performance with minimal developer effort.
paras.zh: 我们的软件平台使晶圆级计算易于使用且高效，从而延伸了我们的硬件优势。我们的软件覆盖完整的 AI 生命周期——从模型编程与编译，到训练与推理，再到跨大型集群的编排。每一层都与我们的硬件协同设计，以最小的开发者投入实现最高性能。

paras.en: Model Programming and Compilation. Our Cerebras Compiler (CSoft) makes it simple to run large language models on our systems. CSoft is core to our solution and provides intuitive usability for developers. CSoft eliminates the need for low-level programming in CUDA or other hardware-specific languages.
paras.zh: 模型编程与编译。我们的 Cerebras 编译器（CSoft）使在我们的系统上运行大型语言模型变得简单。CSoft 是我们解决方案的核心，为开发者提供直观的易用性。CSoft 消除了使用 CUDA 或其他硬件专用语言进行底层编程的需要。

paras.en: For both training and inference, our CSoft platform enables developers to easily represent and map large language models onto the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine using familiar frameworks such as PyTorch. Starting from a user’s PyTorch model, the CSoft graph compiler automatically maps model operations to the WSE, creating an optimized executable without user-level intervention.
paras.zh: 对于训练和推理，我们的 CSoft 平台使开发者能够使用 PyTorch 等熟悉的框架，轻松地将大型语言模型表示并映射到 Cerebras 晶圆级引擎上。从用户的 PyTorch 模型出发，CSoft 图编译器自动将模型运算映射到 WSE，在无需用户干预的情况下生成优化的可执行文件。

paras.en: CSoft allows machine-learning users to accelerate training and inference on models of any size, scaled across any configuration of the Cerebras AI supercomputer, just by changing one number in a configuration file, simulating a single-device programming experience without the complexities of distributed programming. This drastically reduces operational overhead and speeds up developer iteration time and business impact.
paras.zh: CSoft 使机器学习用户能够加速任意规模模型的训练和推理，并可在 Cerebras AI 超级计算机的任意配置上扩展，只需更改配置文件中的一个数字，即可模拟单设备编程体验，而无需应对分布式编程的复杂性。这大幅降低了运营开销，并加快了开发者的迭代时间和业务影响。

paras.en: Inference Serving Stack. Our Cerebras Inference Serving Stack manages model hosting, scaling, and request routing across Cerebras systems and clusters. It provides real-time observability and load balancing, enabling ultra-low-latency inference for production workloads. Customers can serve both open-source and proprietary models through standard APIs, including industry-standard endpoints, with consistent performance across on-premises and cloud deployments.
paras.zh: 推理服务栈。我们的 Cerebras 推理服务栈负责跨 Cerebras 系统和集群的模型托管、扩展和请求路由。它提供实时可观测性和负载均衡，为生产工作负载实现超低延迟推理。客户可通过标准 API（包括行业标准端点）提供开源和专有模型服务，并在本地部署和云部署中保持一致的性能。

paras.en: Orchestration and Life Cycle Management. Our Cerebras Cluster Manager orchestration software unifies multiple CS-3 systems into a single logical computer, managing scheduling, telemetry, and health monitoring. Built-in observability of all hardware and software components is designed to ensure reliability and high utilization across on-premises and in cloud environments. This orchestration layer also allows customers to switch seamlessly between training and inference on the same systems. With simple commands, CS-3 systems can be reconfigured from large-scale model training to real-time inference, driving utilization and shortening deployment cycles.
paras.zh: 编排与生命周期管理。我们的 Cerebras 集群管理器编排软件将多个 CS-3 系统统一为一台逻辑计算机，管理调度、遥测和健康监控。对所有硬件和软件组件的内置可观测性旨在确保本地和云环境中的可靠性和高利用率。该编排层还允许客户在同一系统上无缝切换训练和推理。通过简单的命令，CS-3 系统即可从大规模模型训练重新配置为实时推理，从而提升利用率并缩短部署周期。

paras.en: Together, these components form a unified software platform that integrates seamlessly with our hardware to deliver a complete, end-to-end AI computing system that can be deployed on customer premises or in the cloud.
paras.zh: 这些组件共同构成一个统一的软件平台，与我们的硬件无缝集成，交付一套完整、端到端的 AI 计算系统，可部署在客户本地或云端。

paras.en: Because our software and hardware are co-designed, customers can train and/or deploy frontier-scale models with consistent and simple workflows—without rewriting code or managing distributed infrastructure.
paras.zh: 由于我们的软件和硬件是协同设计的，客户能够以一致且简单的工作流程训练和/或部署前沿规模模型——无需重写代码或管理分布式基础设施。

paras.en: Cerebras Software Platform Makes Wafer Scale Easy To Use Across Training and Inference Model Deployment Model Pre-training Model Serving Model Fine-tuning Cerebras Compiler (CSOFT) - Automatically compiles PyTorch models to WSE Cluster Management Platform . Management & Orchestration Security Upgrades Scheduling Monitoring
paras.zh: Cerebras 软件平台让晶圆级规模在训练与推理中易于使用 模型部署 模型预训练 模型服务 模型微调 Cerebras 编译器（CSOFT）- 自动将 PyTorch 模型编译至 WSE 集群管理平台。管理与编排 安全 升级 调度 监控

paras.en: Wafer-scale integration is not a single achievement—it is a collection of technologies and processes with a multi-generation roadmap. Each successive WSE generation (from 16 nanometer to 7 nanometer and now to 5 nanometer) has delivered substantial improvements in performance, memory bandwidth, efficiency, yield, and manufacturability, without requiring changes to how developers program or deploy models.
paras.zh: 晶圆级集成并非单一成就——它是一系列技术与工艺的集合，并拥有多代路线图。每一代后续 WSE（从 16 纳米到 7 纳米，再到如今的 5 纳米）都在性能、内存带宽、效率、良率和可制造性方面带来了大幅提升，且无需改变开发者编写或部署模型的方式。

paras.en: Competing approaches—such as multi-die packages and chiplet based designs—remain constrained by the physics of small chips and limited off-chip memory bandwidth. Even with advances in packaging technology, these architectures cannot match the bandwidth, locality, or simplicity of computation that result from keeping compute and memory together on a single piece of silicon.
paras.zh: 竞争性方案——例如多芯片封装和基于芯粒的设计——仍受制于小芯片的物理特性以及有限的片外内存带宽。即便封装技术取得进步，这些架构也无法匹敌将计算与内存置于同一片硅片上所带来的带宽、局部性或计算简洁性。

paras.en: Our roadmap builds on the advantages of wafer-scale integration. We intend to invest heavily in research and development to continue to expand on-chip memory and memory bandwidth, improve interconnect density, and leverage advancements in process technology to increase transistor counts and reduce power in future WSE generations. As a result, we expect that future generations of WSEs will have faster compute, and more and faster memory and communication onto and off of the wafer.
paras.zh: 我们的路线图建立在晶圆级集成的优势之上。我们打算在研发上大力投入，以持续扩展片上内存和内存带宽、提升互连密度，并利用工艺技术的进步，在未来各代 WSE 中提高晶体管数量并降低功耗。因此，我们预计未来各代 WSE 将具备更快的算力，以及更多、更快的晶圆上及进出晶圆的内存与通信能力。

paras.en: Because the WSE presents itself as a single programmable device, these improvements compound naturally in both performance and simplicity, without introducing the complexity of massive distributed compute clusters of GPU solutions.
paras.zh: 由于 WSE 表现为单一可编程设备，这些改进在性能和简洁性上自然叠加，而不会引入 GPU 方案那种大规模分布式算力集群的复杂性。

paras.en: The same architectural foundation also supports long-term extensibility across emerging AI workloads. As models grow in size, increase in reasoning depth, and shift toward real-time, multi-step interactions, they place even greater emphasis on memory bandwidth and locality—all areas where wafer-scale architectures possess inherent, structural advantages.
paras.zh: 同样的架构基础还支持面向新兴 AI 工作负载的长期可扩展性。随着模型规模增大、推理深度增加，并转向实时、多步骤交互，它们对内存带宽和局部性的重视程度更高——而这些正是晶圆级架构具备固有结构性优势的领域。

paras.en: Our roadmap includes development of a disaggregated inference-serving solution.
paras.zh: 我们的路线图包括开发一种解耦式推理服务方案。

paras.en: Inference disaggregation is a technique that separates AI inference into two stages: prompt processing, or “prefill,” and output generation, or “decode.” These two stages have different computational characteristics. Prefill is natively parallel and requires very little memory bandwidth. Decode, on the other hand, is inherently serial and memory bandwidth intensive. Decode is typically the bottleneck. It dominates total inference time, and defines the speed of the user experience.
paras.zh: 推理解耦是一种将 AI 推理分为两个阶段的技术：提示处理（即“预填充”）和输出生成（即“解码”）。这两个阶段具有不同的计算特性。预填充天然并行，所需内存带宽极低。而解码本质上是串行的，且内存带宽密集。解码通常是瓶颈。它主导总推理时间，并决定用户体验的速度。

paras.en: Cerebras’s wafer-scale engine would be the fastest at both prefill and decode, but in relative terms, it is much faster at decode. Our wafer-scale architecture and ultra-high memory bandwidth delivers faster output token generation where speed matters most. Disaggregated inference would allow Cerebras to operate alongside other architectures, serving as the high-performance engine for decode while other systems handle prefill.
paras.zh: Cerebras 的晶圆级引擎在预填充和解码两方面都将是最快的，但相对而言，它在解码方面快得多。我们的晶圆级架构和超高内存带宽在速度最为关键的环节实现更快的输出 token 生成。解耦式推理将使 Cerebras 能够与其他架构协同运行，作为解码的高性能引擎，而由其他系统处理预填充。

paras.en: We believe wafer-scale computing positions us as a leader in AI infrastructure, providing a long-term technology roadmap designed to scale with the requirements of modern and future AI systems.
paras.zh: 我们相信，晶圆级计算使我们成为 AI 基础设施领域的领导者，提供旨在随现代及未来 AI 系统需求而扩展的长期技术路线图。

full.sec: 1. Our culture of fearless engineering has enabled us to do pioneering engineering work; we are the
full.secZh: 1. 我们无畏工程的文化使我们能够开展开创性的工程工作；我们是

paras.en: only company ever to deliver a wafer-scale processor to market. Our culture of fearless engineering enables us to solve problems that others failed to solve or were afraid to tackle. As a result, we have solved problems that had remained unsolved for the entire 75-year history of the compute industry, namely wafer-scale integration. A culture of fearless engineering is a foundation for our continued innovation.
paras.zh: 是唯一一家将晶圆级处理器推向市场的公司。我们无畏工程的文化使我们能够解决他人未能解决或不敢着手的问题。因此，我们解决了算力行业整整 75 年历史中一直未解决的问题，即晶圆级集成。无畏工程的文化是我们持续创新的基础。

paras.en: 2. We have durable advantages rooted in our unique silicon architecture. We believe wafer-scale integration is a fundamental advantage in AI compute, enabling large amounts of high-speed memory and hundreds of thousand s of compute cores to reside close together on the same piece of silicon. We have now delivered three generations of wafer-scale processors at the 16, 7, and 5 nanometer nodes. We believe these will be the foundation of our future generations of silicon.
paras.zh: 2. 我们拥有植根于独特硅架构的持久优势。我们相信晶圆级集成是 AI 算力的一项根本性优势，使大量高速内存和数十万个计算核心能够紧密共存于同一片硅片上。我们现已交付三代晶圆级处理器，分别采用 16、7 和 5 纳米制程节点。我们相信这些将成为我们未来几代硅产品的基础。

paras.en: 3. We are an end-to-end systems company. From inception, we co-designed our wafer-scale engine, our CS-system, and our software stack for optimal AI performance. We were among the first in the AI community to deliver water cooling to the processor, enabling us to run colder and extend our processors’ lifetime. The co-design of processor, system, and software is a meaningful competitive advantage.
paras.zh: 3. 我们是一家端到端系统公司。自成立之初，我们就协同设计了我们的晶圆级引擎、我们的 CS 系统和我们的软件栈，以实现最优的 AI 性能。我们是 AI 社区中最早将水冷引入处理器的公司之一，这使我们能够以更低的温度运行并延长处理器的使用寿命。处理器、系统和软件的协同设计是一项有意义的竞争优势。

paras.en: 4. We are building the fastest inference infrastructure in the world. On Cerebras infrastructure, AI responses are up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models. Third-party benchmarker Artificial Analysis wrote in August 2024, “Cerebras Inference is achieving the fastest speeds we have ever benchmarked on Artificial Analysis.” Speed is customer experience. It enables more accurate answers in less time. It enables applications that require real-time interaction such as coding agents, research agents, and voice interfaces. Speed changes the way companies design their experiences; it changes team structures and behaviors; it changes expectations and the perception of what is possible, which can make returning to slower speeds more painful.
paras.zh: 4. 我们正在建设世界上速度最快的推理基础设施。在 Cerebras 基础设施上，以领先的开源模型为基准，AI 响应速度最高可达领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案的 15 倍。第三方基准测试机构 Artificial Analysis 在 2024 年 8 月写道：“Cerebras Inference 达到了我们在 Artificial Analysis 上基准测试过的最快速度。”速度就是客户体验。它能在更短时间内给出更准确的答案。它使需要实时交互的应用成为可能，例如编程智能体、研究智能体和语音界面。速度改变了企业设计其体验的方式；它改变了团队结构和行为；它改变了期望以及对可能性的认知，这可能会让回到较慢的速度变得更加痛苦。

paras.en: 5. We are serving some of the largest and most demanding customers in the AI market. We are engaged with customers such as OpenAI, the world’s leading foundation model lab, and AWS, the world’s leading hyperscale cloud, who have stringent requirements for performance, scale, and reliability. We offer a full-stack hardware and software platform that can be optimized for each customer’s workloads and paired with AI services in order to deploy and operate high-capacity, production-grade systems without requiring customers to manage complex infrastructure.
paras.zh: 5. 我们正在服务 AI 市场中一些规模最大、要求最苛刻的客户。我们与 OpenAI（全球领先的基础模型实验室）和 AWS（全球领先的超大规模云服务商）等客户开展合作，这些客户对性能、规模和可靠性有着严格要求。我们提供全栈硬件和软件平台，可针对每个客户的工作负载进行优化，并与 AI 服务配合使用，从而部署和运营高容量、生产级系统，而无需客户管理复杂的基础设施。

paras.en: 6. We operate at massive scale with more than 100 exaflops of deployed compute. In collaboration with our partners, we have trained some of the largest models in the industry, gaining unique experience and providing rare insight. We have contracted for capacity in multiple data centers across North America and Europe, providing geographic redundancy and regional deployment options for customers with data residency or network time requirements.
paras.zh: 6. 我们以大规模运营，已部署算力超过 100 exaflops。我们与合作伙伴携手，训练了业内一些最大的模型，获得了独特经验并提供了罕见洞见。我们已在北美和欧洲的多个数据中心签约获取容量，为有数据驻留或网络时延要求的客户提供地理冗余和区域部署选项。

full.sec: Our Business Model: Make Buying Easy, by Reaching Customers Where They Are
full.secZh: 我们的业务模式：让购买变得简单，通过触达客户所在之处

paras.en: The AI market is one of the fastest-growing technology sectors in history. Within this rapidly evolving landscape, we engage customers through a combination of direct sales and an ecosystem of strategic partners.
paras.zh: AI 市场是历史上增长最快的技术领域之一。在这一快速演变的格局中，我们通过直销与战略合作伙伴生态系统相结合的方式触达客户。

paras.en: Our sales organization, together with our partners’ sales teams, delivers our high-performance AI solutions through multiple consumption models: (i) on premises, (ii) through our own Cerebras Cloud, (iii) via partners’ clouds, or (iv) through hybrid combinations of these approaches. This flexible delivery model allows customers to adopt our technology in the manner that best aligns with their procurement preferences, operational requirements, and infrastructure strategies.
paras.zh: 我们的销售组织与合作伙伴的销售团队一道，通过多种消费模式交付我们的高性能 AI 解决方案：(i) 本地部署，(ii) 通过我们自有的 Cerebras Cloud,(iii) 通过合作伙伴的云，或 (iv) 通过上述方式的混合组合。这种灵活的交付模式使客户能够以最符合其采购偏好、运营要求和基础设施策略的方式采用我们的技术。

paras.en: Our product portfolio spans on-premises AI supercomputing systems, cloud-based compute for training and inference, and forward-deployed AI services to help customers accelerate the creation and deployment of AI capabilities.
paras.zh: 我们的产品组合涵盖本地部署 AI 超级计算系统、用于训练和推理的云端算力，以及前沿部署 AI 服务，帮助客户加速 AI 能力的创建与部署。

paras.en: #### On-Premises Solutions
paras.zh: #### 本地部署解决方案

paras.en: Cerebras AI supercomputers support both model training and inference and are deployed directly within a customer’s environment. This deployment model is well suited for customers with regulated and high-security environments that require full control over data, infrastructure, and system behavior. Our on-premises customers include large enterprises, national laboratories, the U.S. Department of Defense, and Sovereign AI initiatives.
paras.zh: Cerebras AI 超级计算机同时支持模型训练和推理，并直接部署在客户的环境中。该部署模式非常适合需要在受监管和高安全性环境中对数据、基础设施和系统行为拥有完全控制权的客户。我们的本地部署客户包括大型企业、国家实验室、美国国防部以及主权 AI 计划。

paras.en: Commercial Model for On-Premises Deployments
paras.zh: 本地部署的商业模

paras.en: On-premises customers procure our AI supercomputers through a traditional purchase-order process with payment received upon delivery or acceptance. Each system combines tightly integrated hardware and software and the purchase includes a separate renewable software subscription for continuous updates and upgrades, generating a recurring revenue stream. On-premises deployments are often paired with our forward-deployed AI services, in which we assist customers with data preparation, model architecture design, training management, inference optimization, and, in select cases, ongoing system operations.
paras.zh: 本地部署客户通过传统的采购订单流程采购我们的 AI 超级计算机，并在交付或验收时付款。每套系统都将紧密集成的硬件和软件相结合，购买还包括单独的可续订软件订阅，用于持续更新和升级，从而产生经常性收入流。本地部署通常与我们前沿部署 AI 服务相配合，我们协助客户进行数据准备、模型架构设计、训练管理、推理优化，并在部分情况下参与持续的系統运营。

paras.en: #### Cloud Solutions
paras.zh: #### 云解决方案

paras.en: We also provide access to our high-performance compute through Cerebras Cloud and through our partner cloud platforms, which include AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Marketplace, IBM watsonx Model Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, and Hugging Face. These offerings enable customers to utilize the full capabilities of our AI supercomputers without incurring the capital expenditures associated with building or maintaining on-premises infrastructure, and without the operational complexity of assembling and managing training or inference software stacks. Provisioning is highly streamlined, allowing customers to begin using our cloud resources within minutes.
paras.zh: 我们还通过 Cerebras Cloud 以及我们的合作伙伴云平台提供高性能算力的访问，这些平台包括 AWS Marketplace、Microsoft Marketplace、IBM watsonx Model Gateway、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenRouter 和 Hugging Face。这些产品使客户能够充分利用我们 AI 超级计算机的全部能力，而无需承担构建或维护本地基础设施相关的资本支出，也无需承担组装和管理训练或推理软件栈的运营复杂性。资源配置高度简化，客户可在数分钟内开始使用我们的云资源。

paras.en: Cerebras Cloud serves a broad spectrum of users—from individual developers to some of the world’s largest enterprises. Customers run open-source, fine-tuned, and proprietary models for both training and inference workloads. Across all use cases, our cloud offerings provide access to ultra-high-performance AI compute.
paras.zh: Cerebras Cloud 服务于广泛的用户群体——从个人开发者到全球一些最大的企业。客户运行开源、微调和专有模型，用于训练和推理工作负载。在所有用例中，我们的云产品均提供对超高性能 AI 算力的访问。

paras.en: Customers procure cloud capacity from us and our cloud partners through two primary models: Dedicated Capacity and On-Demand.
paras.zh: 客户通过两种主要模式从我们及我们的云合作伙伴处采购云容量：专用容量和按需。

paras.en: Dedicated Cloud Capacity
paras.zh: 专用云容量

paras.en: Customers can contract for dedicated AI compute capacity for training or inference over defined terms. These contracts are generally structured as take-or-pay commitments, under which customers pay for dedicated compute capacity irrespective of utilization.
paras.zh: 客户可以按约定条款签约获得用于训练或推理的专用 AI 算力容量。此类合同通常采用照付不议承诺结构，即客户无论是否使用均需为专用算力容量付费。

paras.en: Dedicated capacity provides availability and is well suited for production deployments and large-scale workloads. Customers in this model include leading hyperscalers, foundation model labs, AI-native and digital-native businesses, enterprises, and Sovereign AI initiatives operating open-source, fine-tuned, or proprietary models. Dedicated capacity contracts also include access to tailored workload telemetry that enables customers to optimize performance on our systems. This deep integration supports long-term engagement and increases platform stickiness.
paras.zh: 专用容量可提供可用性保障，非常适合生产部署和大规模工作负载。采用该模式的客户包括领先的超大规模云服务商、基础模型实验室、AI 原生和数字原生企业、各类企业，以及运行开源、微调或专有模型的主权 AI 计划。专用容量合同还包括获取定制化工作负载遥测数据，使客户能够在我们系统上优化性能。这种深度集成支持长期合作，并提升平台粘性。

paras.en: On-Demand Cloud Capacity
paras.zh: 按需云容量

paras.en: For customers with variable or unpredictable workload requirements, we offer a consumption-based “pay-as-you-go” option. In this model, customers either purchase tokens—which represent units of compute—as they consume them, or pre-purchase token bundles and draw down their balance as workloads run.
paras.zh: 对于工作负载需求多变或难以预测的客户，我们提供基于用量的“按需付费”选项。在该模式下，客户可以在使用算力时购买代币（代币代表算力单位），也可以预先购买代币包，并在工作负载运行时从中扣减余额。

paras.en: Enterprise customers are billed monthly, while individual developers access the service through a self-service portal. The on-demand model allows customers to scale elastically and is particularly effective for dynamic inference workloads. Historically, many customers have begun with on-demand usage and transitioned to dedicated capacity as their workloads expand.
paras.zh: 企业客户按月计费，个人开发者则通过自助服务门户访问该服务。按需模式使客户能够弹性扩展，尤其适用于动态推理工作负载。从历史上看，许多客户最初使用按需服务，随着工作负载扩大而转向专用容量。

paras.en: Our customers include many of the world’s leading AI organizations. These span frontier model developers; hyperscalers; AI-native companies; as well as enterprises, research institutions, and national laboratories. Across these segments, customers rely on our solutions to accelerate model development and to deploy AI capabilities at production scale.
paras.zh: 我们的客户包括众多全球领先的 AI 组织。这些客户涵盖前沿模型开发者、超大规模云服务商、AI 原生公司，以及企业、研究机构和国家实验室。在这些细分领域中，客户依赖我们的解决方案来加速模型开发，并在生产规模上部署 AI 能力。

paras.en: We go to market through a combination of strategic partnerships, direct sales, channel partnerships, and product-led expansion.
paras.zh: 我们通过战略合作、直销、渠道合作和产品驱动式扩张相结合的方式进入市场。

paras.en: #### Strategic Partnerships
paras.zh: #### 战略合作

paras.en: We partner with frontier model labs and hyperscalers to co-develop and deploy AI systems at scale alongside some of the most influential players in the AI ecosystem.
paras.zh: 我们与前沿模型实验室和超大规模云服务商合作，与 AI 生态系统中一些最具影响力的参与者一道，共同开发和规模化部署 AI 系统。

paras.en: OpenAI. We signed the MRA with OpenAI on December 24, 2025. On January 23, 2026, we began delivering capacity to OpenAI, and on February 12, 2026, OpenAI’s Codex-Spark model, powered by Cerebras infrastructure, was made available to the public. Spark is OpenAI’s model designed for real-time coding. Using Cerebras, OpenAI’s customers can translate ideas into working software in seconds, enabling developers to create software at the speed of thought. OpenAI has committed to purchase 750MW of Cerebras inference compute capacity over the next three years.
paras.zh: OpenAI。我们于 2025 年 12 月 24 日与 OpenAI 签署了 MRA。2026 年 1 月 23 日，我们开始向 OpenAI 交付算力；2026 年 2 月 12 日，由 Cerebras 基础设施驱动的 OpenAI Codex-Spark 模型向公众开放。Spark 是 OpenAI 专为实时编程设计的模型。借助 Cerebras，OpenAI 的客户可以在数秒内将想法转化为可运行的软件，使开发者能够以思维的速度创建软件。OpenAI 已承诺在未来三年内购买 750MW 的 Cerebras 推理算力容量。

paras.en: Our partnership with OpenAI also allows for collaboration and co-design across both frontier model development and hardware architecture. This hardware-software co-development enables OpenAI to design models built for our hardware architecture and Cerebras to evolve hardware design in response to the needs of upcoming frontier model architectures. This creates a continuous feedback loop that can help our systems prepare for the next generation of AI, establishing a structural advantage for Cerebras.
paras.zh: 我们与 OpenAI 的合作还允许在前沿模型开发和硬件架构两方面开展协作与协同设计。这种软硬件协同开发使 OpenAI 能够针对我们的硬件架构设计模型，也使 Cerebras 能够根据即将推出的前沿模型架构的需求演进硬件设计。这形成了一个持续反馈闭环，有助于我们的系统为下一代 AI 做好准备，为 Cerebras 建立结构性优势。

paras.en: AWS. We signed a binding term sheet with Amazon Web Services for AWS to become the first hyperscaler to deploy Cerebras systems in its data centers. Deployment in AWS data centers will require us to meet strict standards for performance, scale, and reliability.
paras.zh: AWS。我们与 Amazon Web Services 签署了一份具有约束力的条款清单，AWS 将成为首家在其数据中心部署 Cerebras 系统的超大规模云服务商。在 AWS 数据中心部署将要求我们满足性能、规模和可靠性方面的严格标准。

paras.en: Pursuant to the term sheet, we will create a co-designed, disaggregated inference-serving solution that will integrate AWS Trainium3 chips with Cerebras CS-3 systems, connected via high-bandwidth networking, to partition inference workloads across Trainium3 and CS-3. Each system will perform the type of computation at which it most excels. The approach is expected to deliver 5 times more token throughput in the same hardware footprint, at up to 15 times faster speeds compared to leading GPU-based solutions as benchmarked on leading open-source models.
paras.zh: 根据该条款清单，我们将创建一套协同设计的解耦式推理服务解决方案，将 AWS Trainium3 芯片与 Cerebras CS-3 系统通过高带宽网络连接进行集成，从而在 Trainium3 和 CS-3 之间划分推理工作负载。每个系统将执行其最擅长的计算类型。该方法预计可在相同硬件占用空间下实现 5 倍的 token 吞吐量，与领先的基于 GPU 的解决方案相比速度最高可提升 15 倍（以领先的开源模型为基准进行测试）。

paras.en: #### Direct Sales, Channel Partnerships, and Product-Led Expansion
paras.zh: #### 直销、渠道合作和产品驱动式扩张

paras.en: Direct Sales. We employ a targeted named-account strategy built on deep technical and commercial engagement. Dedicated account teams work closely with customer executives and their engineering leadership to identify business-critical workloads and then successfully integrate, optimize performance, and scale the deployment of Cerebras systems. This hands-on engagement builds operational trust and frequently results in the expansion of initial projects into multi-system or multi-year commitments.
paras.zh: 直销。我们采用基于深度技术和商业互动的定向大客户战略。专职客户团队与客户高管及其工程领导层紧密合作，识别业务关键型工作负载，然后成功集成、优化性能并规模化部署 Cerebras 系统。这种亲身参与的互动建立了运营信任，并经常使初始项目扩展为多系统或多年期承诺。

paras.en: Alongside our direct sales force, we maintain a dedicated team of AI experts. This team provides customers with access to leading AI expertise, so that they are positioned to leverage our technology effectively.
paras.zh: 除直销团队外，我们还设有一支专门的 AI 专家团队。该团队为客户提供接触领先 AI 专业知识的机会，使其能够有效利用我们的技术。

paras.en: Channel and Technology Partnerships. To broaden our market reach, we leverage a diversified network of channel and technology partners. Cerebras solutions are accessible through AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Marketplace, IBM watsonx Model Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, and Hugging Face, allowing developers and enterprises to incorporate Cerebras performance seamlessly into existing workflows and deployment environments.
paras.zh: 渠道与技术合作伙伴。为扩大市场覆盖，我们依托多元化的渠道与技术合作伙伴网络。Cerebras 解决方案可通过 AWS Marketplace、Microsoft Marketplace、IBM watsonx Model Gateway、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenRouter 和 Hugging Face 获取，使开发者和企业能够将 Cerebras 的性能无缝融入现有工作流和部署环境。

paras.en: Product-Led Growth. Our product-led growth motion introduces developers, startups, and emerging AI organizations to Cerebras through our self-serve inference platform and API. These early interactions often seed future named-account relationships. In addition, partnerships with cloud providers, system integrators, and software platforms that embed Cerebras capabilities into established workflows further expand access and reinforce our enterprise sales motion.
paras.zh: 产品驱动增长。我们的产品驱动增长模式通过自助推理平台和 API，将开发者、初创企业和新兴 AI 组织引入 Cerebras。这些早期互动往往为未来的具名客户关系奠定基础。此外，与云服务商、系统集成商以及将 Cerebras 能力嵌入既有工作流的软件平台建立合作，进一步扩大了触达范围，并强化了我们的企业销售模式。

paras.en: We further extend our presence through integrations with widely used open-source development environments —including Visual Studio Code, Cline, RooCode, and OpenCode—embedding our technology, powered by the Cerebras Cloud, directly where developers build and iterate. These channels enhance visibility within software-developer communities, foster product-led adoption of our self-serve offerings, and extend the reach of our platform beyond traditional enterprise sales.
paras.zh: 我们还通过与广泛使用的开源开发环境（包括 Visual Studio Code、Cline、RooCode 和 OpenCode）集成来进一步拓展业务版图，将依托 Cerebras Cloud 的技术直接嵌入开发者构建和迭代的场所。这些渠道提升了我们在软件开发社区中的知名度，促进了自助产品的产品驱动式采用，并将我们平台的触达范围延伸至传统企业销售之外。
