paras.en: Our sales and marketing strategy centers on deep market understanding and customer-centric product development. We leverage our extensive market knowledge, proven track record in delivering large-scale compute solutions, and close customer collaborations to optimize our product roadmap. This is designed to ensure our solutions consistently deliver significant value to our customers.
paras.zh: 我们的销售与营销战略以深入的市场洞察和以客户为中心的产品开发为核心。我们凭借广泛的市场知识、在大规模算力解决方案交付方面经过验证的业绩记录以及与客户的紧密协作来优化产品路线图。此举旨在确保我们的解决方案持续为客户创造显著价值。

paras.en: We focus our sales and marketing efforts on industry leaders, specifically large enterprises domestically and abroad with rich data assets. Our customers are seeking to leverage their rich proprietary data and combine it with Cerebras’s industry leading compute and AI expertise to build a durable competitive advantage. Among our customers, word of success travels quickly, and as a result, it is very important to our future that we maintain strong and collaborative relationships and that we invest in the success of our customers. We utilize master purchase agreements, purchase orders, and statements of work, to define work scope, price, quantities, delivery terms, warranties, and software subscriptions. We predominantly sell our solutions directly to customers via on-premises hardware or via the cloud, based on a dedicated capacity or consumption-based model.
paras.zh: 我们将销售与营销工作聚焦于行业领军者，具体而言是国内外拥有丰富数据资产的大型企业。我们的客户希望利用其丰富的专有数据，并将其与 Cerebras 行业领先的算力和 AI 专业能力相结合，以构建持久的竞争优势。在我们的客户群体中，成功案例的口碑传播非常迅速，因此，保持牢固的协作关系并投资于客户的成功，对我们的未来至关重要。我们通过主采购协议、采购订单和工作说明书来界定工作范围、价格、数量、交付条款、保证和软件订阅。我们主要通过本地部署硬件或基于专属容量或按用量计费模式的云端方式，将解决方案直接销售给客户。

paras.en: We are committed to relentless innovation in both hardware and software to address the rapidly-evolving computational needs of AI.
paras.zh: 我们致力于在硬件和软件两方面进行不懈创新，以满足 AI 快速演进的计算需求。

paras.en: We dedicate significant resources to ongoing research and development. We invest heavily in attracting and retaining a global team of highly skilled engineers across dedicated facilities in the United States, Canada, and India. This unwavering commitment to innovation fuels our growth and positions us as a leader in the AI landscape.
paras.zh: 我们投入大量资源用于持续的研发。我们大力投入以吸引和留住一支由高技能工程师组成的全球团队，并在美国、加拿大和印度设有专门设施。这种对创新的坚定承诺推动我们的增长，并使我们在 AI 领域处于领先地位。

paras.en: We operate a fabless manufacturing model, strategically partnering with industry leaders for the production of our AI compute systems which include ICs, boards, and systems. Our core manufacturing partners include:
paras.zh: 我们采用无晶圆厂制造模式，与行业领先者进行战略合作，生产我们的 AI 算力系统，其中包括 IC、板和系统。我们的核心制造合作伙伴包括：

paras.en: TSMC, a leading semiconductor foundry, fabricates our cutting-edge WSEs. Advanced Semiconductor Engineering (“ASE”) handles specialized processes, including the deposition of redistribution layers, and we manage final wafer packaging, assembly, and testing in our Sunnyvale, California facility.
paras.zh: 台积电（TSMC）是一家领先的半导体代工厂，负责制造我们前沿的 WSE。日月光半导体（Advanced Semiconductor Engineering，简称“ASE”）负责专业工艺，包括重分布层的沉积，而我们则在加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔的工厂负责最终的晶圆封装、组装和测试。

paras.en: We also use a small number of third parties to manufacture subassemblies and critical components such as printed circuit boards, I/O subsystems, cooling assemblies and power delivery modules. The manufacturing process is subject to extensive testing and verification.
paras.zh: 我们还使用少数第三方来制造子组件和关键组件，例如印刷电路板、I/O 子系统、冷却组件和功率传输模块。制造过程需经过广泛的测试和验证。

paras.en: Our supply chain is designed for flexibility and for quality, as we plan to ramp up production to meet the growing global demand for our AI compute systems. Simultaneously, we are committed to rigorous quality control throughout the manufacturing process to confirm reliability in even the most demanding environments at our customer facilities. Our contract manufacturing partners perform system assembly and extensive testing, and we have verification protocols in place at every stage including post assembly. Final system-level burn-in and test is conducted by Cerebras. Our quality processes include high production test coverage, full product traceability, and extensive post assembly burn-in. We employ a dedicated quality team that continuously monitors feedback during manufacturing and after deployment. This data-driven approach allows us to improve our product quality and reliability, and enables us to meet the stringent demands of our customers worldwide.
paras.zh: 我们的供应链旨在实现灵活性和质量，因为我们计划扩大生产，以满足全球对我们 AI 算力系统日益增长的需求。同时，我们致力于在整个制造过程中进行严格的质量控制，以确保即使在客户设施中最严苛的环境中也能保持可靠性。我们的合同制造合作伙伴负责系统组装和广泛测试，我们在包括组装后在内的每个阶段都制定了验证协议。最终的系统级老化测试和测试由 Cerebras 进行。我们的质量流程包括高生产测试覆盖率、完整的产品可追溯性以及广泛的组装后老化测试。我们拥有一支专门的质量团队，持续监控制造期间和部署后的反馈。这种数据驱动的方法使我们能够提高产品质量和可靠性，并使我们能够满足全球客户的严格要求。

paras.en: Protecting our intellectual property and proprietary technology, including our AI products and solutions, is an important aspect of our business. We rely on a combination of intellectual property rights, including patent, trademark, trade secret, and other related laws in the United States and internationally as well as confidentiality procedures and contractual provisions to protect, maintain, and enforce our proprietary technology, intellectual property rights, and brand. Our intellectual property portfolio includes patents, trademarks, proprietary software, and trade secrets.
paras.zh: 保护我们的知识产权和专有技术（包括我们的 AI 产品和解决方案）是我们业务的重要方面。我们依靠知识产权（包括美国及国际上的专利、商标、商业秘密及其他相关法律）以及保密程序和合同条款的组合，来保护、维持和执行我们的专有技术、知识产权和品牌。我们的知识产权组合包括专利、商标、专有软件和商业秘密。

paras.en: As of March 31, 2026, we owned 96 issued patents and 50 pending patent applications globally. Of these, 50 are issued U.S. patents and 47 are pending U.S. patent applications. Our issued patents and pending patent applications generally relate to the design and fabrication of large-scale (e.g., wafer scale) processors, the assembly, packaging, and cooling of processors, and hardware, and software architectures for accelerated deep learning and for inference. The expiration dates of the U.S.-issued patents are between 2038 and 2041, not taking into account any applicable patent term extensions. We routinely review our development efforts to assess the existence and patentability of new inventions.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，我们在全球拥有 96 项已授权专利和 50 项待审专利申请。其中，50 项为美国已授权专利，47 项为美国待审专利申请。我们的已授权专利和待审专利申请通常涉及大规模（例如晶圆级）处理器的设计与制造、处理器的组装、封装与散热，以及用于加速深度学习和推理的硬件与软件架构。美国已授权专利的到期日介于 2038 年至 2041 年之间，未考虑任何适用的专利期限延长。我们定期审查我们的研发工作，以评估新发明的存在性和可专利性。

paras.en: We have a policy of requiring employees and consultants to execute confidentiality agreements upon the commencement of an employment or consulting relationship with us. Our employee and independent contractor agreements also require relevant employees and independent contractors to assign to us all rights to any inventions made or conceived during their employment or engagement with us. In addition, we typically require individuals and entities with whom we discuss potential business relationships to sign non-disclosure agreements that contain customary confidentiality provisions.
paras.zh: 我们有一项政策，要求员工和顾问在与我们建立雇佣或顾问关系时签署保密协议。我们的员工和独立承包商协议还要求相关员工和独立承包商将其在与我们雇佣或合作期间作出或构思的任何发明的所有权利转让给我们。此外，我们通常要求与我们讨论潜在业务关系的个人和实体签署包含惯常保密条款的保密协议。

paras.en: We offer a purpose-built AI compute platform. Our hardware primarily competes against solutions from NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Intel Corporation, as well as AI accelerators developed by hyperscalers and private companies. We also compete against full-service cloud service providers such as Amazon.com, Inc. (AWS), Microsoft Corporation (Azure), Alphabet Inc. (Google Cloud Platform), and Oracle Corporation, as well as AI-optimized specialized clouds such as CoreWeave, Inc. and other neo-clouds.
paras.zh: 我们提供专为特定目的构建的 AI 算力平台。我们的硬件主要与 NVIDIA Corporation、Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.、Intel Corporation 的解决方案，以及超大规模云服务商和私营企业开发的 AI 加速器展开竞争。我们还与 Amazon.com, Inc.（AWS）、Microsoft Corporation（Azure）、Alphabet Inc.（Google Cloud Platform）和 Oracle Corporation 等全服务云服务商，以及 CoreWeave, Inc. 等 AI 优化型专业云和其他新型云展开竞争。

paras.en: We believe that our ability to remain competitive will depend on how well we are able to anticipate the features and functions that customers will require and whether we are able to deliver consistent volumes of our products and services at acceptable levels of quality and at competitive prices. We expect competition to increase from both existing competitors and new market entrants with products that may be lower priced than ours or may provide better performance or additional features not provided by our products and services. In addition, it is possible that new competitors or alliances among competitors could emerge and acquire significant market share. Some of our competitors have greater marketing, financial, distribution, and manufacturing resources than we do and may be more able to adapt to customers or technological changes. We expect an increasingly competitive environment in the future.
paras.zh: 我们认为，我们保持竞争力的能力将取决于我们能否很好地预判客户所需的功能和特性，以及我们能否以可接受的质量水平和具有竞争力的价格持续交付我们的产品和服务。我们预计，来自现有竞争对手和新市场进入者的竞争将会加剧，他们的产品可能定价低于我们，或可能提供更优的性能或我们的产品和服务所不具备的附加功能。此外，新的竞争对手或竞争对手之间的联盟可能会出现并获取显著的市场份额。我们的一些竞争对手拥有比我们更多的营销、财务、分销和制造资源，并且可能更有能力适应客户或技术变化。我们预计未来竞争环境将日益激烈。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, we had 708 employees, including 426 in the United States, and we have employees located internationally, including in Canada and India. We maintain a full-time workforce and supplement our workforce with contractors and consultants.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我们拥有 708 名员工，其中 426 名位于美国，我们还在国际上设有员工，包括在加拿大和印度。我们维持一支全职员工队伍，并通过承包商和顾问补充我们的员工队伍。

paras.en: To our knowledge, none of our employees are represented by a labor union or party to a collective bargaining agreement. We consider our relationships with our employees to be good. Our human capital resources objectives include, as applicable, identifying, recruiting, retaining, incentivizing, and integrating our existing and new employees. The principal purposes of our equity incentive plans are to attract, retain, and reward personnel through the granting of stock-based compensation awards in order to motivate these individuals to perform to the best of their abilities, enabling us to achieve our objectives.
paras.zh: 据我们所知，我们的员工中没有任何人由工会代表或参与集体谈判协议。我们认为我们与员工的关系良好。我们的人力资本资源目标包括（如适用）识别、招聘、留任、激励和整合我们的现有及新员工。我们股权激励计划的主要目的是通过授予股权激励奖励来吸引、留任和奖励人员，以激励这些个人尽其所能地发挥，从而使我们能够实现我们的目标。

paras.en: Our corporate headquarters is located in Sunnyvale, California, where we lease approximately 68,000 square feet, pursuant to a lease agreement that expires in November 2027, subject to the terms thereof. We lease additional facilities in Canada and India for research and development.
paras.zh: 我们的公司总部位于加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔，我们根据一份于 2027 年 11 月到期的租赁协议在该地租赁约 68,000 平方英尺的场地，并受该协议条款约束。我们还在加拿大和印度租赁了额外设施用于研究与开发。

paras.en: We also enter into agreements for offsite colocation facilities to house and operate our AI supercomputers. We enter into these agreements for our own corporate purposes as well as on behalf of our customers. Currently, these data center facilities are in California, Oklahoma, and Canada.
paras.zh: 我们还就异地托管设施签订协议，以安置和运营我们的 AI 超级计算机。我们签订这些协议既是为我们自身的公司用途，也是代表我们的客户。目前，这些数据中心设施位于加利福尼亚州、俄克拉荷马州和加拿大。

paras.en: We believe that our facilities are suitable to meet our current needs. We intend to expand our facilities or add new facilities as we grow, and we believe that suitable additional or alternative spaces will be available on commercially reasonable terms, if required.
paras.zh: 我们认为，我们的设施适合满足我们当前的需求。我们打算随着业务增长扩建我们的设施或增加新设施，并且我们认为，如有需要，将以商业上合理的条款获得合适的额外或替代场地。

paras.en: We are subject to many U.S. federal and state laws, rules, and regulations, as well as laws, rules, and regulations imposed by various non-U.S. governmental authorities, including those related to AI, intellectual property, tax, import and export requirements, anti-corruption, economic and trade sanctions, national security and foreign investment, foreign exchange controls and cash repatriation restrictions, data privacy and security requirements, competition, advertising, employment, product regulations, environment, health, and safety requirements, and consumer laws. These laws and regulations are complex, are constantly evolving, and may be interpreted, applied, created, or amended, in a manner that could harm our business.
paras.zh: 我们受制于众多美国联邦和州法律、法规和规章，以及各非美国政府机构施加的法律、法规和规章，包括与 AI、知识产权、税务、进出口要求、反腐败、经济和贸易制裁、国家安全和外国投资、外汇管制和现金汇回限制、数据隐私和安全要求、竞争、广告、雇佣、产品法规、环境、健康和安全要求以及消费者保护法相关的法律法规。这些法律法规复杂且不断演变，其解释、适用、制定或修订的方式可能损害我们的业务。

paras.en: The import and export of our offerings are subject to laws and regulations, including international treaties, U.S. and various non-U.S. export controls and sanctions laws, customs regulations, and other trade rules. The scope, nature, and severity of such controls varies widely across different countries and may change frequently over time. Such laws, rules, and regulations may delay the introduction of some of our offerings or impact our competitiveness through restricting our ability to do business in certain countries or territories or with certain parties (including certain governments) or certain jurisdictions. U.S. export restrictions also require us to obtain licenses from the U.S. Department of Commerce to allow the export or transfer of our offerings, and there can be no assurance that export permissions will be granted. These restrictive governmental actions and any similar measures that may be imposed on U.S. companies by other governments could limit our ability to conduct business globally.
paras.zh: 我们产品的进出口受法律法规约束，包括国际条约、美国及各非美国出口管制和制裁法律、海关法规及其他贸易规则。此类管制的范围、性质和严厉程度因国家而异，且可能随时间频繁变化。此类法律、法规和规章可能延迟我们部分产品的推出，或通过限制我们在某些国家或地区或与某些方（包括某些政府）或某些司法管辖区开展业务的能力，影响我们的竞争力。美国出口限制还要求我们获得美国商务部的许可，方可出口或转让我们的产品，且无法保证出口许可会获批。这些限制性政府行为以及其他政府可能对美国公司施加的任何类似措施，可能限制我们在全球开展业务的能力。

paras.en: See the section titled “Risk Factors” for additional information regarding risks we face related to government regulation.
paras.zh: 有关我们面临的政府监管相关风险的更多信息，请参见“风险因素”一节。

paras.en: From time to time, we may be subject to legal proceedings, claims, and investigations in the ordinary course of business. We are not presently a party to any litigation to which the outcome, we believe, if determined adversely to us, would individually or taken together have a material adverse effect on us. We cannot predict the results of any such proceedings, claims, or investigations, and despite the potential outcomes, the existence thereof may have a material adverse impact on us due to diversion of management time and attention as well as the financial costs related to resolving such matters.
paras.zh: 我们可能不时在日常经营过程中面临法律诉讼、索赔和调查。我们目前并非任何诉讼的当事方，我们认为，若该等诉讼的判决结果对我们不利，无论单独或合计均不会对我们产生重大不利影响。我们无法预测任何该等诉讼、索赔或调查的结果，且尽管存在潜在结果，该等事项的存在可能因管理层时间和精力的分散以及与解决该等事项相关的财务成本而对我们产生重大不利影响。

paras.en: #### Executive Officers and Employee Director
paras.zh: #### 高管及员工董事

paras.en: Andrew D. Feldman is one of our co-founders and has served as our Chief Executive Officer and President and as a member of our board of directors since April 2016. From February 2012 to June 2014, Mr. Feldman served as Corporate Vice President and General Manager at Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (“AMD”), a semiconductor company. From November 2007 to February 2012, Mr. Feldman served as Chief Executive Officer at SeaMicro, a dense microserver company acquired by AMD. From August 2003 to December 2006, Mr. Feldman served as Vice President, Marketing and Product Management at Force10 Networks, Inc., a computer networking company acquired by Dell, Inc. From March 2000 to August 2003, Mr. Feldman served as Vice President, Corporate Marketing and Corporate Development at Riverstone Networks Inc., a networking switching hardware company. Mr. Feldman holds an M.B.A. from Stanford University and a B.A. in Economics and Political Science from Stanford University.
paras.zh: Andrew D. Feldman 是我们的联合创始人之一，自 2016 年 4 月起担任我们的首席执行官、总裁以及董事会成员。2012 年 2 月至 2014 年 6 月，Feldman 先生担任半导体公司 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.（“AMD”）的公司副总裁兼总经理。2007 年 11 月至 2012 年 2 月，Feldman 先生担任 SeaMicro 的首席执行官，该公司是一家高密度微服务器公司，后被 AMD 收购。2003 年 8 月至 2006 年 12 月，Feldman 先生担任 Force10 Networks, Inc. 的营销与产品管理副总裁，该公司是一家计算机网络公司，后被 Dell, Inc. 收购。2000 年 3 月至 2003 年 8 月，Feldman 先生担任 Riverstone Networks Inc. 的企业营销与企业发展副总裁，该公司是一家网络交换硬件公司。Feldman 先生拥有斯坦福大学工商管理硕士学位（M.B.A.）以及斯坦福大学经济学与政治学文学学士学位（B.A.）。

paras.en: We believe Mr. Feldman is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of the perspective and experience he brings as our co-founder and Chief Executive Officer. See “—Involvement in Certain Legal Proceedings” for certain details regarding historical legal proceedings involving Mr. Feldman.
paras.zh: 我们认为 Feldman 先生具备担任我们董事会成员的资格，原因在于他作为我们的联合创始人兼首席执行官所带来的视角和经验。有关 Feldman 先生涉及的历史法律程序的某些详情，请参见“——涉及某些法律程序”。

paras.en: Robert Komin has served as our Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer since March 2024. Mr. Komin previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Sunrun Inc. (“Sunrun”), a residential solar and storage company, from March 2015 to May 2020, and then continued as a consultant until January 2021. From September 2013 to January 2015, Mr. Komin served as Chief Financial Officer at Flurry, Inc., a mobile analytics and advertising company. From August 2012 to August 2013, Mr. Komin served as Chief Financial Officer at Ticketfly, Inc., a music ticketing and marketing services provider. From January 2010 to July 2012, Mr. Komin served as Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer at Linden Research, Inc., a creator of virtual digital entertainment and cybercurrency. Mr. Komin previously served as a member of the board of directors and chairman of the audit committee of Bird Global Inc., a micromobility company, from June 2021 to April 2024. Mr. Komin holds an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School and a B.S. in Accounting and General Science from the University of Oregon.
paras.zh: Robert Komin 自 2024 年 3 月起担任我们的首席财务官兼财务主管。Komin 先生此前于 2015 年 3 月至 2020 年 5 月担任住宅太阳能及储能公司 Sunrun Inc.（“Sunrun”）的首席财务官，随后继续担任顾问至 2021 年 1 月。2013 年 9 月至 2015 年 1 月，Komin 先生担任 Flurry, Inc. 的首席财务官，该公司是一家移动分析与广告公司。2012 年 8 月至 2013 年 8 月，Komin 先生担任 Ticketfly, Inc. 的首席财务官，该公司是一家音乐票务与营销服务提供商。2010 年 1 月至 2012 年 7 月，Komin 先生担任 Linden Research, Inc. 的首席运营官兼首席财务官，该公司是虚拟数字娱乐与网络货币的创造者。Komin 先生此前于 2021 年 6 月至 2024 年 4 月担任微型出行公司 Bird Global Inc. 的董事会成员兼审计委员会主席。Komin 先生拥有哈佛商学院工商管理硕士学位（M.B.A.）以及俄勒冈大学会计与通用科学理学学士学位（B.S.）。

paras.en: Sean Lie is one of our co-founders and has served in various roles since 2016, including most recently as our Chief Technology Officer since April 2022. From April 2012 to June 2015, Mr. Lie served as Chief Architect, Data Center Server Solutions at AMD. From March 2008 to March 2012, Mr. Lie served as Lead Hardware Architect of the IO virtualization fabric ASIC at SeaMicro. From July 2004 to February 2008, Mr. Lie worked as a microprocessor architect at AMD in the advanced architecture team. Mr. Lie holds an M.Eng. and a B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: Sean Lie 是我们的联合创始人之一，自 2016 年起担任多个职务，最近自 2022 年 4 月起担任我们的首席技术官。2012 年 4 月至 2015 年 6 月，Lie 先生担任 AMD 数据中心服务器解决方案首席架构师。2008 年 3 月至 2012 年 3 月，Lie 先生担任 SeaMicro 的 IO 虚拟化架构 ASIC 首席硬件架构师。2004 年 7 月至 2008 年 2 月，Lie 先生在 AMD 先进架构团队担任微处理器架构师。Lie 先生拥有麻省理工学院电气工程与计算机科学专业的工程硕士学位和学士学位。

paras.en: Dhiraj Mallick has served as our Chief Operating Officer since September 2023. From June 2018 to September 2023, Mr. Mallick served as our Senior Vice President of Engineering and Operations. From November 2015 to May 2018, Mr. Mallick served as Vice President of Innovation, Pathfinding and Architecture, Data Center Group at Intel Corporation, a multinational technology company. From April 2012 to August 2015, Mr. Mallick served as General Manager and Corporate Vice President at AMD. Since January 2020, Mr. Mallick has served on the Global Advisory Group of the Global Semiconductor Alliance, a semiconductor and technology industry organization. Mr. Mallick holds an M.S. in Electrical Engineering from Stanford University and a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Rochester.
paras.zh: Dhiraj Mallick 自 2023 年 9 月起担任我们的首席运营官。2018 年 6 月至 2023 年 9 月，Mallick 先生担任我们的工程与运营高级副总裁。2015 年 11 月至 2018 年 5 月，Mallick 先生担任跨国科技公司 Intel Corporation 数据中心事业部创新、探索与架构副总裁。2012 年 4 月至 2015 年 8 月，Mallick 先生担任 AMD 总经理兼公司副总裁。自 2020 年 1 月起，Mallick 先生担任半导体与技术行业组织全球半导体联盟全球顾问委员会成员。Mallick 先生拥有斯坦福大学电气工程硕士学位和罗切斯特大学电气工程学士学位。

paras.en: #### Non-Employee Directors
paras.zh: #### 非雇员董事

paras.en: Paul Auvil has served as a member of our board of directors since July 2024. Mr. Auvil previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Proofpoint, Inc., an enterprise security company, from March 2007 to February 2023. From September 2006 to March 2007, Mr. Auvil was an entrepreneur-in-residence with Benchmark, a venture capital firm. From August 2002 to July 2006, Mr. Auvil served as Chief Financial Officer at VMware, Inc., a cloud-computing and virtualization company. From April 1998 to January 2002, Mr. Auvil served as Chief Financial Officer at Vitria Technology, Inc., an eBusiness platform company. Mr. Auvil held various executive positions at VLSI Technology, Inc., a semiconductor and circuit manufacturing company, from August 1988 to March 1998, including serving as the Vice President of the Internet and Secure Products Division. Mr. Auvil has served as a member of the boards of directors of Modern Treasury Corp., a fintech company, since October 2024, Chainalysis Inc., a blockchain data platform, since November 2024, and Elastic N.V., a platform for search-powered solutions, since October 2023. Mr. Auvil previously served as a member of the boards of directors of 1Life Healthcare, Inc. (doing business as One Medical), a primary care organization acquired by Amazon.com, Inc., from September 2019 to February 2023, Quantum Corporation, a data storage company, from August 2007 to November 2017, Marin Software Incorporated, a cloud-based advertisement management platform company, from October 2009 to April 2017, and OpenTV Corp., a provider of interactive television software and services, from January 2010 to April 2010. Mr. Auvil holds an M.M. from the Kellogg Graduate School of Management at Northwestern University and a B.E. in Electrical Engineering from Dartmouth College.
paras.zh: Paul Auvil 自 2024 年 7 月起担任我们董事会成员。Auvil 先生此前曾于 2007 年 3 月至 2023 年 2 月担任企业安全公司 Proofpoint, Inc. 的首席财务官。2006 年 9 月至 2007 年 3 月，Auvil 先生担任风险投资公司 Benchmark 的驻场创业者。2002 年 8 月至 2006 年 7 月，Auvil 先生担任云计算与虚拟化公司 VMware, Inc. 的首席财务官。1998 年 4 月至 2002 年 1 月，Auvil 先生担任电子商务平台公司 Vitria Technology, Inc. 的首席财务官。1988 年 8 月至 1998 年 3 月，Auvil 先生在半导体与电路制造公司 VLSI Technology, Inc. 担任多个高管职务，包括担任互联网与安全产品部门副总裁。Auvil 先生自 2024 年 10 月起担任金融科技公司 Modern Treasury Corp. 的董事会成员，自 2024 年 11 月起担任区块链数据平台 Chainalysis Inc. 的董事会成员，并自 2023 年 10 月起担任搜索驱动解决方案平台 Elastic N.V. 的董事会成员。Auvil 先生此前曾于 2019 年 9 月至 2023 年 2 月担任 1Life Healthcare, Inc.（以 One Medical 为商号经营，系一家被 Amazon.com, Inc. 收购的初级保健机构）的董事会成员，于 2007 年 8 月至 2017 年 11 月担任数据存储公司 Quantum Corporation 的董事会成员，于 2009 年 10 月至 2017 年 4 月担任基于云的广告管理平台公司 Marin Software Incorporated 的董事会成员，并于 2010 年 1 月至 2010 年 4 月担任交互式电视软件与服务提供商 OpenTV Corp. 的董事会成员。Auvil 先生拥有西北大学凯洛格管理研究生院的管理学硕士学位（M.M.）以及达特茅斯学院电气工程学士学位（B.E.）。

paras.en: We believe Mr. Auvil is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of his extensive experience in the technology industry and as an executive and a member of the boards of directors of technology companies.
paras.zh: 我们认为，Auvil 先生因其在科技行业的丰富经验以及作为科技公司高管和董事会成员的经历，具备担任我们董事会成员的资格。

paras.en: Elena Donio has served as a member of our board of directors since April 2026. Ms. Donio previously served in various roles at Twilio Inc., a cloud-based communications platform, including as President, Data and Applications from February 2023 to December 2023 and as President, Revenue from May 2022 to February 2023. Prior to Twilio, Ms. Donio served as Chief Executive Officer Axiom Global, Inc., a provider of technology-enabled legal services, from November 2016 to July 2020, and as a member of its board of directors from November 2016 to January 2021. From January 1998 to November 2016, Ms. Donio served in various roles at Concur Technologies, Inc., a business travel and expense management software company acquired by SAP SE in 2014, including as Concur President, Executive Vice President, and General Manager of Worldwide Small and Mid-Sized Businesses, and Vice President of Sales and Marketing. Ms. Donio previously served as a member of the board of directors of Twilio from February 2016 to May 2022. Ms. Donio serves as a member of the boards of directors of several private companies, including Databricks, Inc., Plaid Inc., and Benchling, Inc. Ms. Donio holds a B.A. in Economics from the University of California, San Diego.
paras.zh: Elena Donio 自 2026 年 4 月起担任我们董事会成员。Donio 女士此前曾在云通信平台 Twilio Inc. 担任多个职务，包括 2023 年 2 月至 2023 年 12 月担任数据与应用业务总裁，以及 2022 年 5 月至 2023 年 2 月担任营收总裁。在加入 Twilio 之前，Donio 女士于 2016 年 11 月至 2020 年 7 月担任技术驱动型法律服务提供商 Axiom Global, Inc. 的首席执行官，并于 2016 年 11 月至 2021 年 1 月担任其董事会成员。1998 年 1 月至 2016 年 11 月，Donio 女士曾在商务旅行与费用管理软件公司 Concur Technologies, Inc.（该公司于 2014 年被 SAP SE 收购）担任多个职务，包括 Concur 总裁、执行副总裁兼全球中小企业业务总经理，以及销售与营销副总裁。Donio 女士此前曾于 2016 年 2 月至 2022 年 5 月担任 Twilio 董事会成员。Donio 女士目前担任多家私营公司的董事会成员，包括 Databricks, Inc.、Plaid Inc. 和 Benchling, Inc.。Donio 女士持有加州大学圣地亚哥分校经济学学士学位。

paras.en: We believe Ms. Donio is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of her expertise and experience working with and for technology companies.
paras.zh: 我们相信，Donio 女士凭借其在科技公司工作及为其提供服务的专业知识和经验，具备担任我们董事会成员的资格。

paras.en: Lior Susan has served as a member of our board of directors since April 2023. Since January 2015, Mr. Susan has served as Founder and Managing Partner of Eclipse, an investment firm. Mr. Susan is a co-founder of Bright Machines, Inc., a software company, and has served as its Executive Chairman since January 2018 and as its Chief Executive Officer from January 2018 to May 2018, from December 2021 to December 2022, and from August 2023 to the present. From June 2012 to January 2015, Mr. Susan served as Founder and General Partner at LabIX, the hardware investment platform of Flextronics International Ltd., an end-to-end supply chain solutions company. Mr. Susan served as an Advisor at Intucell Ltd., a self-optimizing network software company, from April 2008 until it was sold to Cisco in 2012. Mr. Susan has served as a member of the board of directors of Owlet, Inc., a health technology company, since March 2015, and has served as the chairman of its board of directors since July 2021. He also serves as a member of the boards of directors of several private companies, including Augury, Inc., Bright Machines, Inc., Cybertoka Ltd., Datapelago, Inc, Dutch Pet, Inc., Prime Minute, Inc., Skyryse, Inc., The Heart Company, Inc., and Usrsa Major Technologies, Inc. Mr. Susan previously served as a member of the board of directors of Lucira Health, Inc., a medical diagnostics company, from August 2020 to December 2022. Mr. Susan is a former member of an elite Special Forces unit in the Israel Defense Force.
paras.zh: Lior Susan 自 2023 年 4 月起担任我们董事会成员。自 2015 年 1 月起，Susan 先生担任投资公司 Eclipse 的创始人兼管理合伙人。Susan 先生是软件公司 Bright Machines, Inc. 的联合创始人，自 2018 年 1 月起担任其执行董事长，并曾于 2018 年 1 月至 2018 年 5 月、2021 年 12 月至 2022 年 12 月以及 2023 年 8 月至今担任其首席执行官。2012 年 6 月至 2015 年 1 月，Susan 先生担任端到端供应链解决方案公司 Flextronics International Ltd. 旗下硬件投资平台 LabIX 的创始人兼普通合伙人。Susan 先生于 2008 年 4 月至 2012 年该公司被 Cisco 收购期间，担任自优化网络软件公司 Intucell Ltd. 的顾问。Susan 先生自 2015 年 3 月起担任健康科技公司 Owlet, Inc. 的董事会成员，并自 2021 年 7 月起担任其董事会主席。他还担任多家私营公司的董事会成员，包括 Augury, Inc.、Bright Machines, Inc.、Cybertoka Ltd.、Datapelago, Inc、Dutch Pet, Inc.、Prime Minute, Inc.、Skyryse, Inc.、The Heart Company, Inc. 和 Usrsa Major Technologies, Inc.。Susan 先生此前曾于 2020 年 8 月至 2022 年 12 月担任医学诊断公司 Lucira Health, Inc. 的董事会成员。Susan 先生曾是以色列国防军一支精锐特种部队的成员。

paras.en: We believe Mr. Susan is qualified to serve as a member of our board of directors because of his expertise and experience working with and investing in technology companies.
paras.zh: 我们相信，Susan 先生凭借其在科技公司工作及投资方面的专业知识和经验，具备担任我们董事会成员的资格。

paras.en: Steve Vassallo has served as a member of our board of directors since May 2016. Since October 2007, Mr. Vassallo has served as a general partner and in various other roles at Foundation Capital, a venture capital firm. From September 2004 to September 2006, Mr. Vassallo served as Vice President of Product and Engineering at Ning Interactive Inc., a social platform. From May 1999 to September 2002, Mr. Vassallo served as director of engineering at Immersion Corporation, a haptic technology company. Mr. Vassallo previously served as a member of the board of directors of Sunrun from May 2008 to June 2019. Mr. Vassallo also serves as a member of the boards of directors of several private companies. Mr. Vassallo holds an M.B.A. from Stanford University, an M.S. in Electromechanical Engineering from Stanford University, and a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Worcester Polytechnic Institute.
paras.zh: Steve Vassallo 自 2016 年 5 月起担任我们的董事会成员。自 2007 年 10 月起，Vassallo 先生在一家风险投资公司 Foundation Capital 担任普通合伙人及多个其他职务。自 2004 年 9 月至 2006 年 9 月，Vassallo 先生在一家社交平台公司 Ning Interactive Inc. 担任产品与工程副总裁。自 1999 年 5 月至 2002 年 9 月，Vassallo 先生在一家触觉技术公司 Immersion Corporation 担任工程总监。Vassallo 先生曾于 2008 年 5 月至 2019 年 6 月担任 Sunrun 的董事会成员。Vassallo 先生还担任多家私营公司的董事会成员。Vassallo 先生持有斯坦福大学工商管理硕士（M.B.A.）学位、斯坦福大学机电工程理学硕士（M.S.）学位，以及伍斯特理工学院机械工程理学学士（B.S.）学位。

paras.en: We believe Mr. Vassallo is qualified to serve on our board of directors because of his extensive experience in the technology industry.
paras.zh: 我们认为，Vassallo 先生因其在科技行业的丰富经验而有资格担任我们的董事会成员。

paras.en: Eric Vishria has served as a member of our board of directors since May 2016. Since July 2014, Mr. Vishria has served as a General Partner of Benchmark, a venture capital firm. From August 2013 to August 2014, Mr. Vishria served as Vice President, Digital Magazines and Verticals at Yahoo! Inc., a web services provider. From November 2008 to August 2013, Mr. Vishria served as co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of RockMelt, Inc., a social media web browser. He has served as a member of the board of directors of Confluent, Inc., a data solutions company, since September 2014. Mr. Vishria previously served as a member of the board of directors of Amplitude, Inc., a digital optimization company, from December 2014 to June 2025. He also serves as a member of the boards of directors of several private companies. Mr. Vishria holds a B.S. in Mathematical and Computational Science from Stanford University.
paras.zh: Eric Vishria 自 2016 年 5 月起担任我们的董事会成员。自 2014 年 7 月起，Vishria 先生在一家风险投资公司 Benchmark 担任普通合伙人。自 2013 年 8 月至 2014 年 8 月，Vishria 先生在一家网络服务提供商 Yahoo! Inc. 担任数字杂志与垂直业务副总裁。自 2008 年 11 月至 2013 年 8 月，Vishria 先生在一家社交媒体网络浏览器公司 RockMelt, Inc. 担任联合创始人兼首席执行官。自 2014 年 9 月起，他担任一家数据解决方案公司 Confluent, Inc. 的董事会成员。Vishria 先生曾于 2014 年 12 月至 2025 年 6 月担任一家数字优化公司 Amplitude, Inc. 的董事会成员。他还担任多家私营公司的董事会成员。Vishria 先生持有斯坦福大学数学与计算科学理学学士（B.S.）学位。

paras.en: We believe Mr. Vishria is qualified to serve on our board of directors because of his extensive experience as a venture capital investor and a member of the boards of directors of other technology companies.
paras.zh: 我们认为，Vishria 先生因其作为风险投资投资者的丰富经验以及在其他科技公司董事会任职的经历而有资格担任我们的董事会成员。

paras.en: Andrew D. Feldman was previously one of six named defendants in the action SEC v. Pereira, No. 3:06-cv-06384-CRB (N.D. Cal.), in which the SEC alleged, among other things, that Mr. Feldman, as Vice President, Corporate Marketing and Corporate Development of Riverstone Networks, Inc., negotiated, reviewed, approved, or was otherwise aware of sales transactions in 2001 and 2002 that were improperly accounted for by Riverstone and aided and abetted Riverstone in violating U. S. securities laws. Without admitting or denying the allegations of the complaint, Mr. Feldman settled the claims against him in 2008 by entering into an agreement with the SEC permanently restraining and enjoining Mr. Feldman from violating federal securities laws and requiring Mr. Feldman to pay $289,507 plus interest. In connection with the same alleged facts, Mr. Feldman also pled guilty in December 2007 to one count of circumventing accounting controls of an issuer in violation of 15 U.S.C. sections 78m(b)(5) and 78ff, and was sentenced to three years of probation and fined $5,000 in connection with an action brought by the U.S. Department of Justice captioned USA v. Feldman, No. 3:07-cr-07-00731-0001-CRB (N.D. Cal.).
paras.zh: Andrew D. Feldman 此前是 SEC v. Pereira, No. 3:06-cv-06384-CRB（N.D. Cal.）一案中六名具名被告之一，在该案中，SEC 指控（其中包括）Feldman 先生作为 Riverstone Networks, Inc. 的公司营销与公司发展副总裁，曾就 2001 年和 2002 年的销售交易进行谈判、审核、批准或以其他方式知悉该等交易，而 Riverstone 对该等交易进行了不当会计处理，且 Feldman 先生协助和教唆 Riverstone 违反美国证券法。Feldman 先生既不承认也不否认起诉状中的指控，于 2008 年与 SEC 达成协议，永久限制并禁止 Feldman 先生违反联邦证券法，并要求 Feldman 先生支付 $289,507 加利息，以此了结针对其的索赔。就同一被指控事实，Feldman 先生还于 2007 年 12 月对一项规避发行人会计控制的罪名认罪，该行为违反 15 U.S.C. 第 78m(b)(5) 条和第 78ff 条，并在美国司法部提起的、案名为 USA v. Feldman, No. 3:07-cr-07-00731-0001-CRB（N.D. Cal.）的诉讼中被判处三年缓刑并处罚金 $5,000。

paras.en: There are no family relationships among any of our executive officers or directors.
paras.zh: 我们的任何高管或董事之间均不存在亲属关系。

paras.en: #### Director Independence
paras.zh: #### 董事独立性

paras.en: Our board of directors currently consists of six members. Our board of directors has determined that all of our directors, other than Mr. Feldman, qualify as independent directors in accordance with the Nasdaq Listing Rules. Mr. Feldman is not considered independent by virtue of his position as an executive officer of the company. Under the Nasdaq Listing Rules, the definition of independence includes a series of objective tests, such as that the director is not, and has not been for at least three years, one of our employees and that neither the director nor any of his or her family members has engaged in various types of business dealings with us. In addition, as required by the Nasdaq Listing Rules, our board of directors has made a subjective determination as to each independent director that no relationships exists that, in the opinion of our board of directors, would interfere with the exercise of independent judgment in carrying out the responsibilities of a director. In making these determinations, our board of directors reviewed and discussed information provided by the directors and us with regard to each director’s relationships as they may relate to us and our management.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会目前由六名成员组成。我们的董事会已确定，除 Feldman 先生外，我们所有董事均符合纳斯达克上市规则规定的独立董事资格。Feldman 先生因其担任公司高管的职务而不被视为独立董事。根据纳斯达克上市规则，独立性的定义包括一系列客观测试，例如该董事目前不是、且至少在过去三年内未曾是我们的员工，以及该董事及其任何家庭成员均未与我们进行过各类业务往来。此外，根据纳斯达克上市规则的要求，我们的董事会已对每位独立董事作出主观认定，即不存在董事会认为会妨碍其在履行董事职责时行使独立判断的关系。在作出上述认定时，我们的董事会审阅并讨论了董事及我们提供的有关各董事与我们及我们管理层可能存在关系的信息。

paras.en: #### Classified Board of Directors
paras.zh: #### 分类董事会

paras.en: In accordance with our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will be effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, our board of directors will be divided into three classes with staggered three-year terms. At each annual general meeting of stockholders, the successors to directors whose terms then expire will be elected to serve from the time of election and qualification until the third annual meeting following their election. Our directors will be divided among the three classes as follows:
paras.zh: 根据我们经修订和重述的公司章程（该章程将在本次发行完成前立即生效），我们的董事会将分为三个类别，任期交错，每类任期三年。在每届年度股东大会上，任期届满的董事的继任者将当选，自当选并符合资格之时起任职，直至其当选后的第三届年度股东大会。我们的董事将按如下方式分为三个类别：

paras.en: - The Class I directors will be Andrew Feldman and Paul Auvil, and their terms will expire at the annual meeting of stockholders to be held in 2027;
paras.zh: - 第一类董事为 Andrew Feldman 和 Paul Auvil，其任期将在 2027 年召开的年度股东大会上届满；

paras.en: - The Class II directors will be Steve Vassallo and Eric Vishria, and their terms will expire at the annual meeting of stockholders to be held in 2028; and
paras.zh: - 第二类董事为 Steve Vassallo 和 Eric Vishria，其任期将在 2028 年召开的年度股东大会上届满；以及

paras.en: - The Class III directors will be Elena Donio and Lior Susan, and their terms will expire at the annual meeting of stockholders to be held in 2029.
paras.zh: - 第三类董事为 Elena Donio 和 Lior Susan，其任期将在 2029 年召开的年度股东大会上届满。

paras.en: We expect that any additional directorships resulting from an increase in the number of directors will be distributed among the three classes so that, as nearly as possible, each class will consist of one-third of the directors. The division of our board of directors into three classes with staggered three-year terms may delay or prevent a change of our management or a change in control.
paras.zh: 我们预计，因董事人数增加而产生的任何新增董事职位将在三个类别之间分配，以使每个类别尽可能由三分之一的董事组成。将我们的董事会分为三个类别并实行三年交错任期，可能会延迟或阻止我们管理层的变更或控制权的变更。

paras.en: #### Leadership Structure of the Board of Directors
paras.zh: #### 董事会的领导结构

paras.en: Our amended and restated bylaws and corporate governance guidelines to be adopted immediately following the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part will provide our board of directors with flexibility to combine or separate the positions of chairperson of the board of directors and Chief Executive Officer and to implement a lead director in accordance with its determination regarding which structure would be in the best interests of our company.
paras.zh: 我们经修订和重述的章程以及将在本招股说明书所属注册声明生效后立即采纳的公司治理准则，将赋予我们的董事会灵活性，以合并或分离董事会主席与首席执行官这两个职位，并根据其关于何种结构最符合我们公司利益的判断设立首席独立董事。

paras.en: Our board of directors currently believes that our existing leadership structure, under which our chief executive officer, Mr. Feldman, serves as chairman of our board of directors, is effective.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会目前认为，我们现有的领导架构是有效的，即由我们的首席执行官 Feldman 先生兼任董事会主席。

paras.en: Our board of directors will continue to periodically review our leadership structure and may make such changes in the future as it deems appropriate.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会将继续定期审查我们的领导架构，并可能在未来作出其认为适当的此类变更。

paras.en: Our board of directors has appointed Eric Vishria to serve as lead independent director. As lead independent director, Mr. Vishria will preside at all meetings of the board of directors at which the chairman of the board of directors is not present, including executive sessions, and perform such additional responsibilities as set forth in our corporate governance guidelines.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会已任命 Eric Vishria 担任首席独立董事。作为首席独立董事，Vishria 先生将在董事会主席未出席的所有董事会会议上主持，包括执行会议，并履行我们的公司治理准则中规定的其他职责。

paras.en: #### Voting Arrangements
paras.zh: #### 投票安排

paras.en: The election of the members of our board of directors is currently governed by our amended and restated voting agreement that we entered into with certain holders of our capital stock and the related provisions of our current amended and restated certificate of incorporation. Pursuant to our amended and restated voting agreement and current amended and restated certificate of incorporation, Mr. Feldman was elected by certain holders of our common stock, voting together as a single class, and Messrs. Susan, Vassallo, and Vishria were elected by the holders of our Series A redeemable convertible preferred stock.
paras.zh: 我们董事会成员的选举目前受我们与某些资本股票持有人签订的经修订和重述的投票协议以及我们现行经修订和重述的公司章程的相关条款管辖。根据我们经修订和重述的投票协议和现行经修订和重述的公司章程，Feldman 先生由我们的某些普通股持有人作为单一类别共同投票选举产生，Susan 先生、Vassallo 先生和 Vishria 先生由我们的 A 系列可赎回可转换优先股持有人选举产生。

paras.en: Our amended and restated voting agreement will terminate and the provisions of our current amended and restated certificate of incorporation by which our directors were elected will be amended and restated in connection with this offering. After this offering, the number of directors will be fixed by our board of directors, subject to the terms of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws that will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering. Each of our current directors will continue to serve as a director until the election and qualification of his or her successor, or until his or her earlier death, resignation, or removal.
paras.zh: 我们的经修订和重述的投票协议将终止，我们现行经修订和重述的公司章程中关于董事选举的条款将在本次发行中予以修订和重述。本次发行后，董事人数将由我们的董事会确定，但须遵守将在本次发行完成前立即生效的经修订和重述的公司章程和经修订和重述的章程细则的条款。我们每位现任董事将继续担任董事，直至其继任者经选举并符合资格，或直至其提前去世、辞职或被免职。

full.sec: Role of Board in Risk Oversight Process
full.secZh: 董事会在风险监督流程中的作用

paras.en: Risk assessment and oversight are an integral part of our governance and management processes. Our board of directors encourages management to promote a culture that incorporates risk management into our corporate strategy and day-to-day business operations. Management discusses strategic and operational risks at regular management meetings, and conducts specific strategic planning and review sessions during the year that include a focused discussion and analysis of the risks facing us. Throughout the year, senior management reviews these risks with the board of directors at regular board meetings as part of management presentations that focus on particular business functions, operations or strategies, and presents the steps taken by management to mitigate or eliminate such risks.
paras.zh: 风险评估与监督是我们治理和管理流程中不可或缺的组成部分。我们的董事会鼓励管理层培育一种将风险管理融入公司战略和日常业务运营的文化。管理层在定期管理会议上讨论战略风险和运营风险，并在年内开展特定的战略规划与审查会议，其中包括对我们所面临风险的集中讨论与分析。全年中，高级管理层在定期董事会会议上向董事会汇报这些风险，作为聚焦特定业务职能、运营或战略的管理层演示的一部分，并说明管理层为减轻或消除此类风险所采取的措施。

paras.en: Our board of directors does not have a standing risk management committee, but rather administers this oversight function directly through our board of directors as a whole, as well as through various standing committees of our board of directors that address risks inherent in their respective areas of oversight. While our board of directors is responsible for monitoring and assessing strategic risk exposure, our audit committee is responsible for overseeing our major financial and cybersecurity risk exposures and the steps our management has taken to monitor and control these exposures. The audit committee also approves or disapproves any related person transactions. Our nominating and corporate governance committee monitors the effectiveness of our corporate governance guidelines. Our compensation committee assesses and monitors whether any of our compensation policies and programs has the potential to encourage excessive risk-taking. The risk oversight process also includes receiving regular reports from our committees and members of senior management to enable our board of directors to understand our risk identification, risk management, and risk mitigation strategies with respect to areas of potential material risk, including operations, finance, legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, strategic, and reputational risk.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会未设立常设的风险管理委员会，而是通过董事会整体以及董事会下设的各常设委员会直接行使这一监督职能，各常设委员会负责处理其各自监督领域所固有的风险。董事会负责监控和评估战略风险敞口，而我们的审计委员会负责监督我们的重大财务风险和网络安全风险敞口以及管理层为监控和控制这些敞口所采取的措施。审计委员会还负责批准或不批准任何关联人交易。我们的提名与公司治理委员会监控公司治理准则的有效性。我们的薪酬委员会评估并监控我们的任何薪酬政策和计划是否有可能鼓励过度冒险。风险监督流程还包括定期接收各委员会和高级管理层成员的报告，使董事会能够了解我们在潜在重大风险领域（包括运营、财务、法律、监管、网络安全、战略和声誉风险）的风险识别、风险管理和风险缓释策略。

paras.en: Effective as of the date the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is declared effective by the SEC, our board of directors will have three standing committees: an audit committee; a compensation committee; and a nominating and corporate governance committee. Each committee is governed by a charter that will be available on our website following completion of this offering. Members serve on these committees until their resignation or until otherwise determined by our board of directors.
paras.zh: 自本招股说明书所属的注册声明被 SEC 宣布生效之日起，我们的董事会将设立三个常设委员会：审计委员会、薪酬委员会以及提名与公司治理委员会。各委员会均依据章程运作，该等章程将在本次发行完成后在我们网站上提供。各委员会成员任职至其辞职或直至我们的董事会另行决定为止。

paras.en: #### Audit Committee
paras.zh: #### 审计委员会

paras.en: Effective as of the date the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is declared effective by the SEC, the members of our audit committee will consist of Paul Auvil, Elena Donio, and Eric Vishria. Mr. Auvil will be the chairperson of our audit committee. The composition of our audit committee meets the requirements for independence under the current Nasdaq Listing Rules and Rule 10A-3 of the Exchange Act. Each member of our audit committee is financially literate. In addition, our board of directors has determined that Mr. Auvil is an “audit committee financial expert” within the meaning of the SEC rules. This designation does not impose on such directors any duties, obligations, or liabilities that are greater than are generally imposed on members of our audit committee and our board of directors. Our audit committee is directly responsible for, among other things:
paras.zh: 自本招股说明书所属的注册声明被 SEC 宣布生效之日起，我们的审计委员会成员将由 Paul Auvil、Elena Donio 和 Eric Vishria 组成。Auvil 先生将担任我们的审计委员会主席。我们审计委员会的构成符合现行纳斯达克上市规则和《交易法》第 10A-3 条规定的独立性要求。我们审计委员会的每位成员均具备财务知识。此外，我们的董事会已认定 Auvil 先生属于 SEC 规则所指的“审计委员会财务专家”。该认定并不对此类董事施加任何高于通常施加于我们审计委员会成员和董事会成员的职责、义务或责任。我们的审计委员会直接负责以下事项（其中包括）：

paras.en: - appointing, retaining, compensating, and overseeing the work of our independent registered public accounting firm;
paras.zh: - 任命、留用、确定薪酬并监督我们的独立注册公共会计师事务所的工作；

paras.en: - assessing the independence and performance of the independent registered public accounting firm;
paras.zh: - 评估独立注册公共会计师事务所的独立性和业绩；

paras.en: - reviewing with our independent registered public accounting firm the scope and results of the firm’s annual audit of our financial statements;
paras.zh: - 与我们的独立注册公共会计师事务所审阅其对我们财务报表年度审计的范围和结果；

paras.en: - overseeing the financial reporting process and discussing with management and our independent registered public accounting firm the financial statements that we will file with the SEC;
paras.zh: - 监督财务报告流程，并与管理层及我们的独立注册公共会计师事务所讨论我们将向 SEC 提交的财务报表；

paras.en: - pre-approving all audit and permissible non-audit services to be performed by our independent registered public accounting firm;
paras.zh: - 预先批准我们的独立注册公共会计师事务所将提供的所有审计服务和允许的非审计服务；

paras.en: - reviewing policies and practices related to risk assessment and management;
paras.zh: - 审阅与风险评估和管理相关的政策和实践；

paras.en: - reviewing our accounting and financial reporting policies and practices and accounting controls, as well as compliance with legal and regulatory requirements;
paras.zh: - 审阅我们的会计和财务报告政策与实践及会计控制，以及对法律和监管要求的遵守情况；

paras.en: - reviewing cybersecurity matters;
paras.zh: - 审阅网络安全事项；

paras.en: - reviewing, overseeing, approving, or disapproving any related-person transactions;
paras.zh: - 审阅、监督、批准或不批准任何关联人交易；

paras.en: - reviewing with our management the scope and results of management’s evaluation of our disclosure controls and procedures and management’s assessment of our internal control over financial reporting, including the related certifications to be included in the periodic reports we will file with the SEC; and
paras.zh: - 与管理层一同审阅管理层对我们披露控制与程序评估的范围及结果，以及管理层对我们财务报告内部控制的评估，包括将纳入我们向 SEC 提交的定期报告中的相关认证；以及

paras.en: - establishing procedures for the confidential anonymous submission of concerns regarding questionable accounting, internal controls, or auditing matters, or other ethics or compliance issues.
paras.zh: - 建立相关程序，以便就存疑的会计、内部控制或审计事项，或其他道德或合规问题，进行保密匿名举报。

paras.en: #### Compensation Committee
paras.zh: #### 薪酬委员会

paras.en: Effective as of the date the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is declared effective by the SEC, the members of our compensation committee will consist of Elena Donio, Lior Susan, and Steve Vassallo. Ms. Donio will be the chairperson of our compensation committee. Each of Ms. Donio and Messrs. Susan and Vassallo is a non-employee director, as defined by Rule 16b-3 promulgated under the Exchange Act and meets the requirements for independence under the current Nasdaq Listing Rules. Our compensation committee is responsible for, among other things:
paras.zh: 自本招股说明书所属注册声明获 SEC 宣布生效之日起，我们薪酬委员会的成员将由 Elena Donio、Lior Susan 和 Steve Vassallo 组成。Donio 女士将担任我们薪酬委员会的主席。Donio 女士以及 Susan 先生和 Vassallo 先生均为《交易法》下第 16b-3 条规则所定义的非雇员董事，并符合现行纳斯达克上市规则下的独立性要求。我们薪酬委员会负责（其中包括）:

paras.en: - reviewing and approving the compensation of our executive officers, including reviewing and approving corporate goals and objectives with respect to compensation;
paras.zh: - 审阅并批准我们高管的薪酬，包括审阅并批准与薪酬相关的公司目标和目的；

paras.en: - authority to act as an administrator of our equity incentive plans;
paras.zh: - 有权担任我们股权激励计划的管理人；

paras.en: - reviewing and approving, or making recommendations to our board of directors with respect to, incentive compensation and equity plans;
paras.zh: - 审阅并批准激励薪酬和股权计划，或就此向我们的董事会提出建议；

paras.en: - reviewing and recommending that our board of directors approve the compensation for our non-employee directors; and
paras.zh: - 审阅并建议我们的董事会批准我们非雇员董事的薪酬；以及

paras.en: - establishing and reviewing general policies relating to compensation and benefits of our employees.
paras.zh: - 制定并审阅与我们员工薪酬和福利相关的一般政策。

paras.en: #### Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee
paras.zh: #### 提名与公司治理委员会

paras.en: Effective as of the date the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is declared effective by the SEC, the members of our nominating and corporate governance committee will consist of Paul Auvil, Lior Susan, and Steve Vassallo. Mr. Vassallo will be the chairperson of our nominating and corporate governance committee. Each of Messrs. Auvil, Susan, and Vassallo meet the requirements for independence under the current Nasdaq Listing Rules. Our nominating and corporate governance committee is responsible for, among other things:
paras.zh: 自本招股说明书所属注册声明获 SEC 宣布生效之日起，我们提名与公司治理委员会的成员将由 Paul Auvil、Lior Susan 和 Steve Vassallo 组成。Vassallo 先生将担任我们提名与公司治理委员会的主席。Auvil 先生、Susan 先生和 Vassallo 先生均符合现行纳斯达克上市规则下的独立性要求。我们提名与公司治理委员会负责（其中包括）:

paras.en: - identifying and recommending candidates for membership on our board of directors, including the consideration of nominees submitted by stockholders, and on each of the board’s committees;
paras.zh: - 物色并推荐我们的董事会成员人选，包括考虑股东提交的提名人选，以及董事会各委员会的人选；

paras.en: - reviewing and recommending our corporate governance guidelines and policies;
paras.zh: - 审议并就我们的公司治理准则和政策提出建议；

paras.en: - reviewing proposed waivers of the code of business conduct and ethics for directors and executive officers;
paras.zh: - 审议针对董事和高级管理人员的商业行为与道德准则拟议豁免；

paras.en: - overseeing the process of evaluating the performance of our board of directors; and
paras.zh: - 监督我们董事会的绩效评估流程；以及

paras.en: - assisting our board of directors on corporate governance matters.
paras.zh: - 就公司治理事项协助我们的董事会。

full.sec: Code of Business Conduct and Ethics

paras.en: In connection with this offering, our board of directors will adopt a code of business conduct and ethics that applies to all of our employees, officers, and directors, including our Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and other executive and senior financial officers. Upon completion of this offering, the full text of our code of business conduct and ethics will be posted on the investor relations section of our website. We intend to disclose future amendments to our code of business conduct and ethics, or any waivers of such code, on our website or in public filings.
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们的董事会将通过一套适用于我们全体员工、高管和董事（包括我们的首席执行官、首席财务官以及其他高管和高级财务官）的商业行为与道德准则。本次发行完成后，我们的商业行为与道德准则全文将发布在我们网站的投资者关系板块。我们拟在我们网站或公开申报文件中披露未来对该商业行为与道德准则的修订或对该准则的任何豁免。

paras.en: We maintain directors’ and officers’ liability insurance. Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws will include provisions limiting the liability of directors and officers and indemnifying them under certain circumstances. We have entered or will enter into indemnification agreements with each of our directors and officers to provide our directors and officers with additional indemnification and related rights. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Limitations on Liability and Indemnification Matters” for additional information.
paras.zh: 我们投保了董事及高级管理人员责任保险。我们经修订并重述的公司章程和经修订并重述的章程细则将包含限制董事及高级管理人员责任并在特定情形下对其予以补偿的条款。我们已与或将与每位董事及高级管理人员签订补偿协议，为我们的董事及高级管理人员提供额外的补偿及相关权利。更多信息请参见“股本说明——责任限制与补偿事项”一节。

full.sec: Compensation Committee Interlocks and Insider Participation
full.secZh: 薪酬委员会交叉任职与内部人参与

paras.en: None of the members of our board of directors who will serve on our compensation committee upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part is or has been an officer or employee of our company. None of our executive officers currently serves, or in the past fiscal year has served, as a member of a compensation committee (or if no committee performs that function, the board of directors) of any other entity that has an executive officer serving as a member of our board of directors.
paras.zh: 在构成这份招股说明书一部分的注册声明生效后，将担任我们薪酬委员会成员的董事会成员中，没有任何一人现在是或曾经是我们公司的高级职员或员工。我们的任何高级职员目前均未担任、在过去一个财政年度内也未担任任何其他实体的薪酬委员会（若无委员会履行该职能，则为董事会）成员，而该实体的高级职员同时担任我们董事会成员。

paras.en: EXECUTIVE · AND DIRECTOR COMPENSATION
paras.zh: 高管 · 与董事薪酬

paras.en: The following is a discussion and analysis of compensation arrangements of our named executive officers (“NEOs”). This discussion contains forward looking statements that are based on our current plans, considerations, expectations and determinations regarding future compensation programs. Actual compensation programs that we adopt may differ materially from currently planned programs as summarized in this discussion. As an “emerging growth company” as defined in the JOBS Act, we are not required to include a Compensation Discussion and Analysis section and have elected to comply with the scaled disclosure requirements applicable to emerging growth companies.
paras.zh: 以下是对我们列名高管（“NEO”）薪酬安排的讨论与分析。本讨论包含前瞻性陈述，这些陈述基于我们当前对未来薪酬计划的方案、考量、预期和决定。我们实际采用的薪酬计划可能与本讨论所概述的当前计划存在重大差异。作为《JOBS 法案》所定义的“新兴成长型公司”，我们无需包含“薪酬讨论与分析”章节，并已选择遵守适用于新兴成长型公司的简化披露要求。

paras.en: We seek to ensure that the total compensation paid to our executive officers is reasonable and competitive. Compensation of our executive officers is structured around the achievement of individual performance and near-term corporate targets as well as long-term business objectives.
paras.zh: 我们力求确保向我们的高管支付的总薪酬合理且具有竞争力。我们高管的薪酬围绕个人绩效和近期公司目标的实现以及长期业务目标来构建。

paras.zh: - Andrew D. Feldman，我们的首席执行官兼总裁；

paras.zh: - Sean Lie，我们的首席技术官；以及

paras.en: #### Annual Base Salaries
paras.zh: #### 年度基本薪酬

paras.en: We pay each of our NEOs a base salary to compensate them for services rendered to our company. The base salary payable to each NEO is intended to provide a fixed component of compensation reflecting the executive’s skill set, experience, role, and responsibilities.
paras.zh: 我们向每位 NEO 支付基本薪酬，作为其向我们公司提供服务的报酬。应付每位 NEO 的基本薪酬旨在提供固定薪酬组成部分，以反映高管的技能组合、经验、角色和职责。

paras.en: The compensation committee of our board of directors established the annual base salary of each NEO for 2025 as follows: Mr. Feldman, $450,000; Mr. Lie, $400,000; and Mr. Mallick, $400,000. In February 2026, our compensation committee increased the 2026 base salaries of Messrs. Feldman, Lie, and Mallick to $600,000, $500,000, and $450,000, respectively.
paras.zh: 我们董事会薪酬委员会确定了每位 NEO 2025 年的年度基本薪酬如下：Feldman 先生，$450,000；Lie 先生，$400,000；Mallick 先生，$400,000。2026 年 2 月，我们的薪酬委员会将 Feldman 先生、Lie 先生和 Mallick 先生 2026 年的基本薪酬分别提高至 $600,000、$500,000 和 $450,000。

paras.en: Our board of directors and compensation committee may adjust base salaries from time to time in their discretion.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会和薪酬委员会可不时酌情调整基本薪酬。

paras.en: #### Annual Bonuses
paras.zh: #### 年度奖金

paras.en: We maintain an annual performance-based cash bonus program in which each of our NEOs participated in 2025. Under our annual performance-based cash bonus program, our compensation committee has established a target bonus opportunity for each NEO, with the NEO’s earnings based 50% on the achievement of certain corporate financial objectives established by our compensation committee and 50% upon individual performance. The target bonus opportunity established for each NEO for 2025 was as follows: Mr. Feldman, $250,000; Mr. Lie, $200,000; and Mr. Mallick, $200,000.
paras.zh: 我们设有年度绩效现金奖金计划，每位 NEO 均参与了 2025 年度的该计划。根据我们的年度绩效现金奖金计划，我们的薪酬委员会为每位 NEO 设定了目标奖金机会，其中 NEO 的收益 50% 基于我们薪酬委员会设定的特定公司财务目标的实现情况，50% 基于个人绩效。2025 年为每位 NEO 设定的目标奖金机会如下：Feldman 先生，$250,000；Lie 先生，$200,000；Mallick 先生，$200,000。

paras.en: In January 2026, our compensation committee determined achievement of the corporate financial objectives under our annual performance-based cash bonus program (which were achieved at 200% of target), and individual performance levels, and approved the following bonuses for our NEOs based on 2025 performance: Mr. Feldman, $487,500; Mr. Lie, $350,000; and Mr. Mallick: $290,000.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，我们的薪酬委员会确定了年度绩效现金奖金计划下公司财务目标的实现情况（该目标以目标的 200% 达成）以及个人绩效水平，并基于 2025 年绩效批准了以下 NEO 奖金：Feldman 先生，$487,500；Lie 先生，$350,000；Mallick 先生：$290,000。

paras.en: For 2026, our compensation committee adopted a similar annual performance-based cash bonus program. Additionally, in February 2026, our compensation committee increased the annual target bonus opportunities of Messrs. Feldman and Lie to $600,000 and $375,000, respectively.
paras.zh: 2026 年，我们的薪酬委员会通过了类似的年度绩效现金奖金计划。此外，2026 年 2 月，我们的薪酬委员会将 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生的年度目标奖金机会分别提高至 $600,000 和 $375,000。

paras.en: Our board of directors and compensation committee may adjust annual target bonus opportunities or award discretionary bonuses from time to time.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会和薪酬委员会可不时调整年度目标奖金机会或授予酌情奖金。

paras.en: #### Equity-Based Compensation
paras.zh: #### 股权激励薪酬

paras.en: We have granted stock options and RSUs to our NEOs to attract and retain them, as well as to align their interests with the interests of our stockholders. Our stock options are generally exercisable prior to vesting (with any unvested shares subject to repurchase at the original exercise price upon any termination of service) and generally vest over one, three or four years, subject to continued service to the company. Our RSUs generally require satisfaction of both a service-based vesting condition, which is generally satisfied over a one-to four-year period, and a liquidity-based vesting condition, which was satisfied in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 我们已向 NEO 授予股票期权和 RSU，以吸引和留住他们，并使他们的利益与股东的利益保持一致。我们的股票期权通常可在归属前行使（任何未归属股份在服务终止时可按原行使价回购），且通常在一、三或四年内归属，前提是持续为公司服务。我们的 RSU 通常需要同时满足服务归属条件（通常在一年至四年内满足）和流动性归属条件（已在本次发行相关事项中满足）。

paras.en: #### 2025 Equity Awards

In February 2025, we granted each of Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie awards of 400,000 RSUs, which vest subject to satisfaction of service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/48th of the total number of RSUs on each monthly anniversary of January 5, 2025, subject to the executive continuing to provide services through the applicable date. The liquidity-based vesting condition was satisfied in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月，我们向 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生各授予 400,000 份 RSU，该等 RSU 须在满足基于服务及基于流动性的归属条件后方可归属。基于服务的条件自 2025 年 1 月 5 日起，于每个月的周年日就 RSU 总数的 1/48 满足，前提是该高管在相应日期前持续提供服务。基于流动性的归属条件已在本次发行中满足。

paras.en: #### 2026 Founder Equity Awards
paras.zh: #### 2026 年创始人股权奖励

paras.en: In connection with this offering, our compensation committee and board of directors worked closely with Compensia, the compensation committee’s independent compensation consultant, to design a comprehensive, integrated equity compensation package for our co-founder NEOs, Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie. This package consists of three complementary components: make-whole time-based RSU awards, annual time-based RSU awards, and large performance-based RSU (“PRSU”) awards. These components are designed to work together to align the interests of our co-founder executives with those of our stockholders and to drive long-term stockholder value. In designing this equity compensation package, our compensation committee and board of directors engaged Compensia to perform a comprehensive study of market practices among our peers, including overall equity holdings of Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie in comparison to similarly situated executives at peer companies, and the size and structure of equity awards granted to similarly situated co-founder executives. After considerable deliberation, in February 2026, upon the recommendation of our compensation committee, our board of directors granted the equity awards described below.
paras.zh: 就本此发行，我们的薪酬委员会和董事会与薪酬委员会的独立薪酬顾问 Compensia 密切合作，为我们的联合创始人 NEO（Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生）设计了一套全面、综合的股权薪酬方案。该方案由三个互补的组成部分构成：补足性时间归属 RSU 奖励、年度时间归属 RSU 奖励，以及大额绩效归属 RSU（"PRSU"）奖励。这些组成部分旨在协同发挥作用，使我们的联合创始人高管的利益与股东的利益保持一致，并推动长期股东价值。在设计该股权薪酬方案时，我们的薪酬委员会和董事会聘请 Compensia 对我们的同行市场实践进行了全面研究，包括 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生的整体股权持有情况与同行公司中类似高管的比较，以及授予类似联合创始人高管的股权奖励的规模和结构。经过充分审议，2026 年 2 月，根据我们薪酬委员会的建议，我们的董事会授予了下述股权奖励。

paras.en: First Component: Founder Make-Whole RSU Awards
paras.zh: 第一部分：创始人补足性 RSU 奖励

paras.en: After reviewing market data on similarly situated co-founder executives at peer companies and the relative equity holdings of each of Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie, our compensation committee and board of directors determined to grant each executive an award of RSUs intended to bring their existing equity stake in the Company in line with the top 10% of similarly situated executives at our peers. Accordingly, our board of directors granted Mr. Feldman an award of 500,000 RSUs and Mr. Lie an award of 312,500 RSUs. Each award vests subject to satisfaction of service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/60th of the total number of RSUs on each monthly anniversary of January 5, 2026, subject to the executive’s continued employment as the Company’s Chief Executive Officer (for Mr. Feldman) or Chief Technology Officer or higher (for Mr. Lie) (in either case, “Qualified Service”) through the applicable date. The liquidity-based vesting condition was satisfied in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 在审阅了同行公司中类似联合创始人高管的市场数据以及 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生各自的相对股权持有情况后，我们的薪酬委员会和董事会决定向每位高管授予一项 RSU 奖励，旨在使其在公司的现有股权比例与同行中类似高管的前 10% 水平保持一致。因此，我们的董事会向 Feldman 先生授予 500,000 份 RSU，向 Lie 先生授予 312,500 份 RSU。每项奖励须在满足基于服务及基于流动性的归属条件后方可归属。基于服务的条件自 2026 年 1 月 5 日起，于每个月的周年日就 RSU 总数的 1/60 满足，前提是该高管在相应日期前持续担任公司首席执行官（Feldman 先生）或首席技术官或更高职位（Lie 先生）（任一情形均称为“合格服务”）。基于流动性的归属条件已在本此发行中满足。

paras.en: Second Component: Founder Annual RSU Awards
paras.zh: 第二部分：创始人年度 RSU 奖励

paras.en: After reviewing market data on similarly situated co-founder executives at peer companies, our compensation committee and board of directors determined to grant each of Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie an award of RSUs intended to constitute an annual refresh grant that rewards the executive for performance over the prior year while ensuring continued retention. Accordingly, our board of directors granted Mr. Feldman an award of 243,902 RSUs and Mr. Lie an award of 182,926 RSUs. Each award vests subject to satisfaction of service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/48th of the total number of RSUs on each monthly anniversary of January 5, 2026, subject to the executive’s Qualified Service through the applicable date. The liquidity-based vesting condition was satisfied in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 在审阅了同业公司中情况类似的联合创始人高管的薪酬市场数据后，我们的薪酬委员会和董事会决定向 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生各授予一笔限制性股票单位（RSU），该奖励拟构成年度刷新授予，旨在奖励高管过去一年的业绩表现，同时确保其继续留任。据此，我们的董事会向 Feldman 先生授予 243,902 个 RSU，向 Lie 先生授予 182,926 个 RSU。每笔奖励的归属须满足基于服务和基于流动性的归属条件。基于服务的条件在自 2026 年 1 月 5 日起的每个月度周年日就 RSU 总数的 1/48 满足，前提是该高管在相关日期前保持合格服务。基于流动性的归属条件已与本次发行相关而满足。

paras.en: Third Component: Founder PRSU Awards
paras.zh: 第三部分：创始人 PRSU 奖励

paras.en: After reviewing market data on similarly situated co-founder executives at peer companies that underwent an initial public offering of their common stock, our compensation committee and board of directors determined to grant each of Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie an award of PRSUs intended to provide a meaningful incentive to drive long-term value to our stockholders. Accordingly, our board of directors granted Mr. Feldman an award of 5,700,000 PRSUs and Mr. Lie an award of 3,300,000 PRSUs. These PRSU awards significantly align Mr. Feldman’s and Mr. Lie’s compensation with our stockholders’ interests by requiring sustained achievement of market capitalization targets. The size of the awards was determined after consideration of Mr. Feldman’s and Mr. Lie’s current equity holdings, after giving effect to the 2026 make-whole RSUs and 2026 annual RSUs described above, and similar equity awards granted to founders of publicly traded companies serving in executive positions.
paras.zh: 在审阅了同业公司中情况类似的、其普通股已完成首次公开发行的联合创始人高管的薪酬市场数据后，我们的薪酬委员会和董事会决定向 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生各授予一笔 PRSU，旨在提供有意义的激励，以推动为我们的股东创造长期价值。据此，我们的董事会向 Feldman 先生授予 5,700,000 个 PRSU，向 Lie 先生授予 3,300,000 个 PRSU。这些 PRSU 奖励要求持续实现市值目标，从而使 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生的薪酬与我们的股东利益显著保持一致。奖励规模是在考虑了 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生当前的股权持有情况（在计入上述 2026 年补足 RSU 和 2026 年年度 RSU 之后），以及授予担任高管职务的上市公司创始人的类似股权奖励后确定的。

paras.en: Each PRSU represents the right to receive one share of Class B common stock upon vesting. The PRSUs are eligible to vest starting six months following completion of this offering in three separate tranches in the event the market capitalization hurdles in the table below are achieved, subject to the executive’s Qualified Service through the vesting date.
paras.zh: 每个 PRSU 代表在归属时获得一股 B 类普通股的权利。在实现下表所列市值门槛的情况下，PRSU 有资格自本次发行完成之日起六个月后分三个独立批次归属，前提是该高管在归属日之前保持合格服务。

paras.en: **Tranche**
(Feldman)(Lie)
paras.zh: （Feldman）（Lie）

paras.en: For purposes of determining whether a market capitalization hurdle has been achieved, the 90-trading-day trailing average of the product of (i) the closing trading price of our Class A common stock on the applicable trading day multiplied by (ii) the number of outstanding shares of Class A common stock on such trading day, must equal or exceed the applicable market capitalization hurdle. In the event of a change in control of the Company, subject to the executive’s Qualified Service through such change in control, the per share amount to be paid in connection with the change in control will be used to determine final market capitalization hurdle achievement (using linear interpolation if such amount falls between two market capitalization hurdles). In the event of a significant merger or acquisition by the Company pursuant to which Company capital stock is used as full or partial consideration, the market capitalization hurdles shall be appropriately and proportionately adjusted upwards to reflect the capital stock issued in such merger or acquisition.
paras.zh: 为确定是否达到某一市值门槛，须以（i）我们 A 类普通股在适用交易日的收盘交易价格乘以（ii）该交易日 A 类普通股的流通在外股数所得乘积的 90 个交易日移动平均值，等于或超过适用的市值门槛。若公司发生控制权变更，且该高管在控制权变更前持续提供合格服务，则控制权变更中每股应付金额将用于确定最终市值门槛的达成情况（若该金额介于两个市值门槛之间，则采用线性插值法）。若公司进行重大合并或收购，且以公司股本作为全部或部分对价，则市值门槛应相应且按比例向上调整，以反映该合并或收购中发行的股本。

paras.en: Except as otherwise determined by the compensation committee, in the event of a termination of Mr. Feldman’s or Mr. Lie’s Qualified Service, all then-unvested PRSUs held by such executive will automatically forfeit. Additionally, any PRSUs that remain unvested as of the ninth anniversary of the completion of this offering will automatically forfeit.
paras.zh: 除薪酬委员会另有决定外，若 Feldman 先生或 Lie 先生的合格服务终止，该高管届时持有的全部未归属 PRSU 将自动失效。此外，截至本次发行完成九周年之日仍未归属的任何 PRSU 将自动失效。

paras.en: Other 2026 Equity Awards
paras.zh: 其他 2026 年股权奖励

paras.en: In February 2026, we granted Mr. Mallick an award of 150,000 RSUs, which vests subject to satisfaction of service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based condition is satisfied as to 1/24th of the total number of RSUs on each monthly anniversary of August 5, 2026, subject to him continuing to provide services through the applicable date. The liquidity-based vesting condition was satisfied in connection with this offering.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月，我们向 Mallick 先生授予 150,000 份 RSU，该奖励须满足基于服务和基于流动性的归属条件方可归属。基于服务的条件自 2026 年 8 月 5 日起，于每个月的周年日就 RSU 总数的 1/24 满足，前提是其持续提供服务至适用日期。基于流动性的归属条件已在本次发行相关事项中满足。

paras.en: #### New Equity Plan
paras.zh: #### 新股权计划

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we adopted a 2026 Incentive Award Plan (the “2026 Plan”), in order to facilitate the grant of cash and equity incentives to employees (including our NEOs), directors, and consultants of our company and certain of our affiliates and to enable us to obtain and retain services of these individuals, which is essential to our long-term success. The 2026 Plan became effective on the day immediately prior to the date of effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. For additional information about the 2026 Plan, see the section titled “Equity Compensation Plans” below.
paras.zh: 就本次发行，我们通过了 2026 年激励奖励计划（“2026 年计划”），以便向我们公司及若干关联方的员工（包括我们的 NEO）、董事和顾问授予现金及股权激励，并使我们能够获得并留住这些人员的服务，这对我们的长期成功至关重要。2026 年计划于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日期的前一天生效。有关 2026 年计划的更多信息，请参见下文标题为“股权激励计划”的章节。

paras.en: #### Retirement Savings and Health and Welfare Benefits
paras.zh: #### 退休储蓄及健康与福利待遇

paras.en: We currently maintain a 401(k) retirement savings plan for our employees, including our NEOs, who satisfy certain eligibility requirements. Our NEOs are eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan on the same terms as other full-time employees. The U.S. Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”) allows eligible employees to defer a portion of their compensation, within prescribed limits, on a pre-tax basis through contributions to the 401(k) plan. We believe that providing a vehicle for tax-deferred retirement savings through our 401(k) plan adds to the overall desirability of our executive compensation package and further incentivizes our employees, including our NEOs, in accordance with our compensation policies.
paras.zh: 我们目前为符合特定资格要求的员工（包括我们的 NEO）维持一项 401(k) 退休储蓄计划。我们的 NEO 有资格以与其他全职员工相同的条件参与 401(k) 计划。经修订的《1986 年美国国内税收法典》（“法典”）允许符合条件的员工在规定限额内，通过向 401(k) 计划缴款，以税前方式递延部分薪酬。我们认为，通过 401(k) 计划提供递延纳税退休储蓄工具，提升了我们高管薪酬方案的整体吸引力，并按照我们的薪酬政策进一步激励我们的员工（包括我们的 NEO）。

paras.en: All of our full-time employees, including our NEOs, are eligible to participate in our health and welfare plans, including medical, dental, and vision benefits; medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts; short-term and long-term disability insurance; and life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance.
paras.zh: 我们的所有全职员工（包括我们的 NEO）均有资格参与我们的健康与福利计划，包括医疗、牙科和视力福利；医疗及受抚养人护理灵活支出账户；短期和长期伤残保险；以及人寿和意外死亡及肢体离断保险。

paras.en: #### Perquisites and Other Personal Benefits
paras.zh: #### 附加福利及其他个人福利

paras.en: We provide perquisites and other personal benefits to our NEOs when we believe it is necessary to attract or retain the NEO. None of our NEOs received any perquisites during 2025.
paras.zh: 当我们认为有必要吸引或留任 NEO 时，我们会向 NEO 提供附加福利及其他个人福利。2025 年，我们的 NEO 均未获得任何附加福利。
