paras.en: #### Offer Letters
paras.zh: #### 聘用函

paras.en: We are party to continued employment offer letters with Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie, and an amended and restated offer letter with Mr. Mallick. Each offer letter provides for an initial base salary, target bonus opportunity, eligibility for employee benefits, and eligibility for future equity awards. The continued employment offer letters for Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie provide that, commencing in 2027 and for so long as they remain employed by us, they will each be eligible to receive an annual equity award, (i) with the size and terms of such awards to be determined by our compensation committee and approved by our board of directors each year, (ii) with such awards to be based on a market assessment of the value of equity awards granted to chief executive officers (for Mr. Feldman) or chief technology officers (for Mr. Lie) in our compensation peer group for the applicable year, and (iii) with the terms and conditions of such awards to be no less favorable than those of the annual equity awards granted to the other executive officers in our compensation peer group for the applicable year, other than with respect to the mix between performance-based and time-based equity awards.
paras.zh: 我们与 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生签订了持续聘用函，并与 Mallick 先生签订了经修订和重述的聘用函。每份聘用函均规定了初始基本工资、目标奖金机会、员工福利资格以及未来股权奖励资格。Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生的持续聘用函规定，自 2027 年起，只要他们仍受雇于我们，他们每人将有资格获得年度股权奖励，(i) 该等奖励的规模和条款由我们的薪酬委员会确定并经我们的董事会每年批准，(ii) 该等奖励应基于对我们薪酬同行组中首席执行官（针对 Feldman 先生）或首席技术官（针对 Lie 先生）在适用年度所获股权奖励价值的市场评估，以及 (iii) 该等奖励的条款和条件不得劣于我们薪酬同行组中其他高管在适用年度所获年度股权奖励的条款和条件，但基于业绩的股权奖励与基于时间的股权奖励之间的组合除外。

paras.en: #### Change in Control and Severance Arrangements
paras.zh: #### 控制权变更与遣散安排

paras.en: Each NEO participates in our Executive Change in Control and Severance Plan (the “Severance Plan”), and their benefits under the Severance Plan are described below. Payments and benefits under the Severance Plan are contingent on the applicable executive timely providing us with (and not revoking) a general release of claims.
paras.zh: 每位 NEO 均参与我们的高管控制权变更与遣散计划（“遣散计划”），其在遣散计划下的福利如下所述。遣散计划下的付款和福利以适用高管及时向我们提供（且不撤销）一般性索赔豁免为条件。

paras.en: If we terminate an NEO’s employment without “cause” or the NEO resigns for “good reason” (in each case, as defined in the Severance Plan) other than during the period beginning three months before and ending 12 months after a change in control (the “CIC Protection Period”), in addition to any accrued obligations, the executive will be entitled to the following: (i) an amount equal to 15 months (for Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie) or 12 months (for Mr. Mallick) of the executive’s then-current base salary, (ii) payment or reimbursement of COBRA premiums for up to 12 months following the termination date, and (iii) for Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie only, six months of additional vesting for the executive’s outstanding equity awards that vest solely based on continued service to the Company.
paras.zh: 如果我们无“正当理由”终止 NEO 的雇佣关系，或 NEO 因“正当理由”辞职（每种情况均按遣散计划中的定义），且该等终止或辞职并非发生在控制权变更前三个月开始至控制权变更后 12 个月结束的期间（“CIC 保护期”）内，则除任何应计义务外，该高管将有权获得以下各项：(i) 相当于该高管当时基本工资 15 个月（针对 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生）或 12 个月（针对 Mallick 先生）的金额，(ii) 在终止日期后最多 12 个月的 COBRA 保费支付或报销，以及 (iii) 仅针对 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生，其仅基于对公司持续服务而归属的未兑现股权奖励可额外归属六个月。

paras.en: If we terminate an NEO’s employment without “cause” or the NEO resigns for “good reason” during the CIC Protection Period, in addition to any accrued obligations, in lieu of the benefits in the paragraph above the NEO will be entitled to the following: (i) an amount equal to 18 months (for Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie) or 12 months (for Mr. Mallick) of the executive’s then-current base salary, (ii) an amount equal to 1.5 times (for Mr. Feldman and Mr. Lie) or 1.0 times (for Mr. Mallick) the executive’s target annual bonus for the year of termination, (iii) payment or reimbursement of COBRA premiums for up to 12 months following the termination date, and (iv) full vesting acceleration of the executive’s outstanding equity awards that vest based solely on continued service to the Company.
paras.zh: 如果我们在 CIC 保护期内无“正当理由”终止 NEO 的雇佣关系，或 NEO 因“正当理由”辞职，则除任何应计义务外，作为对上述段落中福利的替代，NEO 将有权获得以下各项：(i) 相当于该高管当时基本工资 18 个月（针对 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生）或 12 个月（针对 Mallick 先生）的金额，(ii) 相当于该高管终止年度目标年度奖金 1.5 倍（针对 Feldman 先生和 Lie 先生）或 1.0 倍（针对 Mallick 先生）的金额，(iii) 在终止日期后最多 12 个月的 COBRA 保费支付或报销，以及 (iv) 其仅基于对公司持续服务而归属的未兑现股权奖励的全部加速归属。

paras.en: The following summarizes the material terms of the long-term incentive compensation plan and employee stock purchase plan in which our NEOs will be eligible to participate following this offering and our existing equity plans, under which we have previously made periodic grants of equity and equity-based awards to our NEOs and other employees.
paras.zh: 以下概述了长期激励薪酬计划和员工购股计划的主要条款，我们的 NEO 在本次发行后将有权参与该等计划，同时亦概述了我们现有股权计划的主要条款，我们此前已根据该等计划向我们的 NEO 及其他员工定期授予股权及基于股权的奖励。

paras.en: #### 2026 Incentive Award Plan
paras.zh: #### 2026 激励奖励计划

paras.en: We have adopted the 2026 Plan, which became effective on the day immediately prior to the date of effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. The principal purpose of the 2026 Plan is to attract, retain, and motivate selected employees, directors, and consultants through the granting of stock-based compensation awards and cash-based performance bonus awards. The material terms of the 2026 Plan are summarized below.
paras.zh: 我们已采纳 2026 计划，该计划于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日期的前一天生效。2026 计划的主要目的是通过授予基于股票的薪酬奖励和基于现金的绩效奖金奖励，吸引、留住并激励选定的员工、董事和顾问。2026 计划的主要条款概述如下。

paras.en: Share Reserve. Under the 2026 Plan, 42,650,268 shares of our Class A common stock were initially reserved for issuance pursuant to a variety of stock-based compensation awards, including stock options, stock appreciation rights (“SARs”), restricted stock awards, RSU awards, and other stock-based awards. The number of shares initially reserved for issuance or transfer pursuant to awards under the 2026 Plan will be increased by (i) the number of shares of our Class A common stock and Class B common stock represented by awards outstanding under the 2016 Plan that become available for issuance under the counting provisions described below following the effective date of the 2026 Plan and (ii) an annual increase on the first day of each fiscal year beginning in 2027 and ending in 2036, equal to the lesser of (A) 5% of the sum of (1) all shares of all classes of our common stock, and (2) the number of shares issuable upon the exercise of warrants to purchase shares of our common stock with an exercise price per share of $0.01 or less, in each case, outstanding on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal year and (B) such smaller number of shares of stock as determined by our board of directors; provided, however, that no more than 275,520,731 shares may be issued upon the exercise of incentive stock options.
paras.zh: 股份储备。根据 2026 计划，最初预留 42,650,268 股我们的 A 类普通股，用于根据各类基于股票的薪酬奖励发行，包括股票期权、股票增值权（“SARs”）、限制性股票奖励、RSU 奖励及其他基于股票的奖励。根据 2026 计划项下奖励最初预留用于发行或转让的股份数量将增加：(i) 2016 计划项下尚未行使的奖励所代表的、在 2026 计划生效日期后根据下述计算条款可供发行的我们的 A 类普通股和 B 类普通股股份数量；以及 (ii) 自 2027 年起至 2036 年止，每个财年第一天的年度增加额，等于以下两者中的较小者：(A) 以下两项之和的 5%：(1) 我们所有类别普通股的全部股份，以及 (2) 行使购买我们普通股股份的认股权证（每股行权价等于或低于 $0.01）时可发行的股份数量，在每种情况下均为紧接上一财年最后一日尚未行使的股份；以及 (B) 我们董事会确定的较小股份数量；但前提是，因行使激励性股票期权而发行的股份不得超过 275,520,731 股。

paras.en: The following counting provisions are in effect for the share reserve under the 2026 Plan:
paras.zh: 以下计算条款适用于 2026 计划项下的股份储备：

paras.en: - to the extent that an award (including an award granted under the 2016 Plan (a “Prior Plan Award”)) terminates, expires, or lapses for any reason or an award is settled in cash without the delivery of shares, any shares subject to the award at such time will be available for future grants under the 2026 Plan;
paras.zh: - 若某项奖励（包括根据 2016 计划授予的奖励（“先前计划奖励”））因任何原因终止、到期或失效，或某项奖励以现金结算而未交付股份，则届时受该奖励约束的任何股份将可用于 2026 计划项下的未来授予；

paras.en: - to the extent shares are tendered or withheld to satisfy the grant, exercise price, or tax withholding obligation with respect to any award under the 2026 Plan or Prior Plan Award, such tendered or withheld shares will be available for future grants under the 2026 Plan;
paras.zh: - 若为满足 2026 计划项下任何奖励或先前计划奖励的授予、行权价或预扣税义务而交回或预扣股份，则该等交回或预扣的股份将可用于 2026 计划项下的未来授予；

paras.en: - to the extent shares subject to stock appreciation rights are not issued in connection with the stock settlement of stock appreciation rights on exercise thereof, such shares will be available for future grants under the 2026 Plan;
paras.zh: - 若受股票增值权约束的股份在行使股票增值权进行股票结算时未予发行，则该等股份将可用于 2026 计划项下的未来授予；

paras.en: - to the extent that shares of our Class A common stock are repurchased by us prior to vesting so that shares are returned to us, such shares will be available for future grants under the 2026 Plan;
paras.zh: - 若我们的 A 类普通股股份在归属前被我们回购，从而使该等股份返还给我们，则该等股份将可用于 2026 年计划项下的未来授予；

paras.en: - the payment of dividend equivalents in cash in conjunction with any outstanding awards or Prior Plan Awards will not be counted against the shares available for issuance under the 2026 Plan; and
paras.zh: - 就任何未兑现奖励或先前计划奖励以现金支付的股息等值款项，不计入 2026 年计划项下可供发行的股份数量；以及

paras.en: - to the extent permitted by applicable law or any exchange rule, shares issued in assumption of, or in substitution for, any outstanding awards of any entity acquired in any form of combination by us or any of our subsidiaries will not be counted against the shares available for issuance under the 2026 Plan.
paras.zh: - 在适用法律或任何交易所规则允许的范围内，为承接或替代我们或我们任何子公司以任何形式合并方式收购的任何实体的任何未兑现奖励而发行的股份，不计入 2026 年计划项下可供发行的股份数量。

paras.en: In addition, the sum of the grant date fair value of all equity-based awards and the maximum that may become payable pursuant to all cash-based awards to any individual for services as a non-employee director during any calendar year may not exceed $4,000,000 for a non-employee director’s first year of service as a non-employee director, and $1,000,000 for each year thereafter. Our board of directors may make exceptions to this limit for individual non-employee directors in extraordinary circumstances, as our board of directors may determine in its discretion, provided that the non-employee director receiving such additional compensation may not participate in the decision to award such compensation or in other contemporaneous compensation decisions involving non-employee directors.
paras.zh: 此外，就任何个人作为非雇员董事在一个日历年度内提供的服务，所有股权类奖励的授予日公允价值与所有现金类奖励可能应付的最高金额之和，在非雇员董事担任非雇员董事的第一年不得超过 $4,000,000，此后每年不得超过 $1,000,000。在特殊情况下，我们的董事会可自行决定对个别非雇员董事的该限额作出例外安排，但获得该等额外薪酬的非雇员董事不得参与授予该等薪酬的决定，也不得参与涉及非雇员董事的其他同期薪酬决定。

paras.en: Administration. The compensation committee of our board of directors will administer the 2026 Plan unless our board of directors assumes authority for administration. The compensation committee must consist of at least three members of our board of directors, each of whom is intended to qualify as a “non-employee director” for purposes of Rule 16b-3 under the Exchange Act and an “independent director” within the meaning of the rules of the applicable stock exchange, or other principal securities market on which shares of our Class A common stock are traded. The 2026 Plan provides that our board of directors or compensation committee may delegate its authority to grant awards to employees other than executive officers and certain senior executives of the company to a committee consisting of one or more members of our board of directors or one or more of our officers, other than awards made to our non-employee directors, which must be approved by our full board of directors.
paras.zh: 管理。我们的董事会薪酬委员会将管理 2026 年计划，除非我们的董事会承担管理权。薪酬委员会必须由至少三名董事会成员组成，每名成员均须符合《交易法》第 16b-3 条规则所指的“非雇员董事”资格，并符合我们的 A 类普通股股票所上市交易的适用证券交易所或其他主要证券市场的规则所指的“独立董事”含义。2026 年计划规定，我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可将其向公司非高管员工及某些高级管理人员授予奖励的权力授予由一名或多名董事会成员或一名或多名公司高管组成的委员会，但向我们的非雇员董事作出的奖励除外，该等奖励必须经我们的全体董事会批准。

paras.en: Subject to the terms and conditions of the 2026 Plan, the administrator has the authority to select the persons to whom awards are to be made, to determine the number of shares to be subject to awards and the terms and conditions of awards, and to make all other determinations and to take all other actions necessary or advisable for the administration of the 2026 Plan. The administrator is also authorized to adopt, amend or rescind rules relating to administration of the 2026 Plan. Our board of directors may at any time remove the compensation committee as the administrator and revest in itself the authority to administer the 2026 Plan. The full board of directors will administer the 2026 Plan with respect to awards to non-employee directors.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年计划的条款和条件约束下，管理人有权选择授予奖励的对象、确定受奖励约束的股份数量及奖励的条款和条件，并作出所有其他决定以及采取为管理 2026 年计划所必需或适宜的所有其他行动。管理人亦获授权制定、修订或废止与 2026 年计划管理相关的规则。我们的董事会可随时免去薪酬委员会的管理人职务，并将管理 2026 年计划的权力重新收归董事会自身。对于向非雇员董事授予的奖励，2026 年计划将由全体董事会管理。

paras.en: Eligibility. Awards under the 2026 Plan may be granted to individuals who are then our officers, employees, or consultants or are the officers, employees, or consultants of certain of our subsidiaries. Such awards also may be granted to our directors. Only employees of our company or certain of our subsidiaries may be granted incentive stock options.
paras.zh: 资格。2026 年计划项下的奖励可授予当时担任我们高级管理人员、员工或顾问的个人，或担任我们某些子公司高级管理人员、员工或顾问的个人。此类奖励亦可授予我们的董事。仅我们公司或我们某些子公司的员工方可获授激励性股票期权。

paras.en: Awards. The 2026 Plan provides that the administrator may grant or issue stock options, SARs, restricted stock, RSUs, other stock-or cash-based awards and dividend equivalents, or any combination thereof. Each award will be set forth in a separate agreement with the person receiving the award and will indicate the type, terms, and conditions of the award.
paras.zh: 奖励。2026 年计划规定，管理人可授予或发行股票期权、股票增值权（SARs）、限制性股票、限制性股票单位（RSU）、其他基于股票或现金的奖励及股息等值权利，或上述各项的任意组合。每项奖励将在与获授人另行签订的协议中载明，并注明奖励的类型、条款和条件。

paras.en: - Nonqualified Stock Options (“NSOs”) will provide for the right to purchase shares of our Class A common stock at a specified price which may not be less than fair market value on the date of grant, and usually will become exercisable (at the discretion of the administrator) in one or more installments after the grant date, subject to the participant’s continued employment or service with us and/or subject to the satisfaction of corporate performance targets and individual performance targets established by the administrator. NSOs may be granted for any term specified by the administrator that does not exceed ten years.
paras.zh: - 非合格股票期权（“NSOs”）将赋予按指定价格购买我们 A 类普通股的权利，该价格不得低于授予日的公允市场价值，且通常将在授予日后（由管理人酌情决定）分一期或多期归属可行权，前提是参与人继续受雇于我们或为我们提供服务，和/或满足管理人设定的公司业绩目标和个人业绩目标。NSOs 的授予期限可由管理人指定，但不得超过十年。

paras.en: - Incentive Stock Options (“ISOs”) will be designed in a manner intended to comply with the provisions of Section 422 of the Code and will be subject to specified restrictions contained in the Code. Among such restrictions, ISOs must have an exercise price of not less than the fair market value of a share of Class A common stock on the date of grant, may only be granted to employees, and must not be exercisable after a period of ten years measured from the date of grant. In the case of an ISO granted to an individual who owns (or is deemed to own) at least 10% of the total combined voting power of all classes of our capital stock, the 2026 Plan provides that the exercise price must be at least 110% of the fair market value of a share of Class A common stock on the date of grant and the ISO must not be exercisable after a period of five years measured from the date of grant.
paras.zh: - 激励性股票期权（“ISOs”）的设计旨在符合《税法》第 422 条的规定，并受《税法》所载特定限制的约束。此类限制包括：ISOs 的行权价格不得低于授予日 A 类普通股每股的公允市场价值，仅可授予员工，且自授予日起满十年后不得行权。对于授予拥有（或被视同拥有）我们全部股本各类别合计投票权至少 10% 的个人的 ISO，2026 年计划规定行权价格必须至少为授予日 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值的 110%，且该 ISO 自授予日起满五年后不得行权。

paras.en: - Restricted Stock may be granted to any eligible individual and made subject to such restrictions as may be determined by the administrator. Restricted stock, typically, may be forfeited for no consideration or repurchased by us at the original purchase price or other stated or formula price if the conditions or restrictions on vesting are not met. In general, restricted stock may not be sold or otherwise transferred until restrictions are removed or expire. Purchasers of restricted stock, unlike recipients of options, will have voting rights and will have the right to receive dividends, if any, prior to the time when the restrictions lapse, however, extraordinary dividends will generally be placed in escrow, and will not be released until restrictions are removed or expire.
paras.zh: - 限制性股票可授予任何符合条件的个人，并受管理人可能确定的限制条件约束。通常情况下，若归属条件或限制未达成，限制性股票可被无偿没收，或由我们按原始购买价格或其他约定价格或公式价格回购。一般而言，在限制解除或到期之前，限制性股票不得出售或以其他方式转让。与期权获授人不同，限制性股票的购买者在限制失效之前享有投票权，并有权获得股息（如有）；但特别股息通常将被置于托管账户，直至限制解除或到期后方可释放。

paras.en: - RSUs may be awarded to any eligible individual, typically without payment of consideration, but subject to vesting conditions based on continued employment or service or on performance criteria established by the administrator. Like restricted stock, RSUs may not be sold, or otherwise transferred or hypothecated, until vesting conditions are removed or expire. Unlike restricted stock, stock underlying RSUs will not be issued until the RSUs have vested, and recipients of RSUs generally will have no voting or dividend rights prior to the time when vesting conditions are satisfied.
paras.zh: - RSU 可授予任何符合条件的个人，通常无需支付对价，但须满足基于持续雇佣或服务或管理人设定的业绩标准的归属条件。与限制性股票一样，在归属条件解除或到期之前，RSU 不得出售或以其他方式转让或质押。与限制性股票不同，RSU 所对应的股票在 RSU 归属之前不会发行，且 RSU 获授人在归属条件满足之前通常不享有投票权或股息权。

paras.en: - SARs may be granted in connection with stock options or other awards, or separately. SARs granted in connection with stock options or other awards typically will provide for payments to the holder based upon increases in the price of our Class A common stock over a set exercise price. The exercise price of any SAR granted under the 2026 Plan must be at least 100% of the fair market value of a share of our Class A common stock on the date of grant. SARs under the 2026 Plan will be settled in cash or shares of our Class A common stock, or in a combination of both, at the election of the administrator.
paras.zh: - SAR 可与股票期权或其他奖励一并授予，也可单独授予。与股票期权或其他奖励一并授予的 SAR 通常规定，根据我们的 A 类普通股价格超过设定行权价格的涨幅向持有人付款。根据 2026 年计划授予的任何 SAR 的行权价格必须至少为授予日我们 A 类普通股每股公允市场价值的 100%。2026 年计划下的 SAR 将由管理人选择以现金或我们的 A 类普通股股份或两者组合方式结算。

paras.en: - Other Stock or Cash Based Awards are awards of cash, fully vested shares of our Class A common stock and other awards valued wholly or partially by referring to, or otherwise based on, shares of our Class A common stock. Other stock-or cash-based awards may be granted to participants and may also be available as a payment form in the settlement of other awards, as standalone payments and as payment in lieu of base salary, bonus, fees or other cash compensation otherwise payable to any individual who is eligible to receive awards. The administrator will determine the terms and conditions of other stock-or cash-based awards, which may include vesting conditions based on continued service, performance and/or other conditions.
paras.zh: - 其他股票或现金奖励是指现金奖励、完全归属的我们的 A 类普通股股份，以及全部或部分参照我们的 A 类普通股股份估值或以其他方式基于我们的 A 类普通股股份的其他奖励。其他股票或现金奖励可授予参与者，也可作为其他奖励结算时的支付形式、作为独立付款以及作为替代任何有资格获得奖励的个人原本应得的基本工资、奖金、费用或其他现金薪酬的付款方式。管理人将确定其他股票或现金奖励的条款和条件，其中可能包括基于持续服务、业绩和/或其他条件的归属条件。

paras.en: - Dividend Equivalents represent the right to receive the equivalent value of dividends paid on shares of our Class A common stock and may be granted alone or in tandem with awards other than stock options or SARs. Dividend equivalents are credited as of dividend payments dates during the period between a specified date and the date such award terminates or expires, as determined by the administrator. In addition, dividend equivalents with respect to shares covered by a performance award will only be paid to the participant at the same time or times and to the same extent that the vesting conditions, if any, are subsequently satisfied and the performance award vests with respect to such shares.
paras.zh: - 股息等值代表收取我们 A 类普通股所支付股息等值金额的权利，可单独授予，也可与股票期权或 SAR 以外的其他奖励一并授予。股息等值在指定日期与该奖励终止或到期之日之间的股息支付日计入，由管理人确定。此外，与绩效奖励所涵盖股份相关的股息等值，仅在归属条件（如有）随后得到满足且该绩效奖励就该等股份归属时，于相同时间或相同次数、按相同程度支付给参与者。

paras.en: Any award may be granted as a performance award, meaning that the award will be subject to vesting and/or payment based on the attainment of specified performance goals.
paras.zh: 任何奖励均可作为绩效奖励授予，即该奖励将根据特定绩效目标的达成情况而受归属和/或支付条件的约束。

paras.en: Change in Control. In the event of a change in control, unless the administrator elects to terminate an award in exchange for cash, rights, or other property, or cause an award to accelerate in full prior to the change in control, such award will continue in effect or be assumed or substituted by the acquirer, provided that any performance-based portion of the award will be subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable award agreement. In the event the acquirer refuses to assume or replace awards granted, prior to the completion of such transaction, awards issued under the 2026 Plan will be subject to accelerated vesting such that 100% of such awards will become vested and exercisable or payable, as applicable. The administrator may also make appropriate adjustments to awards under the 2026 Plan and is authorized to provide for the acceleration, cash-out, termination, assumption, substitution or conversion of such awards in the event of a change in control or certain other unusual or nonrecurring events or transactions.
paras.zh: 控制权变更。在控制权变更的情况下，除非管理人选择以现金、权利或其他财产终止奖励，或促使奖励在控制权变更前全部加速归属，否则该奖励将继续有效，或由收购方承继或替代，但奖励中任何基于绩效的部分将受适用奖励协议条款和条件的约束。如收购方拒绝承继或替换已授予的奖励，则在该交易完成前，根据 2026 年计划发行的奖励将加速归属，使该等奖励的 100%归属并可行使或应付（视情况而定）。管理人还可对 2026 年计划下的奖励作出适当调整，并有权在控制权变更或某些其他不寻常或非经常性事件或交易的情况下，规定该等奖励的加速、现金兑现、终止、承继、替代或转换。

paras.en: Adjustments of Awards. In the event of any stock dividend or other distribution, stock split, reverse stock split, reorganization, combination or exchange of shares, merger, consolidation, split-up, spin-off, recapitalization, repurchase, or any other corporate event affecting the number of outstanding shares of our Class A common stock or the share price of our Class A common stock that would require adjustments to the 2026 Plan or any awards under the 2026 Plan in order to prevent the dilution or enlargement of the potential benefits intended to be made available thereunder, the administrator will make appropriate, proportionate adjustments to: (i) the aggregate number and type of shares subject to the 2026 Plan; (ii) the number and kind of shares subject to outstanding awards and terms and conditions of outstanding awards (including, without limitation, any applicable performance targets or criteria with respect to such awards); and (iii) the grant or exercise price per share of any outstanding awards under the 2026 Plan.
paras.zh: 奖励的调整。在发生任何股票股息或其他分配、股票拆分、反向股票拆分、重组、股份合并或交换、合并、整合、拆股、分拆、资本重组、回购，或任何其他影响我们 A 类普通股流通股数量或 A 类普通股股价、且需要对 2026 年计划或 2026 年计划下任何奖励进行调整以防止稀释或扩大拟根据该计划提供的潜在利益的公司事件时，管理人将作出适当、按比例的调整，涉及：(i) 2026 年计划所涵盖股份的总数量和类型；(ii) 未兑现奖励所涵盖股份的数量和种类以及未兑现奖励的条款和条件（包括但不限于该等奖励的任何适用绩效目标或标准）；以及(iii) 2026 年计划下任何未兑现奖励的每股授予价格或行权价格。

paras.en: Amendment and Termination. The administrator may terminate, amend or modify the 2026 Plan at any time and from time to time. However, we must generally obtain stockholder approval to the extent required by applicable law, rule or regulation (including any applicable stock exchange rule). Notwithstanding the foregoing, an option may be amended to reduce the per share exercise price below the per share exercise price of such option on the grant date and options may be granted in exchange for, or in connection with, the cancellation or surrender of options having a higher per share exercise price without receiving additional stockholder approval.
paras.zh: 修订与终止。管理人可随时并不时终止、修订或修改 2026 年计划。但是，在适用法律、规则或法规（包括任何适用的证券交易所规则）要求的范围内，我们通常必须获得股东批准。尽管有前述规定，可将期权修订为将每股行权价格降至低于该期权授予日的每股行权价格，且可授予期权以换取或配合注销或交回每股行权价格更高的期权，而无需另行获得股东批准。

paras.en: No ISOs may be granted pursuant to the 2026 Plan after the tenth anniversary of the date the 2026 Plan was approved by our board of directors, and no additional annual share increases to the 2026 Plan’s aggregate share limit will occur from and after such anniversary. Any award that is outstanding on the termination date of the 2026 Plan will remain in force according to the terms of the 2026 Plan and the applicable award agreement.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年计划经我们董事会批准之日起满十周年后，不得根据 2026 年计划授予任何 ISO，且自该周年日起，2026 年计划的总股份限额不再发生额外的年度股份增加。在 2026 年计划终止日尚未行权或归属的任何奖励，将根据 2026 年计划及适用奖励协议的条款继续有效。

paras.en: #### 2016 Equity Incentive Plan
paras.zh: #### 2016 年股权激励计划

paras.en: The 2016 Plan became effective on May 5, 2016 upon its adoption by our board of directors and approval of our stockholders. Following this offering and in connection with the effectiveness of our 2026 Plan, the 2016 Plan terminated and no further awards will be granted under the 2016 Plan. However, all outstanding awards will continue to be governed by their existing terms.
paras.zh: 2016 年计划于 2016 年 5 月 5 日经我们董事会通过并经我们股东批准后生效。本次发行完成后，并与我们 2026 年计划的生效相关，2016 年计划终止，且不再根据 2016 年计划授予任何奖励。但是，所有尚未行权或归属的奖励将继续受其现有条款的约束。

paras.en: Administration. Our board of directors, the compensation committee, or another committee thereof appointed by our board of directors, has the authority to administer the 2016 Plan and the awards granted under it. The administrator has the authority to select the service providers to whom awards will be granted under the 2016 Plan, the number of shares to be subject to those awards under the 2016 Plan, and the terms and conditions of the awards granted. In addition, the administrator has the authority to construe and interpret the 2016 Plan and to adopt rules relating to the 2016 Plan and exercise such other powers that it deems necessary and desirable to promote the best interests of the company and that are consistent with the terms of the 2016 Plan.
paras.zh: 管理。我们的董事会、薪酬委员会或董事会任命的其他委员会有权管理 2016 年计划及根据其授予的奖励。管理人有权选择将根据 2016 年计划向其授予奖励的服务提供商、根据 2016 年计划受该等奖励约束的股份数量以及所授予奖励的条款和条件。此外，管理人有权解释和阐释 2016 年计划，制定与 2016 年计划相关的规则，并行使其认为必要且适当、符合 2016 年计划条款且有助于促进公司最佳利益的其他权力。

paras.en: Share Reserve. As of December 31, 2025, after giving effect to the Common Stock Reclassification, stock options to purchase a total of 28,361,707 shares of our Class B common stock were outstanding, 772,584 shares of restricted stock acquired upon exercise of options prior to vesting were outstanding, 15,229,068 RSUs covering shares of our Class B common stock were outstanding, and 9,036,864 shares remained available for future grants under the 2016 Plan.
paras.zh: 股份储备。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，在使普通股重分类生效后，可购买总计 28,361,707 股我们 B 类普通股的股票期权尚未行权，在归属前行使期权所获得的 772,584 股限制性股票尚未归属，涵盖我们 B 类普通股的 15,229,068 份 RSU 尚未归属，且根据 2016 年计划仍有 9,036,864 股可供未来授予。

paras.en: Awards. The 2016 Plan provides that the administrator may grant or issue stock options, including ISOs and NSOs, restricted stock, and RSUs to employees, directors, and consultants, provided that only employees may be granted ISOs.
paras.zh: 奖励。2016 年计划规定，管理人可向员工、董事和顾问授予或发行股票期权（包括 ISO 和 NSO）、限制性股票和 RSU，但只有员工可获授 ISO。

paras.en: - Stock Options. The 2016 Plan provides for the grant of ISOs or NSOs. ISOs may be granted only to employees. NSOs may be granted to employees, directors, or consultants. The exercise price of ISOs granted to employees who at the time of grant own stock representing more than 10% of the voting power of all classes of our common stock may not be less than 110% of the fair market value per share of our common stock on the date of grant, and the exercise price of ISOs granted to any other employees may not be less than 100% of the fair market value per share of our common stock on the date of grant. The exercise price of NSOs to employees, directors, or consultants may not be less than 100% of the fair market value per share of our common stock on the date of grant.
paras.zh: - 股票期权。2016 年计划规定授予 ISO 或 NSO。ISO 仅可授予员工。NSO 可授予员工、董事或顾问。授予在授予时持有代表我们全部普通股各类别表决权 10% 以上股票的员工的 ISO，其行权价格不得低于授予日我们普通股每股公允市场价值的 110%；授予任何其他员工的 ISO，其行权价格不得低于授予日我们普通股每股公允市场价值的 100%。授予员工、董事或顾问的 NSO，其行权价格不得低于授予日我们普通股每股公允市场价值的 100%。

paras.en: - Restricted Stock. The 2016 Plan provides for the grant of restricted stock. Each share of restricted stock that is accepted will be governed by a restricted stock purchase agreement, which will detail the restrictions on transferability, risk of forfeiture, and other restrictions the administrator approves. In general, restricted stock acquired upon exercise of a stock purchase right may not be sold, transferred, pledged, hypothecated, margined, or otherwise encumbered until restrictions are removed or expire. Holders of restricted stock, unlike recipients of stock options, will have voting rights and will have the right to receive dividends, if any, prior to the time when the restrictions lapse.
paras.zh: - 限制性股票。2016 年计划规定授予限制性股票。每一股被接受的限制性股票将由一份限制性股票购买协议管辖，该协议将详细规定可转让性限制、没收风险以及管理人批准的其他限制。一般而言，通过行使股票购买权获得的限制性股票在限制解除或到期之前不得出售、转让、质押、抵押、以保证金方式处置或以其他方式设置权利负担。与股票期权接受者不同，限制性股票持有人在限制失效之前享有表决权，并有权获得股息（如有）。

paras.en: - RSUs. The 2016 Plan provides for the grant of RSUs. Each RSU represents the unfunded, unsecured right to receive a share of our common stock or an amount of cash or other consideration equal to the fair market value of a share of our common stock. The terms of each award of RSUs are set forth in a RSU agreement.
paras.zh: - RSU。2016 年计划规定授予 RSU。每份 RSU 代表一项无资金支持、无担保的权利，即获得一股我们普通股或相当于一股我们普通股公允市场价值的现金或其他对价。每项 RSU 授予的条款均在 RSU 协议中规定。

paras.en: - SARs. The 2016 Plan provides for the grant of SARs. SARs may be settled in cash or shares (which may consist of restricted stock or RSUs or a combination thereof, having a value equal to multiplying the difference between the fair market value on the date of exercise over the exercise price and the number of shares with respect to which the SARs are being exercised). All grants of SARs made will be evidenced by an award agreement.
paras.zh: - SAR。2016 年计划规定授予 SAR。SAR 可以现金或股份结算（股份可包括限制性股票或 RSU 或其组合，其价值等于行权日公允市场价值与行权价格之间的差额乘以正在行权的 SAR 所对应的股份数量）。所有 SAR 授予均以授予协议为凭证。

paras.en: Adjustments of Awards. In the event of any dividend or other distribution, reorganization, merger, consolidation, combination, repurchase, liquidation, dissolution, or sale, transfer, exchange, or other disposition of substantially all of our assets, or exchange of shares or other similar corporate transaction or event, the administrator will make adjustments to the number and class of shares available for issuance under the 2016 Plan and the number, class, and price of shares subject to outstanding awards, in order to prevent dilution or enlargement of benefits.
paras.zh: 奖励的调整。如发生任何股息或其他分配、重组、合并、整合、联合、回购、清算、解散，或出售、转让、交换或以其他方式处置我们几乎全部资产，或股份交换或其他类似公司交易或事件，管理人将对 2016 年计划下可供发行的股份数量和类别以及受未决奖励约束的股份数量、类别和价格进行调整，以防止利益被稀释或扩大。

paras.en: Change in Control. In the event of a change in control, any outstanding awards acquired under the 2016 Plan shall be subject to the agreement evidencing the change of control. The successor or acquiring entity may elect for such outstanding awards to be assumed or substituted. Otherwise, in the event of a merger or change in control, the change of control agreement has broad discretion to determine the treatment of each outstanding award, including providing for awards to terminate or accelerate or for awards to terminate in exchange for cash or other property.
paras.zh: 控制权变更。若发生控制权变更，根据 2016 年计划已授予的任何未行权奖励应受证明该控制权变更的协议约束。继受实体或收购实体可选择承接或替换该等未行权奖励。否则，在发生合并或控制权变更时，控制权变更协议拥有广泛的自由裁量权，以决定每项未行权奖励的处理方式，包括规定奖励终止或加速行权，或规定奖励终止以换取现金或其他财产。

paras.en: Amendment and Termination. Our board of directors may amend or terminate the 2016 Plan or any portion thereof at any time. However, no amendment may impair the rights of a holder of an outstanding option grant without the holder’s consent, and any action by our board of directors to increase the number of shares subject to the plan or extend the term of the plan is subject to the approval of our stockholders. Additionally, an amendment of the plan shall be subject to the approval of our stockholders, where such approval by our stockholders of an amendment is required by applicable law. In connection with the effectiveness of our 2026 Plan, the 2016 Plan terminated and no further awards will be granted under the 2016 Plan.
paras.zh: 修订与终止。我们的董事会可随时修订或终止 2016 年计划或其任何部分。但是，未经持有人同意，任何修订不得损害已授予未行权期权的持有人的权利，且董事会任何增加计划项下股份数量或延长计划期限的行动均须经我们的股东批准。此外，在适用法律要求股东批准某项修订的情况下，对计划的修订亦须经我们的股东批准。随着我们 2026 年计划的生效，2016 年计划已终止，且不再根据 2016 年计划授予任何奖励。

paras.en: #### 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan
paras.zh: #### 2026 年员工购股计划

paras.en: We have adopted the ESPP, which became effective on the day immediately prior to the date of effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. The ESPP is designed to allow our eligible employees to purchase shares of our Class A common stock, at periodic intervals, with their accumulated payroll deductions. The ESPP is intended to qualify under Section 423 of the Code. The material terms of the ESPP are summarized below.
paras.zh: 我们已采纳 ESPP，该计划于本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日期的前一天生效。ESPP 旨在允许我们的合资格员工按定期间隔，以其累积的工资扣款购买我们的 A 类普通股股份。ESPP 拟符合《税法》第 423 条的规定。ESPP 的重大条款概述如下。

paras.en: Administration. Subject to the terms and conditions of the ESPP, our compensation committee will administer the ESPP. Our compensation committee can delegate administrative tasks under the ESPP to the services of an agent and/or employees to assist in the administration of the ESPP. The administrator will have the discretionary authority to administer and interpret the ESPP. Interpretations and constructions of the administrator of any provision of the ESPP or of any rights thereunder will be conclusive and binding on all persons. We will bear all expenses and liabilities incurred by the ESPP administrator.
paras.zh: 管理。在 ESPP 的条款和条件约束下，我们的薪酬委员会将管理 ESPP。我们的薪酬委员会可将 ESPP 项下的行政事务委托给代理人和/或员工的服务，以协助 ESPP 的管理。管理方将拥有管理和解释 ESPP 的自由裁量权。管理方对 ESPP 任何条款或项下任何权利的解释和构建将对所有人具有终局性和约束力。我们将承担 ESPP 管理方产生的所有费用和负债。

paras.en: Share Reserve. The maximum number of our shares of our Class A common stock that will be authorized for sale under the ESPP is equal to the sum of (i) 3,554,189 shares of Class A common stock and (ii) an annual increase on the first day of each fiscal year beginning in 2027 and ending in 2036, equal to the lesser of (A) 1% of the sum of (1) all shares of all classes of our common stock, and (2) the number of shares issuable upon the exercise of warrants to purchase shares of our common stock with an exercise price per share of $0.01 or less, in each case, outstanding on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal year and (B) such smaller number of shares of Class A common stock as determined by our board of directors; provided, however, no more than 48,870,099 shares of our Class A common stock may be issued under the ESPP. The shares reserved for issuance under the ESPP may be authorized but unissued shares, treasury shares, or reacquired shares.
paras.zh: 股份储备。根据 ESPP 授权可供出售的 A 类普通股最大股数等于以下两项之和：(i) 3,554,189 股 A 类普通股，以及 (ii) 自 2027 年起至 2036 年止，于每个财年首日按年增加的股份数，该增加额等于以下两项中的较小者：(A) (1) 我们全部类别普通股的全部股份数与 (2) 可因行使购买我们普通股的认股权证（每股行权价等于或低于 $0.01）而发行的股份数之和的 1%，在每种情况下均指紧接前一财年最后一日尚未发行的股份，以及 (B) 由我们的董事会确定的较小 A 类普通股股数；但是，根据 ESPP 发行的 A 类普通股不得超过 48,870,099 股。根据 ESPP 预留供发行的股份可为已授权但未发行的股份、库存股份或回购股份。

paras.en: Eligibility. Employees eligible to participate in the ESPP for a given offering period generally include employees who are employed by us or one of our subsidiaries on the first day of the offering period. Our employees (and, if applicable, any employees of our subsidiaries) who customarily work less than five months in a calendar year or are customarily scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week will not be eligible to participate in the ESPP. Finally, an employee who owns (or is deemed to own through attribution) 5% or more of the combined voting power or value of all our classes of stock or of one of our subsidiaries will not be allowed to participate in the ESPP.
paras.zh: 资格。有资格参与某一发售期 ESPP 的员工通常包括在该发售期首日受雇于我们或我们某一子公司的员工。惯常在一个日历年内工作不足五个月或惯常被安排每周工作不足 20 小时的我们的员工（以及如适用，我们任何子公司的员工）将无资格参与 ESPP。最后，拥有（或被认定通过归属而拥有）我们全部类别股票或我们某一子公司合计投票权或价值 5% 或以上的员工不得参与 ESPP。

paras.en: Participation. Employees will enroll under the ESPP by completing a payroll deduction form permitting the deduction from their compensation of at least 1% of their base compensation but not more than 15% of their base compensation. Such payroll deductions will be expressed as a whole number percentage, and the accumulated deductions will be applied to the purchase of shares on each purchase date. However, a participant may not purchase more than 10,000 shares in each offering period and may not accrue the right to purchase shares of Class A common stock at a rate that exceeds $25,000 in fair market value of shares of our Class A common stock (determined at the time the option is granted) for each calendar year the option is outstanding (as determined in accordance with Section 423 of the Code). The ESPP administrator has the authority to change these limitations for any particular offering period.
paras.zh: 参与。员工将通过填写工资扣款表来加入 ESPP，该表允许从其薪酬中扣除至少为其基本薪酬的 1% 但不超过其基本薪酬的 15%。该等工资扣款将以整数百分比表示，累计扣款将用于在每个购买日购买股份。但是，参与者在每个发售期内不得购买超过 10,000 股，且不得累积以超过以下速度购买 A 类普通股的权利：在该期权尚未行权的每个日历年度内，所购买 A 类普通股的公平市场价值超过 $25,000（按授予期权时确定）（依据《税法》第 423 条确定）。ESPP 管理人有权就任何特定发售期更改该等限制。

paras.en: Offering. Under the ESPP, participants are offered the option to purchase shares of our Class A common stock at a discount during a series of successive offering periods, the duration and timing of which will be determined by the ESPP administrator. However, in no event may an offering period be longer than 27 months in length. The first offering period commenced on the date of effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part and ends in February 2027.
paras.zh: 发售。根据 ESPP，参与者在由 ESPP 管理人确定期限和时间的连续一系列发售期内，被授予按折扣价购买我们 A 类普通股的选择权。但是，任何发售期的期限在任何情况下均不得超过 27 个月。首个发售期自本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效之日起开始，并于 2027 年 2 月结束。

paras.en: The option purchase price will be the lower of 85% of the closing trading price per share of our Class A common stock as of the first date of an offering period in which a participant is enrolled or 85% of the closing trading price per share as of the purchase date, which will occur on the last day of each purchase period within an offering period.
paras.zh: 期权购买价格将取以下两者中的较低者：参与人加入的发行期首日我们 A 类普通股每股收盘交易价格的 85%，或购买日每股收盘交易价格的 85%，购买日为发行期内每个购买期的最后一日。

paras.en: Unless a participant has previously cancelled his or her participation in the ESPP before the purchase date, the participant will be deemed to have exercised his or her option in full as of each purchase date. Upon exercise, the participant will purchase the number of whole shares that his or her accumulated payroll deductions will buy at the option purchase price, subject to the participation limitations listed above.
paras.zh: 除非参与人此前已在购买日之前取消其参与 ESPP，否则参与人将被视为已于每个购买日全额行使其期权。行权时，参与人将按期权购买价格购买其累计工资扣款所能购买的整数股份，但须受上述参与限制的约束。

paras.en: A participant may cancel his or her payroll deduction authorization at any time prior to the end of the offering period. Upon cancellation, the participant will have the option to either (i) receive a refund of the participant’s account balance in cash without interest or (ii) exercise the participant’s option for the current offering period for the maximum number of shares of Class A common stock on the applicable purchase date, with the remaining account balance refunded in cash without interest. Following at least one payroll deduction, a participant may also decrease (but not increase) his or her payroll deduction authorization once during any offering period. If a participant wants to increase or decrease the rate of payroll withholding, he or she may do so effective for the next offering period by submitting a new form before the offering period for which such change is to be effective.
paras.zh: 参与人可在发行期结束前的任何时间取消其工资扣款授权。取消后，参与人可选择：(i) 以现金方式获得其账户余额的退款，不计利息；或 (ii) 在适用的购买日就当前发行期行使其期权，购买最多数量的 A 类普通股，剩余账户余额以现金方式退还，不计利息。在至少进行一次工资扣款后，参与人还可在任一发行期内一次调低（但不得调高）其工资扣款授权。若参与人希望调高或调低工资扣款比例，其可在拟生效的发行期之前提交新表格，使该变更自下一发行期起生效。

paras.en: A participant may not assign, transfer, pledge or otherwise dispose of (other than by will or the laws of descent and distribution) payroll deductions credited to a participant’s account or any rights to exercise an option or to receive shares of our Class A common stock under the ESPP, and during a participant’s lifetime, options in the ESPP shall be exercisable only by such participant. Any such attempt at assignment, transfer, pledge, or other disposition will not be given effect.
paras.zh: 参与人不得转让、转移、质押或以其他方式处置（遗赠或继承与分配法律规定除外）记入参与人账户的工资扣款或 ESPP 项下行使期权或收取我们 A 类普通股的任何权利，且在参与人在世期间，ESPP 项下的期权仅可由该参与人行使。任何此类转让、转移、质押或其他处置的尝试均不产生效力。

paras.en: Adjustments Upon Changes in Recapitalization, Dissolution, Liquidation, Merger, or Asset Sale. In the event of any increase or decrease in the number of issued shares of our Class A common stock resulting from a stock split, reverse stock split, stock dividend, combination, or reclassification of the Class A common stock, or any other increase or decrease in the number of shares of Class A common stock effected without receipt of consideration by us, we will proportionately adjust the aggregate number of shares of our Class A common stock offered under the ESPP, the number and price of shares which any participant has elected to purchase under the ESPP and the maximum number of shares which a participant may elect to purchase in any single offering period. If there is a proposal to dissolve or liquidate us, then the ESPP will terminate immediately prior to the consummation of such proposed dissolution or liquidation, and any offering period then in progress will be shortened by setting a new purchase date to take place before the date of our dissolution or liquidation. We will notify each participant of such change in writing prior to the new exercise date. If we undergo a merger with or into another corporation or sell all or substantially all of our assets, each outstanding option will be assumed or an equivalent option substituted by the successor corporation or the parent or subsidiary of the successor corporation. If the successor corporation refuses to assume the outstanding options or substitute equivalent options, then any offering period then in progress will be shortened by setting a new purchase date to take place before the date of our proposed sale or merger. We will notify each participant of such change in writing prior to the new exercise date.
paras.zh: 资本重组、解散、清算、合并或资产出售时的调整。若因 A 类普通股的股票拆分、反向股票拆分、股票股息、股份合并或 A 类普通股重新分类，或因我们未收取对价而实施的任何其他导致 A 类普通股已发行股份数量增加或减少的情形，我们将按比例调整 ESPP 项下拟发售的 A 类普通股总股数、任何参与人根据 ESPP 选择购买的股份数量及价格，以及任何参与人在任一发售期内可选择购买的股份数量上限。若出现解散或清算我们的提案，则 ESPP 将在该拟议解散或清算完成前立即终止，届时正在进行的任何发售期将通过设定一个新的购买日期而缩短，该购买日期应早于我们解散或清算之日。我们将在新的行权日期之前以书面形式通知各参与人该等变更。若我们与另一家公司合并或并入另一家公司，或出售我们全部或实质上全部资产，则每一未行权期权将由承继公司或其母公司或子公司承继，或由承继公司或其母公司或子公司以等值期权替代。若承继公司拒绝承继未行权期权或以等值期权替代，则届时正在进行的任何发售期将通过设定一个新的购买日期而缩短，该购买日期应早于我们拟议出售或合并之日。我们将在新的行权日期之前以书面形式通知各参与人该等变更。

paras.en: Amendment and Termination. Our board of directors may amend, suspend, or terminate the ESPP at any time. However, the board of directors may not amend the ESPP without obtaining stockholder approval within 12 months before or after such amendment to the extent required by applicable laws.
paras.zh: 修订与终止。我们的董事会可随时修订、暂停或终止 ESPP。但是，在适用法律要求的范围内，董事会不得在未经股东批准的情况下修订 ESPP，该股东批准须在该等修订前后 12 个月内取得。

paras.en: For the year ended December 31, 2025, we did not have a formalized non-employee director compensation program, and none of our non-employee directors was paid cash compensation or granted an option or stock award in connection with the non-employee director’s service to us during 2025. As of December 31, 2025, Paul Auvil held 138,855 shares of restricted Class B common stock that were acquired upon early exercise of an option and remained subject to a company repurchase right at the original exercise price per share, Glenda Dorchak held an option to purchase 215,000 shares of our Class B common stock, and Thomas Lantzsch held 13,918 RSUs. In connection with Ms. Dorchak stepping down from our board of directors in April 2026, the vesting of her option was partially accelerated such that a total of 120,000 shares were deemed vested. Prior to Mr. Lantzsch stepping down from our board of directors in April 2026, he was granted an award of 5,000 fully vested RSUs, and the service-and liquidity-based vesting conditions on his 13,918 RSUs were fully accelerated.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我们并无正式的非雇员董事薪酬计划，且我们的非雇员董事在 2025 年期间均未因向我们提供服务而获得现金薪酬或被授予期权或股票奖励。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Paul Auvil 持有 138,855 股受限 B 类普通股，该等股份系于提前行权期权时取得，且仍须按每股原行权价格受制于公司回购权；Glenda Dorchak 持有可购买 215,000 股我们 B 类普通股的期权；Thomas Lantzsch 持有 13,918 个 RSU。因 Dorchak 女士于 2026 年 4 月从我们的董事会卸任，其期权的归属被部分加速，以致合计 120,000 股被视为已归属。在 Lantzsch 先生于 2026 年 4 月从我们的董事会卸任之前，其获授 5,000 个已完全归属的 RSU，且其 13,918 个 RSU 的服务及流动性归属条件被完全加速。

paras.en: We have adopted a non-employee director compensation program (the “Director Compensation Program”) that, effective upon the completion of this offering, provides for annual retainers for board and committee service and the automatic grant of initial and annual equity awards.
paras.zh: 我们已采纳一项非雇员董事薪酬计划（“董事薪酬计划”），该计划自本次发行完成时生效，规定董事会及委员会服务的年度津贴以及初始和年度股权奖励的自动授予。

paras.en: Under the Director Compensation Program, our non-employee directors will receive cash compensation, paid quarterly in arrears, as follows:
paras.zh: 根据董事薪酬计划，我们的非雇员董事将获得现金薪酬，按季度于期末支付，具体如下：

paras.en: - Each non-employee director (other than the non-employee chairperson of our board of directors or the lead independent director) will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $60,000 per year.
paras.zh: - 每位非雇员董事（我们的董事会非雇员主席或首席独立董事除外）将获得每年$60,000 的现金津贴。

paras.en: - The non-employee chairperson of our board of directors or the lead independent director will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $70,000 per year.
paras.zh: - 我们的董事会非雇员主席或首席独立董事将获得每年$70,000 的现金津贴。

paras.en: - The chairperson of the audit committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $25,000 per year for such chairperson’s service on the audit committee. Each non-chairperson member of the audit committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $12,500 per year for such member’s service on the audit committee.
paras.zh: - 审计委员会主席将因其在审计委员会的服务获得每年$25,000 的现金津贴。审计委员会每位非主席成员将因其在审计委员会的服务获得每年$12,500 的现金津贴。

paras.en: - The chairperson of the compensation committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $20,000 per year for such chairperson’s service on the compensation committee. Each non-chairperson member of the compensation committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $10,000 per year for such member’s service on the compensation committee.
paras.zh: - 薪酬委员会主席将因其在薪酬委员会的服务获得每年$20,000 的现金津贴。薪酬委员会每位非主席成员将因其在薪酬委员会的服务获得每年$10,000 的现金津贴。

paras.en: - The chairperson of the nominating and corporate governance committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $10,000 per year for such chairperson’s service on the nominating and corporate governance committee. Each non-chairperson member of the nominating and corporate governance committee will receive a cash retainer in the amount of $5,000 per year for such member’s service on the nominating and corporate governance committee.
paras.zh: - 提名与公司治理委员会主席将因其在提名与公司治理委员会的服务获得每年$10,000 的现金津贴。提名与公司治理委员会每位非主席成员将因其在提名与公司治理委员会的服务获得每年$5,000 的现金津贴。

paras.en: At its discretion, our board of directors or compensation committee may allow non-employee directors to elect to convert all or a portion of their cash retainer into a number of RSUs granted under the 2026 Plan, which will be fully vested on the date of grant.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可自行决定，允许非雇员董事选择将其全部或部分现金董事费转换为根据 2026 年计划授予的一定数量的 RSU，该等 RSU 将于授予日全部归属。

paras.en: Under the Director Compensation Program, each non-employee director on the date the non-employee director is appointed to our board of directors will automatically be granted that number of RSUs (the “Initial Grant”) under the 2026 Plan determined by dividing $3,000,000 by the average closing trading price of a share of our Class A common stock over the most recent 30 trading days as of the date of grant. The Initial Grant will vest in substantially equal annual installments over three years, subject to continued service on our board of directors through the applicable vesting date. In addition, on the date of each annual meeting of our stockholders, each non-employee director who will continue to serve as a non-employee director immediately following such annual meeting will automatically be granted that number of RSUs (the “Annual Grant”) under the 2026 Plan determined by dividing $250,000 by the average closing trading price of a share of our Class A common stock over the most recent 30 trading days as of the date of grant. The Annual Grant will vest in full on the earlier of (i) the first anniversary of the grant date and (ii) immediately prior to the annual meeting of our stockholders following the date of grant, subject to continued service on our board of directors through the applicable vesting date.
paras.zh: 根据董事薪酬计划，每位非雇员董事在其被任命为董事会成员之日，将自动获授根据 2026 年计划确定的一定数量的 RSU（“首次授予”），该数量等于 $3,000,000 除以截至授予日最近 30 个交易日内我们 A 类普通股每股平均收盘交易价格。首次授予将在三年内以基本相等的年度分期归属，前提是该非雇员董事持续在董事会任职至适用的归属日。此外，在我们每次股东年会之日，每位在该年会结束后立即继续担任非雇员董事的非雇员董事将自动获授根据 2026 年计划确定的一定数量的 RSU（“年度授予”），该数量等于 $250,000 除以截至授予日最近 30 个交易日内我们 A 类普通股每股平均收盘交易价格。年度授予将于以下两者中较早者全部归属：(i) 授予日一周年之日，及 (ii) 授予日之后我们股东年会召开之前，前提是该非雇员董事持续在董事会任职至适用的归属日。

paras.en: At its discretion, our board of directors or compensation committee may allow non-employee directors to elect to defer the settlement of RSUs granted to them under the Director Compensation Program.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会或薪酬委员会可自行决定，允许非雇员董事选择推迟根据董事薪酬计划授予他们的 RSU 的结算。

paras.en: Pursuant to the Director Compensation Program, upon a change in control transaction, all outstanding equity awards held by our non-employee directors will vest in full.
paras.zh: 根据董事薪酬计划，在控制权变更交易发生时，我们的非雇员董事持有的所有未归属股权奖励将全部归属。

paras.en: **CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS AND RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS**
paras.zh: **某些关系及关联方交易**

paras.en: The following includes a summary of transactions since January 1, 2023 and any currently proposed transactions, to which we were or are to be a participant, in which (i) the amount involved exceeded or will exceed $120,000; and (ii) any of our directors, executive officers, or holders of more than 5% of our capital stock, or any affiliate or member of the immediate family of the foregoing persons or entities, had or will have a direct or indirect material interest, other than compensation and other arrangements that are described under the section titled “Executive and Director Compensation.”
paras.zh: 以下内容概述了自 2023 年 1 月 1 日以来的交易以及任何目前拟议的交易，我们曾经或将要参与其中，且 (i) 所涉金额超过或将超过 $120,000；及 (ii) 我们的任何董事、高级管理人员或持有我们超过 5% 资本股的持有人，或上述人士或实体的任何关联方或直系亲属成员，曾经或将要拥有直接或间接的重大利益，但“高管及董事薪酬”一节中所述的薪酬及其他安排除外。

paras.en: We believe the terms obtained or consideration that we paid or received, as applicable, in connection with the transactions described below were comparable to terms available or the amounts that we would pay or receive, as applicable, in arm’s-length transactions.
paras.zh: 我们认为，就下述交易获得的条件或我们支付或收到的对价（如适用），与我们在公平交易中可获得的条件或我们应支付或收取的金额（如适用）相当。

paras.en: #### Series F-1 Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock Financing
paras.zh: #### F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股融资

paras.en: In May 2024, we entered into a Series F-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock purchase agreement, as subsequently amended and restated in August 2025, with various investors pursuant to which we agreed to issue and sell 5,798,089 shares of our Series F-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock at a purchase price of $14.66 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $85.0 million. In July and August 2024, various investors purchased an aggregate of 2,728,512 shares of our Series F-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $40.0 million.
paras.zh: 2024 年 5 月，我们与多家投资者签订了 F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股购买协议（该协议随后于 2025 年 8 月经修订并重述），据此，我们同意发行并出售 5,798,089 股 F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股，购买价格为每股 $14.66，总募集资金毛额约为 $85.0 million。2024 年 7 月和 8 月，多家投资者合计购买了 2,728,512 股 F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股，合计购买价格约为 $40.0 million。

paras.en: In September 2024, Alpha Wave Ventures II, LP, an existing stockholder, purchased 3,069,577 shares of our Series F-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $45.0 million. Entities affiliated with Alpha Wave collectively beneficially own more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock following the purchase of our Series F-1 redeemable convertible preferred stock. See the section titled “Principal Stockholders” for additional information.
paras.zh: 2024 年 9 月，现有股东 Alpha Wave Ventures II, LP 购买了 3,069,577 股 F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股，合计购买价格约为 $45.0 million。在购买我们的 F-1 系列可赎回可转换优先股后，Alpha Wave 关联实体合计实益拥有我们已发行股本超过 5% 的股份。更多信息请参见标题为“主要股东”的章节。

paras.en: In December 2025, we completed a tender offer for shares of our outstanding Class B common stock from certain of our employees and purchased an aggregate of 2,156,765 shares of our outstanding Class B common stock at a purchase price of $36.2324 per share, for an aggregate gross purchase price of $78.1 million (the “2025 Tender Offer”). We repurchased an aggregate of 27,599 shares of our Class B common stock from Robert Komin, our Chief Financial Officer, and an aggregate of 27,599 shares of our Class B common stock from Dhiraj Mallick, our Chief Operating Officer, in the 2025 Tender Offer, for an aggregate gross purchase price of $1.0 million and $1.0 million, respectively.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，我们完成了对我们已发行 B 类普通股的收购要约，从我们的部分员工处购买了我们已发行的 B 类普通股合计 2,156,765 股，购买价格为每股$36.2324，总购买价（毛额）为$78.1 million（“2025 年收购要约”）。在 2025 年收购要约中，我们从我们的首席财务官 Robert Komin 处回购了我们 B 类普通股合计 27,599 股，并从我们的首席运营官 Dhiraj Mallick 处回购了我们 B 类普通股合计 27,599 股，总购买价（毛额）分别为$1.0 million 和$1.0 million。

paras.en: #### Master Relationship Agreement
paras.zh: #### 主关系协议

paras.en: In December 2025, we entered into the MRA with OpenAI, under which OpenAI agreed to purchase the Committed Capacity and related services. We expect to deploy the Committed Capacity in tranches during 2026 through 2028, with each tranche of deployed capacity having a term of three or four years that is extendable by OpenAI to a maximum of five years in total. In addition to the Committed Capacity, which we are contractually obligated to deliver and OpenAI is contractually obligated to purchase, OpenAI has the option to purchase the Additional Capacity for deployment in tranches by the end of 2030.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，我们与 OpenAI 签订了主关系协议（MRA），根据该协议，OpenAI 同意购买承诺算力及相关服务。我们预计将在 2026 年至 2028 年期间分批部署承诺算力，每批已部署算力的期限为三年或四年，OpenAI 可将期限延长至总计最长五年。除承诺算力（我们有合同义务交付且 OpenAI 有合同义务购买）外，OpenAI 还可选择购买额外算力，并在 2030 年底前分批部署。

paras.en: In January 2026, OpenAI advanced to us the $1.0 billion Working Capital Loan to accelerate our engineering development, manufacturing scale-up, and data center expansion. The Working Capital Loan can be repaid in cash or through the delivery of compute capacity or purchase of hardware or other services under the MRA. The Working Capital Loan is subject to a secured promissory note with a maturity date of no later than December 31, 2032.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，OpenAI 向我们预付了 $1.0 billion 的营运资金贷款，以加速我们的工程开发、制造规模扩大和数据中心扩建。营运资金贷款可以现金偿还，也可以通过交付算力或根据 MRA 购买硬件或其他服务的方式偿还。营运资金贷款由一份有担保本票作为凭证，到期日不迟于 2032 年 12 月 31 日。

paras.en: #### OpenAI Warrant
paras.zh: #### OpenAI 认股权证

paras.en: In December 2025, we issued the OpenAI Warrant to OpenAI in connection with the execution of the MRA. Pursuant to the OpenAI Warrant, OpenAI has the right to purchase up to 33,445,026 shares of our Class N common stock at an exercise price of $0.00001 per share. The OpenAI Warrant expires on the earlier of December 24, 2035 and five business days following the first date during which there is no binding capacity purchase commitments or contractually obligated current or future payments under the MRA.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，我们与 OpenAI 签署 MRA 的同时，向 OpenAI 发行了 OpenAI 认股权证。根据 OpenAI 认股权证，OpenAI 有权以每股 $0.00001 的行权价购买最多 33,445,026 股我们的 N 类普通股。OpenAI 认股权证于 2035 年 12 月 24 日与 MRA 项下不存在有约束力的算力购买承诺或合同约定的当前或未来付款义务之日后的第五个工作日两者中的较早者到期。

paras.en: The shares of Class N common stock underlying the OpenAI Warrant vest and become exercisable upon the occurrence of certain events, as set forth below:
paras.zh: OpenAI 认股权证对应的 N 类普通股在发生下述特定事件时归属并可行使：

paras.en: - 4,459,337 shares vested in January 2026 upon our receipt of the Working Capital Loan;
paras.zh: - 4,459,337 股已于 2026 年 1 月在我们收到营运资金贷款时归属；

paras.en: - 5,574,171 shares will vest upon the earlier of (i) the first date that our market capitalization exceeds $40 billion, measured by the product of (a) the number of shares of common stock outstanding (on an as-converted basis for each authorized class or series of our common stock), multiplied by (b) the 30-day volume-weighted average closing price per share of our Class A common stock on Nasdaq, and (ii) receipt by us of certain fee payments from OpenAI under the MRA; and
paras.zh: - 5,574,171 股将在以下两者中的较早者归属：(i) 我们的市值首次超过 $40 billion 之日，市值按 (a) 已发行普通股股数（按我们各类已授权普通股或系列普通股转换后的基准计算）乘以 (b) 我们 A 类普通股在纳斯达克的 30 日成交量加权平均收盘价计算，以及 (ii) 我们收到 OpenAI 根据 MRA 支付的某些费用款项之日；以及

paras.en: - 23,411,518 shares in the aggregate will vest in multiple tranches on certain committed delivery dates of compute capacity pursuant to the MRA, including committed delivery dates to be mutually agreed upon for the Additional Capacity (if any).
paras.zh: - 合计 23,411,518 股将根据 MRA 在特定承诺算力交付日期分批归属，包括就额外算力（如有）经双方共同商定的承诺交付日期。

paras.en: The OpenAI Warrant will only fully vest if OpenAI exercises all options to purchase Additional Capacity under the MRA, such that a total of 2GW of AI inference compute capacity and related services is purchased by OpenAI.
paras.zh: 只有在 OpenAI 行使 MRA 项下购买额外算力的全部选择权，从而使 OpenAI 购买的 AI 推理算力及相关服务总计达到 2GW 时，OpenAI 认股权证才会完全归属。

paras.en: #### Amended and Restated Investors’ Rights Agreement
paras.zh: #### 修订及重述的投资者权利协议

paras.en: We are party to an amended and restated investors’ rights agreement which provides, among other things, that certain holders of our capital stock, including entities affiliated with Alpha Wave, Benchmark, Eclipse, Fidelity, and Foundation Capital, each of which hold more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, have the right to demand that we file a registration statement. This agreement also provides that such parties and others, including Andrew D. Feldman, our Chief Executive Officer, President, and a member of our board of directors, and Sean Lie, our Chief Technology Officer, have the right to request that their shares of our capital stock be included on a registration statement that we are otherwise filing. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights— Amended and Restated Investors’ Rights Agreement” for additional information regarding these registration rights.
paras.zh: 我们是修订及重述的投资者权利协议的一方，该协议规定，除其他事项外，我们股本的某些持有人，包括与 Alpha Wave、Benchmark、Eclipse、Fidelity 和 Foundation Capital 有关联的实体，各自持有我们已发行股本超过 5%，有权要求我们提交注册声明。该协议还规定，该等各方及其他人士，包括我们的首席执行官、总裁兼董事会成员 Andrew D. Feldman 以及我们的首席技术官 Sean Lie，有权要求将其持有的我们股本股份纳入我们另行提交的注册声明中。有关该等注册权利的更多信息，请参见标题为“股本说明——注册权利——修订及重述的投资者权利协议”的章节。

paras.en: #### OpenAI Registration Rights Agreement
paras.zh: #### OpenAI 注册权利协议

paras.en: In December 2025, we entered into a registration rights agreement with OpenAI in connection with the OpenAI Warrant, pursuant to which, among other things, OpenAI has the right to demand that we file a registration statement to register for resale the shares of Class N common stock issued or issuable to OpenAI upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights—OpenAI Registration Rights Agreement” for additional information regarding these registration rights.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，我们就 OpenAI 认股权证与 OpenAI 签订了注册权利协议，据此，除其他事项外，OpenAI 有权要求我们提交注册声明，以登记因行使 OpenAI 认股权证而向 OpenAI 发行或可向其发行的 N 类普通股股份以供转售。有关该等注册权利的更多信息，请参见标题为“股本说明——注册权利——OpenAI 注册权利协议”的章节。

paras.en: Pursuant to our equity compensation plans and certain agreements with our stockholders, including a right of first refusal and co-sale agreement with certain holders of our capital stock, including entities affiliated with Alpha Wave, Benchmark, Eclipse, Fidelity, and Foundation Capital, each of which hold more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, and Messrs. Feldman, Lie, and Mallick, we or our assignees have a right to purchase shares of our capital stock which certain stockholders propose to sell to other parties. This right under the right of first refusal and co-sale agreement terminated upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part.
paras.zh: 根据我们的股权激励计划以及与部分股东签订的若干协议（包括与部分股本持有人签订的优先购买权和共同出售权协议，这些持有人包括与 Alpha Wave、Benchmark、Eclipse、Fidelity 和 Foundation Capital 关联的实体，上述各方各自持有我们已发行股本 5% 以上，以及 Feldman 先生、Lie 先生和 Mallick 先生），我们或我们的受让人有权购买若干股东拟向其他方出售的股本股份。优先购买权和共同出售权协议项下的该项权利在本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效时终止。

paras.en: Since January 1, 2023, we have waived our right of first refusal in connection with secondary sales of shares of our capital stock, including sales by certain of our executive officers.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 1 月 1 日起，我们已就股本的二级出售（包括由我们部分高级管理人员进行的出售）放弃我们的优先购买权。

paras.en: We are party to an amended and restated voting agreement under which certain holders of our capital stock, including entities affiliated with Alpha Wave, Benchmark, Eclipse, Fidelity, and Foundation Capital, each of which hold more than 5% of our outstanding capital stock, and Messrs. Feldman, Lie, and Mallick have agreed as to the manner in which they will vote their shares of our capital stock on certain matters, including with respect to the election of directors. Upon the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, the voting agreement terminated and none of our stockholders have any special rights regarding the election or designation of members of our board of directors.
paras.zh: 我们是一份经修订和重述的表决协议的当事方，根据该协议，我们股本的部分持有人（包括与 Alpha Wave、Benchmark、Eclipse、Fidelity 和 Foundation Capital 有关联的实体，其中每一方均持有我们已发行股本 5% 以上）以及 Feldman、Lie 和 Mallick 先生已就其在某些事项（包括董事选举）上对其所持我们股本股份的投票方式达成一致。本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效后，该表决协议即告终止，且我们的任何股东均不享有关于选举或指定董事会成员的任何特殊权利。

paras.en: At our request, the underwriters have reserved up to 1,500,000 shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus, for sale at the initial public offering price through a directed share program to certain persons identified by our management and certain long-tenured employees, which may include parties with whom we have a business relationship and friends and family of management and such employees. See the section titled “Underwriters— Directed Share Program” for additional information.
paras.zh: 应本公司请求，承销商已预留本招股说明书发售的最多 1,500,000 股 A 类普通股，通过定向股份计划按首次公开发行价格向本公司管理层指定的若干人士及若干长期任职员工出售，其中可能包括与本公司存在业务关系的各方以及管理层和该等员工的亲友。详情请参见“承销商——定向股份计划”一节。

paras.en: We have entered into offer letter agreements with certain of our executive officers that, among other things, provide for certain compensatory and change in control benefits. For a description of these agreements with our named executive officers, see the section titled “Executive and Director Compensation—Executive Compensation Arrangements.”
paras.zh: 我们已与部分高级管理人员签订录用通知书协议，其中除其他事项外，约定了若干薪酬及控制权变更福利。有关与我们列名高级管理人员签订的该等协议的说明，请参见标题为“高管与董事薪酬——高管薪酬安排”的章节。

paras.en: We have also granted stock options, RSUs, and restricted stock to our executive officers and directors. For a description of these equity awards, see the section titled “Executive and Director Compensation—Outstanding Equity Awards at 2025 Year End.”
paras.zh: 我们还向我们的高级管理人员和董事授予了股票期权、限制性股票单位（RSU）和限制性股票。有关该等股权奖励的说明，请参见标题为“高管与董事薪酬——截至 2025 年末的未行使股权奖励”的章节。

paras.en: We have entered into indemnification agreements with certain of our current executive officers and directors, and intend to enter into new indemnification agreements with each of our current executive officers and directors before the completion of this offering.
paras.zh: 我们已与部分现任高级管理人员和董事签订了赔偿协议，并计划在本次发行完成前与每一位现任高级管理人员和董事签订新的赔偿协议。

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation also provides that, to the fullest extent permitted by law, we will indemnify any officer or director of our company against all damages, claims, and liabilities arising out of the fact that the person is or was our officer or director, or served any other enterprise at our request as an officer or director. Amending this provision will not reduce our indemnification obligations relating to actions taken before an amendment.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程还规定，在法律允许的最大范围内，我们将就任何现任或曾任本公司高级管理人员或董事、或应本公司要求担任任何其他企业高级管理人员或董事的人员，因其身份而产生的所有损害赔偿、索赔和责任予以赔偿。修订该条款不会减少我们与修订前所采取行动相关的赔偿义务。

paras.en: We have a written related person transaction policy, to be effective upon the completion of this offering, that applies to our executive officers, directors, director nominees, holders of more than 5% of any class of our voting securities and any member of the immediate family of, and any entity affiliated with, any of the foregoing persons. Such persons will not be permitted to enter into a related person transaction with us without the prior consent of our audit committee, or other independent members of our board of directors in the event it is inappropriate for our audit committee to review such transaction due to a conflict of interest. Any request for us to enter into a transaction with an executive officer, director, director nominee, principal stockholder, or any of their immediate family members or affiliates, in which the amount involved exceeds $120,000 must first be presented to our audit committee for review, consideration, and approval. In approving or rejecting any such proposal, our audit committee will consider the relevant facts and circumstances available and deemed relevant to our audit committee, including, but not limited to, the commercial reasonableness of the terms of the transaction and the materiality and character of the related person’s direct or indirect interest in the transaction. All of the transactions described in this section occurred prior to the adoption of this policy.
paras.zh: 我们已制定书面关联人交易政策，该政策将在本次发行完成后生效，适用于我们的高级管理人员、董事、董事候选人、持有我们任何类别有表决权证券超过 5% 的持有人，以及上述任何人员的直系亲属成员和与上述任何人员有关联的任何实体。未经我们的审计委员会事先同意，或在因利益冲突而不宜由我们的审计委员会审查该交易的情况下未经我们董事会其他独立成员事先同意，上述人员不得与我们进行关联人交易。任何要求我们与高级管理人员、董事、董事候选人、主要股东或其任何直系亲属或关联方进行且涉及金额超过 $120,000 的交易，必须首先提交我们的审计委员会进行审查、审议和批准。在批准或否决任何此类提案时，我们的审计委员会将考虑现有且其认为相关的有关事实和情况，包括但不限于交易条款在商业上的合理性，以及关联人在该交易中的直接或间接利益的重大性和性质。本节所述的所有交易均发生在本政策通过之前。

paras.zh: - 我们的每一位董事；

paras.zh: - 我们的每一位具名高管；

paras.zh: - 全体董事及高管作为一个整体；以及

paras.en: - each person, or group of persons, known to us who beneficially owns more than 5% of our capital stock.
paras.zh: - 我们所知的每一位实益拥有我们股本 5% 以上的个人或群体。

paras.en: We have based percentage ownership of our common stock before this offering on no shares of our Class A common stock, 185,304,949 shares of our Class B common stock, and 2,026,025 shares of our Class N common stock outstanding, in each case, as of March 31, 2026, and assume the occurrence of each of the filing and effectiveness of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will be in effect immediately prior to the completion of this offering, the Preferred Stock Conversion, the Common Stock Reclassification, and the RSU Net Settlement, in each case as if it had occurred as of March 31, 2026, but do not give effect to any voting proxies that will expire in connection with this offering. The exact number of shares of our Class B common stock that will be withheld from a stockholder in connection with the RSU Net Settlement will differ based on the stockholder’s personal tax rates. The percentage ownership of our common stock after this offering also assumes the foregoing and the issuance and sale of 30,000,000 shares of Class A common stock by us in this offering, and assumes no exercise of the underwriters’ over-allotment option.
paras.zh: 本次发行前我们普通股的持股比例，系基于截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日我们已发行的 A 类普通股 0 股、B 类普通股 185,304,949 股及 N 类普通股 2,026,025 股计算，并假设经修订及重述的公司章程（将于本次发行完成前立即生效）的提交与生效、优先股转换、普通股重分类及 RSU 净额结算均已于 2026 年 3 月 31 日发生，但未考虑将于本次发行相关事项中到期的任何投票权委托。因 RSU 净额结算而从股东处扣留的 B 类普通股的确切股数将因股东个人税率而异。本次发行后我们普通股的持股比例亦假设上述事项已发生，并假设我们于本次发行中发行并出售 30,000,000 股 A 类普通股，且假设承销商未行使超额配售选择权。

paras.en: In accordance with the rules of the SEC, beneficial ownership includes voting or investment power with respect to securities and includes the shares issuable pursuant to stock options that are exercisable within 60 days of March 31, 2026 or issuable pursuant to RSUs that are subject to vesting and settlement conditions expected to occur within 60 days of March 31, 2026, after giving effect to the RSU Net Settlement (based on individual tax withholding elections). Shares issuable pursuant to stock options are deemed outstanding for computing the percentage of the person holding such options but are not outstanding for computing the percentage of any other person. In addition, the below table does not reflect any shares of Class A common stock that may be purchased in this offering or pursuant to our directed share program described in the section titled “Underwriters—Directed Share Program.”
paras.zh: 根据 SEC 规则，实益拥有权包括对证券的投票权或投资权，并包括根据可于 2026 年 3 月 31 日后 60 天内行使的股票期权可发行的股份，或根据预计将于 2026 年 3 月 31 日后 60 天内满足归属及结算条件的 RSU（在 RSU 净额结算生效后，基于个人预扣税选择）可发行的股份。计算持有该等期权之人士的持股比例时，根据股票期权可发行的股份被视为已发行在外，但在计算任何其他人士的持股比例时则不被视为已发行在外。此外，下表未反映可能在本次发行中或根据标题为“承销商—定向股份计划”一节所述我们的定向股份计划购买的 A 类普通股股份。
