paras.en: The following summary describes our capital stock and certain provisions of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and our amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement to which we and certain of our stockholders are parties, and of the Delaware General Corporation Law. Because the following is only a summary, it does not contain all of the information that may be important to you. For a complete description, you should refer to our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, amended and restated bylaws, and amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, copies of which are filed as exhibits to the registration statement of which this prospectus is part.
paras.zh: 以下概要介绍了我们的股本以及我们经修订并重述的公司章程和经修订并重述的公司细则的若干条款（该等章程和细则将在本次发行完成前立即生效）、我们与若干股东签署的经修订并重述的投资者权利协议，以及《特拉华州普通公司法》。由于以下内容仅为概要，因此并不包含可能对您重要的全部信息。如需完整说明，您应参阅我们经修订并重述的公司章程、经修订并重述的公司细则以及经修订并重述的投资者权利协议，其副本已作为本招股说明书所属注册声明的附件提交。

paras.en: Immediately following the completion of this offering, our authorized capital stock will consist of 3,500,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, 240,000,000 shares of Class B common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, 100,000,000 shares of Class N common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, and 100,000,000 shares of undesignated preferred stock, par value $0.00001 per share.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们的授权股本将由 3,500,000,000 股 A 类普通股（每股面值$0.00001）、240,000,000 股 B 类普通股（每股面值$0.00001）、100,000,000 股 N 类普通股（每股面值$0.00001）以及 100,000,000 股未指定优先股（每股面值$0.00001）组成。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, after giving effect to (i) the filing and effectiveness of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, (ii) the Preferred Stock Conversion, (iii) the Common Stock Reclassification, and (iv) the RSU Net Settlement, there were 185,110,345 shares of our Class B common stock outstanding, held by 1,386 stockholders of record, and no shares of our Class A common stock, Class N common stock, or preferred stock outstanding.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，在使(i)我们经修订和重述的公司章程的提交和生效、(ii)优先股转换、(iii)普通股重新分类以及(iv)RSU 净额结算生效后，我们的 B 类普通股有 185,110,345 股流通在外，由 1,386 名登记在册的股东持有，且我们的 A 类普通股、N 类普通股或优先股均无流通在外的股份。

paras.en: Immediately following the completion of this offering, we will have three classes of authorized common stock: Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and Class N common stock. The rights of holders of Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and Class N common stock will be identical, except with respect to voting and conversion rights.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们将拥有三类获授权普通股：A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 N 类普通股。A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 N 类普通股持有人的权利将完全相同，但在投票权和转换权方面除外。

paras.en: #### Voting Rights
paras.zh: #### 投票权

paras.en: Each holder of our Class A common stock is entitled to one vote per share, each holder of our Class B common stock is entitled to 20 votes per share, and each holder of our Class N common stock is entitled to no votes per share. The holders of our Class A common stock and Class B common stock will generally vote as a single class on all matters submitted to a vote of our stockholders, unless otherwise required by Delaware law or our amended and restated certificate of incorporation. Delaware law could require holders of our Class A common stock, Class B common stock, or Class N common stock to vote separately as a single class in the following circumstances:
paras.zh: 我们 A 类普通股的每位持有人每股享有 1 票投票权，B 类普通股的每位持有人每股享有 20 票投票权，N 类普通股的每位持有人每股不享有投票权。除非特拉华州法律或我们经修订并重述的公司章程另有要求，否则我们 A 类普通股和 B 类普通股的持有人通常将作为单一类别就提交我们股东投票的所有事项进行投票。在下列情形下，特拉华州法律可能要求我们 A 类普通股、B 类普通股或 N 类普通股的持有人作为单一类别单独投票：

paras.en: - if we were to seek to amend our amended and restated certificate of incorporation to increase or decrease the par value of a class of our capital stock, then that class would be required to vote separately to approve the proposed amendment; and
paras.zh: - 如果我们寻求修订我们经修订并重述的公司章程，以增加或减少我们某一类别股本的票面价值，则该类别将被要求单独投票以批准拟议修订；以及

paras.en: - if we were to seek to amend our amended and restated certificate of incorporation in a manner that alters or changes the powers, preferences, or special rights of a class of our capital stock in a manner that affected its holders adversely, then that class would be required to vote separately to approve the proposed amendment.
paras.zh: - 如果我们寻求以对某一类别股本持有人产生不利影响的方式修订我们经修订并重述的公司章程，从而改变或变更该类别股本的权力、优先权或特殊权利，则该类别将被要求单独投票以批准拟议修订。

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation does not provide for cumulative voting for the election of directors. As a result, the holders of a majority of shares of our Class A common stock and Class B common stock can elect all of the directors then standing for election. Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation establishes a classified board of directors, to be divided into three classes with staggered three-year terms. Only one class of directors will be elected at each annual meeting of our stockholders, with the other classes continuing for the remainder of their respective three-year terms.
paras.zh: 我们经修订并重述的公司章程未规定董事选举的累积投票制。因此，我们 A 类普通股和 B 类普通股多数股份的持有人可以选举当时全部参选董事。我们经修订并重述的公司章程设立了分类董事会，将分为三个类别，任期交错，每类任期三年。每次年度股东大会上仅选举一个类别的董事，其他类别董事将继续完成其各自三年任期的剩余部分。

paras.en: #### Conversion Rights
paras.zh: #### 转换权

paras.en: #### Class B Common Stock
paras.zh: #### B 类普通股

paras.en: Each share of Class B common stock is convertible at any time at the option of the holder into one share of Class A common stock. Following the completion of this offering and prior to the Final Conversion Date (as defined below), each share of Class B common stock will convert automatically into one share of Class A common stock upon sale or transfer, except for certain permitted transfers, as set forth in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, including estate planning or other transfers among our Founders (as defined below) and their permitted entities and permitted transferees. In addition, each share of our Class B common stock held by a Founder will convert automatically into one share of our Class A common stock on the earlier of (i) the death or incapacity of such Founder or (ii) the date that is six months following the date on which such Founder is no longer an employee or director of our company (unless such Founder has rejoined our company during such six-month period). In addition, all outstanding shares of Class B common stock will convert automatically into one share of Class A common stock on the date that is six months following the date on which no Founder is an employee or director of our company (unless a Founder has rejoined our company during such six-month period). We refer to the date on which such final conversion of all outstanding shares of Class B common stock pursuant to the terms of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation occurs as the “Final Conversion Date,” and we refer to each of Andrew D. Feldman, Sean Lie, Jean-Philippe Fricker, and Michael James as the “Founders.” Once converted into Class A common stock, the Class B common stock will not be reissued.
paras.zh: 每股 B 类普通股可由持有人随时选择转换为一股 A 类普通股。本次发行完成后至最终转换日（定义见下文）之前，每股 B 类普通股在出售或转让时将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股，但经修订并重述的公司章程所规定的若干允许转让除外，包括在创始人（定义见下文）及其允许实体和允许受让人之间进行的遗产规划或其他转让。此外，创始人持有的每股 B 类普通股将在以下较早日期自动转换为一股 A 类普通股：(i) 该创始人死亡或丧失行为能力之日，或 (ii) 该创始人不再担任本公司员工或董事之日起满六个月之日（除非该创始人在该六个月期间内重新加入本公司）。此外，在所有创始人均不再担任本公司员工或董事之日起满六个月之日（除非某创始人在该六个月期间内重新加入本公司），所有已发行的 B 类普通股将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股。我们将根据经修订并重述的公司章程条款，所有已发行 B 类普通股完成最终转换的日期称为“最终转换日”，并将 Andrew D. Feldman、Sean Lie、Jean-Philippe Fricker 和 Michael James 各自称为“创始人”。B 类普通股一经转换为 A 类普通股，将不再重新发行。

paras.en: #### Class N Common Stock
paras.zh: #### N 类普通股

paras.en: Each share of Class N common stock will convert automatically into one share of Class A common stock upon any transfer, whether or not for value, except for certain permitted transfers, as set forth in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation. Permitted transferees include entities under common control with or controlled by such holder of our Class N common stock or if the holder provides prior written notice to us electing for the transfer to not result in a conversion. Once converted into Class A common stock, the Class N common stock will not be reissued.
paras.zh: 每股 N 类普通股在任何转让时（无论是否有偿）将自动转换为一股 A 类普通股，但经修订并重述的公司章程所规定的若干允许转让除外。允许受让人包括与该 N 类普通股持有人受共同控制或受其控制的实体，或该持有人事先向我们发出书面通知，选择使该转让不导致转换的情形。N 类普通股一经转换为 A 类普通股，将不再重新发行。

paras.en: #### Dividends

Subject to preferences that may be applicable to any then outstanding preferred stock, holders of our common stock are entitled to receive dividends as may be declared from time to time by our board of directors out of legally available funds; provided, however, that if a dividend is paid in the form of common stock (or rights to acquire, or securities convertible into or exchangeable for, such shares), then the holders of the Class A common stock shall receive shares of Class A common stock (or rights to acquire, or securities convertible into or exchangeable for, such shares, as the case may be), holders of the Class B common stock shall receive shares of Class B common stock (or rights to acquire, or securities convertible into or exchangeable for, such shares, as the case may be), and holders of Class N common stock shall receive shares of Class N common stock (or rights to acquire, or securities convertible into or exchangeable for, such shares, as the case may be), unless a disparate dividend treatment of the shares of each such class is approved by the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of the then-outstanding shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and Class N common stock, each voting separately as a class.
paras.zh: 在受制于可能适用于当时任何已发行优先股的优先权的前提下，我们普通股的持有人有权从合法可用资金中收取我们董事会不时宣布派发的股息；但前提是，如果股息以普通股（或可收购该等股份的权利，或可转换为该等股份或可交换为该等股份的证券）形式支付，则 A 类普通股持有人应获得 A 类普通股股份（或可收购该等股份的权利，或可转换为该等股份或可交换为该等股份的证券，视情况而定），B 类普通股持有人应获得 B 类普通股股份（或可收购该等股份的权利，或可转换为该等股份或可交换为该等股份的证券，视情况而定），N 类普通股持有人应获得 N 类普通股股份（或可收购该等股份的权利，或可转换为该等股份或可交换为该等股份的证券，视情况而定），除非对每一该类别的股份采取不同股息待遇已获得当时已发行的 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 N 类普通股各自作为独立类别分别投票的多数持有人的赞成票批准。

paras.en: #### Right to Receive Liquidation Distributions
paras.zh: #### 获得清算分配的权利

paras.en: In the event of our liquidation, dissolution, or winding up, holders of our common stock will be entitled to share ratably in the net assets legally available for distribution to stockholders after the payment of all of our debts and other liabilities, subject to the satisfaction of any liquidation preference granted to the holders of any then outstanding shares of preferred stock.
paras.zh: 在我们清算、解散或停业清理的情况下，我们普通股的持有人将有权在支付我们所有债务和其他负债后，按比例分享合法可用于向股东分配的净资产，但须满足授予当时任何已发行优先股持有人的任何清算优先权。

paras.en: #### No Preemptive or Similar Rights
paras.zh: #### 无优先认购权或类似权利

paras.en: Our common stock is not entitled to preemptive rights and is not subject to redemption or sinking fund provisions. The rights, preferences, and privileges of the holders of our common stock will be subject to, and may be adversely affected by, the rights of the holders of shares of any series of our preferred stock that we may designate in the future.
paras.zh: 我们的普通股不享有优先认购权，也不受赎回或偿债基金条款的约束。我们普通股持有人的权利、优先权和特权将受制于我们未来可能指定的任何系列优先股股份持有人的权利，并可能受到其不利影响。

paras.en: Pursuant to the provisions of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, each currently outstanding share of redeemable convertible preferred stock will automatically be converted into one share of common stock effective upon the completion of this offering. Following this offering, no shares of redeemable convertible preferred stock will be outstanding.
paras.zh: 根据我们经修订和重述的公司章程细则的规定，每一股目前已发行的可赎回可转换优先股将在本次发行完成后自动转换为一股普通股。本次发行完成后，将不再有任何已发行的可赎回可转换优先股。

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, our board of directors will be authorized, subject to limitations prescribed by Delaware law, to issue preferred stock in one or more series, to establish from time to time the number of shares to be included in each series, and to fix the designation, powers, preferences, and rights of the shares of each series and any of its qualifications, limitations, or restrictions, in each case without further vote or action by our stockholders. Our board of directors can also increase or decrease the number of shares of any series of preferred stock, but not below the number of shares of that series then outstanding, without any further vote or action by our stockholders. Our board of directors may authorize the issuance of preferred stock with voting or conversion rights that could adversely affect the voting power or other rights of the holders of our common stock. The issuance of preferred stock, while providing flexibility in connection with possible acquisitions and other corporate purposes, could, among other things, have the effect of delaying, deferring, or preventing a change in control of our company and might adversely affect the price of our common stock and the voting and other rights of the holders of our common stock. We have no current plans to issue any shares of preferred stock.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，我们的董事会将获授权，在特拉华州法律规定的限制下，发行一个或多个系列的优先股，不时确定每个系列所包含的股份数量，并确定每个系列股份的名称、权力、优先权和权利及其任何资格、限制或约束，在每种情况下均无需我们的股东进一步投票或采取行动。我们的董事会还可以增加或减少任何系列优先股的股份数量，但不得低于该系列当时已发行的股份数量，且无需我们的股东进一步投票或采取行动。我们的董事会可以授权发行具有投票权或转换权的优先股，这些权利可能对我们普通股持有人的投票权或其他权利产生不利影响。发行优先股虽然在可能的收购和其他公司目的方面提供了灵活性，但除其他事项外，可能具有延迟、推迟或阻止我们公司控制权变更的效果，并可能对我们普通股的价格以及我们普通股持有人的投票权和其他权利产生不利影响。我们目前没有发行任何优先股股份的计划。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, we had outstanding options to purchase an aggregate of 28,361,707 shares of our Class B common stock, with a weighted-average exercise price of $4.97 per share, issued pursuant to the 2016 Plan.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我们根据 2016 年计划已发行在外的可购买合计 28,361,707 股 B 类普通股的期权，加权平均行权价为每股 $4.97。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, we had outstanding RSUs representing 15,229,068 shares of our Class B common stock, issuable upon satisfaction of service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions and issued pursuant to the 2016 Plan.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我们拥有代表 15,229,068 股 B 类普通股的未行权 RSU，该等 RSU 在满足基于服务和基于流动性的归属条件后可发行，且系根据 2016 年计划发行。

paras.en: In connection with the RSU Net Settlement, we will issue 2,550,477 shares of our Class B common stock, after withholding an aggregate of an estimated 2,249,088 shares of Class B common stock, to satisfy associated estimated tax withholding and remittance obligations.
paras.zh: 就 RSU 净额结算而言，我们将发行 2,550,477 股 B 类普通股，此前已扣留合计约 2,249,088 股 B 类普通股，以满足相关的预计税款预扣和汇缴义务。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, we had an outstanding warrant to purchase up to 1,857,516 shares of our Class N common stock, with an exercise price of $0.01 per share, which was exercised in full in January 2026.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我们有一份尚未行权的认股权证，可购买最多 1,857,516 股 N 类普通股，行权价为每股 $0.01，该认股权证已于 2026 年 1 月全部行权。

paras.en: As of December 31, 2025, we had an outstanding warrant to purchase up to 33,445,026 shares of our Class N common stock, with an exercise price of $0.00001 per share, pursuant to the OpenAI Warrant.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，根据 OpenAI 认股权证，我们有一份尚未行权的认股权证，可购买最多 33,445,026 股 N 类普通股，行权价为每股 $0.00001。

paras.en: #### Amended and Restated Investors’ Rights Agreement
paras.zh: #### 经修订和重述的投资者权利协议

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, and subject to the lock-up agreements entered into in connection with this offering and market standoff provisions, the holders of up to an aggregate of approximately 148.7 million shares of our common stock (excluding shares of our Class N common stock issued or issuable upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant), or their permitted transferees, will be entitled to rights with respect to the registration of the Class A common stock issuable upon conversion of such shares under the Securities Act. These rights are provided under the terms of an amended and restated investors’ rights agreement between us and the holders of these shares, which was entered into in connection with our redeemable convertible preferred stock financings, and include Form S-1 and Form S-3 demand registration rights and piggyback registration rights. In any registration made pursuant to such amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, all fees, costs, and expenses of underwritten registrations will be borne by us and all selling expenses, including all underwriting discounts, selling commissions, and stock transfer taxes, will be borne by the holders of the shares being registered. We will not be required to bear the expenses in connection with the exercise of the demand registration rights of a registration if the request is subsequently withdrawn at the request of the selling stockholders holding a majority of securities to be registered. In an underwritten public offering, the underwriters have the right, subject to specified conditions, to limit the number of shares such holders may include.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，在遵守与本次发行相关的锁定协议及市场禁售规定的前提下，合计约 148.7 百万股普通股（不包括在行使 OpenAI 认股权证时已发行或可发行的 N 类普通股股份）的持有人或其获准受让人，将有权就该等股份转换后可发行的 A 类普通股依据《证券法》进行注册登记享有相关权利。该等权利依据我们与该等股份持有人之间签订的经修订和重述的投资者权利协议条款提供，该协议系与我们可赎回可转换优先股融资相关而订立，包括 S-1 表格和 S-3 表格的请求注册权和附带注册权。在依据该经修订和重述的投资者权利协议进行的任何注册中，承销注册的所有费用、成本和开支将由我们承担，所有出售费用，包括所有承销折扣、销售佣金和股票转让税，将由被注册股份的持有人承担。如果持有拟注册证券多数的出售股东随后要求撤回注册请求，我们将无需承担与该请求注册权行使相关的费用。在承销公开发行中，承销商有权在特定条件下限制该等持有人可纳入的股份数量。

paras.en: The registration rights terminate upon the earliest of (i) upon a deemed liquidation event or stock sale, each as defined in the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, (ii) five years following the completion of this offering, or (iii) at such time as any particular stockholder may sell all of its shares during any 90-day period pursuant to Rule 144 or another similar exemption under the Securities Act.
paras.zh: 注册权在以下最早发生的情形下终止：(i) 经修订和重述的投资者权利协议所定义的视为清算事件或股票出售发生时，(ii) 本次发行完成后五年，或 (iii) 任何特定股东可在任何 90 天期间内依据 Rule 144 或《证券法》下其他类似豁免出售其全部股份之时。

paras.en: Form S-1 Demand Registration Rights
paras.zh: S-1 表格请求注册权

paras.en: The holders of up to an aggregate of approximately 130.5 million shares of our common stock (excluding shares of our Class N common stock issued or issuable upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant), or their permitted transferees, are entitled to Form S-1 demand registration rights. Under the terms of the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, at any time beginning 180 days after the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part, the holders representing a majority of the then-outstanding shares that are entitled to registration rights can request that we file a registration statement on Form S-1 covering all or some of their shares as soon as practicable, and in any event within 90 days after the date of such request, if the aggregate price to the public of the shares offered is at least $25.0 million (net of underwriting discounts, selling commissions, and stock transfer taxes). We may be required to effect up to two registrations pursuant to this provision of the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement. We may postpone the filing of a registration statement once for up to 90 days in a 12-month period if our board of directors determines that the filing would be materially detrimental to us. We are not required to effect a Form S-1 demand registration under certain additional circumstances specified in the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, including during the period beginning 60 days prior to our good faith estimate of the date of filing and ending on a date 180 days after the effective date of a registration statement filed by our initiation.
paras.zh: 合计约 130.5 百万股普通股（不包括在行使 OpenAI 认股权证时已发行或可发行的 N 类普通股股份）的持有人或其获准受让人，享有 S-1 表格要求登记权。根据经修订和重述的投资者权利协议，自本招股说明书构成其一部分的注册声明生效日起 180 天后的任何时间，持有当时已发行且享有登记权股份多数的持有人，可要求我们在可行的情况下尽快提交涵盖其全部或部分股份的 S-1 表格注册声明，且无论如何应在该要求提出之日起 90 天内提交，前提是所发售股份向公众发行的总价至少为 $25.0 百万（扣除承销折扣、销售佣金和股票转让税后）。根据经修订和重述的投资者权利协议的这一条款，我们可能被要求最多进行两次登记。如果我们的董事会认定提交注册声明会对我们造成重大不利影响，我们可在 12 个月期间内推迟提交注册声明一次，最长不超过 90 天。在经修订和重述的投资者权利协议规定的某些额外情形下，我们无需履行 S-1 表格要求登记，包括自我们善意估计的提交日期前 60 天起，至我们主动提交的注册声明生效日后 180 天之日止的期间。

paras.en: Form S-3 Demand Registration Rights
paras.zh: S-3 表格要求登记权

paras.en: The holders of up to an aggregate of approximately 130.5 million shares of our common stock (excluding shares of our Class N common stock issued or issuable upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant), or their permitted transferees, are also entitled to Form S-3 demand registration rights. Under the terms of the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, at any time once we are eligible to file a registration statement on Form S-3, the holders representing a majority of the then-outstanding shares that are entitled to registration rights can request that we file a registration statement on Form S-3 covering all or some of their shares, as soon as practicable, and in any event within 45 days of such request, if the aggregate price to the public of the shares offered is at least $5.0 million (net of underwriting discounts, selling commissions, and stock transfer taxes). The holders may only require us to effect at most two registration statements on Form S-3 in any 12-month period. We may postpone the filing of a registration statement once for up to 90 days in a 12-month period if our board of directors determines that the filing would be materially detrimental to us. We are not required to effect a Form S-3 registration under certain additional circumstances specified in the amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, including during the period beginning 30 days prior to our good faith estimate of the date of filing and ending on a date 90 days after the effective date of a registration statement filed by our initiation.
paras.zh: 最多合计约 130.5 百万股我们普通股的持有人（不包括在行使 OpenAI 认股权证时已发行或可发行的 N 类普通股股份），或其获准受让人，亦享有 S-3 表格要求登记权。根据经修订和重述的投资者权利协议条款，一旦我们符合提交 S-3 表格注册声明的资格，持有当时已发行且享有登记权股份多数的持有人即可要求我们在切实可行的情况下尽快提交涵盖其全部或部分股份的 S-3 表格注册声明，且无论如何应在该请求提出后 45 天内完成，前提是所发售股份向公众发售的总价至少为 $5.0 百万（扣除承销折扣、销售佣金和股票转让税后）。持有人在任何 12 个月期间内最多只能要求我们提交两份 S-3 表格注册声明。若我们的董事会认定提交注册声明将对我们造成重大不利影响，我们可在 12 个月期间内推迟提交注册声明一次，最长不超过 90 天。在经修订和重述的投资者权利协议规定的某些其他情形下，我们无须办理 S-3 表格登记，包括自我们善意估计的提交日期前 30 天起至我们主动提交的注册声明生效日期后 90 天止的期间。

paras.en: Piggyback Registration Rights
paras.zh: 附带登记权

paras.en: If we register any of our securities for public sale, holders of up to an aggregate of approximately 148.7 million shares of our common stock (excluding shares of our Class N common stock issued or issuable upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant), or their permitted transferees, will have the right to include the Class A common stock issuable upon conversion of such shares in the registration statement. However, this right does not apply to a registration relating to the sale of securities pursuant to any company stock plan, a registration relating to an SEC Rule 145 transaction, a registration on any form that does not include substantially the same information as would be required to be included in a registration statement covering the sale of the common stock, or a registration in which the only common stock being registered is common stock issuable upon conversion of debt securities that are also being registered. The underwriters of any underwritten offering will have the right to limit the number of shares registered by these holders if they determine that marketing factors require limitation, in which case the number of shares to be registered will be apportioned pro rata among these holders, according to the total amount of securities entitled to be included by each holder. However, the number of shares to be registered by these holders cannot be reduced unless all other securities of such holders are first entirely excluded from the underwriting.
paras.zh: 若我们登记任何证券进行公开发售，最多合计约 148.7 百万股我们普通股的持有人（不包括在行使 OpenAI 认股权证时已发行或可发行的 N 类普通股股份），或其获准受让人，将有权将该等股份转换后可发行的 A 类普通股纳入注册声明。但是，该权利不适用于根据任何公司股票计划进行的证券发售登记、与 SEC 规则 145 交易相关的登记、采用任何不包含与涵盖普通股发售的注册声明所需包含信息实质相同信息的表格进行的登记，或仅登记在转换亦同时登记债务证券时可发行普通股的登记。任何包销发售的承销商若认定市场因素要求限制，将有权限制该等持有人登记的股份数量，在此情况下，拟登记的股份数量将按各持有人有权纳入的证券总量在这些持有人之间按比例分配。但是，除非首先将该等持有人的所有其他证券完全排除在承销之外，否则不得减少该等持有人拟登记的股份数量。

paras.en: #### OpenAI Registration Rights Agreement
paras.zh: #### OpenAI 登记权协议

paras.en: Following the completion of this offering, and subject to the lock-up agreements entered into in connection with this offering and market standoff provisions, OpenAI will be entitled, with respect to the shares of our Class N common stock issued or issuable upon the exercise of the OpenAI Warrant, to rights with respect to the registration of these shares under the Securities Act. These rights are provided under the terms of a registration rights agreement between us and OpenAI, which was entered into in connection with the OpenAI Warrant, and includes Form S-3 demand registration rights and piggyback registration rights. In any registration made pursuant to such registration rights agreement, all fees, costs, and expenses of underwritten registrations will be borne by us and all underwriting discounts, selling commissions, applicable transfer taxes in connection with the sale of the securities under the registration statement, and the fees and disbursements of OpenAI’s counsel will be borne by OpenAI. We will not be required to bear the expenses in connection with the exercise of the demand registration rights of a registration if the request is subsequently withdrawn at the request of OpenAI. In an underwritten public offering, the underwriters have the right, subject to specified conditions, to limit the number of shares OpenAI may include.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，在遵守与本次发行相关的锁定期协议及市场禁售条款的前提下，OpenAI 将有权就其因行使 OpenAI 认股权证而已发行或可发行的我方 N 类普通股股份，享有根据《证券法》对该等股份进行注册登记的权利。该等权利依据我方与 OpenAI 之间就 OpenAI 认股权证签订的注册权协议条款予以提供，包括 S-3 表格要求注册权及附带注册权。在依据该注册权协议进行的任何注册中，包销注册的全部费用、成本及开支由我方承担，而全部承销折扣、销售佣金、与根据注册声明出售证券相关的适用转让税以及 OpenAI 律师的费用及支出由 OpenAI 承担。如该等要求随后应 OpenAI 的请求被撤回，我方无须承担与该次注册的要求注册权行使相关的费用。在包销公开发行中，承销商有权在特定条件约束下限制 OpenAI 可纳入的股份数量。

paras.en: The registration rights terminate upon the earliest of (i) the three-year anniversary of the expiration date of the OpenAI warrant, (ii) December 24, 2032, or (iii) at such time as OpenAI ceases to hold shares of our Class N common stock issued pursuant to the OpenAI Warrant.
paras.zh: 注册权在以下最早发生之日终止：(i) OpenAI 认股权证到期日三周年之日，(ii) 2032 年 12 月 24 日，或 (iii) OpenAI 不再持有依据 OpenAI 认股权证发行的我方 N 类普通股股份之时。

paras.en: Form S-3 Demand Registration Rights
paras.zh: S-3 表格要求注册权

paras.en: OpenAI is entitled to Form S-3 demand registration rights. Under the terms of the registration rights agreement, at any time once we are eligible to file a registration statement on Form S-3, OpenAI can request that we use commercially reasonable efforts to file a registration statement on Form S-3 covering all or some of the shares of Class N common stock underlying the OpenAI Warrant within 30 days of such request, if the aggregate price to the public of the shares offered is at least $50.0 million (based on the market price of our Class A common stock as of the date of the demand request). OpenAI may only require us to effect one registration of all or a portion of its shares on an underwritten basis and one registration on a non-underwritten basis in any 12-month period, not to exceed a maximum of three registrations on an underwritten basis in the aggregate. We may postpone the filing of a registration statement twice for up to 75 days in any 12-month period or in the 12-month period prior to the expiration of OpenAI’s registration rights under the registration rights agreement if our board of directors determines that the filing would be materially detrimental to us. We are not required to effect a Form S-3 registration under certain additional circumstances specified in the registration rights agreement, including during the period beginning 30 days prior to our good faith estimate of the date of filing and ending on a date 90 days after the effective date of a registration statement filed by our initiation.
paras.zh: OpenAI 有权享有 Form S-3 要求注册权。根据注册权协议的条款，一旦我们具备提交 Form S-3 注册声明的资格，OpenAI 即可在任何时候要求我们尽商业上合理的努力，在该要求提出后 30 天内提交一份 Form S-3 注册声明，涵盖 OpenAI 认股权证所对应的全部或部分 N 类普通股，前提是所发售股份的公开总价至少为 $50.0 million（基于要求提出之日我们 A 类普通股的市场价格）。在任何 12 个月期间内，OpenAI 仅可要求我们就其全部或部分股份进行一次包销注册和一次非包销注册，且包销注册累计最多不超过三次。如果我们的董事会认定提交注册声明将对我们造成重大不利影响，我们可在任何 12 个月期间内或 OpenAI 在注册权协议项下的注册权到期前的 12 个月期间内，两次推迟提交注册声明，每次最长 75 天。在注册权协议规定的某些额外情形下，我们无需进行 Form S-3 注册，包括自我们善意估计的提交日期前 30 天起，至我们主动提交的注册声明生效日期后 90 天之日止的期间。

paras.en: Piggyback Registration Rights
paras.zh: 附带注册权

paras.en: If we register shares of our Class N common stock for public sale, OpenAI, or its permitted transferees, will have the right to include the shares underlying the OpenAI Warrant in the registration statement. However, this right does not apply to a registration on Form S-8, Form S-4, or on another form, or in another context, in which such “piggyback” registration would be inappropriate. The underwriters of any underwritten offering will have the right to limit the number of shares registered by these holders if they determine that marketing factors require limitation, in which case the number of shares to be registered will be apportioned pro rata among these holders, according to the total amount of securities requested to be included by each holder.
paras.zh: 如果我们为公开出售而注册我们的 N 类普通股股份，OpenAI 或其获准受让人将有权将 OpenAI 认股权证所对应的股份纳入该注册声明。但是，此项权利不适用于在 Form S-8、Form S-4 或其它表格上的注册，也不适用于此类“附带”注册不适当的其它情形。任何包销发售的承销商如果认定营销因素要求限制注册股份数量，将有权限制这些持有人注册的股份数量，在此情况下，将按照各持有人要求纳入的证券总量，在这些持有人之间按比例分配拟注册的股份数量。

paras.en: Certain provisions of Delaware law, our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and our amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, which are summarized below, may have the effect of delaying, deferring, or discouraging another person from acquiring control of us. They are also designed, in part, to encourage persons seeking to acquire control of us to negotiate first with our board of directors. We believe that the benefits of increased protection of our potential ability to negotiate with an unfriendly or unsolicited acquirer outweigh the disadvantages of discouraging a proposal to acquire us because negotiation of these proposals could result in an improvement of their terms.
paras.zh: 特拉华州法律、我们经修订并重述的公司章程以及我们经修订并重述的公司细则（二者将在本次发行完成前立即生效）的某些条款（概述如下）可能会产生延迟、推迟或阻止他人取得我们控制权的效果。这些条款的部分目的还在于鼓励寻求取得我们控制权的人首先与我们的董事会进行协商。我们认为，增强对我们与不友好或未经请求的收购方进行协商的潜在能力的保护所带来的益处，超过了因阻止收购我们的提议而产生的不利之处，因为对此类提议进行协商可能会改善其条款。

paras.en: #### Delaware Law
paras.zh: #### 特拉华州法律

paras.en: We are subject to Section 203 of the Delaware General Corporation Law, which prohibits a Delaware corporation from engaging in any business combination with any interested stockholder for a period of three years after the date that such stockholder became an interested stockholder, with the following exceptions:
paras.zh: 我们受《特拉华州普通公司法》第 203 条的约束，该条禁止特拉华州公司在某股东成为利害关系股东之日起三年内与该利害关系股东进行任何业务合并，但以下情形除外：

paras.en: - the business combination or transaction which resulted in the stockholder becoming an interested stockholder was approved by the board of directors prior to the time that the stockholder became an interested stockholder;
paras.zh: - 导致该股东成为利害关系股东的业务合并或交易在该股东成为利害关系股东之前已获得董事会批准；

paras.en: - upon consummation of the transaction which resulted in the stockholder becoming an interested stockholder, the interested stockholder owned at least 85% of the voting stock of the corporation outstanding at the time the transaction commenced, excluding shares owned by directors who are also officers of the corporation and shares owned by employee stock plans in which employee participants do not have the right to determine confidentially whether shares held subject to the plan will be tendered in a tender or exchange offer; or
paras.zh: - 在导致该股东成为利害关系股东的交易完成时，该利害关系股东拥有公司在该交易开始时已发行有表决权股份的至少 85%，但不包括同时担任公司高管的董事所拥有的股份，以及员工参与者无权保密决定其持有的计划项下股份是否会在要约收购或交换要约中出售的员工持股计划所拥有的股份；或

paras.en: - at or subsequent to the time the stockholder became an interested stockholder, the business combination was approved by the board of directors and authorized at an annual or special meeting of the stockholders, and not by written consent, by the affirmative vote of at least 66 2/3% of the outstanding voting stock which is not owned by the interested stockholder.
paras.zh: - 在该股东成为利害关系股东之时或之后，该业务合并经董事会批准，并在年度或特别股东大会上经授权（而非通过书面同意），且获得至少 66 2/3% 的非该利害关系股东所拥有的已发行有表决权股份的赞成票。

paras.en: In general, Section 203 defines a “business combination” to include mergers, asset sales and other transactions resulting in financial benefit to a stockholder and an “interested stockholder” as a person who, together with affiliates and associates, owns, or within three years did own, 15% or more of the corporation’s outstanding voting stock. These provisions may have the effect of delaying, deferring, or preventing changes in control of our company.
paras.zh: 一般而言，第 203 条将“业务合并”定义为包括合并、资产出售以及其他使股东获得财务利益的交易，并将“利害关系股东”定义为连同关联方和关系方一起拥有、或在三年内曾拥有公司已发行有表决权股份 15% 或以上的人。这些条款可能会产生延迟、推迟或阻止我们公司控制权变更的效果。

paras.en: **Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation and Amended and Restated Bylaws**
paras.zh: **经修订并重述的公司章程及经修订并重述的公司细则**

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and our amended and restated bylaws, which will become effective immediately prior to the completion of this offering, will include a number of provisions that could deter hostile takeovers or delay or prevent changes in control of our board of directors or management team, including the following:
paras.zh: 我们经修订并重述的公司章程和经修订并重述的公司细则将在本次发行完成前立即生效，其中将包含若干可能阻止敌意收购或延迟或阻止我们董事会或管理团队控制权变更的条款，包括以下内容：

paras.en: #### Classified Board
paras.zh: #### 分类董事会

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will further provide that our board of directors is divided into three classes, Class I, Class II, and Class III, with each class serving staggered three-year terms. In addition, directors may only be removed from the board of directors for cause. The existence of a classified board could delay a potential acquirer from obtaining majority control of our board of directors, and the prospect of that delay might deter a potential acquirer. See the section titled “Management—Board Structure and Composition” for additional information.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程将进一步规定，我们的董事会分为三类，即 I 类、II 类和 III 类，每类董事的任期交错，均为三年。此外，董事仅可因正当理由被免职。分类董事会的存在可能延迟潜在收购方获得我们董事会多数控制权，而这种延迟的前景可能使潜在收购方望而却步。有关更多信息，请参见标题为“管理层——董事会结构与组成”的章节。

paras.en: #### Board of Directors Vacancies
paras.zh: #### 董事会空缺

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and our amended and restated bylaws will authorize only our board of directors to fill vacant directorships, including newly created seats. In addition, the number of directors constituting our board of directors will be permitted to be set only by a resolution adopted by a majority vote of our entire board of directors. These provisions would prevent a stockholder from increasing the size of our board of directors and then gaining control of our board of directors by filling the resulting vacancies with its own nominees. This will make it more difficult to change the composition of our board of directors and will promote continuity of management.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程以及修订并重述的公司细则将授权仅由我们的董事会填补董事空缺，包括新设立的席位。此外，构成我们董事会的董事人数将仅允许通过经我们全体董事会多数票通过的决议来确定。这些条款将阻止股东扩大我们董事会的规模，然后通过用其自己的提名人填补由此产生的空缺来获得对我们董事会的控制权。这将使改变我们董事会的组成变得更加困难，并将促进管理层的连续性。

paras.en: #### Stockholder Action; Special Meeting of Stockholders
paras.zh: #### 股东行动；股东特别会议

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will provide that our stockholders may not take action by written consent, but may only take action at annual or special meetings of our stockholders. As a result, a holder controlling a majority of our capital stock would not be able to amend our amended and restated bylaws or remove directors without holding a meeting of our stockholders called in accordance with our amended and restated bylaws. Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will further provide that special meetings of our stockholders may be called only by a majority of our board of directors, the chairperson of our board of directors, our Chief Executive Officer, or our President, thus prohibiting a stockholder from calling a special meeting. These provisions might delay the ability of our stockholders to force consideration of a proposal or for stockholders controlling a majority of our capital stock to take any action, including the removal of directors.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程将规定，我们的股东不得通过书面同意采取行动，而只能在我们的股东年度会议或特别会议上采取行动。因此，控制我们多数股本的持有人将无法在不按照我们修订并重述的公司细则召开股东会议的情况下修改我们修订并重述的公司细则或罢免董事。我们修订并重述的公司章程将进一步规定，我们的股东特别会议只能由我们董事会的多数成员、我们的董事会主席、我们的首席执行官或我们的总裁召集，从而禁止股东召集特别会议。这些条款可能延迟我们的股东强制审议提案的能力，或延迟控制我们多数股本的股东采取任何行动（包括罢免董事）的能力。

paras.en: #### Advance Notice Requirements for Stockholder Proposals and Director Nominations
paras.zh: #### 股东提案和董事提名的提前通知要求

paras.en: Our amended and restated bylaws will provide advance notice procedures for stockholders seeking to bring business before our annual meeting of stockholders or to nominate candidates for election as directors at our annual meeting of stockholders. Our amended and restated bylaws will also specify certain requirements regarding the form and content of a stockholder’s notice. These provisions might preclude our stockholders from bringing matters before our annual meeting of stockholders or from making nominations for directors at our annual meeting of stockholders if the proper procedures are not followed. We expect that these provisions may also discourage or deter a potential acquirer from conducting a solicitation of proxies to elect the acquirer’s own slate of directors or otherwise attempting to obtain control of our company.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程将规定股东提案预告程序，适用于拟在年度股东大会上提出事项或提名董事候选人的股东。我们修订并重述的公司章程还将就股东通知的形式和内容规定若干要求。若未遵循适当程序，该等条款可能使我们的股东无法在年度股东大会上提出事项或提名董事。我们预计，该等条款还可能阻碍或抑制潜在收购方征集委托书以选举其自身提名的董事人选，或以其他方式试图取得对我们公司的控制权。

paras.en: #### No Cumulative Voting
paras.zh: #### 无累积投票制

paras.en: The Delaware General Corporation Law provides that stockholders are not entitled to cumulate votes in the election of directors unless a corporation’s certificate of incorporation provides otherwise. Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will not provide for cumulative voting.
paras.zh: 《特拉华州普通公司法》规定，除非公司章程另有规定，股东在选举董事时无权累积投票。我们修订并重述的公司章程将不规定累积投票制。

paras.en: #### Amendment of Charter and Bylaws Provisions
paras.zh: #### 章程条款的修订

paras.en: Amendments to our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will require the approval of 66 2/3% of the outstanding voting power of our common stock. Our amended and restated bylaws will provide that approval of stockholders holding 66 2/3% of our outstanding voting power voting as a single class is required for stockholders to amend or adopt any provision of our bylaws. In addition, amendments to our amended and restated certificate of incorporation or our amended and restated bylaws that amend, alter, change, adopt, or repeal any provision in a manner that modifies the voting, conversion, or other powers, preferences, or other special rights or privileges, or restrictions of the Class N common stock will require the approval of a majority of the then-outstanding shares of Class N common stock, voting as a separate class.
paras.zh: 对我们修订并重述的公司章程的修订，须经我们普通股已发行表决权 66 2/3%的批准。我们修订并重述的公司章程将规定，股东修订或采纳我们公司章程的任何条款，须经持有我们已发行表决权 66 2/3%的股东作为一个单一类别表决批准。此外，对我们修订并重述的公司章程或我们修订并重述的公司章程的修订，若以修改 N 类普通股的投票权、转换权或其他权力、优先权或其他特殊权利或特权，或限制的方式修订、变更、更改、采纳或废止任何条款，须经当时已发行的 N 类普通股多数股份作为一个单独类别表决批准。

paras.en: #### Issuance of Undesignated Preferred Stock
paras.zh: #### 发行未指定优先股

paras.en: Our board of directors will have the authority, without further action by our stockholders, to issue up to 100,000,000 shares of undesignated preferred stock with rights and preferences, including voting rights, designated from time to time by our board of directors. The existence of authorized but unissued shares of preferred stock would enable our board of directors to render more difficult or to discourage an attempt to obtain control of us by means of a merger, tender offer, proxy contest, or other means.
paras.zh: 我们的董事会有权在无需股东进一步行动的情况下，发行最多 100,000,000 股未指定优先股，其权利和优先权（包括投票权）由我们的董事会不时指定。已授权但未发行的优先股的存在，将使我们的董事会能够通过合并、要约收购、委托书争夺或其他方式，使取得对我们控制权的尝试变得更加困难或予以阻碍。

paras.en: #### Choice of Forum
paras.zh: #### 管辖法院的选择

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws will provide that, unless we consent in writing to the selection of an alternative forum, the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware will be the exclusive forum for the following types of actions or proceedings under Delaware statutory or common law: any derivative action or proceeding brought on our behalf; any action asserting a claim of breach of fiduciary duty owed by any of our directors, officers or stockholders to us or to our stockholders; any action asserting a claim against us arising pursuant to the Delaware General Corporation Law, our amended and restated certificate of incorporation or our amended and restated bylaws (as either may be amended from time to time); or any action asserting a claim against us that is governed by the internal affairs doctrine. As a result, any action brought by any of our stockholders with regard to any of these matters will need to be filed in the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware and cannot be filed in any other jurisdiction; provided that, the exclusive forum provision will not apply to suits brought to enforce any liability or duty created solely by the Exchange Act or any other claim for which the federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction; and provided further that, if and only if the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware dismisses any such action for lack of subject matter jurisdiction, such action may be brought in another state or federal court sitting in the State of Delaware. Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws will also provide that the federal district courts of the United States of America will be the exclusive forum for the resolution of any complaint asserting a cause or causes of action against us or any defendant arising under the Securities Act. Such provision is intended to benefit and may be enforced by us, our officers and directors, employees, and agents, including the underwriters and any other professional or entity who has prepared or certified any part of this prospectus. Nothing in our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws preclude stockholders that assert claims under the Exchange Act from bringing such claims in state or federal court, subject to applicable law.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程和修订并重述的公司细则将规定，除非我们书面同意选择替代法院，否则特拉华州衡平法院将作为以下类型依据特拉华州成文法或普通法提起的诉讼或程序的专属法院：任何代表我们提起的派生诉讼或程序；任何主张我们的任何董事、高级职员或股东对我们或我们的股东负有违反信义义务的索赔的诉讼；任何依据《特拉华州普通公司法》、我们修订并重述的公司章程或我们修订并重述的公司细则（两者均可不时修订）对我们提出索赔的诉讼；或任何主张受内部事务原则管辖的针对我们的索赔的诉讼。因此，我们的任何股东就任何该等事项提起的任何诉讼均需向特拉华州衡平法院提起，而不得向任何其他司法管辖区提起；但前提是，专属法院条款不适用于为执行仅由《交易法》创设的任何责任或义务而提起的诉讼，或联邦法院拥有专属管辖权的任何其他索赔；并且进一步前提是，当且仅当特拉华州衡平法院因缺乏标的物管辖权而驳回任何该等诉讼时，该等诉讼可在位于特拉华州的另一州法院或联邦法院提起。我们修订并重述的公司章程和修订并重述的公司细则还将规定，美利坚合众国联邦地区法院将作为解决任何依据《证券法》对我们或任何被告主张一项或多项诉因的投诉的专属法院。该条款旨在使我们、我们的高级职员和董事、员工和代理人（包括承销商以及任何其他编制或认证本招股说明书任何部分的专业人士或实体）受益，并可由其强制执行。我们修订并重述的公司章程和修订并重述的公司细则中的任何内容均不阻止依据《交易法》提出索赔的股东在适用法律允许的情况下向州法院或联邦法院提起该等索赔。

paras.en: If any action the subject matter of which is within the scope described above is filed in a court other than a court located within the State of Delaware (a “Foreign Action”), in the name of any stockholder, such stockholder shall be deemed to have consented to the personal jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located within the State of Delaware in connection with any action brought in any such court to enforce the applicable provisions of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws and having service of process made upon such stockholder in any such action by service upon such stockholder’s counsel in the Foreign Action as agent for such stockholder. Although our amended and restated certificate of incorporation and amended and restated bylaws will contain the choice of forum provision described above, it is possible that a court could find that such a provision is inapplicable for a particular claim or action or that such provision is unenforceable.
paras.zh: 若上述标的范围内的任何诉讼以任何股东的名义向特拉华州以外的法院提起（“域外诉讼”），该股东应被视为已同意特拉华州内州法院和联邦法院对为执行我们经修订和重述的公司章程及经修订和重述的章程细则的适用条款而在任何此类法院提起的任何诉讼具有属人管辖权，并同意在任何此类诉讼中通过向该股东在域外诉讼中的律师送达法律文书作为该股东的代理人而向其送达法律文书。尽管我们经修订和重述的公司章程及经修订和重述的章程细则将包含上述法院选择条款，但法院仍可能认定该条款对特定索赔或诉讼不适用，或认定该条款不可执行。

paras.en: This choice of forum provision may limit a stockholder’s ability to bring a claim in a judicial forum that it finds favorable for disputes with us or any of our directors, officers, other employees or stockholders, which may discourage lawsuits with respect to such claims or make such lawsuits more costly for stockholders, although our stockholders will not be deemed to have waived our compliance with federal securities laws and the rules and regulations thereunder.
paras.zh: 该法院选择条款可能限制股东就与我们或我们的任何董事、高级管理人员、其他员工或股东之间的争议向其认为有利的司法论坛提起诉讼，这可能抑制就此等索赔提起诉讼，或使股东提起此类诉讼的成本更高，尽管我们的股东不会被视为已放弃我们遵守联邦证券法及其项下规则和法规的义务。

full.sec: Limitations on Liability and Indemnification Matters

paras.en: Our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will limit the liability of our directors and officers to the fullest extent permitted by the Delaware General Corporation Law, and our amended and restated bylaws will provide that we will indemnify them to the fullest extent permitted by such law. We expect to enter into indemnification agreements with our current directors and executive officers prior to the completion of this offering and expect to enter into a similar agreement with any new directors or executive officers. Further, pursuant to our indemnification agreements and directors’ and officers’ liability insurance, our directors and executive officers will be indemnified and insured against the cost of defense, settlement, or payment of a judgment under certain circumstances. In addition, as permitted by Delaware law, our amended and restated certificate of incorporation will include provisions that eliminate the personal liability of our directors and executive officers for monetary damages resulting from breaches of certain fiduciary duties as a director or officer. The effect of this provision is to restrict our rights and the rights of our stockholders in derivative suits to recover monetary damages against a director or officer for breach of fiduciary duties as a director or officer.
paras.zh: 我们修订并重述的公司章程将在《特拉华州普通公司法》允许的最大范围内限制我们的董事和高级管理人员的责任，且我们修订并重述的公司细则将规定，我们将在该法允许的最大范围内对他们进行补偿。我们预计将在本次发行完成前与现任董事和高级管理人员签订补偿协议，并预计与任何新任董事或高级管理人员签订类似协议。此外，根据我们的补偿协议以及董事和高级管理人员责任保险，我们的董事和高级管理人员将在特定情况下就抗辩、和解或判决支付的成本获得补偿和保险保障。另外，在特拉华州法律允许的范围内，我们修订并重述的公司章程将包含相关条款，免除我们的董事和高级管理人员因作为董事或高级管理人员违反某些信义义务而产生的金钱损害的个人责任。该条款的效果是限制我们及我们的股东在衍生诉讼中就董事或高级管理人员因作为董事或高级管理人员违反信义义务而追索金钱损害赔偿的权利。

paras.en: These provisions may be held not to be enforceable for violations of the federal securities laws of the United States.
paras.zh: 上述条款可能因违反美国联邦证券法而被认定为不可执行。

paras.en: We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “CBRS.”
paras.zh: 我们已获准在纳斯达克全球精选市场（Nasdaq Global Select Market）上市我们的 A 类普通股，股票代码为“CBRS”。

paras.en: The transfer agent and registrar for our Class A common stock, Class B common stock, and Class N common stock will be Computershare Trust Company, N.A. The address of the transfer agent and registrar is 250 Royall Street, Canton, Massachusetts 02021.
paras.zh: 我们 A 类普通股、B 类普通股和 N 类普通股的过户代理及登记机构将为 Computershare Trust Company, N.A.。过户代理及登记机构的地址为 250 Royall Street, Canton, Massachusetts 02021。

paras.en: Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our common stock. Future sales of substantial amounts of our Class A common stock in the public market could adversely affect market prices prevailing from time to time. Furthermore, because only a limited number of shares will be available for sale shortly after this offering due to existing contractual and legal restrictions on resale as described below, there may be sales of substantial amounts of our Class A common stock in the public market after the restrictions lapse. This may adversely affect the prevailing market price and our ability to raise equity capital in the future.
paras.zh: 在本次发行之前，我们的普通股不存在公开市场。未来在公开市场大量出售我们的 A 类普通股可能会对不时 prevailing 的市场价格产生不利影响。此外，由于下述现有的合同和法律转售限制，本次发行后不久可供出售的股份数量有限，因此在限制解除后，公开市场可能会出现大量 A 类普通股的出售。这可能对 prevailing 市场价格以及我们未来筹集股权资本的能力产生不利影响。

paras.en: Upon the completion of this offering, based on the number of shares of our capital stock outstanding as of December 31, 2025, we will have an aggregate of 30,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock (or 34,500,000 shares of Class A common if the underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full), 185,110,345 shares of our Class B common stock, and no shares of our Class N common stock outstanding, after giving effect to (i) the filing and effectiveness of our amended and restated certificate of incorporation, which will occur immediately prior to the completion of this offering; (ii) the Preferred Stock Conversion; (iii) the Common Stock Reclassification; and (iv) the RSU Net Settlement, and assuming no exercise of any additional options or settlement of additional RSUs subsequent to December 31, 2025; and assuming no exercise of the underwriters’ over-allotment option to purchase additional shares from us.
paras.zh: 本次发行完成后，基于截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日我们已发行的股本股份数量，在使以下事项生效后：(i) 我们经修订和重述的公司章程的提交和生效，该事项将在本次发行完成前立即发生；(ii) 优先股转换；(iii) 普通股重新分类；以及 (iv) RSU 净额结算，并假设 2025 年 12 月 31 日之后不行使任何额外期权或结算额外 RSU；且假设承销商不行使向我们购买额外股份的超额配售选择权，我们将合计拥有 30,000,000 股 A 类普通股（若承销商全额行使超额配售选择权，则为 34,500,000 股 A 类普通股）、185,110,345 股 B 类普通股，以及无已发行的 N 类普通股。

paras.en: Of these shares, all of the shares of Class A common stock sold in this offering, plus any shares sold by us, if any, upon exercise of the underwriters’ over-allotment option, will be freely tradable without restrictions or further registration under the Securities Act, except for any shares purchased by our “affiliates,” as that term is defined in Rule 144 under the Securities Act, whose sales would be subject to the Rule 144 resale restrictions described below, other than the holding period requirement.
paras.zh: 在这些股份中，本次发行中出售的全部 A 类普通股，加上我们（如有）在承销商行使超额配售选择权时出售的任何股份，将可自由交易，无需根据《证券法》进行限制或进一步登记，但我们的“关联方”（定义见《证券法》第 144 条）购买的任何股份除外，其出售将受下述第 144 条转售限制的约束，持有期要求除外。

paras.en: The remaining shares of Class B common stock and shares of Class B common stock subject to stock options will be on issuance deemed “restricted securities,” as that term is defined in Rule 144 under the Securities Act. These restricted securities are eligible for public sale only if they are registered under the Securities Act or if they qualify for an exemption from registration under Rules 144 or 701 under the Securities Act, which are summarized below.

paras.en: As used herein,
paras.zh: 如本文所用，

paras.en: - “Directors and Officers” means our directors and officers subject to reporting under Section 16 of the Exchange Act during the Lock-up Period.
paras.zh: - “董事及高管”指在锁定期内需根据《交易法》第 16 条进行报告的我们的董事及高管。

paras.en: - “Non-Executive Employees” means our employees as of March 31, 2026, who are not Directors and Officers.
paras.zh: - “非高管员工”指截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日我们的员工中不属于董事及高管的人员。

paras.en: - “Non-Employee Holders” means holders of our capital stock, and securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for shares of our capital stock, who are not Directors and Officers or Non-Executive Employees.
paras.zh: - “非员工持有人”指我们的股本以及可转换为或可行使或可交换为我们股本股份的证券的持有人中不属于董事及高管或非高管员工的人员。

paras.en: - “Eligible Securities” means vested shares of our Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock held by the Directors and Officers, Non-Executive Employees, and Non-Employee Holders as of April 30, 2026. Eligible Securities also include equity awards (including stock options and RSUs) granted prior to April 30, 2026 to Directors and Officers and Non-Executive Employees for which the service-based vesting condition will be satisfied as of November 9, 2026.
paras.zh: - “合格证券”指截至 2026 年 4 月 30 日由董事及高管、非高管员工和非员工持有人持有的我们 A 类普通股的已归属股份，以及可直接或间接转换为或可交换或可行使为我们 A 类普通股的证券。合格证券还包括在 2026 年 4 月 30 日之前授予董事及高管和非高管员工的股权奖励（包括股票期权和 RSU），且该等奖励的服务期归属条件将于 2026 年 11 月 9 日满足。

paras.en: In general, a person who has beneficially owned restricted shares of our common stock for at least six months would be entitled to sell such securities, provided that (i) such person is not deemed to have been one of our affiliates at the time of, or at any time during the 90 days preceding, a sale; and (ii) we are subject to the Exchange Act periodic reporting requirements for at least 90 days before the sale. Persons who have beneficially owned restricted shares of our common stock for at least six months but who are our affiliates at the time of, or any time during the 90 days preceding, a sale, would be subject to additional restrictions, by which such person would be entitled to sell within any three-month period only a number of securities that does not exceed the greater of either of the following:
paras.zh: 一般而言，实益持有本公司普通股受限股份至少六个月的人士，有权出售该等证券，前提是：(i) 该人士在出售时或出售前 90 天内任何时点均不被视为我们的关联方之一；且 (ii) 我们在出售前至少 90 天内受《交易法》定期报告要求的约束。实益持有本公司普通股受限股份至少六个月、但在出售时或出售前 90 天内任何时点属于我们关联方的人士，将受到额外限制，据此该人士在任何三个月期间内仅有权出售不超过以下两者中较大者的证券数量：

paras.en: - 1% of the number of shares of our Class A common stock then outstanding, which will equal approximately 300,000 shares immediately after this offering, assuming no exercise of the underwriters’ over-allotment option; or
paras.zh: - 当时已发行的 A 类普通股股份数量的 1%，假设承销商未行使超额配售选择权，本次发行后立即约为 300,000 股；或

paras.en: - the average weekly trading volume of shares of our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market during the four calendar weeks preceding the filing of a notice on Form 144 with respect to that sale;
paras.zh: - 在就该项出售向 SEC 提交 Form 144 通知之前的四个日历周内，本公司 A 类普通股在纳斯达克全球精选市场的平均每周交易量；

paras.en: provided, in each case, that we are subject to the Exchange Act periodic reporting requirements for at least 90 days before the sale. Such sales both by affiliates and by non-affiliates must also comply with the manner of sale, current public information and notice provisions of Rule 144 to the extent applicable.
paras.zh: 但在每种情况下，均须我们在出售前至少 90 天内受《交易法》定期报告要求的约束。关联方和非关联方的此类出售还必须在适用范围内遵守 Rule 144 的出售方式、当前公开信息和通知条款。

paras.en: In general, under Rule 701 as currently in effect, any of our employees, directors, officers, consultants, or advisors who acquired common stock from us in connection with a written compensatory stock or option plan or other written agreement in compliance with Rule 701 before the effective date of the registration statement of which this prospectus is a part (to the extent such common stock is not subject to a lock-up agreement or market standoff provision) and who are not our “affiliates” as defined in Rule 144 during the immediately preceding 90 days, is entitled to rely on Rule 701 to resell such shares beginning 90 days after the date of this prospectus in reliance on Rule 144, but without complying with the notice, manner of sale, public information requirements or volume limitation provisions of Rule 144. Persons who are our “affiliates” may resell those shares beginning 90 days after the date of this prospectus without compliance with minimum holding period requirements under Rule 144 (subject to the terms of the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions referred to below, if applicable).
paras.zh: 一般而言，根据现行有效的 Rule 701，我们的任何员工、董事、高级管理人员、顾问或咨询人，凡在包含本招股说明书的注册声明生效日之前，依据书面薪酬性股票或期权计划或其他书面协议、按照 Rule 701 从我方取得普通股的（以该等普通股不受锁定期协议或市场禁售条款约束为限），且在此前紧接的 90 天内不属于 Rule 144 所定义的我们的“关联方”的，有权自本招股说明书日期起 90 天后依据 Rule 144 转售该等股份，但无需遵守 Rule 144 的通知、销售方式、公开信息要求或成交量限制规定。属于我们“关联方”的人士可自本招股说明书日期起 90 天后转售该等股份，而无需遵守 Rule 144 项下的最低持有期要求（受下文所述锁定期协议和市场禁售条款的约束，如适用）。

full.secZh: 锁定期与市场禁售协议

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we, our executive officers and directors, and certain other record holders that together represent approximately 71.4% of our Class A common stock, stock options, and other securities convertible into, exercisable, or exchangeable for our Class A common stock have entered into lock-up agreements with the underwriters pursuant to which we and they have agreed to not, among other things and subject to certain exceptions, offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, or otherwise dispose of, (or enter into any transaction which is designed to, or might reasonably be expected to, result in the disposition (whether by actual disposition or effective economic disposition due to cash settlement or otherwise) any shares of Class A common stock or securities convertible into or exchangeable for shares of our Class A common stock during the Lock-up Period.
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们、我们的高级管理人员和董事，以及合计持有约 71.4% 的 A 类普通股、股票期权及可转换为、可行使或可交换为 A 类普通股的其他证券的若干其他登记持有人，已与承销商签订锁定期协议，据此，我们及上述各方已同意，除其他事项外并受若干例外情形约束，在锁定期内不会要约、出售、订立出售合同、质押或以其他方式处置（或订立任何旨在或合理预期会导致处置（无论是实际处置，还是因现金结算或其他原因导致的有效经济处置）任何 A 类普通股或可转换为或可交换为 A 类普通股的证券的交易）。

paras.en: Furthermore, (i) an additional approximately 4.9% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to the market standoff provisions in our amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, pursuant to which such holders agreed to not lend, offer, pledge, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our Class A common stock held immediately prior to the effectiveness of this registration statement, or enter into any swap or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of such securities during the Lock-up Period and (ii) an additional approximately 23.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to restrictions contained in market standoff agreements with us that include restrictions on the sale, transfer, or other disposition of shares during the Lock-up Period. The forms and specific restrictive provisions within these market standoff provisions vary among security holders. For example, although some of these market standoff provisions do not specifically restrict hedging transactions and others may be subject to different interpretations between us and security holders as to whether they restrict hedging, our insider trading compliance policy prohibits hedging by all of our current directors, officers, employees, contractors, and consultants. Sales, short sales, or hedging transactions involving our equity securities, whether before or after this offering and whether or not we believe them to be prohibited, could adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 此外，(i) 另有约 4.9% 的已发行 A 类普通股及可直接或间接转换为、可交换或可行使为 A 类普通股的证券，受我们经修订和重述的投资者权利协议中市场禁售条款的约束，据此，该等持有人同意，在锁定期内不会出借、要约、质押、出售、订立出售合同、出售任何购买期权或合同、购买任何出售期权或合同、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证，或以其他方式直接或间接转让或处置其在本注册声明生效前立即持有的任何 A 类普通股或可转换为、可行使或可交换为 A 类普通股的任何证券，或订立任何互换或其他安排，将此类证券所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给他人；以及 (ii) 另有约 23.7% 的已发行 A 类普通股及可直接或间接转换为、可交换或可行使为 A 类普通股的证券，受与我们签订的市场禁售协议中所含限制的约束，该等限制包括在锁定期内对出售、转让或其他处置股份的限制。这些市场禁售条款的形式和具体限制性规定因证券持有人而异。例如，尽管其中部分市场禁售条款并未明确限制对冲交易，其他条款在是否限制对冲的问题上可能在我们与证券持有人之间存在不同解释，但我们的内幕交易合规政策禁止我们所有现任董事、高级管理人员、员工、承包商和顾问进行对冲。涉及我们股权证券的出售、卖空或对冲交易，无论发生在本次发行之前还是之后，也无论我们是否认为其被禁止，均可能对我们 A 类普通股的价格产生不利影响。

paras.en: As a result of the foregoing, substantially all of our outstanding shares of Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to a lock-up agreement or market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period. We have agreed to enforce all such market standoff restrictions on behalf of the underwriters and not to amend or waive any such market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period without the prior consent of Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Citigroup Global Markets Inc., and Barclays Capital Inc., on behalf of the underwriters, provided that we may release shares from such restrictions to the extent such shares would be entitled to release under the form of lock-up agreement with the underwriters signed by our directors and executive officers and certain other record holders of our securities as described herein.
paras.zh: 基于上述情况，在我们已发行在外的 A 类普通股以及可直接或间接转换为 A 类普通股或可交换为 A 类普通股或可对其行使认购权的证券中，绝大部分在锁定期内均受锁定期协议或市场禁售条款的约束。我们已同意代表承销商执行所有该等市场禁售限制，并且在锁定期内，未经 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC、Citigroup Global Markets Inc. 和 Barclays Capital Inc.（代表承销商）事先同意，我们不会修订或豁免任何该等市场禁售条款；但前提是，对于根据本文件所述由我们的董事和高级管理人员以及我们证券的某些其他登记持有人与承销商签署的锁定期协议格式本应有权解除限制的股份，我们可以解除该等限制。

paras.en: Notwithstanding the foregoing, and in each case, subject to the provisions of Rule 144 and Rule 701 under the Securities Act and our insider trading compliance policy, as applicable:
paras.zh: 尽管有上述规定，且在每种情况下均受《证券法》第 144 条和第 701 条以及我们的内幕交易合规政策（如适用）的约束：

paras.en: (i) 7.5% of the Eligible Securities held by Non-Executive Employees will be released beginning at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the First Trading Day;

paras.zh: (v) 董事及高管、非执行雇员和非雇员持有人各自所持合格证券的 6.7%，将在以下各日东部时间上午 6:00 解除：

Without limiting the above, the restrictions imposed by the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period are subject to certain additional exceptions, including with respect to:

paras.en: (i) any sales of our Class A common stock to the underwriters pursuant to the underwriting agreement to be entered into in connection with this offering;
paras.zh: (i) 依据与本发行相关的承销协议将向承销商出售的任何 A 类普通股股份；

paras.en: (ii) transfers (A) as a bona fide gift or gifts (including contributions to a charitable organization or educational institution) or (B) for bona fide estate or tax planning purposes (including contributions to a family foundation);
paras.zh: (ii) 以下转让：(A) 作为一项或多项善意赠与（包括向慈善组织或教育机构的捐赠），或 (B) 出于善意的遗产或税务规划目的（包括向家族基金会的捐赠）；

paras.en: (iii) transfers by will, other testamentary document, or intestacy;
paras.zh: (iii) 通过遗嘱、其他遗嘱文件或无遗嘱继承进行的转让；

paras.en: (iv) transfers to any trust for the direct or indirect benefit of the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party, or if the lock-up party is a trust, to a trustor or beneficiary of the trust or to the estate of a beneficiary of such trust;
paras.zh: (iv) 向为锁定期方或锁定期方直系亲属直接或间接利益设立的任何信托进行的转让，或若锁定期方为信托，则向该信托的委托人、受益人或该信托受益人的遗产进行的转让；

paras.en: (v) transfers to a partnership, limited liability company, or other entity of which the lock-up party and/or the immediate family of the lock-up party are the legal and/or beneficial owner of all of the outstanding equity securities or similar interests;
paras.zh: (v) 向锁定期方和/或锁定期方直系亲属为全部已发行股权证券或类似权益的法定和/或实益拥有人的合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体进行的转让；

paras.en: (vi) transfers to a nominee, custodian or trustee of a person or entity to whom a disposition or transfer would be permissible under clauses (ii) through (v) above;
paras.zh: (vi) 向根据上文第(ii)至(v)项允许进行处置或转让的人士或实体的名义持有人、托管人或受托人进行的转让；

paras.en: (vii)transactions relating to shares of Class A common stock acquired by the lock-up party in this offering or in open market transactions after the closing date of this offering;
paras.zh: (vii) 与锁定期方在本发行中或在本发行交割日之后通过公开市场交易取得的 A 类普通股股份相关的交易；

paras.en: (viii) if the lock-up party is a corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other business entity, (A) transfers to another corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other business entity that is an affiliate (as defined in Rule 405 promulgated under the Securities Act) of the lock-up party, or to any investment fund or other entity controlling, controlled by, managing, or managed by or under common control with the lock-up party or affiliates of the lock-up party (including, for the avoidance of doubt, where the lock-up party is a partnership, to its general partner or a successor partnership or fund, or any other funds managed by such partnership), or (B) transfers as part of a distribution to members, partners, shareholders, or other equity-holders of the lock-up party;
paras.zh: (viii) 若锁定期方为公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，(A) 向作为锁定期方关联方（定义见《证券法》第 405 条）的另一公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，或向控制锁定期方、受锁定期方控制、与锁定期方共同管理或受其管理、或与锁定期方或锁定期方关联方处于共同控制之下的任何投资基金或其他实体进行的转让（包括，为免疑义，若锁定期方为合伙企业，向其普通合伙人或继任合伙企业或基金，或由该合伙企业管理的任何其他基金进行的转让），或 (B) 作为向锁定期方成员、合伙人、股东或其他权益持有人进行分配的一部分而进行的转让；

paras.en: (ix) transfers by operation of law, such as pursuant to a qualified domestic order, divorce settlement, divorce decree, separation agreement or other court order;
paras.zh: (ix) 依法律实施的转让，例如依据合格家庭关系令、离婚和解协议、离婚判决、分居协议或其他法院命令进行的转让；

paras.en: (x) transfers to us from a service provider of the Company upon death, disability or termination of services, in each case, of such service provider;
paras.zh: (x) 公司服务提供方在其死亡、丧失行为能力或服务终止时向本公司进行的转让（在每种情况下均指该服务提供方）。

paras.en: (xi) transfers to us in connection with the vesting, exercise, or settlement of options, warrants, RSUs, or other rights to purchase shares of our Class A common stock, Class B common stock, or Class N common stock (including, in each case, by way of “net” or “cashless” exercise), including for the payment of exercise price and tax and remittance payments due as a result of the vesting, exercise, or settlement of such options, warrants, RSUs, or rights, provided that any shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock, or Class N common stock received upon such vesting, exercise, or settlement shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above, and provided further that any such options, warrants, RSUs, or rights are held by the lock-up party pursuant to (A) an agreement or (B) equity awards granted under an equity incentive plan, stock purchase plan, or other equity award plan described in this prospectus;
paras.zh: (xi) 就期权、认股权证、RSU 或其他购买我们 A 类普通股、B 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份的权利的归属、行权或结算而向我们进行的转让（在每种情况下均包括通过“净额”或“无现金”行权方式），包括用于支付行权价格以及因该等期权、认股权证、RSU 或权利的归属、行权或结算而应付的税款和汇款款项，前提是于该等归属、行权或结算时收到的任何 A 类普通股、B 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份仍应受上述限制的约束，并且进一步前提是该等期权、认股权证、RSU 或权利由锁定方依据 (A) 一项协议或 (B) 根据本招股说明书中所述的股权激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划授予的股权奖励而持有；

paras.en: (xii)transfers in connection with the sale or other transfer of the lock-up party’s shares of Class A common stock to satisfy any tax obligations or payments due as a result of (A) the exercise of stock options or (B) the settlement of RSUs (other than RSUs that vest in connection with or upon the completion of this offering) pursuant to awards granted under an equity incentive plan, stock purchase plan, or other equity award plan described in this prospectus, provided that, in each case, any remaining shares of Class A common stock or Class B common stock received upon such exercise or settlement shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above;
paras.zh: (xii) 就出售或以其他方式转让锁定方的 A 类普通股股份以履行因 (A) 行使股票期权或 (B) 结算 RSU（不包括与本发售完成相关或于本发售完成时归属的 RSU）而应付的任何税务义务或款项而进行的转让，上述行权或结算系依据本招股说明书中所述的股权激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划授予的奖励进行，前提是在每种情况下，于该等行权或结算时收到的任何剩余 A 类普通股或 B 类普通股股份仍应受上述限制的约束；

paras.en: (xiii) the conversion of our outstanding Class B common stock, Class N common stock, or preferred stock into shares of our Class A common stock or Class N common stock, as applicable, provided that any such shares of Class A common stock or Class B common stock received upon such conversion shall be subject to the restrictions set forth above; or
paras.zh: (xiii) 我们已发行的 B 类普通股、N 类普通股或优先股转换为我们的 A 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份（视情况而定），前提是于该等转换时收到的任何该等 A 类普通股或 B 类普通股股份应受上述限制的约束；或

paras.en: (xiv) transfers pursuant to a bona fide third-party tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction that is approved by our board of directors and made to all holders of our capital stock involving a change of control of the company; provided that in the event that such tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction is not completed, the lock-up party’s securities shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above;
paras.zh: (xiv) 依据经我们董事会批准并向我们全部股本持有人作出、涉及公司控制权变更的善意第三方要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易而进行的转让；前提是倘若该等要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易未能完成，锁定方的证券仍应受上述限制的约束；

paras.en: provided that (A) in the case of any transfer, distribution or other disposition pursuant to clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (viii), and (ix), such transfer shall not involve a disposition for value and such securities shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above; (B) in the case of any transfer, distribution, or other disposition pursuant to clauses (a)(vii) and (viii), no filing by any party under the Exchange Act or other public announcement shall be required or will be made voluntarily in connection with such transfer, disposition, or distribution (other than a filing on a Form 5 or pursuant to Section 13 of the Exchange Act); and (C) in the case of any transfer or distribution pursuant to clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (ix), (x), (xi), and (xii), that no public filing, report, or announcement will be voluntarily made, and if any filing under Section 16(a) of the Exchange Act, or other public filing, report, or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of shares of Class A common stock in connection with the transfer or distribution is legally required during the Lock-up Period, such filing, report, or announcement must clearly indicate in the footnotes thereto the nature and conditions of the transfer.
paras.zh: 前提是：(A) 对于依据第 (a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(viii) 和 (ix) 项进行的任何转让、分配或其他处置，该等转让不得涉及有偿处置，且该等证券仍应受上述限制的约束；(B) 对于依据第 (a)(vii) 和 (viii) 项进行的任何转让、分配或其他处置，任何一方均无需根据《交易法》进行申报，亦不会就该等转让、处置或分配自愿进行任何公开公告（依据 Form 5 或《交易法》第 13 条进行的申报除外）；以及 (C) 对于依据第 (a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(ix)、(x)、(xi) 和 (xii) 项进行的任何转让或分配，不会自愿进行任何公开申报、报告或公告，且如果在锁定期内依法要求就与该等转让或分配相关的 A 类普通股受益所有权减少进行《交易法》第 16(a) 条项下的任何申报或其他公开申报、报告或公告，则该等申报、报告或公告必须在其脚注中明确说明该等转让的性质和条件。

paras.en: All remaining securities held by our security holders and not previously eligible for sale, subject to applicable limitations under Rule 144, including for “affiliates” and compliance with other applicable law, and subject to the provisions of our insider trading compliance policy, as applicable, will be fully released on the earlier of (i) 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day following our release of earnings for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 or (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus.
paras.zh: 我们的证券持有人持有的、此前不具备出售资格的所有剩余证券，在遵守第 144 条适用限制（包括针对“关联方”的限制）及遵守其他适用法律的前提下，并受我们的内幕交易合规政策条款（如适用）的约束，将在以下两者中较早发生之日完全解除限制：(i) 我们发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度财报后第二个交易日美国东部时间上午 6:00，或 (ii) 本招股说明书日期后 180 天。
