Upon the expiration of the Lock-up Period, substantially all of the securities subject to such transfer restrictions will become eligible for sale, subject to the limitations discussed above.
paras.zh: 有关上述锁定期协议和市场禁售条款的例外情况以及这些协议的进一步说明，请参见题为“承销商”的章节。锁定期届满后，受该等转让限制约束的绝大部分证券将具备出售资格，但须遵守上述讨论的限制。

paras.en: We have granted Form S-1 and Form S-3 demand and piggyback registration rights to certain of our stockholders. Registration of the sale of these shares under the Securities Act would result in these shares becoming freely tradable without restriction under the Securities Act immediately upon the effectiveness of the registration, except for shares purchased by affiliates. See the section titled “Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights” for additional information.
paras.zh: 我们已向部分股东授予 S-1 表格和 S-3 表格的主动请求及附带登记权。根据《证券法》登记这些股份的出售，将使这些股份在登记生效后立即可以根据《证券法》自由交易而不受限制，但关联方购买的股份除外。更多信息请参见“股本说明——登记权”一节。

paras.en: We intend to file with the SEC one or more registration statements on Form S-8 under the Securities Act to register all of the shares of our Class A common stock issuable or issuable and reserved for issuance under the 2016 Plan, the 2026 Plan, and the ESPP. Shares covered by such registration statement will be eligible for sale in the public market, subject to the Rule 144 limitations, vesting restrictions, and the lock-up agreements described above, if applicable.
paras.zh: 我们拟根据《证券法》向 SEC 提交一份或多份 S-8 表格注册声明，以登记根据 2016 年计划、2026 年计划和 ESPP 可发行或可发行并预留供发行的全部 A 类普通股股份。该等注册声明所涵盖的股份将有资格在公开市场出售，但须遵守第 144 条限制、归属限制以及上文所述（如适用）的锁定期协议。

full.sec: Material U.S. Federal Income Tax Consequences to Non-u.s. Holders
full.secZh: 对非美国持有人的重大美国联邦所得税后果

paras.en: The following discussion is a summary of the material U.S. federal income tax consequences to Non-U.S. Holders (as defined below) of the purchase, ownership, and disposition of our Class A common stock issued pursuant to this offering, but does not purport to be a complete analysis of all potential tax effects. The effects of other U.S. federal tax laws, such as estate and gift tax laws, and any applicable state, local, or non-U.S. tax laws are not discussed. This discussion is based on the U.S. Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder, judicial decisions, and published rulings and administrative pronouncements of the U.S. Internal Revenue Service (the “IRS”), in each case in effect as of the date hereof. These authorities may change or be subject to differing interpretations. Any such change or differing interpretation may be applied retroactively in a manner that could adversely affect a Non-U.S. Holder of our Class A common stock. We have not sought and will not seek any rulings from the IRS regarding the matters discussed below. There can be no assurance the IRS or a court will not take a contrary position to that discussed below regarding the tax consequences of the purchase, ownership, and disposition of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 以下讨论是对非美国持有人（定义见下文）依据本次发行获得的 A 类普通股的购买、持有和处置所涉及的重大美国联邦所得税后果的摘要，但并非对所有潜在税务影响的完整分析。其他美国联邦税法（如遗产税和赠与税法）以及任何适用的州、地方或非美国税法的影响未予讨论。本讨论基于经修订的 1986 年《美国国内税收法典》（“法典”）、据此颁布的财政部条例、司法判决以及美国国税局（“IRS”）已公布的裁定和行政公告，且均以本文件日期生效的版本为准。这些权威依据可能发生变化或受到不同解释。任何此类变化或不同解释可能具有追溯力，从而可能对 A 类普通股的非美国持有人产生不利影响。我们未曾且不会就下文讨论的事项向 IRS 寻求任何裁定。无法保证 IRS 或法院不会就 A 类普通股的购买、持有和处置的税务后果采取与下文讨论相反的立场。

paras.en: This discussion is limited to Non-U.S. Holders that hold our Class A common stock as a “capital asset” within the meaning of Section 1221 of the Code (generally, property held for investment). This discussion does not address all U.S. federal income tax consequences relevant to a Non-U.S. Holder’s particular circumstances, including the impact of the Medicare contribution tax on net investment income and the alternative minimum tax. In addition, it does not address consequences relevant to Non-U.S. Holders subject to special rules, including, without limitation:
paras.zh: 本讨论仅限于将 A 类普通股作为《法典》第 1221 条含义内的“资本资产”（一般为持有用于投资的财产）持有的非美国持有人。本讨论并未涉及与非美国持有人特定情况相关的所有美国联邦所得税后果，包括对净投资收入征收的医疗保险附加税以及替代性最低税的影响。此外，本讨论也未涉及适用于受特别规则约束的非美国持有人的相关后果，包括但不限于：

paras.en: - U.S. expatriates and former citizens or long-term residents of the United States;
paras.zh: - 美国侨民以及美国前公民或长期居民；

paras.en: - persons holding our Class A common stock as part of a hedge, straddle, or other risk reduction strategy or as part of a conversion transaction or other integrated investment;
paras.zh: - 作为对冲、跨式或其他风险降低策略的一部分，或作为转换交易或其他综合投资的一部分持有 A 类普通股的人士；

paras.en: - banks, insurance companies, and other financial institutions;
paras.zh: - 银行、保险公司和其他金融机构；

paras.en: - brokers, dealers, or traders in securities;
paras.zh: - 证券经纪商、交易商或交易员；

paras.en: - “controlled foreign corporations,” “foreign controlled foreign corporations,” “passive foreign investment companies,” and corporations that accumulate earnings to avoid U.S. federal income tax;
paras.zh: - “受控外国公司”、“外国控制的受控外国公司”、“被动外国投资公司”，以及为规避美国联邦所得税而累积收益的公司；

paras.en: - partnerships or other entities or arrangements treated as partnerships for U.S. federal income tax purposes (and investors therein);
paras.zh: - 在美国联邦所得税目的下被视为合伙企业的合伙企业或其他实体或安排（及其中的投资者）；

paras.en: - tax-exempt organizations or governmental organizations;
paras.zh: - 免税组织或政府组织；

paras.en: - persons deemed to sell our Class A common stock under the constructive sale provisions of the Code;
paras.zh: - 根据《法典》的推定出售条款被视为出售 A 类普通股的人士；

paras.en: - persons who hold or receive our Class A common stock pursuant to the exercise of any employee stock option or otherwise as compensation;
paras.zh: - 根据任何员工股票期权的行使或以其他方式作为补偿而持有或接收 A 类普通股的人士；

paras.en: - tax-qualified retirement plans; and
paras.zh: - 符合税务条件的退休计划；以及

paras.en: - “qualified foreign pension funds” as defined in Section 897(l)(2) of the Code and entities all of the interests of which are held by qualified foreign pension funds.
paras.zh: - 符合《税法》第 897(l)(2) 条定义的“合格外国养老基金”，以及全部权益均由合格外国养老基金持有的实体。

paras.en: If an entity treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes holds our Class A common stock, the tax treatment of a partner in the partnership will depend on the status of the partner, the activities of the partnership, and certain determinations made at the partner level. Accordingly, partnerships holding our Class A common stock and the partners in such partnerships should consult their tax advisors regarding the U.S. federal income tax consequences to them.
paras.zh: 若某一实体在美国联邦所得税目的下被视为合伙企业并持有我们的 A 类普通股，则该合伙企业中合伙人的税务处理将取决于该合伙人的身份、合伙企业的活动以及在合伙人层面作出的某些认定。因此，持有我们 A 类普通股的合伙企业及其合伙人应就其美国联邦所得税后果咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: **THIS DISCUSSION IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY AND IS NOT TAX ADVICE.**
paras.zh: **本讨论仅供参考，不构成税务建议。**

full.sec: Investors Should Consult Their Tax Advisors with Respect to the Application OF THE U.S. FEDERAL INCOME TAX LAWS TO THEIR PARTICULAR SITUATIONS AS WELL AS ANY TAX CONSEQUENCES OF THE PURCHASE, OWNERSHIP, AND DISPOSITION OF OUR CLASS A COMMON STOCK ARISING UNDER THE U.S. FEDERAL ESTATE OR GIFT TAX LAWS OR UNDER THE LAWS OF ANY STATE, LOCAL, OR NON-U.S. TAXING JURISDICTION OR UNDER
full.secZh: 投资者应就其特定情况下的美国联邦所得税法适用问题，以及购买、持有和处置我们的 A 类普通股在美国联邦遗产税或赠与税法下、或在任何州、地方或非美国征税管辖区法律下、或在……下产生的任何税务后果，咨询其税务顾问

paras.en: **ANY APPLICABLE INCOME TAX TREATY.**
paras.zh: **任何适用的所得税协定。**

paras.en: For purposes of this discussion, a “Non-U.S. Holder” is any beneficial owner of our Class A common stock that is neither a “U.S. person” nor an entity treated as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes. A U.S. person is any person that, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, is or is treated as any of the following:
paras.zh: 就本讨论而言，“非美国持有人”指不属于“美国人”、且就美国联邦所得税目的不被视为合伙企业的我们 A 类普通股的任何受益所有人。美国人指就美国联邦所得税目的属于或被视为下列任何情形的人：

paras.en: - an individual who is a citizen or resident of the United States;
paras.zh: - 美国公民或居民的个人；

paras.en: - a corporation created or organized under the laws of the United States, any state thereof, or the District of Columbia;
paras.zh: - 根据美国、美国任何州或哥伦比亚特区法律设立或组织的公司；

paras.en: - an estate, the income of which is subject to U.S. federal income tax regardless of its source; or
paras.zh: - 其收入无论来源如何均须缴纳美国联邦所得税的遗产；或

paras.en: - a trust that (i) is subject to the primary supervision of a U.S. court and all substantial decisions of which are subject to the control of one or more “United States persons” (within the meaning of Section 7701(a)(30) of the Code), or (ii) has a valid election in effect to be treated as a United States person for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
paras.zh: - 符合下列条件的信托：(i) 受美国法院的主要监督，且其所有实质性决定均受一名或多名“美国人”(按《税法》第 7701(a)(30) 条的含义)控制；或 (ii) 已作出有效选择，就美国联邦所得税目的被视为美国人。

paras.en: As described in the section titled “Dividend Policy,” we do not anticipate declaring or paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future. However, if we do make distributions of cash or property on our Class A common stock, such distributions will constitute dividends for U.S. federal income tax purposes to the extent paid from our current or accumulated earnings and profits, as determined under U.S. federal income tax principles. Amounts not treated as dividends for U.S. federal income tax purposes will constitute a return of capital and first be applied against and reduce a Non-U.S. Holder’s adjusted tax basis in its Class A common stock, but not below zero. Any excess will be treated as capital gain and will be treated as described under the subsection titled “—Sale or Other Taxable Disposition” below.
paras.zh: 如“股息政策”一节所述，我们预计在可预见的未来不会宣布或支付任何现金股息。但是，如果我们确实就我们的 A 类普通股进行现金或财产分配，则该等分配在美国联邦所得税目的下将构成股息，但以从我们根据美国联邦所得税原则确定的当期或累计收益和利润中支付的部分为限。在美国联邦所得税目的下不被视为股息的金额将构成资本返还，并首先用于冲抵并减少非美国持有人在其 A 类普通股中的调整后计税基础，但不得低于零。任何超出部分将被视为资本利得，并按下文“—出售或其他应税处置”小节所述处理。

paras.en: Subject to the discussion below regarding effectively connected income, dividends paid to a Non-U.S. Holder will be subject to U.S. federal withholding tax at a rate of 30% of the gross amount of the dividends (or such lower rate specified by an applicable income tax treaty, provided the Non-U.S. Holder furnishes a valid IRS Form W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E (or other applicable documentation) certifying qualification for the lower treaty rate). A Non-U.S. Holder that does not timely furnish the required documentation, but that qualifies for a reduced treaty rate, may obtain a refund of any excess amounts withheld by timely filing an appropriate claim for refund with the IRS. Non-U.S. Holders should consult their tax advisors regarding their entitlement to benefits under any applicable tax treaties.
paras.zh: 在受下文关于有效关联收入的讨论约束的前提下，向非美国持有人支付的股息将按股息总额的 30%（或适用的所得税条约规定的较低税率，前提是该非美国持有人提供有效的 IRS Form W-8BEN 或 W-8BEN-E（或其他适用文件），证明其符合享受较低条约税率的资格）缴纳美国联邦预扣税。未及时提供所需文件但符合享受较低条约税率资格的非美国持有人，可通过及时向 IRS 提交适当的退税申请，获得任何超额预扣金额的退款。非美国持有人应就其是否有权享受任何适用税收条约下的优惠咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: If dividends paid to a Non-U.S. Holder are effectively connected with the Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, the Non-U.S. Holder maintains a permanent establishment in the United States to which such dividends are attributable), the Non-U.S. Holder will be exempt from the U.S. federal withholding tax described above. To claim the exemption, the Non-U.S. Holder must furnish to the applicable withholding agent a valid IRS Form W-8ECI, certifying that the dividends are effectively connected with the Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States.
paras.zh: 如果向非美国持有人支付的股息与该非美国持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务有效关联（并且，如果适用的所得税条约要求，该非美国持有人在美国维持该等股息所归属的常设机构），则该非美国持有人将免于缴纳上述美国联邦预扣税。为申请该豁免，非美国持有人必须向适用的预扣代理人提供有效的 IRS Form W-8ECI，证明该等股息与该非美国持有人在美国境内开展贸易或业务有效关联。

paras.en: Any such effectively connected dividends will be subject to U.S. federal income tax on a net income basis at the regular rates applicable to U.S. persons. A Non-U.S. Holder that is a corporation also may be subject to a branch profits tax at a rate of 30% (or such lower rate specified by an applicable income tax treaty) on such effectively connected dividends, as adjusted for certain items. Non-U.S. Holders should consult their tax advisors regarding any applicable tax treaties that may provide for different rules.
paras.zh: 任何该等有效关联股息将按适用于美国人的常规税率，以净收入为基础缴纳美国联邦所得税。作为公司的非美国持有人还可能须就该等有效关联股息缴纳税率为 30%（或适用的所得税条约规定的较低税率）的分支利润税，并针对某些项目进行调整。非美国持有人应就其可能规定不同规则的任何适用税收条约咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: A Non-U.S. Holder will not be subject to U.S. federal income tax on any gain realized upon the sale or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock unless:
paras.zh: 非美国持有人就出售或以其他方式应税处置我们的 A 类普通股所实现的任何收益，无需缴纳美国联邦所得税，除非：

paras.en: - the gain is effectively connected with the Non-U.S. Holder’s conduct of a trade or business within the United States (and, if required by an applicable income tax treaty, the Non-U.S. Holder maintains a permanent establishment in the United States to which such gain is attributable);
paras.zh: - 该收益与非美国持有人在美国境内开展的贸易或业务存在实际关联（且若适用所得税条约有要求，该非美国持有人在美国设有可归属于该收益的常设机构）;

paras.en: - the Non-U.S. Holder is a nonresident alien individual present in the United States for 183 days or more during the taxable year of the disposition and certain other requirements are met; or
paras.zh: - 该非美国持有人为在处置所在纳税年度内在美国停留 183 天或以上的非居民外籍个人，且满足某些其他要求；或

paras.en: - our Class A common stock constitutes a U.S. real property interest (“USRPI”) by reason of our status as a U.S. real property holding corporation (“USRPHC”) for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
paras.zh: - 由于我们在美国联邦所得税目的下属于美国不动产控股公司（"USRPHC"），我们的 A 类普通股构成美国不动产权益（"USRPI"）。

paras.en: Gain described in the first bullet point above generally will be subject to U.S. federal income tax on a net income basis at the regular rates applicable to U.S. persons. A Non-U.S. Holder that is a corporation also may be subject to a branch profits tax at a rate of 30% (or such lower rate specified by an applicable income tax treaty) on such effectively connected gain, as adjusted for certain items.
paras.zh: 上述第一项要点所述收益，一般将按适用于美国人的常规税率，以净收入为基础缴纳美国联邦所得税。作为公司的非美国持有人，还可能就该实际关联收益按 30%的税率（或适用所得税条约规定的较低税率）缴纳分支机构利润税，并针对某些项目进行调整。

paras.en: A Non-U.S. Holder described in the second bullet point above will be subject to U.S. federal income tax at a rate of 30% (or such lower rate specified by an applicable income tax treaty) on gain realized upon the sale or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock, which may be offset by certain U.S. source capital losses of the Non-U.S. Holder (even though the individual is not considered a resident of the United States), provided the Non-U.S. Holder has timely filed U.S. federal income tax returns with respect to such losses.
paras.zh: 上述第二项要点所述的非美国持有人，就出售或以其他方式应税处置我们的 A 类普通股所实现的收益，将按 30%的税率（或适用所得税条约规定的较低税率）缴纳美国联邦所得税，该收益可用该非美国持有人的某些美国来源资本损失予以抵减（即使该个人不被视为美国居民），前提是该非美国持有人已就此类损失及时申报美国联邦所得税申报表。

paras.en: With respect to the third bullet point above, we believe we currently are not, and do not anticipate becoming, a USRPHC. Because the determination of whether we are a USRPHC depends, however, on the fair market value of our USRPIs relative to the fair market value of our non-U.S. real property interests and our other business assets, there can be no assurance we currently are not a USRPHC or will not become one in the future. Even if we are or were to become a USRPHC, gain arising from the sale or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock by a Non-U.S. Holder will not be subject to U.S. federal income tax if our Class A common stock is “regularly traded,” as defined by applicable Treasury Regulations, on an established securities market, and such Non-U.S. Holder owned, actually and constructively, 5% or less of our Class A common stock throughout the shorter of the five-year period ending on the date of the sale or other taxable disposition or the Non-U.S. Holder’s holding period.
paras.zh: 关于上述第三项要点，我们认为我们目前不是、且预计不会成为 USRPHC。然而，由于我们是否为 USRPHC 取决于我们的 USRPI 的公允市场价值相对于我们的非美国不动产权益及其他业务资产的公允市场价值，因此无法保证我们目前不是 USRPHC 或将来不会成为 USRPHC。即使我们目前是或将来成为 USRPHC，只要我们的 A 类普通股在成熟证券市场上“定期交易”（按适用财政部条例的定义），且该非美国持有人在截至出售或其他应税处置之日止的五年期间与该非美国持有人持有期中较短者的整个期间内，实际和推定拥有的我们的 A 类普通股不超过 5%，则非美国持有人出售或以其他方式应税处置我们的 A 类普通股所产生的收益将无需缴纳美国联邦所得税。

paras.en: Non-U.S. Holders should consult their tax advisors regarding any applicable tax treaties that may provide for different rules.
paras.zh: 非美国持有人应就其可能规定不同规则的任何适用税收条约咨询其税务顾问。

full.secZh: 信息申报与备用预扣税

paras.en: Payments of dividends on our Class A common stock will not be subject to backup withholding, provided the Non-U.S. Holder certifies its non-U.S. status, such as by furnishing a valid IRS Form W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E or W-8ECI, or otherwise establishes an exemption. However, information returns are required to be filed with the IRS in connection with any distributions on our Class A common stock paid to the Non-U.S. Holder, regardless of whether such distributions constitute dividends or whether any tax was actually withheld. In addition, proceeds of the sale or other taxable disposition of our Class A common stock within the United States or conducted through certain U.S.-related brokers generally will not be subject to backup withholding or information reporting if the applicable withholding agent receives the certification described above or the Non-U.S. Holder otherwise establishes an exemption. Proceeds of a disposition of our Class A common stock conducted through a non-U.S. office of a non-U.S. broker that does not have certain enumerated relationships with the United States generally will not be subject to backup withholding or information reporting.
paras.zh: 只要非美国持有人证明其非美国身份（例如提供有效的 IRS W-8BEN、W-8BEN-E 或 W-8ECI 表格），或以其他方式确立豁免，我们 A 类普通股的股息支付将不受备用预扣税约束。但是，无论该等分配是否构成股息，也无论是否实际预扣任何税款，向非美国持有人支付的我们 A 类普通股的任何分配均须向 IRS 提交信息申报表。此外，如果适用的预扣代理人收到上述证明，或非美国持有人以其他方式确立豁免，则在美国境内或通过某些与美国相关的经纪商进行的我们 A 类普通股出售或其他应税处置的所得款项，通常不受备用预扣税或信息申报的约束。通过非美国经纪商的非美国办事处进行的我们 A 类普通股处置所得款项，如果该非美国经纪商与美国不存在某些列举的关系，通常不受备用预扣税或信息申报的约束。

paras.en: Copies of information returns that are filed with the IRS may also be made available under the provisions of an applicable treaty or agreement to the tax authorities of the country in which the Non-U.S. Holder resides or is established.
paras.zh: 向 IRS 提交的信息申报表副本，也可能根据适用的条约或协定的规定，提供给非美国持有人居住或设立所在国家的税务机关。

paras.en: Backup withholding is not an additional tax. Any amounts withheld under the backup withholding rules may be allowed as a refund or a credit against a Non-U.S. Holder’s U.S. federal income tax liability, provided the required information is timely furnished to the IRS.
paras.zh: 备用预扣税不是额外税款。根据备用预扣税规则预扣的任何金额，只要及时向 IRS 提供所需信息，均可作为退款或抵免非美国持有人的美国联邦所得税负债。

full.sec: Additional Withholding Tax on Payments Made to Foreign Accounts
full.secZh: 向外国账户付款的额外预扣税

paras.en: Withholding taxes may be imposed under Sections 1471 to 1474 of the Code (such Sections commonly referred to as the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (“FATCA”)) on certain types of payments made to non-U.S. financial institutions and certain other non-U.S. entities. Specifically, a 30% withholding tax may be imposed on dividends on, or (subject to the proposed Treasury Regulations discussed below) gross proceeds from the sale or other disposition of, our Class A common stock paid to a “foreign financial institution” or a “non-financial foreign entity” (each as defined in the Code), unless (i) the foreign financial institution undertakes certain diligence and reporting obligations, (ii) the non-financial foreign entity either certifies it does not have any “substantial United States owners” (as defined in the Code) or furnishes identifying information regarding each substantial United States owner, or (iii) the foreign financial institution or non-financial foreign entity otherwise qualifies for an exemption from these rules. If the payee is a foreign financial institution and is subject to the diligence and reporting requirements in (i) above, it must enter into an agreement with the U.S. Department of the Treasury requiring, among other things, that it undertake to identify accounts held by certain “specified United States persons” or “United States owned foreign entities” (each as defined in the Code), annually report certain information about such accounts, and withhold 30% on certain payments to non-compliant foreign financial institutions and certain other account holders. Foreign financial institutions located in jurisdictions that have an intergovernmental agreement with the United States governing FATCA may be subject to different rules.
paras.zh: 根据《税法》第 1471 条至第 1474 条(该等条款通常称为《外国账户税收合规法案》（“FATCA”）)，对向非美国金融机构及某些其他非美国实体支付的某些类型款项可能征收预提税。具体而言，就向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息，或（在受下述拟议财政部条例约束的前提下）出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入，若支付给“外国金融机构”或“非金融外国实体”（《税法》所定义），可能被征收 30%的预提税，除非(i)该外国金融机构承担某些尽职调查和报告义务，(ii)该非金融外国实体证明其没有任何“美国实质性所有人”（《税法》所定义）或提供每一美国实质性所有人的身份信息，或(iii)该外国金融机构或非金融外国实体另行符合上述规则的豁免条件。如果收款人是外国金融机构且须遵守上述(i)中的尽职调查和报告要求，则其必须与美国财政部签订协议，要求其除其他事项外承诺识别由某些“特定美国人”或“美国拥有的外国实体”（《税法》所定义）持有的账户，每年报告有关该等账户的某些信息，并对向不合规的外国金融机构及某些其他账户持有人支付的某些款项预提 30%。位于与美国签有政府间协议以规范 FATCA 的司法管辖区的外国金融机构可能适用不同的规则。

paras.en: Under applicable Treasury Regulations and administrative guidance, withholding under FATCA generally applies to payments of dividends on our Class A common stock. While withholding under FATCA would have applied also to payments of gross proceeds from the sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock beginning on January 1, 2019, proposed Treasury Regulations eliminate FATCA withholding on payments of gross proceeds entirely. Taxpayers generally may rely on these proposed Treasury Regulations until final Treasury Regulations are issued.
paras.zh: 根据适用的财政部条例和行政指引，FATCA 项下的预提通常适用于向我们 A 类普通股支付的股息。尽管自 2019 年 1 月 1 日起，FATCA 项下的预提原本也将适用于出售或以其他方式处置我们 A 类普通股所得的毛收入款项，但拟议的财政部条例完全取消了针对毛收入款项的 FATCA 预提。在最终财政部条例发布之前，纳税人通常可以依赖该等拟议的财政部条例。

paras.en: Prospective investors should consult their tax advisors regarding the potential application of withholding under FATCA to their investment in our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 潜在投资者应就其对我们 A 类普通股的投资可能适用 FATCA 项下预提的问题咨询其税务顾问。

paras.en: The underwriters and the representatives are collectively referred to as the “underwriters” and the “representatives,” respectively. The underwriters are offering the shares of Class A common stock subject to their acceptance of the shares from us, and subject to prior sale. The underwriting agreement provides that the obligations of the several underwriters to pay for and accept delivery of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus are subject to the approval of certain legal matters by their counsel and to certain other conditions. The underwriters are obligated to take and pay for all of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus if any such shares are taken. However, the underwriters are not required to take or pay for the shares covered by the underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares described below.
paras.zh: 承销商与代表分别统称为“承销商”和“代表”。承销商发售 A 类普通股股份，须以其向我们承接该等股份为前提，并须以先行售出为前提。承销协议规定，各承销商支付并接受本招股说明书所发售 A 类普通股股份交付的义务，须经其法律顾问对若干法律事项的批准并满足若干其他条件。若承销商承接本招股说明书所发售的任何 A 类普通股股份，则有义务承接并支付全部该等股份。但是，承销商无须承接或支付下文所述承销商超额配售选择权所涵盖的股份。

paras.en: The underwriters initially propose to offer part of the shares of Class A common stock directly to the public at the offering price listed on the cover page of this prospectus and part to certain dealers at a price that represents a concession not in excess of $2.6085 per share under the public offering price. After the initial offering of the shares of Class A common stock, the offering price and other selling terms may from time to time be varied by the representatives. Sales of any shares of Class A common stock made outside of the United States may be made by affiliates of the underwriters.
paras.zh: 承销商初步拟按本招股说明书封面所列的发售价格向公众直接发售部分 A 类普通股股份，并按不高于公开发售价格每股 $2.6085 的折让价向若干交易商发售部分股份。在 A 类普通股股份的首次发售后，代表可不时变更发售价格及其他销售条款。在美国境外进行的任何 A 类普通股股份销售可由承销商的关联方进行。

paras.en: We have granted the underwriters an option, exercisable for 30 days from the date of this prospectus, to purchase up to 4,500,000 additional shares of Class A common stock from us at the public offering price listed on the cover page of this prospectus, less the underwriting discounts and commissions. The underwriters may exercise this option solely for the purpose of covering over-allotments, if any, made in connection with the offering of the shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus. To the extent the option is exercised, each underwriter will become obligated, subject to certain conditions, to purchase about the same percentage of the additional shares of Class A common stock as the number listed next to the underwriter’s name in the preceding table bears to the total number of shares of Class A common stock listed next to the names of all underwriters in the preceding table.
paras.zh: 我们已授予承销商一项期权，自本招股说明书之日起 30 天内可行使，按本招股说明书封面所列公开发行价格（扣除承销折扣和佣金）向我们额外购买最多 4,500,000 股 A 类普通股。承销商行使该期权仅用于覆盖与本招股说明书所发售 A 类普通股相关的超额配售（如有）。在期权被行使的范围内，各承销商将有义务（受某些条件约束）按其名称在前表中对应的 A 类普通股数量占前表中所有承销商名称对应的 A 类普通股总数的比例，购买大致相同比例的额外 A 类普通股。

These amounts are shown assuming both no exercise and full exercise of the underwriters’ option to purchase up to an additional 4,500,000 shares of Class A common stock from us.

paras.en: The underwriters have informed us that they do not intend sales to discretionary accounts to exceed 5% of the total number of shares of Class A common stock offered by them.
paras.zh: 承销商已告知我们，其不打算向全权委托账户的销售超过其发售的 A 类普通股总数的 5%。

paras.en: We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “CBRS.”
paras.zh: 我们已获准将我们的 A 类普通股在纳斯达克全球精选市场（Nasdaq Global Select Market）上市，股票代码为“CBRS”。

paras.en: In connection with this offering, we, our executive officers and directors, and certain other record holders that together represent approximately 71.4% of our Class A common stock, stock options, and other securities convertible into, exercisable, or exchangeable for our Class A common stock have entered into lock-up agreements with the underwriters pursuant to which we and they have agreed to not, among other things and subject to certain exceptions, offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, or otherwise dispose of, (or enter into any transaction which is designed to, or might reasonably be expected to, result in the disposition (whether by actual disposition or effective economic disposition due to cash settlement or otherwise) any shares of Class A common stock or securities convertible into or exchangeable for shares of our Class A common stock during the period from the date of this prospectus continuing through the earlier of (i) 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day following our release of earnings for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 or (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus (the “Lock-up Period”).
paras.zh: 就本次发行而言，我们、我们的高级管理人员和董事，以及合计持有约 71.4% 的 A 类普通股、股票期权及可转换为、可行使或可交换为 A 类普通股的其他证券的若干其他登记持有人，已与承销商签订锁定期协议。根据该等协议，除若干例外情形外，我们及上述各方已同意，自本招股说明书之日起至下列较早者为止的期间内（即“锁定期”）：(i) 我们发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩后的第二个交易日东部时间上午 6:00，或 (ii) 本招股说明书日期后 180 天，不进行下列行为（其中包括）：要约、出售、订立出售合同、质押或以其他方式处置（或订立任何旨在、或合理预期将导致处置（无论是实际处置，还是因现金结算或其他原因而产生的有效经济处置）任何 A 类普通股或可转换为或可交换为 A 类普通股的证券的交易）。

paras.en: Furthermore, (i) an additional approximately 4.9% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to the market standoff provisions in our amended and restated investors’ rights agreement, pursuant to which such holders agreed to not lend, offer, pledge, sell, contract to sell, sell any option or contract to purchase, purchase any option or contract to sell, grant any option, right, or warrant to purchase, or otherwise transfer or dispose of, directly or indirectly, any shares of our Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for our Class A common stock held immediately prior to the effectiveness of this registration statement, or enter into any swap or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of such securities during the Lock-up Period and (ii) an additional approximately 23.7% of our outstanding Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to restrictions contained in market standoff agreements with us that include restrictions on the sale, transfer, or other disposition of shares during the Lock-up Period. The forms and specific restrictive provisions within these market standoff provisions vary among security holders. For example, although some of these market standoff provisions do not specifically restrict hedging transactions and others may be subject to different interpretations between us and security holders as to whether they restrict hedging, our insider trading policy prohibits hedging by all of our current directors, officers, employees, contractors, and consultants. Sales, short sales, or hedging transactions involving our equity securities, whether before or after this offering and whether or not we believe them to be prohibited, could adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 此外，(i) 我们已发行 A 类普通股中另有约 4.9% 的股份，以及可直接或间接转换为、交换为或行使为我们的 A 类普通股的证券，受我们经修订并重述的投资者权利协议中市场禁售条款的约束；根据该条款，该等持有人同意，在本注册声明生效前立即持有的任何 A 类普通股股份或可转换为、可行使为或可交换为我们的 A 类普通股的任何证券，在锁定期内不得出借、要约、质押、出售、签订出售合同、出售任何期权或购买合同、购买任何期权或出售合同、授予任何购买期权、权利或认股权证，或以其他方式直接或间接转让或处置，亦不得订立任何互换或其他安排，将此类证券所有权的任何经济后果全部或部分转移给他人；并且 (ii) 我们已发行 A 类普通股中另有约 23.7% 的股份，以及可直接或间接转换为、交换为或行使为我们的 A 类普通股的证券，受与我们签订的市场禁售协议中所含限制的约束，该等限制包括在锁定期内对股份出售、转让或其他处置的限制。这些市场禁售条款的形式和具体限制性规定因证券持有人而异。例如，尽管其中部分市场禁售条款并未明确限制对冲交易，且其他条款在我们与证券持有人之间就可能是否限制对冲存在不同解释，但我们的内幕交易政策禁止我们所有现任董事、高级管理人员、员工、承包商和顾问进行对冲。涉及我们股权证券的出售、卖空或对冲交易，无论发生在本次发行之前还是之后，也无论我们是否认为其被禁止，均可能对我们 A 类普通股的价格产生不利影响。

paras.en: As a result of the foregoing, substantially all of our outstanding shares of Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock are subject to a lock-up agreement or market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period. We have agreed to enforce all such market standoff restrictions on behalf of the underwriters and not to amend or waive any such market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period without the prior consent of Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Citigroup Global Markets Inc., and Barclays Capital Inc., on behalf of the underwriters, provided that we may release shares from such restrictions to the extent such shares would be entitled to release under the form of lock-up agreement with the underwriters signed by our directors and executive officers and certain other record holders of our securities as described herein.
paras.zh: 鉴于上述情况，我们已发行的 A 类普通股股份以及可直接或间接转换为、交换为或行使为我们的 A 类普通股的证券中，绝大部分在锁定期内均受锁定期协议或市场禁售条款的约束。我们已同意代表承销商执行所有该等市场禁售限制，并且未经 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC、Citigroup Global Markets Inc. 和 Barclays Capital Inc.（代表承销商）事先同意，我们不会在锁定期内修订或豁免任何该等市场禁售条款；但前提是，如果根据我们的董事和高级管理人员以及本文所述我们证券的某些其他登记持有人与承销商签署的锁定期协议格式，相关股份有权解除限制，我们可解除该等股份的上述限制。

paras.en: Notwithstanding the foregoing, and in each case, subject to the provisions of Rule 144 and Rule 701 under the Securities Act and our insider trading compliance policy, as applicable:
paras.zh: 尽管有上述规定，且在每种情况下均须遵守《证券法》第 144 条和第 701 条的规定以及我们的内幕交易合规政策（如适用）:

paras.en: (i) 7.5% of the Eligible Securities held by Non-Executive Employees will be released beginning at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the First Trading Day;
paras.zh: (i) 非高管员工持有的合格证券的 7.5% 将于首个交易日上午 6:00（美国东部时间）起解除限售；

paras.en: (ii) if the Second Trading Day Release Trigger is satisfied, 7.5% of the Eligible Securities held by Non-Executive Employees will be released beginning at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day on which our Class A common stock is traded on Nasdaq;
paras.zh: (ii) 若第二个交易日解除限售触发条件得到满足，非高管员工持有的合格证券的 7.5% 将于我们的 A 类普通股在纳斯达克交易的第二个交易日上午 6:00（美国东部时间）起解除限售；

paras.en: (iii) at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day after we publicly announce earnings for the quarter ended March 31, 2026,
paras.zh: (iii) 在我们公开公布截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止季度业绩后的第二个交易日上午 6:00（美国东部时间）,

paras.en: (A) if the Second Trading Day Release Trigger is satisfied:
paras.zh: (A) 若第二个交易日解除限售触发条件得到满足：

paras.en: - 15% of the Eligible Securities held by Directors and Officers; and
paras.zh: - 董事及高管持有的合格证券的 15%；以及

paras.en: - 15% of the Eligible Securities held by the Non-Employee Holders
paras.zh: - 非员工持有人持有的合格证券的 15%

paras.en: will be released; or,
paras.zh: 将解除限售；或，

paras.en: (B) if the Second Trading Day Release Trigger is not satisfied:
paras.zh: (B) 若第二个交易日解除限售触发条件未得到满足：

paras.en: - 15% of the Eligible Securities held by Directors and Officers;
paras.zh: - 董事及高管持有的合格证券的 15%;

paras.en: - 7.5% of the Eligible Securities held by Non-Executive Employees; and
paras.zh: - 非高管员工持有的合格证券的 7.5%；以及

paras.en: - 15% of the Eligible Securities held by the Non-Employee Holders
paras.zh: - 非员工持有人持有的合格证券的 15%

paras.en: will be released;
paras.zh: 将解除限售；

paras.en: (iv) 16.7% of the Eligible Securities held by each of the Directors and Officers, Non-Executive Employees, and Non-Employee Holders will be released at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day after we publicly announce earnings for the quarter ending June 30, 2026;
paras.zh: (iv) 董事及高管、非高管员工和非员工持有人各自持有的合格证券中的 16.7% 将于我们公开公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度财报后的第二个交易日美国东部时间上午 6:00 解除锁定；

paras.en: (v) 6.7% of the Eligible Securities held by each of the Directors and Officers, Non-Executive Employees, and Non-Employee Holders will be released at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on each of:
paras.zh: (v) 董事及高管、非高管员工和非员工持有人各自持有的合格证券中的 6.7% 将于下列各日美国东部时间上午 6:00 解除锁定：

paras.en: - August 19, 2026;
- September 2, 2026; and

- September 16, 2026; and (vi) 8.9% of the Eligible Securities held by each of the Directors and Officers, Non-Executive Employees, and Non-Employee Holders will be released at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on each of:
paras.zh: - 2026 年 9 月 16 日；及 (vi) 董事及高管、非高管员工和非员工持有人各自持有的合格证券中的 8.9% 将于下列各日美国东部时间上午 6:00 解除锁定：

paras.en: - September 30, 2026;
- October 14, 2026; and
- October 28, 2026.
As used herein,
paras.zh: 本文件所用术语：

paras.en: - “Directors and Officers” means our directors and officers subject to reporting under Section 16 of the Exchange Act during the Lock-up Period.
paras.zh: - “董事及高管”指在锁定期内须根据《交易法》第 16 条履行报告义务的我们的董事及高管。

paras.en: - “Non-Executive Employees” means our employees as of March 31, 2026, who are not Directors and Officers.
paras.zh: - “非高管员工”指截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日不属于董事及高管的我们的员工。

paras.en: - “Non-Employee Holders” means holders of our capital stock, and securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for shares of our capital stock, who are not Directors and Officers or Non-Executive Employees.
paras.zh: - “非员工持有人”指不属于董事及高管或非高管员工的我们的股本以及可转换为或可行使或可交换为我们的股本股份的证券的持有人。

paras.en: - “Eligible Securities” means vested shares of our Class A common stock and securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock held by the Directors and Officers, Non-Executive Employees, and Non-Employee Holders as of April 30, 2026. Eligible Securities also include equity awards (including stock options and RSUs) granted prior to April 30, 2026 to Directors and Officers and Non-Executive Employees for which the service-based vesting condition will be satisfied as of November 9, 2026.
paras.zh: - “合格证券”指截至 2026 年 4 月 30 日由董事和高级管理人员、非高管员工及非员工持有人持有的、已归属的 A 类普通股股份，以及可直接或间接转换为 A 类普通股或可交换或可行使为 A 类普通股的证券。合格证券还包括在 2026 年 4 月 30 日之前授予董事和高级管理人员及非高管员工的股权奖励（包括股票期权和 RSU），且该等奖励的服务期归属条件将于 2026 年 11 月 9 日满足。

paras.en: Furthermore, pursuant to certain exceptions to the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions as described below, certain shares of our Class A common stock will be eligible for sale in the open market during the Lock-up Period in sell-to-cover transactions in order to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the settlement of RSUs. Pursuant to such exceptions, we estimate up to an aggregate of (i) 0.2 million shares and (ii) 0.4 million shares may be sold in the open market on or around June 24, 2026 and August 18, 2026, respectively (representing quarterly vesting of service-based RSUs), in connection with such tax withholding obligations (based on an assumed 46.9% tax withholding rate). In addition, certain exceptions to the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions permit holders of stock options to sell shares of our Class A common stock on the open market to cover the tax obligations or payments due in connection with the exercise of such options. As of April 30, 2026, there were an aggregate of approximately 21.5 million vested stock options outstanding.
paras.zh: 此外，根据下文所述锁定期协议和禁售条款的若干例外情形，部分 A 类普通股股份将有资格在锁定期内通过卖出补足（sell-to-cover）交易在公开市场出售，以满足与 RSU 结算相关的代扣税义务。根据该等例外情形，我们估计，在与该等代扣税义务相关的交易中（基于假设的 46.9% 代扣税率），最多合计 (i) 0.2 百万股和 (ii) 0.4 百万股可分别于 2026 年 6 月 24 日前后和 2026 年 8 月 18 日前后在公开市场出售（对应服务期 RSU 的按季归属）。此外，锁定期协议和禁售条款的若干例外情形允许股票期权持有人为支付与行使该等期权相关的到期税款或款项而在公开市场出售其 A 类普通股股份。截至 2026 年 4 月 30 日，已归属的未行权股票期权合计约 21.5 百万份。

paras.en: Without limiting the above, the restrictions imposed by the lock-up agreements and market standoff provisions during the Lock-up Period are subject to certain additional exceptions, including with respect to:
paras.zh: 在不限制上述规定的前提下，锁定期内锁定期协议和禁售条款所施加的限制还受若干额外例外情形的约束，包括就以下事项而言：

paras.en: (i) any sales of our Class A common stock to the underwriters pursuant to the underwriting agreement to be entered into in connection with this offering;
paras.zh: (i) 根据与本发行相关的将订立的承销协议向承销商出售的任何 A 类普通股股份；

paras.en: (ii) transfers (A) as a bona fide gift or gifts (including contributions to a charitable organization or educational institution) or (B) for bona fide estate or tax planning purposes (including contributions to a family foundation);
paras.zh: (ii) (A) 作为善意赠与（包括向慈善组织或教育机构捐赠）或 (B) 出于善意遗产或税务规划目的（包括向家族基金会捐赠）的转让；

paras.en: (iii) transfers by will, other testamentary document, or intestacy;
paras.zh: (iii) 通过遗嘱、其他遗嘱文件或无遗嘱继承进行的转让；

paras.en: (iv) transfers to any trust for the direct or indirect benefit of the lock-up party or the immediate family of the lock-up party, or if the lock-up party is a trust, to a trustor or beneficiary of the trust or to the estate of a beneficiary of such trust;
paras.zh: (iv) 向为锁定期一方或其直系亲属直接或间接利益设立的任何信托进行的转让，或若锁定期一方为信托，则向该信托的委托人、受益人或该信托受益人的遗产进行的转让；

paras.en: (v) transfers to a partnership, limited liability company, or other entity of which the lock-up party and/or the immediate family of the lock-up party are the legal and/or beneficial owner of all of the outstanding equity securities or similar interests;
paras.zh: (v) 向锁定期一方和/或其直系亲属为全部已发行股权证券或类似权益的法定和/或实益拥有人的合伙企业、有限责任公司或其他实体进行的转让；

paras.en: (vi) transfers to a nominee, custodian or trustee of a person or entity to whom a disposition or transfer would be permissible under clauses (ii) through (v) above;
paras.zh: (vi) 向根据上文第 (ii) 至 (v) 项允许进行处置或转让的人士或实体的名义持有人、托管人或受托人进行的转让；

paras.en: (vii)transactions relating to shares of Class A common stock acquired by the lock-up party in this offering or in open market transactions after the closing date of this offering;
paras.zh: (vii) 与锁定期一方在本发行中或在本发行交割日之后的公开市场交易中取得的 A 类普通股股份相关的交易；

paras.en: (viii) if the lock-up party is a corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other business entity, (A) transfers to another corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, or other business entity that is an affiliate (as defined in Rule 405 promulgated under the Securities Act) of the lock-up party, or to any investment fund or other entity controlling, controlled by, managing, or managed by or under common control with the lock-up party or affiliates of the lock-up party (including, for the avoidance of doubt, where the lock-up party is a partnership, to its general partner or a successor partnership or fund, or any other funds managed by such partnership), or (B) transfers as part of a distribution to members, partners, shareholders, or other equity-holders of the lock-up party;
paras.zh: (viii) 若锁定期一方为公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体，(A) 向该锁定期一方的关联方（按《证券法》第 405 条规则的定义）的另一公司、合伙企业、有限责任公司、信托或其他商业实体转让，或向控制该锁定期一方、受该锁定期一方控制、与该锁定期一方共同管理或受其管理、或与该锁定期一方或其关联方处于共同控制之下的任何投资基金或其他实体转让（为免疑义，包括在锁定期一方为合伙企业时，向其普通合伙人或承继合伙企业或基金，或由该合伙企业管理的任何其他基金转让），或 (B) 作为向该锁定期一方的成员、合伙人、股东或其他权益持有人进行分配的一部分而转让；

paras.en: (ix) transfers by operation of law, such as pursuant to a qualified domestic order, divorce settlement, divorce decree, separation agreement or other court order;
paras.zh: (ix) 依法律实施的转让，例如依据适格家庭关系令、离婚和解协议、离婚判决、分居协议或其他法院命令进行的转让；

paras.en: (x) transfers to us from a service provider of the Company upon death, disability or termination of services, in each case, of such service provider;
paras.zh: (x) 公司服务提供者在其死亡、丧失劳动能力或服务终止时向本公司进行的转让（在每种情况下均指该服务提供者）；

paras.en: (xi) transfers to us in connection with the vesting, exercise, or settlement of options, warrants, RSUs, or other rights to purchase shares of our Class A common stock, Class B common stock, or Class N common stock (including, in each case, by way of “net” or “cashless” exercise), including for the payment of exercise price and tax and remittance payments due as a result of the vesting, exercise, or settlement of such options, warrants, RSUs, or rights, provided that any shares of Class A common stock, Class B common stock, or Class N common stock received upon such vesting, exercise, or settlement shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above, and provided further that any such options, warrants, RSUs, or rights are held by the lock-up party pursuant to (A) an agreement or (B) equity awards granted under an equity incentive plan, stock purchase plan, or other equity award plan described in this prospectus;
paras.zh: (xi) 就期权、认股权证、RSU 或其他购买本公司 A 类普通股、B 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份的权利的归属、行权或结算（在每种情况下包括通过“净额”或“无现金”行权方式）而向本公司进行的转让，包括用于支付行权价格以及因该等期权、认股权证、RSU 或权利的归属、行权或结算而应缴的税款和汇款，但前提是因该等归属、行权或结算而收到的任何 A 类普通股、B 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份仍应受上述限制的约束，且进一步前提是该等期权、认股权证、RSU 或权利系由锁定期一方依据 (A) 一项协议或 (B) 本招股说明书所述股权激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划项下授予的股权奖励而持有；

paras.en: (xii)transfers in connection with the sale or other transfer of the lock-up party’s shares of Class A common stock to satisfy any tax obligations or payments due as a result of (A) the exercise of stock options or (B) the settlement of RSUs (other than RSUs that vest in connection with or upon completion of this offering) pursuant to awards granted under an equity incentive plan, stock purchase plan, or other equity award plan described in this prospectus, provided that, in each case, any remaining shares of Class A common stock or Class B common stock received upon such exercise or settlement shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above;
paras.zh: (xii) 与出售或以其他方式转让锁定期一方的 A 类普通股股份相关的转让，以满足因 (A) 股票期权的行权或 (B) RSU（不包括与本首次公开发行完成相关或于其完成时归属的 RSU）的结算而应缴的任何税务义务或款项，该等行权或结算系依据本招股说明书所述股权激励计划、股票购买计划或其他股权奖励计划项下授予的奖励进行，但前提是在每种情况下，因该等行权或结算而收到的任何剩余 A 类普通股或 B 类普通股股份仍应受上述限制的约束；

paras.en: (xiii) the conversion of our outstanding Class B common stock, Class N common stock, or preferred stock into shares of our Class A common stock or Class B common stock, as applicable, provided that any such shares of Class A common stock or Class B common stock received upon such conversion shall be subject to the restrictions set forth above; or
paras.zh: (xiii) 本公司已发行的 B 类普通股、N 类普通股或优先股转换为 A 类普通股或 B 类普通股股份（视情况而定），但前提是因该等转换而收到的任何 A 类普通股或 B 类普通股股份应受上述限制的约束；或

paras.en: (xiv) transfers pursuant to a bona fide third-party tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction that is approved by our board of directors and made to all holders of our capital stock involving a change of control of the company; provided that in the event that such tender offer, merger, consolidation, or other similar transaction is not completed, the lock-up party’s securities shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above; provided that (A) in the case of any transfer, distribution or other disposition pursuant to clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (viii), and (ix), such transfer shall not involve a disposition for value and such securities shall remain subject to the restrictions set forth above; (B) in the case of any transfer, distribution, or other disposition pursuant to clauses (a)(vii) and (viii), no filing by any party under the Exchange Act or other public announcement shall be required or will be made voluntarily in connection with such transfer, disposition, or distribution (other than a filing on a Form 5 or pursuant to Section 13 of the Exchange Act); and (C) in the case of any transfer or distribution pursuant to clauses (a)(ii), (iii), (iv), (v), (vi), (ix), (x), (xi), and (xii), that no public filing, report, or announcement will be voluntarily made, and if any filing under Section 16(a) of the Exchange Act, or other public filing, report, or announcement reporting a reduction in beneficial ownership of shares of Class A common stock in connection with the transfer or distribution is legally required during the Lock-up Period, such filing, report, or announcement must clearly indicate in the footnotes thereto the nature and conditions of the transfer.
paras.zh: (xiv) 依据经我们董事会批准、向本公司全体股本持有人发出、涉及公司控制权变更的善意第三方要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易进行的转让；但若该等要约收购、合并、兼并或其他类似交易未能完成，则锁定方证券仍应受上述限制约束；但前提是：(A) 对于依据第 (a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(viii) 和 (ix) 项进行的任何转让、分配或其他处置，该等转让不得涉及有偿处置，且该等证券仍应受上述限制约束；(B) 对于依据第 (a)(vii) 和 (viii) 项进行的任何转让、分配或其他处置，任何一方均无需根据《交易法》进行申报，亦不会就该等转让、处置或分配自愿进行任何公开公告（依据 Form 5 或《交易法》第 13 条进行的申报除外）；以及 (C) 对于依据第 (a)(ii)、(iii)、(iv)、(v)、(vi)、(ix)、(x)、(xi) 和 (xii) 项进行的任何转让或分配，不会自愿进行任何公开申报、报告或公告，且若在锁定期内法律要求依据《交易法》第 16(a) 条进行任何申报，或进行其他公开申报、报告或公告，以报告与该等转让或分配相关的 A 类普通股受益所有权的减少，则该等申报、报告或公告必须在其脚注中明确说明该等转让的性质和条件。

paras.en: The restrictions on issuances by us during the Lock-up Period are subject to certain exceptions, including with respect to:
paras.zh: 我们在锁定期内发行证券所受的限制受若干例外情形约束，包括：

paras.en: (i) the sale of our Class A common stock to the underwriters pursuant to the underwriting agreement;
paras.zh: (i) 依据承销协议向承销商出售我们的 A 类普通股；

paras.en: (ii) the issuance of shares of common stock upon the exercise of an option or warrant or the conversion of a security outstanding as of the date of this prospectus or the settlement of RSUs;
paras.zh: (ii) 因行使期权或认股权证、或转换截至本招股说明书日期已发行的证券、或结算 RSU 而发行普通股股份；

paras.en: (iii) grants of stock options, stock awards, restricted stock, RSUs, or other equity awards and the issuance of shares of common stock or securities convertible into or exercisable for common stock (whether upon the exercise of stock options or otherwise) to employees, officers, directors, advisors or consultants of the Company pursuant to the terms of an equity incentive plan or employee benefit plan in effect as of the closing of this offering and described herein, provided that all recipients of any such grants, stock awards, restricted stock, RSUs, or other equity awards shall execute and deliver to the underwriters a lock-up agreement covering the remainder of the Lock-up Period to the extent the securities held by such person are not otherwise bound by a market standoff agreement that is at least as restrictive as the terms described herein;
paras.zh: (iii) 依据截至本次发行交割时生效且在本招股说明书中描述的股权激励计划或员工福利计划的条款，向公司员工、高级管理人员、董事、顾问或咨询人员授予股票期权、股票奖励、限制性股票、RSU 或其他股权奖励，以及发行普通股股份或可转换为普通股或可行使为普通股的证券（无论是因行使股票期权还是其他方式），但前提是，任何该等授予、股票奖励、限制性股票、RSU 或其他股权奖励的所有接收方均应签署并向承销商交付一份涵盖锁定期剩余期间的锁定协议，前提是该等人士所持证券未以其他方式受限于一份限制性不低于本协议所述条款的市场禁售协议；

paras.en: (iv) facilitating the establishment of a trading plan on behalf of a stockholder, officer, or director pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act for the transfer of shares of Class A common stock, provided that (A) such plan does not provide for the transfer of Class A common stock during the Lock-up Period (except as otherwise permitted under the lock-up agreement) and (B) to the extent a public announcement or filing under the Exchange Act, if any, is required of or voluntarily made by us regarding the establishment of such plan, such announcement or filing shall include a statement to the effect that no transfer of shares of Class A common stock may be made under such plan during the Lock-up Period (except as otherwise permitted under the lock-up agreement);
paras.zh: (iv) 代表股东、高级管理人员或董事根据《交易法》第 10b5-1 条规则设立交易计划以转让 A 类普通股股份，前提是 (A) 该计划未规定在锁定期内转让 A 类普通股（锁定期协议另有许可的除外），且 (B) 若我们就设立该计划须根据《交易法》作出任何公告或备案，或我们自愿作出该等公告或备案，则该等公告或备案应包含一项声明，表明在锁定期内不得根据该计划转让 A 类普通股股份（锁定期协议另有许可的除外）;

paras.en: (v) the sale or issuance of or entry into an agreement to sell or issue Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for Class A common stock in connection with one or more mergers, acquisitions of securities, businesses, property or other assets, products or technologies, joint ventures, commercial relationships, or other strategic corporate transactions or alliances; provided that the aggregate amount of Class A common stock or any securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for Class A common stock (on an as-converted, as-exercised, or as-exchanged basis) that we may sell or issue or agree to sell or issue pursuant to this clause (v) shall not exceed 10% of the total number of shares of our common stock issued and outstanding immediately following the completion of this offering, and provided, further, that each recipient of such securities enter into a lock-up agreement with the underwriters covering the remainder of the Lock-up Period to the extent the securities held by such person are not otherwise bound by a market standoff agreement that is at least as restrictive as the terms described herein;
paras.zh: (v) 就一项或多项合并、收购证券、业务、财产或其他资产、产品或技术、合资、商业关系或其他战略性公司交易或联盟，出售或发行 A 类普通股或可转换为、可行使或可交换为 A 类普通股的证券，或订立出售或发行该等证券的协议；前提是我们根据本第 (v) 项可能出售或发行或同意出售或发行的 A 类普通股或可转换为、可行使或可交换为 A 类普通股的证券（按转换后、行使后或交换后基准计算）的合计数量不得超过本次发行完成后我们已发行在外普通股总数的 10%，并且进一步前提是，该等证券的每一接收方须与承销商订立锁定期协议，涵盖锁定期剩余期间，但以该人士所持证券未受限于一项限制性不低于本协议所述条款的市场禁售协议为限；

paras.en: (vi) the sale or issuance of warrants to purchase shares of our Class N common stock in connection with commercial transactions, provided, that the recipient of such securities enter into a lock-up agreement with the underwriters covering the remainder of the Lock-up Period;
paras.zh: (vi) 就商业交易出售或发行可购买我们 N 类普通股股份的认股权证，前提是该等证券的接收方须与承销商订立锁定期协议，涵盖锁定期剩余期间；

paras.en: (vii) the issuance of shares of Class A common stock upon the conversion of shares of our Class B common stock or Class N common stock; or
paras.zh: (vii) 因转换我们的 B 类普通股或 N 类普通股股份而发行 A 类普通股股份；或

paras.en: (viii) the filing of one or more registration statements on Form S-8 for the registration of shares of Class A common stock issued pursuant to our equity incentive and employee benefit plans disclosed in this prospectus.
paras.zh: (viii) 就根据本招股说明书所披露的股权激励计划和员工福利计划发行的 A 类普通股股份，提交一份或多份 S-8 表格注册声明以进行注册。

paras.en: In order to facilitate the offering of our Class A common stock, the underwriters may engage in transactions that stabilize, maintain, or otherwise affect the price of our Class A common stock. Specifically, the underwriters may sell more shares than they are obligated to purchase under the underwriting agreement, creating a short position. A short sale is covered if the short position is no greater than the number of shares available for purchase by the underwriters under the option to purchase additional shares. The underwriters can close out a covered short sale by exercising the option to purchase additional shares or purchasing shares in the open market. In determining the source of shares to close out a covered short sale, the underwriters will consider, among other things, the open market price of shares compared to the price available under the option to purchase additional shares. The underwriters may also sell shares in excess of the option to purchase additional shares, creating a naked short position. The underwriters must close out any naked short position by purchasing shares in the open market. A naked short position is more likely to be created if the underwriters are concerned that there may be downward pressure on the price of our Class A common stock in the open market after pricing that could adversely affect investors who purchase in this offering. As an additional means of facilitating this offering, the underwriters may bid for, and purchase, shares of Class A common stock in the open market to stabilize the price of our Class A common stock. These activities may raise or maintain the market price of our Class A common stock above independent market levels or prevent or retard a decline in the market price of our Class A common stock. The underwriters are not required to engage in these activities and may end any of these activities at any time.
paras.zh: 为便于我们 A 类普通股的发行，承销商可能进行稳定、维持或以其他方式影响我们 A 类普通股价格的交易。具体而言，承销商可能出售超过其在承销协议项下有义务购买的股份，从而形成空头头寸。如果空头头寸不超过承销商根据超额配售选择权可购买的股份数量，则该卖空为有担保卖空。承销商可通过行使超额配售选择权或在一级市场购买股份来平掉有担保卖空。在确定平掉有担保卖空的股份来源时，承销商将考虑（其中包括）股份的一级市场价格与超额配售选择权项下可购买价格之间的比较。承销商还可能出售超过超额配售选择权数量的股份，从而形成裸空头头寸。承销商必须通过在一级市场购买股份来平掉任何裸空头头寸。如果承销商担心定价后我们 A 类普通股的一级市场价格可能面临下行压力，从而可能对本次发行中购买股份的投资者产生不利影响，则更有可能形成裸空头头寸。作为促进本次发行的额外手段，承销商可能在一级市场出价购买 A 类普通股，以稳定我们 A 类普通股的价格。这些活动可能使我们的 A 类普通股市场价格高于独立市场水平，或阻止或延缓我们 A 类普通股市场价格的下跌。承销商无义务进行这些活动，并可随时终止任何此类活动。

paras.en: We and the underwriters have agreed to indemnify each other against certain liabilities, including liabilities under the Securities Act.
paras.zh: 我们与承销商已同意就某些责任（包括《证券法》项下的责任）相互赔偿。

paras.en: A prospectus in electronic format may be made available on websites maintained by one or more underwriters, or selling group members, if any, participating in this offering. The representatives may agree to allocate a number of shares of Class A common stock to underwriters for sale to their online brokerage account holders. Internet distributions will be allocated by the representatives to underwriters that may make Internet distributions on the same basis as other allocations.
paras.zh: 电子格式的招股说明书可能在一个或多个承销商或参与本次发行的任何销售团成员维护的网站上提供。承销商代表可能同意向承销商分配一定数量的 A 类普通股，由其出售给其在线经纪账户持有人。互联网分销将由承销商代表分配给可能以与其他分配相同的基础进行互联网分销的承销商。

paras.en: The underwriters and their respective affiliates are full service financial institutions engaged in various activities, which may include securities trading, commercial and investment banking, financial advisory, investment management, investment research, principal investment, hedging, financing, and brokerage activities. Certain of the underwriters and their respective affiliates have, from time to time, performed, and may in the future perform, various financial advisory and investment banking services for us, for which they received or will receive customary fees and expenses. For example, Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Citigroup Global Markets Inc., Barclays Capital Inc., UBS Securities LLC, Mizuho Securities USA LLC, TD Securities (USA) LLC, Credit Agricole Securities (USA) Inc., MUFG Securities Americas Inc., and First Citizens Capital Securities, LLC, underwriters or financial advisors in this offering, and/or their affiliates, are lenders under the Revolving Credit Facility.
paras.zh: 承销商及其各自的关联方均为提供全方位服务的金融机构，从事各类业务，可能包括证券交易、商业与投资银行业务、财务顾问、投资管理、投资研究、自营投资、对冲、融资及经纪业务。部分承销商及其各自的关联方不时为我们提供并可能在未来继续提供各类财务顾问及投资银行服务，并已就此收取或将收取惯常的费用及开支。例如，Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC、Citigroup Global Markets Inc.、Barclays Capital Inc.、UBS Securities LLC、Mizuho Securities USA LLC、TD Securities (USA) LLC、Credit Agricole Securities (USA) Inc.、MUFG Securities Americas Inc. 及 First Citizens Capital Securities, LLC（本次发行的承销商或财务顾问）和/或其关联方，系循环信贷融资项下的贷款人。

paras.en: In addition, Credit Agricole Securities (USA) Inc. is acting as our financial advisor in connection with this offering, for which we will pay them a fee equal to up to 1.67% of the total underwriting discounts and commissions paid to the underwriters in connection with the offering.
paras.zh: 此外，Credit Agricole Securities (USA) Inc. 担任与本次发行相关的我们的财务顾问，我们将就此向其支付相当于本次发行中向承销商支付的承销折扣及佣金总额最高 1.67% 的费用。

paras.en: We have also granted certain of the underwriters a right of first refusal to participate as book-running lead managing underwriters, book-running lead arrangers, or exclusive placement agents in connection with any “underwritten” Rule 144A offering, underwritten public offering or other equity financing by us through September 2026. Such right of first refusal will be deemed by FINRA to be underwriting compensation with a value of 1% of the offering proceeds.
paras.zh: 我们还授予部分承销商优先购买权，使其有权在截至 2026 年 9 月的期间内，就我们进行的任何“承销”Rule 144A 发行、承销公开发行或其他股权融资，担任账簿管理人牵头主承销商、账簿管理人牵头安排行或独家配售代理。FINRA 将视该优先购买权为承销补偿，其价值为发行募集资金的 1%。

paras.en: In the ordinary course of their various business activities, the underwriters and their respective affiliates may make or hold a broad array of investments and actively trade debt and equity securities (or related derivative securities) and financial instruments (including bank loans) for their own account and for the accounts of their customers and may at any time hold long and short positions in such securities and instruments. Such investment and securities activities may involve our securities and instruments. The underwriters and their respective affiliates may also make investment recommendations or publish or express independent research views in respect of such securities or instruments and may at any time hold, or recommend to clients that they acquire, long or short positions in such securities and instruments.
paras.zh: 在其各类日常业务活动中，承销商及其各自的关联方可能进行或持有广泛的投资，并为其自身账户及客户账户积极交易债务和权益证券（或相关衍生证券）及金融工具（包括银行贷款），并可能随时持有该等证券及工具的多头或空头头寸。该等投资及证券活动可能涉及我们的证券及工具。承销商及其各自的关联方还可能就该等证券或工具提出投资建议，或发布或表达独立的研究观点，并可能随时持有或建议客户取得该等证券及工具的多头或空头头寸。

paras.en: At our request, the underwriters have reserved up to 1,500,000 shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus for sale at the initial public offering price through a directed share program to certain persons identified by our management and certain long-tenured employees, which may include parties with whom we have a business relationship and friends and family of management and such employees. If purchased by these persons, these shares will not be subject to a lock-up restriction, except to the extent that the purchasers of such shares are otherwise subject to lock-up agreements as a result of their relationships with us. The number of shares of Class A common stock available for sale to the general public will be reduced by the number of reserved shares sold to these persons. Any reserved shares not purchased by these persons will be offered by the underwriters to the general public on the same basis as the other shares of Class A common stock offered by this prospectus. Other than the underwriting discount described on the front cover of this prospectus, the underwriters will not be entitled to any commission with respect to shares of Class A common stock sold pursuant to the directed share program. We have agreed to indemnify the underwriters against certain liabilities and expenses, including liabilities under the Securities Act, in connection with sales of the shares reserved for the directed share program. Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC will administer our directed share program.
paras.zh: 应我们的要求，承销商已预留最多 1,500,000 股由本招股说明书发售的 A 类普通股，通过定向股份计划按首次公开发行价格向由我们管理层指定的若干人士及若干长期任职员工出售，其中可能包括与我们存在业务关系的各方以及管理层和该等员工的亲友。若该等人士购买，该等股份将不受锁定期限制，但若该等股份的购买人因其与我们之间的关系而另行受锁定期协议约束的除外。向公众发售的 A 类普通股数量将减去向该等人士出售的预留股份数量。该等人士未购买的任何预留股份将由承销商按与本招股说明书发售的其他 A 类普通股相同的基础向公众发售。除本招股说明书封面所述的承销折扣外，承销商无权就根据定向股份计划出售的 A 类普通股收取任何佣金。我们已同意就定向股份计划预留股份的出售事宜，赔偿承销商若干责任和费用，包括《证券法》项下的责任。Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC 将管理我们的定向股份计划。

paras.en: Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. The initial public offering price was determined by negotiations between us and the representatives. Among the factors considered in determining the initial public offering price were our future prospects and those of our industry in general, our sales, earnings, and certain other financial and operating information in recent periods, and the price-earnings ratios, price-sales ratios, market prices of securities, and certain financial and operating information of companies engaged in activities similar to ours. Neither we nor the underwriters can assure investors that an active trading market will develop for shares of our Class A common stock, or that the shares will trade in the public market at or above the initial public offering price.
paras.zh: 在本次发行之前，我们的 A 类普通股不存在公开市场。首次公开发行价格由我们与承销商代表协商确定。在确定首次公开发行价格时考虑的因素包括我们的未来前景及所处行业的整体前景、我们近期的销售额、盈利以及某些其他财务和经营信息，以及从事与我们类似业务的公司的市盈率、市销率、证券市场价格及某些财务和经营信息。我们和承销商均无法向投资者保证，我们的 A 类普通股将形成活跃的交易市场，或该等股份将在公开市场以等于或高于首次公开发行价格的价格交易。

paras.en: #### European Economic Area
paras.zh: #### 欧洲经济区

paras.en: In relation to each Member State of the European Economic Area (each a “Relevant State”), no shares of our Class A common stock have been offered or will be offered pursuant to the offering to the public in that Relevant State prior to the publication of a prospectus in relation to the shares of our Class A common stock which has been approved by the competent authority in that Relevant State or, where appropriate, approved in another Relevant State and notified to the competent authority in that Relevant State, all in accordance with the Prospectus Regulation, except that offers of shares of our Class A common stock may be made to the public in that Relevant State at any time under the following exemptions under the Prospectus Regulation:
paras.zh: 就欧洲经济区各成员国（各称“相关国家”）而言，在有关我们 A 类普通股的招股说明书经该相关国家主管机关批准，或在适当情况下经另一相关国家批准并通知该相关国家主管机关之前，概无亦不会根据本次发行在该相关国家向公众发售任何 A 类普通股，上述一切均须遵守《招股说明书条例》，但根据《招股说明书条例》的下列豁免情形，我们 A 类普通股可随时在该相关国家向公众发售：

paras.en: (a) to any legal entity which is a qualified investor as defined under Article 2 of the Prospectus Regulation;
paras.zh: (a) 向《招股说明书条例》第 2 条所界定的任何合格投资者法人实体发售；

paras.en: (b) to fewer than 150 natural or legal persons (other than qualified investors as defined under Article 2 of the Prospectus Regulation), subject to obtaining the prior consent of the representatives for any such offer; or
paras.zh: (b) 向少于 150 名自然人或法人（不包括《招股说明书条例》第 2 条所界定的合格投资者）发售，但须就任何该等发售事先取得代表同意；或

paras.en: (c) in any other circumstances falling within Article 1(4) of the Prospectus Regulation,
paras.zh: (c) 属于《招股说明书条例》第 1(4)条规定的任何其他情形，

paras.en: provided that no such offer of shares of our Class A common stock shall require us or any underwriter to publish a prospectus pursuant to Article 3 of the Prospectus Regulation or supplement a prospectus pursuant to Article 23 of the Prospectus Regulation, and each person who initially acquires any shares of our Class A common stock or to whom any offer is made will be deemed to have represented, acknowledged and agreed to and with each of the underwriters and the Company that it is a “qualified investor” within the meaning of Article 2(e) of the Prospectus Regulation.
paras.zh: 前提是任何该等 A 类普通股发售均不要求我们或任何承销商根据《招股说明书条例》第 3 条刊发招股说明书或根据《招股说明书条例》第 23 条补充招股说明书，且每位初始认购任何 A 类普通股的人士或任何发售对象将被视为已向各承销商及本公司陈述、确认并同意，其属于《招股说明书条例》第 2(e)条含义内的“合格投资者”。

paras.en: In the case of any shares of our Class A common stock being offered to a financial intermediary as that term is used in Article 5 of the Prospectus Regulation, each such financial intermediary will be deemed to have represented, acknowledged and agreed that the shares of our Class A common stock acquired by it in the offer have not been acquired on a non-discretionary basis on behalf of, nor have they been acquired with a view to their offer or resale to, persons in circumstances which may give rise to an offer of any shares of our Class A common stock to the public other than their offer or resale in a Relevant State to qualified investors as so defined or in circumstances in which the prior consent of the representatives has been obtained to each such proposed offer or resale.
paras.zh: 如向《招股说明书条例》第 5 条所指的金融中介机构发售任何 A 类普通股，则各该等金融中介机构将被视为已陈述、确认并同意，其于本次发行中认购的 A 类普通股并非以非自主方式代表他人认购，亦非以向可能引致任何 A 类普通股向公众发售的情形下的人士发售或转售为目的而认购，但其在相关国家向上述所界定的合格投资者发售或转售，或已就每项该等拟议发售或转售取得代表事先同意的情形除外。

paras.en: For the purposes of this provision, the expression an “offer to the public” in relation to shares of our Class A common stock in any Relevant State means the communication in any form and by any means of sufficient information on the terms of the offer and any shares of our Class A common stock to be offered so as to enable an investor to decide to purchase or subscribe for any shares of our Class A common stock, and the expression “Prospectus Regulation” means Regulation (EU) 2017/1129 (as amended).
paras.zh: 就本条规定而言，在任何相关国家与 A 类普通股有关的“向公众发售”一语，指以任何形式及任何方式传达有关发售条款及拟发售的任何 A 类普通股的充分信息，以使投资者能够决定购买或认购任何 A 类普通股，而“招股说明书条例”一语指第（EU）2017/1129 号条例（经修订）。

paras.en: #### United Kingdom
No shares have been offered or will be offered pursuant to the offering to the public in the United Kingdom except that the shares may be offered to the public in the United Kingdom at any time:
paras.zh: 除以下情形外，未曾且不会依据本次发行在英国向公众发售任何股份：股份可在任何时间在英国向公众发售：

paras.en: (a) where (i) the offer is conditional on the admission of the shares to trading on the London Stock Exchange plc’s main market (in reliance on the exception in paragraph 6(a) of Schedule 1 of the POATR) or (ii) the shares being offered are at the time of the offer already admitted to trading on London Stock Exchange plc’s main market (in reliance on the exception in paragraph 6(b) of Schedule 1 of the POATR);
paras.zh: (a) 在以下情况下：(i) 该要约以股份获准在 London Stock Exchange plc 主板市场交易为条件（依据 POATR 附表 1 第 6(a) 段的例外规定），或 (ii) 所发售的股份在要约发出时已获准在 London Stock Exchange plc 主板市场交易（依据 POATR 附表 1 第 6(b) 段的例外规定）；

paras.en: (b) to any “qualified investor” as defined in paragraph 15 of Schedule 1 of the POATR;
paras.zh: (b) 向 POATR 附表 1 第 15 段所定义的任何“合格投资者”发售；

paras.en: (c) to fewer than 150 persons (other than qualified investors as defined in paragraph 15 of Schedule 1 of the POATR), subject to obtaining the prior consent of the representatives for any such offer; or
paras.zh: (c) 向少于 150 名人士（POATR 附表 1 第 15 段所定义的合格投资者除外）发售，但任何此类要约须事先取得代表的同意；或

paras.en: (d) in any other circumstances falling within Part 1 of Schedule 1 of the POATR.
paras.zh: (d) 属于 POATR 附表 1 第 1 部分范围内的任何其他情形。

paras.en: For the purposes of this provision, the expression an “offer to the public” in relation to the shares in the United Kingdom means the communication to any person which presents sufficient information on: (a) the shares to be offered; and (b) the terms on which they are to be offered, to enable an investor to decide to buy or subscribe for the shares and the expression “POATR” means the Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024.
paras.zh: 就本条规定而言，在英国与股份相关的“向公众发售”一词，指向任何人传达以下方面的充分信息：(a) 拟发售的股份；以及 (b) 发售该等股份所依据的条款，以使投资者能够决定购买或认购该等股份；“POATR”一词指《2024 年公开发售与上市交易条例》。

paras.en: This prospectus is only being distributed to and is only directed at: (A) persons who are outside the United Kingdom, or (B) qualified investors who are also (i) investment professionals falling within Article 19(5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Financial Promotion) Order 2005 (the “Order”), or (ii) high-net-worth companies, and other persons to whom it may lawfully be communicated, falling within Article 49(2)(a) to (d) of the Order (all such persons together being referred to as “relevant persons”). The shares are only available to, and any invitation, offer or agreement to subscribe, purchase or otherwise acquire the shares will be engaged in only with, relevant persons. Any person who is not a relevant person should not act or rely on this prospectus or any of its contents.
paras.zh: 本招股说明书仅向以下对象分发并仅面向以下对象：(A) 英国境外人士，或 (B) 同时属于以下情形的合格投资者：(i) 属于《2005 年金融服务与市场法（金融推广）令》（以下简称“《令》”）第 19(5) 条所指的投资专业人士，或 (ii) 属于《令》第 49(2)(a) 至 (d) 条所指的高净值公司及其他可合法接收本文件的实体（上述所有人士统称“相关人士”）。股份仅向相关人士提供，任何认购、购买或以其他方式取得股份的邀请、要约或协议亦仅与相关人士进行。任何非相关人士均不得依据本招股说明书或其任何内容行事。

paras.en: #### Hong Kong

The contents of this document have not been reviewed by any regulatory authority in Hong Kong. You are advised to exercise caution in relation to the offer. If you are in any doubt about any of the contents of this document, you should obtain independent professional advice. Shares of our Class A common stock have not been offered or sold and may not be offered or sold by means of any document other than (i) in circumstances which do not constitute an offer to the public within the meaning of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 32, Laws of Hong Kong), (ii) to “professional investors” as defined in the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571, Laws of Hong Kong) and any rules made thereunder, or (iii) in other circumstances which do not result in the document being a “prospectus” within the meaning of the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 32, Laws of Hong Kong). No advertisement, invitation, or document relating to shares of our Class A common stock has been or may be issued or has been or may be in the possession of any person for the purpose of issue (in each case whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere), which is directed at, or the contents of which are likely to be accessed or read by, the public in Hong Kong (except if permitted to do so under the laws of Hong Kong) other than with respect to shares of our Class A common stock that are or are intended to be disposed of only to persons outside Hong Kong or only to “professional investors” as defined in the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571, Laws of Hong Kong) and any rules made thereunder.
paras.zh: 本文件内容未经香港任何监管机构审阅。建议您就本次发行审慎行事。如您对本文件任何内容存有疑问，应获取独立专业意见。我们 A 类普通股的股份未曾且不得以任何文件方式要约或出售，但以下情形除外：(i) 在不构成《公司（清盘及杂项条文）条例》（香港法例第 32 章）所指的向公众作出要约的情况下；(ii) 向《证券及期货条例》（香港法例第 571 章）及其项下任何规则所定义的“专业投资者”作出；或(iii) 在其他不会导致该文件构成《公司（清盘及杂项条文）条例》（香港法例第 32 章）所指的“招股说明书”的情况下。概无与我们的 A 类普通股股份有关的广告、邀请或文件已经或可能被发出，或已经或可能由任何人管有，以供发出（无论在香港或其他地方），而该等广告、邀请或文件是针对香港公众的，或其内容相当可能由香港公众查阅或阅读的（除非根据香港法律获准如此行事），但就仅向香港以外人士或仅向《证券及期货条例》（香港法例第 571 章）及其项下任何规则所定义的“专业投资者”处置或拟处置的 A 类普通股股份者除外。

paras.en: #### Japan

No registration pursuant to Article 4, paragraph 1 of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Law of Japan (Law No. 25 of 1948, as amended) (the “FIEL”) has been made or will be made with respect to the solicitation of the application for the acquisition of the shares of Class A common stock.
paras.zh: 概无就招揽认购 A 类普通股股份的申请，根据日本《金融商品交易法》（1948 年第 25 号法律，经修订）（“FIEL”）第 4 条第 1 款办理或将会办理任何登记。

paras.en: Accordingly, the shares of Class A common stock have not been, directly or indirectly, offered or sold and will not be, directly or indirectly, offered or sold in Japan or to, or for the benefit of, any resident of Japan (which term as used herein means any person resident in Japan, including any corporation or other entity organized under the laws of Japan) or to others for re-offering or re-sale, directly or indirectly, in Japan or to, or for the benefit of, any resident of Japan except pursuant to an exemption from the registration requirements, and otherwise in compliance with, the FIEL and the other applicable laws and regulations of Japan.
paras.zh: 因此，A 类普通股股份未曾且将不会直接或间接在日本境内，或向任何日本居民（本文件所用该术语指任何居住在日本的人士，包括根据日本法律组建的任何公司或其他实体），或为任何日本居民的利益，或向他人作出要约或出售，以供直接或间接在日本境内，或向任何日本居民，或为任何日本居民的利益，进行再次要约或转售，但根据 FIEL 及其他适用日本法律法规的登记要求豁免并另行遵守该等法律法规者除外。

paras.en: #### For Qualified Institutional Investors (“QII”)
paras.zh: #### 面向合格机构投资者（“QII”）

paras.en: Please note that the solicitation for newly issued or secondary securities (each as described in Paragraph 2, Article 4 of the FIEL) in relation to the shares of Class A common stock constitutes either a “QII only private placement” or a “QII only secondary distribution” (each as described in Paragraph 1, Article 23-13 of the FIEL). Disclosure regarding any such solicitation, as is otherwise prescribed in Paragraph 1, Article 4 of the FIEL, has not been made in relation to the shares of Class A common stock. The shares of Class A common stock may only be transferred to QIIs.
paras.zh: 请注意，就 A 类普通股股份而言，对 FIEL 第 4 条第 2 款所述新发行证券或二级证券（各自定义见该款）的招揽，构成“仅面向 QII 的非公开发行”或“仅面向 QII 的二级分销”（各自定义见 FIEL 第 23-13 条第 1 款）。对于任何此类招揽，FIEL 第 4 条第 1 款另行规定的披露并未就 A 类普通股股份作出。A 类普通股股份仅可转让给 QII。

paras.en: #### For Non-QII Investors
paras.zh: #### 面向非 QII 投资者

paras.en: Please note that the solicitation for newly issued or secondary securities (each as described in Paragraph 2, Article 4 of the FIEL) in relation to the shares of Class A common stock constitutes either a “small number private placement” or a “small number private secondary distribution” (each as is described in Paragraph 4, Article 23-13 of the FIEL). Disclosure regarding any such solicitation, as is otherwise prescribed in Paragraph 1, Article 4 of the FIEL, has not been made in relation to the shares of Class A common stock. The shares of Class A common stock may only be transferred en bloc without subdivision to a single investor.
paras.zh: 请注意，就 A 类普通股股份而言，对 FIEL 第 4 条第 2 款所述新发行证券或二级证券（各自定义见该款）的招揽，构成“小规模非公开发行”或“小规模二级分销”（各自定义见 FIEL 第 23-13 条第 4 款）。对于任何此类招揽，FIEL 第 4 条第 1 款另行规定的披露并未就 A 类普通股股份作出。A 类普通股股份仅可整体转让、不得拆分，且仅可转让给单一投资者。

paras.en: #### Singapore
paras.zh: #### 新加坡

paras.en: This prospectus has not been registered as a prospectus with the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Accordingly, this prospectus and any other document or material in connection with the offer or sale, or invitation for subscription or purchase, of shares of our Class A common stock may not be circulated or distributed, nor may the shares of our Class A common stock be offered or sold, or be made the subject of an invitation for subscription or purchase, whether directly or indirectly, to persons in Singapore other than (i) to an institutional investor pursuant to Section 274 of the Securities and Futures Act, Chapter 289 of Singapore (the “SFA”), (ii) to a relevant person, or any person pursuant to Section 275(1A) of the SFA, and in accordance with the conditions specified in Section 275 of the SFA, or (iii) otherwise pursuant to, and in accordance with the conditions of, any other applicable provision of the SFA.
paras.zh: 本招股说明书未作为招股说明书向新加坡金融管理局注册。因此，本招股说明书及与要约或出售、或认购或购买要约邀请相关的任何其他文件或材料，不得在新加坡境内向人士传阅或分发，我们的 A 类普通股股份亦不得直接或间接向新加坡境内人士要约或出售，或作为认购或购买要约邀请的标的，但以下情形除外：(i) 依据新加坡第 289 章《证券与期货法》（“SFA”）第 274 条向机构投资者作出；(ii) 依据 SFA 第 275（1A）条向相关人士或任何人士作出，并符合 SFA 第 275 条规定的条件；或 (iii) 依据 SFA 任何其他适用条款并符合其条件作出。

paras.en: Where shares of our Class A common stock are subscribed or purchased under Section 275 by a relevant person which is:
paras.zh: 凡相关人士依据第 275 条认购或购买我们的 A 类普通股股份，且该相关人士为：

paras.en: (a) a corporation (which is not an accredited investor (as defined in Section 4A of the SFA)) the sole business of which is to hold investments and the entire share capital of which is owned by one or more individuals, each of whom is an accredited investor; or
paras.zh: (a) 一家公司（非 SFA 第 4A 条所定义的认可投资者），其唯一业务为持有投资，且其全部股本由一名或多名个人拥有，且每名个人均为认可投资者；或

paras.en: (b) a trust (where the trustee is not an accredited investor) whose sole purpose is to hold investments and each beneficiary of the trust is an individual who is an accredited investor, securities or securities-based derivatives contracts (each as defined in Section 2(1) of the SFA) of that corporation or the beneficiaries’ rights and interest in that trust shall not be transferable within six months after that corporation or that trust has acquired shares of our Class A common stock under Section 275 of the SFA except:
paras.zh: (b) 一项信托（其受托人非认可投资者），其唯一目的为持有投资，且该信托的每名受益人均为认可投资者，则该等公司或该信托的证券或证券衍生品合约（各自定义见 SFA 第 2(1)条），或该信托中受益人的权利和权益，在该公司或该信托依据 SFA 第 275 条取得我们的 A 类普通股股份后六个月内不得转让，但以下情形除外：

paras.en: (1) to an institutional investor or to a relevant person, or to any person pursuant to Section 275(1A), and in accordance with the conditions, specified in Section 275 of the SFA;
paras.zh: (1) 向机构投资者或相关人士，或依据 SFA 第 275（1A）条向任何人士，并符合 SFA 第 275 条规定的条件；

paras.en: (2) where no consideration is or will be given for the transfer;
paras.zh: (2) 转让未支付或将不会支付任何对价；

paras.en: (3) where the transfer is by operation of law;
paras.zh: (3) 转让因法律实施而发生；

paras.en: (4) as specified in Section 276(7) of the SFA; or
paras.zh: (4) 符合 SFA 第 276(7) 条规定；或

paras.en: (5) as specified in Regulation 37A of the Securities and Futures (Offers of Investments) (Securities and Securities based Derivatives Contracts) Regulation 2018.
paras.zh: (5) 符合《2018 年证券与期货（投资要约）（证券及证券挂钩衍生品合约）条例》第 37A 条规定。

paras.en: Solely for purposes of the notification requirements under Section 309B(1)(c) of the SFA, we have determined, and hereby notify all relevant persons, that the shares are “prescribed capital markets products” (as defined in the Securities and Futures (Capital Markets Products) Regulations 2018) and Excluded Investment Products (as defined in MAS Notice SFA 04-N12: Notice on the Sale of Investment Products and MAS Notice FAA-N16: Notice on Recommendations on Investment Products).
paras.zh: 仅为满足 SFA 第 309B(1)(c) 条项下的通知要求之目的，我们已认定并特此通知所有相关人士，该等股份属于“规定资本市场产品”(定义见《2018 年证券与期货（资本市场产品）条例》)及除外投资产品（定义见 MAS 通知 SFA 04-N12:《投资产品销售通知》及 MAS 通知 FAA-N16:《投资产品推荐通知》）。

This prospectus is intended for distribution only to persons of a type specified in the Offered Securities Rules of the DFSA. It must not be delivered to, or relied on by, any other person. The DFSA has no responsibility for reviewing or verifying any documents in connection with Exempt Offers.
