paras.en: #### Forward Contract Liability
paras.zh: #### 远期合同负债

paras.en: The commitments made by the investors to purchase shares of the Company’s certain series of redeemable convertible preferred stock at a future date for a discounted fixed price of $14.66 per share represented forward contracts between the Company and the counterparties. The forward contracts were classified as a liability and remeasured to fair value at each reporting date, with changes in fair value recorded to other income (expense), net. In September 2024, an investor settled its forward contract by purchasing the underlying preferred shares, and that forward contract was remeasured at a fair value of $27.02 per share as of the settlement date. The forward contracts were considered to be a Level 3 liability in the fair value hierarchy due to certain unobservable inputs. The primary input in the valuation of the forward contract liability was the fair value of the Company’s underlying redeemable convertible preferred stock, which were determined in accordance with the applicable elements of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants guide, Valuation of Privately Held Company Equity Securities Issued as Compensation, and derived from a hybrid method that considered both an option pricing model (“OPM”) and the probability weighted expected return method (“PWERM”) to allocate the value among the Company’s classes of securities. The OPM was based on the Black-Scholes-Merton option pricing model, which allows for the identification for a range of possible future outcomes, each with an associated probability. The OPM is appropriate to use when the range of possible future outcomes is difficult to predict and thus creates highly speculative forecasts. PWERM involves a forward-looking analysis of the possible future outcomes of the enterprise including an initial public offering as well as non-initial public offering market-based outcomes. As of December 31, 2024, the fair value of the Company’s underlying redeemable convertible preferred stock was $30.56 per share. As the G42 Primary Purchase was not consummated by April 15, 2025, the forward contract was extinguished.
paras.zh: 投资者承诺在未来某一日期以每股 $14.66 的折价固定价格购买本公司若干系列可赎回可转换优先股的股份，该等承诺构成本公司与交易对手方之间的远期合同。该等远期合同被分类为负债，并于每个报告日按公允价值重新计量，公允价值变动计入其他收入（费用）净额。2024 年 9 月，一名投资者通过购买标的优先股结算了其远期合同，该远期合同于结算日按每股 $27.02 的公允价值重新计量。由于存在某些不可观察输入值，该等远期合同在公允价值层级中被视为第 3 层级负债。远期合同负债估值的主要输入值为本公司标的可赎回可转换优先股的公允价值，该公允价值依据美国注册会计师协会《作为薪酬发行的非上市公司权益证券估值》指南的适用要素确定，并源自一种混合方法，该方法同时考虑期权定价模型（“OPM”）和概率加权预期回报法（“PWERM”），以在本公司各类证券之间分配价值。OPM 基于 Black-Scholes-Merton 期权定价模型，该模型允许识别一系列可能的未来结果，每一结果均附有相应概率。当可能的未来结果范围难以预测、从而形成高度推测性的预测时，适合使用 OPM。PWERM 涉及对企业可能的未来结果进行前瞻性分析，包括首次公开发行以及非首次公开发行的基于市场的结果。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日，本公司标的可赎回可转换优先股的公允价值为每股 $30.56。由于 G42 首次购买未能在 2025 年 4 月 15 日前完成，该远期合同已消灭。

paras.en: #### Tender Offer
paras.zh: #### 要约收购

paras.en: In October 2025, the Company launched a tender offer to certain employees to purchase a maximum cash outlay of $100.0 million of up to an aggregate of 2,759,960 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock, including cancellation and settlement of shares of common stock underlying eligible options and repurchase of settled RSU shares from eligible sellers (the “Tender Offer”), at a purchase price of $36.23 per share.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月，公司向若干员工发起要约收购，拟以每股$36.23 的购买价格，购买最多现金支出$100.0 million、合计不超过 2,759,960 股公司 A 类普通股，包括注销和结算符合条件的期权所对应的普通股股份，以及从符合条件的卖方回购已结算的 RSU 股份（“要约收购”）。

paras.en: As part of the Tender Offer, the Company modified the liquidity event condition with respect to 185,387 RSUs for which the service-based vesting condition had been satisfied. The Company issued 96,848 shares, net of withholding taxes, upon vesting of the RSUs, and 69,584 shares were repurchased by the Company pursuant to the Tender Offer. Refer to Note 14 – Stock-Based Compensation for further discussion.
paras.zh: 作为要约收购的一部分，公司就 185,387 份已满足服务归属条件的 RSU 修改了流动性事件条件。公司在 RSU 归属时发行了 96,848 股（扣除预扣税后），并有 69,584 股由公司根据要约收购回购。进一步讨论参见附注 14——股权激励费用。

paras.en: In connection with the Tender Offer, the Company canceled and settled 1,567,013 shares underlying eligible stock options. Additionally, the Company repurchased 589,752 shares of common stock as part of the Tender Offer.
paras.zh: 就要约收购而言，公司注销并结算了 1,567,013 股符合条件的股票期权所对应的股份。此外，公司作为要约收购的一部分回购了 589,752 股普通股。

paras.en: The repurchased shares were recorded as treasury stock at cost and reflected as an addition to stockholders’ deficit.
paras.zh: 回购股份按成本记为库存股，并作为股东权益赤字的增加项反映。

paras.en: The Tender Offer was completed in December 2025 and resulted in a total cash outflow of $70.7 million. Of this amount, $49.3 million associated with settlement of eligible options was recorded as a reduction of additional paid-in capital and $21.4 million was recorded in treasury stock within stockholders’ deficit.
paras.zh: 要约收购于 2025 年 12 月完成，导致现金流出总额$70.7 million。其中，与结算符合条件的期权相关的$49.3 million 记为追加实收资本的减少，$21.4 million 记入股东权益赤字中的库存股。

paras.en: #### Stock Options
paras.zh: #### 股票期权

paras.en: Stock options represent the right to purchase shares of common stock on the date of exercise at a stated exercise price. The exercise price of a stock option generally must be at least equal to the fair market value of the common stock on the date of grant. Options generally vest over periods of four years or more and are exercisable over a period of time not to exceed 10 years from the grant date.
paras.zh: 股票期权代表在行权日以既定行权价购买普通股股份的权利。股票期权的行权价通常必须至少等于授予日普通股的公允市场价值。期权通常在四年或更长的期间内归属，并可在自授予日起不超过 10 年的期间内行权。

paras.en: The terms of the plan permit certain option holders to exercise options before their options are vested, subject to certain limitations. Upon early exercise, the awards become subject to a restricted stock agreement. The shares of restricted stock granted upon early exercise of the options are subject to the same vesting provisions in the original stock option awards. Shares issued as a result of early exercise that have not been vested are subject to repurchase by the Company upon termination of the option holder’s employment, at the price paid by the option holder. Such shares are not deemed to be issued for accounting purposes until they vest.
paras.zh: 该计划的条款允许某些期权持有人在期权归属前行权，但须遵守某些限制。提前行权后，奖励将受限制性股票协议约束。因期权提前行权而授予的限制性股票股份，适用原股票期权奖励中相同的归属条款。因提前行权而发行但尚未归属的股份，在期权持有人终止雇佣时，公司有权按期权持有人支付的价格回购。就会计目的而言，该等股份在归属前不视为已发行。

paras.en: The liability is reclassified into common stock and additional paid-in capital as the shares vest and the repurchase right lapses. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, 772,584 and 1,373,428 unvested shares, respectively, were held by employees. Accordingly, the Company recorded the unvested portion of the exercise proceeds of $5.2 million and $8.5 million as a liability from the early exercise in the accompanying consolidated balance sheets as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
paras.zh: 随着股份归属和回购权失效，该负债被重分类为普通股和额外实收资本。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，员工分别持有 772,584 股和 1,373,428 股未归属股份。因此，公司在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日的随附合并资产负债表中，分别将提前行权所得款项中未归属部分 5.2 百万美元和 8.5 百万美元记为负债。

paras.en: The fair value of each option award is determined on the date of grant using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model. The calculation of fair value includes several assumptions that require management’s judgment. Due to the absence of a public market for the Company’s common stock, the Company’s board of directors relies on the assistance of management and external valuation experts to estimate the fair value of its common stock for purposes of granting options and for determining stock-based compensation expense. A reasonable valuation method is used and considers several objective and subjective factors, including obtaining contemporaneous independent third-party valuations, actual and forecasted operating and financial results, market conditions and performance of comparable publicly traded companies, developments and milestones in the Company, the rights and preferences of redeemable convertible preferred stock and common stock, and transactions involving the Company’s stock. The fair value of the Company’s common stock was determined in accordance with applicable elements of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants guide, Valuation of Privately Held Company Equity Securities Issued as Compensation.

paras.en: #### RSUs
paras.zh: #### 限制性股票单位（RSU）

paras.en: RSUs represent a right to receive one share of common stock for each RSU that vests. The Company has granted RSUs that vest on satisfaction of both service-and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based vesting condition for these equity awards is generally satisfied by rendering continuous service through the applicable vesting period, which is generally four years. The liquidity-based vesting condition is satisfied upon the occurrence of an initial public offering, direct listing, or sale of our company, given prevailing market conditions. Unless otherwise determined by the Board of Directors at the time of grant, service-based vesting ceases on the date the participant no longer provides services to the Company. If both the service-based vesting condition and the liquidity-based vesting condition of an RSU are not satisfied, such RSU is forfeited. If an RSU has not been forfeited and both the service-and liquidity-based vesting conditions have been satisfied, then on the date specified in the RSUs, the Company delivers to the holder a number of whole shares of common stock subject to any withholdings to cover tax obligations. Dividend equivalents, if any, are not credited in respect of shares covered by the RSUs, except as otherwise permitted by the Compensation Committee. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company had 15,229,068 and 4,909,256 unvested RSUs, respectively.
paras.zh: 每份归属的限制性股票单位（RSU）代表获得一股普通股的权利。公司已授予的限制性股票单位（RSU）需同时满足服务条件和流动性条件后方可归属。该等股权激励的服务条件通常通过在适用归属期内持续提供服务而满足，归属期一般为四年。流动性条件在首次公开发行、直接上市或本公司出售发生时，视当时市场情况而定予以满足。除董事会于授予时另有决定外，服务条件在参与者不再向公司提供服务之日停止计算。若某限制性股票单位（RSU）的服务条件和流动性条件均未满足，则该限制性股票单位（RSU）将被没收。若某限制性股票单位（RSU）未被没收且服务条件和流动性条件均已满足，则公司于该限制性股票单位（RSU）规定的日期向持有人交付相应数量的完整普通股，并扣除用于缴纳税款的任何代扣份额。除薪酬委员会另有允许外，限制性股票单位（RSU）所涵盖的股份不享有股息等值。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日，公司分别有 15,229,068 份和 4,909,256 份未归属的限制性股票单位（RSU）。

paras.en: #### Modification of stock-based awards
paras.zh: #### 股权激励奖励的修改

paras.en: As part of the Tender Offer, the Company modified the liquidity-event condition with respect to 185,387 RSUs for which the service-based vesting condition had been satisfied. Specifically, the liquidity-event condition was waived, such that those RSUs became fully vested on December 2, 2025, and settled in shares of Class A Common Stock that were eligible to be sold in the Tender Offer. The Company accounted for the modification of the RSUs as a Type III modification. The incremental fair value was measured as of the modification date as the excess of the fair value of the modified awards over the fair value of the original awards immediately prior to modification. The Company recognized $6.7 million of incremental compensation cost during the year ended December 31, 2025. Because the service condition had been satisfied at the modification date, the incremental compensation cost was recognized immediately.
paras.zh: 作为要约收购的一部分，公司修改了 185,387 份 RSU 的流动性事件条件，这些 RSU 的服务期归属条件已获满足。具体而言，流动性事件条件被豁免，从而使该等 RSU 于 2025 年 12 月 2 日全部归属，并以 A 类普通股股份结算，该等股份有资格在要约收购中出售。公司将 RSU 的修改作为第三类修改进行会计处理。增量公允价值以修改日计量，即修改后奖励的公允价值超过修改前即刻原奖励公允价值的差额。公司在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度确认了 $6.7 million 的增量补偿成本。由于服务条件在修改日已获满足，增量补偿成本被立即确认。

The realization of deferred tax assets is dependent upon the generation of sufficient taxable income of the appropriate character in future periods. The Company regularly assesses the ability to realize its deferred tax assets and establishes a valuation allowance if it is more-likely-than-not that some portion of the deferred tax assets will not be realized. The Company weighs all available positive and negative evidence, including its earnings history and results of recent operations, scheduled reversals of deferred tax liabilities, projected future taxable income, and tax planning strategies. Due to the weight of objectively verifiable negative evidence, including its history of losses in the United States, the Company believes that it is more likely than not that its U.S. federal and state deferred tax assets will not be realized. Accordingly, the Company has recorded a valuation allowance on such deferred tax assets. The valuation allowance against our various deferred tax assets increased by $32.6 million and $16.0 million during the years ended December 31, 2025, and 2024, respectively.
paras.zh: 递延所得税资产的实现取决于未来期间产生足够金额且性质适当的应纳税所得额。公司定期评估其递延所得税资产的可实现性，如果递延所得税资产的某些部分很可能无法实现，则计提估值备抵。公司权衡所有可获得的正面和负面证据，包括其盈利历史和近期经营业绩、递延所得税负债的预定转回、预计未来应纳税所得额以及税务筹划策略。由于客观上可验证的负面证据所占权重较大，包括其在美国的亏损历史，公司认为其美国联邦和州递延所得税资产很可能无法实现。因此，公司已就该等递延所得税资产计提估值备抵。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日和 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度，公司各项递延所得税资产的估值备抵分别增加了 $32.6 million 和 $16.0 million。

The Company will recognize operating lease right-of-use assets and corresponding lease liabilities at the commencement date based on the present value of lease payments over the respective lease terms. Aggregate undiscounted future minimum lease payments under these agreements total approximately $344.3 million over the lease term.
paras.zh: 2025 年末，公司就额外数据中心容量签署了不可撤销的租赁协议，租赁开始日期为 2026 年。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，该等租赁尚未开始，因此未反映在合并资产负债表内。公司将在租赁开始日，根据各租赁期内租赁付款额的现值，确认经营租赁使用权资产及相应租赁负债。该等协议项下未折现的未来最低租赁付款额合计在租赁期内约为$344.3 million。

full.secZh: 附注 17 – 承诺及或有事项

paras.en: The Company has entered into certain contracts to receive consulting and other services that represent unconditional purchase obligations to purchase goods or services that are enforceable and legally binding. Purchase commitments exclude agreements that are cancellable without penalty and unconditional purchase commitments with a remaining term of one year or less. As of December 31, 2025, future payments related to non-cancelable commitments under these contracts are due as follows: $4.1 million (2026), and $3.0 million (2027).
paras.zh: 本公司已签订若干合同，以获取咨询及其他服务，这些合同构成无条件购买商品或服务的购买义务，具有可强制执行性和法律约束力。购买承诺不包括可无罚金取消的协议以及剩余期限为一年或一年以下的无条件购买承诺。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，这些合同项下不可取消承诺的未来付款到期情况如下：$4.1 million（2026 年）和 $3.0 million（2027 年）。

paras.en: In the ordinary course of business, the Company may be subject from time to time to various proceedings, lawsuits, disputes, or claims. Although the Company cannot predict with assurance the outcome of any litigation, it does not believe there are currently any such actions that, if resolved unfavorably, would have a material impact on the Company’s financial condition, results of operations, or cash flows.
paras.zh: 在日常经营过程中，本公司可能不时面临各种程序、诉讼、争议或索赔。尽管本公司无法有把握地预测任何诉讼的结果，但本公司认为，目前不存在任何此类诉讼，若其以不利方式解决，会对本公司的财务状况、经营成果或现金流量产生重大影响。

paras.en: The Company has evaluated all transactions through March 31, 2026, the date these consolidated financial statements were available to be issued, and has determined that there are no other events that would require disclosure in or adjustment to these financial statements except as discussed below.
paras.zh: 公司已评估了截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日（即该等合并财务报表可供发布之日）的所有交易，并确定除下文所述者外，不存在其他需要在财务报表中披露或调整的事项。

paras.en: #### Series H Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
paras.zh: #### H 轮可赎回可转换优先股

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company entered into a Series H redeemable convertible preferred stock purchase agreement with various investors to issue up to 11,394,059 shares of the Company’s Series H redeemable convertible preferred stock. The Company raised $1.0 billion, net of issuance costs, through issuance of 11,394,059 shares of Series H redeemable convertible preferred stock at a price of $89.02 per share. The Company intends to use the proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司与多名投资者签订了 H 轮可赎回可转换优先股购买协议，拟发行最多 11,394,059 股公司 H 轮可赎回可转换优先股。公司以每股 $89.02 的价格发行 11,394,059 股 H 轮可赎回可转换优先股，扣除发行费用后募集资金 $1.0 billion。公司拟将募集资金用于营运资金及一般公司用途。

paras.en: #### Working Capital Loan
paras.zh: #### 营运资金贷款

paras.en: In January 2026, the Company received in cash the $1.0 billion Working Capital Loan funded by OpenAI to support the build-out of infrastructure and related capabilities required to deliver such services under the MRA. The Working Capital Loan is subject to a secured promissory note and bears interest at 6% (unless waived) with a maturity date of no later than December 31, 2032. Refer to Note 5 – Revenue for further discussion of the MRA with OpenAI.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月，公司以现金形式收到由 OpenAI 提供的 $1.0 billion 营运资金贷款，用于支持建设根据 MRA 提供此类服务所需的基础设施及相关能力。该营运资金贷款以有担保本票为凭证，按 6% 计息（除非被豁免），到期日不晚于 2032 年 12 月 31 日。有关与 OpenAI 签订的 MRA 的进一步讨论，参见附注 5——收入。

paras.en: #### Executive Grants
paras.zh: #### 高管授予

paras.en: In February 2026, the Company’s board of directors approved equity awards to its co-founder executives, the Chief Executive Officer (“CEO”) and the Chief Technology Officer (“CTO”), consisting of RSUs and performance-based restricted stock units (“PRSUs”).
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月，公司董事会批准向其联合创始人高管，即首席执行官（“CEO”）和首席技术官（“CTO”），授予股权奖励，包括 RSU 和基于业绩的限制性股票单位（“PRSU”）。

paras.en: The Company granted 743,902 RSUs to the CEO and 495,426 RSUs to the CTO. These RSUs vest subject to both service-based and liquidity-based vesting conditions. The service-based condition is satisfied ratably on a monthly basis beginning January 5, 2026 over periods of 48 to 60 months, subject to continued qualifying service. The liquidity-based vesting condition is expected to be satisfied upon the completion of the Company’s initial public offering, subject to continued qualifying service through such date. The Company will begin recognizing stock-based compensation expense for these awards when it is probable that the liquidity condition will be satisfied, using the accelerated attribution method over the requisite service period.
paras.zh: 公司向 CEO 授予 743,902 份 RSU，向 CTO 授予 495,426 份 RSU。该等 RSU 须同时满足服务条件和流动性条件方可归属。服务条件自 2026 年 1 月 5 日起，在 48 至 60 个月的期间内按月等额满足，且须持续提供合格服务。流动性归属条件预计将在公司首次公开发行完成时满足，且须持续提供合格服务至该日。公司将在流动性条件很可能得到满足时开始确认该等奖励的股权激励费用，并在必要服务期内采用加速归属法进行确认。

paras.en: The Company also granted 5,700,000 PRSUs to the CEO and 3,300,000 PRSUs to the CTO. Each PRSU represents the right to receive one share of Class B common stock upon vesting. The PRSUs vest in three equal tranches based on the achievement of market capitalization thresholds of $75 billion, $150 billion and $250 billion, respectively. Vesting may occur beginning six months following the completion of the Company’s initial public offering, subject to continued qualifying service through the applicable vesting date. Market capitalization is determined based on the 90-trading-day trailing average of the Company’s Class A common stock price multiplied by the number of outstanding shares of Class A common stock. Unvested PRSUs are forfeited upon termination of qualifying service, and any PRSUs that remain unvested as of the ninth anniversary of the completion of the Company’s initial public offering will be forfeited. In the event of a change in control, achievement of the market capitalization thresholds is determined based on the transaction price, with linear interpolation applied, as applicable.
paras.zh: 公司还向首席执行官授予了 5,700,000 份 PRSU，向首席技术官授予了 3,300,000 份 PRSU。每份 PRSU 代表在归属时获得一股 B 类普通股的权利。PRSU 分三等份归属，分别基于达到 $75 billion、$150 billion 和 $250 billion 的市值门槛。归属可在公司首次公开发行完成后六个月起开始，前提是截至适用归属日期持续提供合格服务。市值根据公司 A 类普通股股价的 90 个交易日滚动平均值乘以已发行 A 类普通股股数确定。未归属的 PRSU 在合格服务终止时被没收，截至公司首次公开发行完成九周年之日仍未归属的任何 PRSU 将被没收。在发生控制权变更的情况下，市值门槛的达成情况根据交易价格确定，并视情况适用线性插值。

paras.en: The Company is in the process of determining the grant-date fair value of these awards. The grant-date fair value of the PRSUs will reflect the effect of the market capitalization conditions. Stock-based compensation expense for the PRSUs will be recognized over the derived service period for each tranche, and only when the liquidity condition has been met.
paras.zh: 公司正在确定这些奖励的授予日公允价值。PRSU 的授予日公允价值将反映市值条件的影响。PRSU 的股权激励费用将在各批次的推导服务期内确认，且仅在流动性条件满足时确认。

full.sec: Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements

paras.en: #### Leases

In March 2026, the Company entered into a data center lease agreement in Canada that is expected to commence in 2026. The expected minimum lease payments are approximately $2.2 billion over a 10-year term. Concurrent with the lease, the Company entered into a stock purchase agreement with the lessor pursuant to which the lessor purchased 168,509 shares of the Company’s Class N common stock at a purchase price of $89.02 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of $15.0 million.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，本公司在加拿大签订了一份数据中心租赁协议，预计于 2026 年开始生效。预计最低租赁付款额在 10 年期限内约为 $2.2 billion。与租赁同时，本公司与出租人签订了股票购买协议，据此出租人以每股 $89.02 的购买价格购买了本公司 168,509 股 N 类普通股，总购买价格为 $15.0 million。

paras.en: #### Amazon Web Services Collaboration Agreement
paras.zh: #### Amazon Web Services 合作协议

paras.en: In March 2026, the Company entered into a term sheet with Amazon Web Services, Inc. for a multi-year strategic collaboration to deploy AI inference compute infrastructure and related services. The arrangement contemplates an initial deployment under multi-year lease arrangements, with associated recurring payments, subject to the achievement of specified technical milestones and potential expansion through additional system deployments, capacity allocations and hardware purchase options. In addition, the term sheet provides for a commitment to issue a warrant to purchase up to a maximum of 2,696,678 shares of the Company’s Class N common stock with an exercise price of $100.00 per share and a term of seven years. The warrant is expected to vest based on a combination of time-and performance-based conditions.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，本公司与 Amazon Web Services, Inc. 签订了一份条款清单，拟开展多年期战略合作，以部署 AI 推理算力基础设施及相关服务。该安排拟通过多年期租赁安排进行初始部署，并产生相关经常性付款，但须实现特定技术里程碑，并可能通过额外系统部署、容量分配和硬件购买选择权进行扩展。此外，该条款清单规定了一项承诺，即发行一份认股权证，最多可购买本公司 2,696,678 股 N 类普通股，行权价格为每股 $100.00，期限为七年。该认股权证预计将基于时间条件和业绩条件的组合而归属。

paras.en: The term sheet includes certain provisions intended to be binding, including those related to pricing, exclusivity, hardware procurement, and the warrant commitment. The completion of the contemplated transactions remains subject to the execution of definitive agreements and the satisfaction of customary conditions.
paras.zh: 该条款清单包含某些拟具有约束力的条款，包括与定价、排他性、硬件采购和认股权证承诺相关的条款。拟议交易的完成仍须以签署最终协议和满足惯例条件为前提。
